<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从真实视频中识别是哪只狗在叫仍具挑战且少有研究；该能力可支撑长期行为分析、兽医监测与动物福利监测（把发声与行为归属到正确个体）。真实场景难点在于多犬同时吠叫、遮挡、进出画面。

Method: 构建多模态犬类指纹框架：视觉识别 + 多目标跟踪 + 犬吠声纹三部分结合；将吠叫事件与跟踪到的狗在时间上同步，并用视觉外观与声学特征持续更新个体档案，从而在遮挡、发声重叠、画面外吠叫情况下仍能完成识别。同时构建含46段真实视频、213个人工标注吠叫事件的基准。

Result: 在可见事件中，以IoU≥0.30判定，正确框定当前发声的可见犬只比例为61.83%；可见吠叫与画面外吠叫的检测F1达91.33%。

Conclusion: 多模态融合（视觉+声学）相较单模态独立研究更适合真实场景下的个体级犬吠归因，验证了跨模态档案关联与持续更新的有效性；但可见事件定位精度（61.83%）仍为后续改进空间。

Abstract: Identifying individual dogs from barks in real-world videos remains challenging and largely unexplored. Solving this problem would enable long-term behavioral analysis, veterinary monitoring, and animal welfare monitoring by attributing vocalizations and behaviors to the correct individual. Real-world videos are challenging because multiple dogs may bark simultaneously, become occluded, or move in and out of view. Prior studies show that canine vocalizations and visual appearance contain discriminative identity information, but these modalities have largely been studied independently. We present a multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework combining visual identification, multiple-object tracking, and canine vocal fingerprinting to associate bark events with individual dogs while maintaining persistent profiles. The framework synchronizes bark events with tracked dogs and updates profiles using visual appearance and vocal characteristics, enabling identification despite occlusion, overlapping vocalizations, and off-screen barking. We also introduce a benchmark of 46 real-world videos containing 213 manually annotated bark events. Our framework correctly localizes the active visible dog in 61.83% of visible events at IoU $\geq 0.30$ and achieves a 91.33% F1 score for visible versus off-screen barking detection.

</details>


### [19] [RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21086)
*Liangjing Shao,Wanhao Liu,Zhiwei Fang,Rulin Zhou,Quanlu Zhang,Changjing Liu,Beilei Cui,Yiming Huang,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoPE-Flow，一种基于flow matching的端到端单目相机到机器人位姿估计框架，通过关键点中心特征提取、图引导条件生成及定制损失函数，在多类机器人与多相机设定下超越现有方法，并在新建跨场景基准上验证零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目图像恢复机器人3D位姿对视觉导航与控制意义重大，但从2D观测恢复3D结构特征仍是难题。现有方法或依赖耗时的迭代渲染，或采用复杂2D-3D配准，导致投影歧义、远端关节误差累积以及不同关节学习不均衡。

Method: 端到端flow matching框架：由预测的2D热图出发，设计Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor从关键点中心多尺度patch提取位置特征与上下文表示；引入Graph-guided Condition Generator，借助可学习邻接图编码关键点间相关性以生成flow matching条件；并提出Bone Length Loss与Ray-Depth Loss分别保证拓扑一致性与尺度稳定性，辅以逐关节加权缓解不同关节预测难度差异。

Result: 在不同类型机器人与多相机配置下，位姿估计性能优于现有最先进方法；并构建了新的跨场景基准，在零样本跨场景机器人位姿估计上表现突出。

Conclusion: RoPE-Flow通过flow matching结合图引导条件与几何/拓扑一致性约束，有效缓解投影歧义、误差累积与关节不均衡问题，并展现出良好的跨场景零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app

</details>


### [20] [RoboCloth: A Large-Scale Real Cloth Material Dataset for Neural Reflectance Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21090)
*Zhen Li,Haoran Qin,Francesco Di Sario,Daniel Rebain,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoboCloth数据集：500种真实布料材质，在机器人控制的标定相机-光照配置下采集，每材质约580张HDR帧覆盖大范围视角-光照半球；配套两阶段神经重建流程验证数据价值，泛化优于现有实测反射率数据集训练的decoder及解析PBR拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实测反射率数据集在采集配置上不够灵活、视角-光照覆盖有限，缺乏面向布料材质的、可支撑神经材质训练的高质量数据，故构建机器人化可标定采集的布料数据集并验证其训练价值。

Method: 用机器人同时控制相机与光源，在灵活可标定的配置下采集500种真实布料，每材质约580张HDR帧覆盖广域视角-光照半球；通过SfM精化相机位姿并对齐机器人坐标系，得到每材质稀疏表面几何与结构化逐点反射观测。重建采用两阶段流程：阶段1在语料上训练共享MLP decoder学习布料材质先验；阶段2冻结decoder，为每个目标材质拟合2048×2048稠密潜纹理。

Result: 在自数据集留出材质与独立UBO2014基准上评估：本数据集训练的decoder优于基于现有实测反射率数据集训练的decoder，也优于解析PBR拟合，并可无修改迁移到未见过的采集系统。

Conclusion: 机器人化标定采集能提供覆盖充分、结构化可用的布料反射数据，支撑有效的材质先验学习与跨系统泛化；数据集、标定文件、观测张量与训练/测试划分以CC BY 4.0发布于Hugging Face Hub。

Abstract: We present RoboCloth, a dataset of 500 real cloth materials captured under flexible, calibrated camera and lighting configurations, where both are robotically controlled during acquisition. Each material is imaged in approximately 580 high-dynamic range frames spanning a wide view-light hemisphere; camera poses are refined via structure-from-motion and aligned to the robot frame, yielding per-material sparse surface geometry and structured per-point reflectance observations ready for neural material training. We demonstrate the value of this data through a two-stage neural reconstruction pipeline: Stage 1 trains a shared MLP decoder on our corpus to learn cloth material priors; Stage 2 then freezes the decoder and fits a dense 2048x2048 latent texture to each target material. Evaluating on held-out materials from our own dataset and on the independent UBO2014 benchmark, we show that a decoder trained on our captures outperforms decoders trained on existing measured reflectance datasets and analytic PBR fitting, transferring to unseen acquisition systems without modification. The dataset, calibration files, observation tensors, and train/test splits are released under CC BY 4.0 on the Hugging Face Hub.

</details>


### [21] [Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21095)
*Yue Su,Bokai Lin,Xinkai Wang,Chubin Zhang,Xiangnan Wu,Kuan Zhang,Weiyang Jin,Jiwen Yu,Yiming Li,Cewu Lu,Lixin Yang,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OneWM统一因果训练框架，将动作同时作为世界预测的条件与策略学习的目标，验证世界建模与动作生成之间的互惠增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界建模与动作建模密切相关，但在统一因果训练下二者的相互收益尚不明确，作者希望系统性探究：以指定动作为条件学习前向动力学能否提升动作学习，以及学习生成动作能否反过来改善动作条件下的世界建模。

Method: OneWM采用简单的统一因果训练框架，在共享的视频-动作架构中，将动作既作为世界预测的条件，又作为策略学习的目标；在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365等具身测试平台上评估策略学习与世界建模，并辅以真实世界策略实验。

Result: 学习指定动作的视觉后果可提升策略性能及在场景变化下的泛化能力；反过来，动作学习在同一架构下提升了多视角世界预测的保真度。两个问题的答案均为肯定。

Conclusion: 在统一因果训练下，世界建模与动作生成之间存在互惠增益，二者可相互促进。

Abstract: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

</details>


### [22] [Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21129)
*Yun Dai,Yuyun Chen,Jiarui Wen,Huiping Zhuang,Cen Chen,Ziqian Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的GSRS框架，通过"逐步增长的稀疏比例"和"复用早期搜索结果的缩减搜索空间"加速扩散Transformer视频生成，在HunyuanVideo与Wan 2.1上实现1.55×–2.21×加速且质量接近全注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT视频生成受自注意力二次复杂度制约，推理成本高；现有稀疏注意力方法在去噪全程固定稀疏比例，且难以准确判定应跳过哪些计算，导致效率与质量均不理想。

Method: 先以注意力熵与平均注意力距离分析注意力动态，发现注意力随去噪步逐渐集中、早期选中的块在后续步仍占大部分注意力权重。据此设计GSRS：早期保留更多计算并逐步降低；采用Top-p进行自适应稀疏控制；后续搜索限制在早期候选集内以降低搜索开销；并借助FlashAttention内部精确计算注意力权重的高效评估方案实现低开销。整体为training-free。

Result: 在HunyuanVideo与Wan 2.1上取得1.55×–2.21×推理加速，生成质量与全注意力相当。

Conclusion: 注意力在去噪过程中的集中趋势与早期选择的持久性可转化为两种加速机会，GSRS以无需训练的方式同时利用二者，实现高效且高保真的视频生成。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.

</details>


### [23] [Trajectory Prediction Method for person under WSN with Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21132)
*Wenqian Jiang,Qifeng Sun,Xiaosong Gao,Xin Zou,Xingrui Ni,Yuan Hu,Yongming Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分层包络对抗域适应松紧耦合模型（HEADA-LTCTPM），通过包络样本构建与局部/全局对抗域适应，缓解社交耦合单一与域偏移处理不足问题，ADE/FDE分别降低17.6%和19.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测模型存在两点局限：一是仅考虑单一类型的社交耦合，导致交互冗余，且无法刻画不同场景、不同行人之间耦合性质的差异，难以适配多样场景；二是域偏移处理不足，少有的方法依赖基于统计准则的域分布对齐，过度依赖预定义统计度量，在复杂动态环境中受限。

Method: 提出HEADA-LTCTPM模型：1）包络样本构建机制，构造包络样本并将其扩展为图结构；2）对抗域适应模块，融合局部与全局域适应策略，动态适配跨场景的多样耦合关系。

Result: 在两个代表性公开数据集上与六个相关基线算法进行对比验证，模型精度显著优于现有方法，ADE和FDE指标分别降低17.6%和19.1%，时间开销满足实际需求。

Conclusion: 包络样本构建与分层对抗域适应两项关键创新有效提升了轨迹预测的精度与鲁棒性，并兼顾了实际应用的时间效率。

Abstract: Pedestrian trajectory prediction holds significant applications across autonomous driving, intelligent surveillance, and smart cities. However, the complexity and unpredictability of pedestrian interactions make this task a persistent challenge. Current models face two common limitations: 1) Consider only a single type of social coupling. This introduces redundant interactions. More critically, it fails to account for the varying nature of trajectory coupled across different scenarios and between different pedestrians. Consequently, models cannot deeply adapt to diverse scenes. 2) Inadequate domain shift handling. Although very few methods address domain shift, they rely on statistical criterion-based domain distribution alignment. Such approaches exhibit strong dependency on predefined statistical metrics. This leads to significant limitations in complex and dynamic environments. To address these problems, a Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation with Loosely-Tightly coupled model (HEADA-LTCTPM) is proposed. First, an envelope sample construction mechanism was proposed. It constructs envelope samples and extends them into graph structures. Secondly, an adversarial domain adaptation module was proposed. This integrates both local and global domain adaptation strategies. It dynamically adapts to diverse coupled relationships across scenarios. These innovations collectively enhance prediction accuracy and robustness. In the experimental section, two representative public datasets were employed for validation and comprehensive comparisons with six relevant baseline algorithms were conducted. Results demonstrate that our model achieves significantly higher accuracy compared to existing methods, with the ADE and FDE metrics reduced by 17.6% and 19.1% respectively. The time overhead meets practical requirements, which verifies the effectiveness of our key innovations.

</details>


### [24] [VisualTrust: Video Reasoning under On-Screen Claim Framing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21159)
*Huachao Zhu,Junjielong Xu,Sicheng Li,Liang Yang,Mingtao Chen,Zhichao Hu,Li Jiang,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视觉可信度基准 VisualTrust 与免训练方法 DEAR，揭示多模态大模型存在"诉求顺从"（claim deference）现象——即让屏幕文本主张压过冲突的视觉证据，并显著降低这种失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 屏幕文字既可能描述视频内容，也可能框定视频含义。现有基准将两者混为一谈，只考察模型"能不能读懂文本"，而非"应不应该相信文本"，因而无法衡量模型在文本与视觉证据冲突时的可信判断能力。

Method: 构建反事实基准 VisualTrust：5,063 个案例、14 类"主张-事实"类，每例同一问题配三版视频（无主张／准确主张／篡改单一有据事实的误导主张），误导主张对应选项即"陷阱答案"。并提出免训练智能体 DEAR（解耦证据仲裁与阅读）：独立检查器报告冲突证据，选择器在不设固定模态优先级下权衡并遮蔽其保留的信息，阅读器在全新上下文中仅基于所得视频作答。

Result: 7 个开源权重模型与 4 个闭源模型平均准确率从无主张时的 90.1% 降至误导主张下的 51.9%；初始正确的回答中 42.8% 翻转为陷阱答案，仅 0.6% 变为其他错误，说明强无主张准确率不能保证抗干扰。DEAR 在 500 个视频、3 个闭源模型上，将误导主张下准确率由 47.2–64.0% 提升至 81.8–85.2%，陷阱答案选择率由 34.4–50.8% 降至 11.6–15.0%，同时保持无主张准确率。

Conclusion: 论文明确了"诉求顺从"这一被现有基准忽视的失效模式，提供可诊断的评测工具并给出有效的解耦式缓解方案，表明证据仲裁与文本阅读分离是提升多模态模型可信度的关键。

Abstract: On-screen text can describe what a video shows, or it can frame what the video is supposed to mean. Current benchmarks treat both alike, testing whether a model can read the text rather than whether it should trust it. We study claim deference, multimodal large language models' tendency to let an on-screen claim override conflicting visual evidence. We introduce VisualTrust, a counterfactual benchmark with 5,063 cases across 14 claim-fact classes. Each case pairs a question with three versions of the same video: one with no claim, one with an accurate claim, and one with a misleading claim that alters a single grounded fact. The option the misleading claim supports is the trap answer. Across seven open-weight and four proprietary models, mean accuracy falls from 90.1% without a claim to 51.9% with a misleading claim. Among initially correct responses, 42.8% flip to the trap answer and only 0.6% become other errors. Strong no-claim accuracy does not ensure resistance. We also introduce DEAR (Decoupled Evidence Arbitration and Reading), a training-free agent for video question answering that separates evidence arbitration from reading. An independent check reports conflicting evidence, a selector weighs it without a fixed modality priority and blinds what it withholds, and the reader answers from the resulting video in a fresh context. On 500 videos across three proprietary models, DEAR raises accuracy under misleading claims from 47.2--64.0% to 81.8--85.2% and reduces trap-answer selection from 34.4--50.8% to 11.6--15.0%, while preserving no-claim accuracy.

</details>


### [25] [ControlFlow3D: Distilling Multi-View Knowledge into Latent Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21190)
*Yuang Liu,Zhi Zuo,Zhengkai Zhao,Lirui Zhang,Pan Gao,Hao Feng,Zhengzhe Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ControlFlow3D，在训练阶段从预训练基础模型蒸馏多视图视觉知识到轻量点云上采样网络，测试阶段无需多视图图像；通过共享原型的流匹配速度控制与一致性对齐，并用 Mamba 解码器实现线性复杂度稠密坐标生成，同时构建 35K 规模的 ShapeNetPU 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点云上采样因观测稀疏、欠约束而病态；多视图图像可缓解几何歧义，但现有多模态方法未充分利用视觉线索，且测试时依赖多视图输入带来部署负担。

Method: 在冻结 3D 编码器定义的结构化隐空间中做条件流匹配；将多视图图像 token 与 3D 隐 token 通过无监督软 KMeans 联合聚类为共享原型，原型以速度控制引导流轨迹，并用一致性损失渐进迁移图像知识至基础网络；Mamba 几何解码器将隐特征映射为稠密坐标，线性复杂度。

Result: 构建 ShapeNetPU 多模态基准（35K 物体，较先前数据集大 31 倍）；在多个基准上验证了方法有效性与强泛化能力，且推理阶段无需多视图图像。

Conclusion: 多视图知识可在训练期以原型对齐方式蒸馏进单模态上采样网络，兼顾几何精度与轻量推理；大规模多模态基准有助于该方向的系统评测。

Abstract: Point cloud upsampling is essential for 3D applications but remains challenging due to sparse, under-constrained observations. Multi-view images can resolve geometric ambiguity, but existing multi-modal methods do not fully exploit visual cues. We propose ControlFlow3D, a framework that distills knowledge from pretrained foundation models into a lightweight generation network during training, enabling strong performance without multi-view images available at test time. Specifically, our method performs conditional flow matching in a structured latent space defined by a frozen 3D encoder. Multi-view image tokens and 3D latent tokens are jointly clustered into shared prototypes via unsupervised soft KMeans; the resulting prototypes guide the flow trajectory through velocity control and are aligned by a consistency loss that progressively transfers image knowledge into the base network. A Mamba-based geometry decoder then maps latent features to dense coordinates with linear complexity. We also construct ShapeNetPU, a 35K-object multi-modal benchmark that is 31 times larger than prior datasets. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its strong generalization capability.

</details>


### [26] [UltraDiff: Transferring High-Fidelity Priors to Compressed Latent Spaces for High-Resolution Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21202)
*Jingjing Ren,Haitian Zheng,Haoyu Chen,Connelly Barnes,Zhifei Zhang,Yuqian Zhou,Zhe Lin,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraDiff将高分辨率生成的"压缩率-保真度"权衡重构为"联合潜扩散学习+边缘分数蒸馏":用双分支DiT(MixTeacher)建模f8-f32联合分布,并在原生f32空间做向量场蒸馏,以f32效率逼近f8质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜扩散模型(LDM)的计算开销与生成保真度主要由潜压缩因子f决定:激进压缩(f32)效率高但信息损失与歧义严重,标准f8保真度高但代价大。如何在保留f32效率的同时消除压缩空间歧义,是核心问题。

Method: 提出UltraDiff框架:(1)将问题转化为联合潜扩散学习+边缘(marginal)分数蒸馏;(2)MixTeacher——双分支DiT建模f8与f32的联合分布,通过共享注意力以f8高保真先验消解f32压缩空间的歧义;(3)在原生f32空间进行向量场蒸馏(vector field distillation)。理论上,该蒸馏促使学生模型学习教师轨迹的条件期望,从而过滤压缩伪影。

Result: 在1K至4K评估设置中,UltraDiff质量接近f8水平,同时保持f32效率。单张A100、20步采样下,6.2秒生成2K图像,较f8基线快40倍以上。

Conclusion: 通过联合潜扩散与原生f32向量场蒸馏,UltraDiff解耦了压缩率与保真度的强绑定,为高效高分辨率合成提供了可行范式;共享注意力引导与条件期望式蒸馏是消解压缩歧义的关键机制。

Abstract: High-resolution synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) faces a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and generative fidelity. This trade off is largely governed by the latent compression factor f (e.g. f8 denotes f=8 and f32 f=32). While aggressive compression (f32) significantly improves efficiency, it suffers from severe information loss and ambiguity compared to standard f8 models. We propose UltraDiff, a framework that reformulates this challenge as joint latent diffusion learning followed by marginal score distillation. We introduce MixTeacher, a dual branch DiT that models the joint f8-f32 distribution, utilizing shared attention to resolve the ambiguity of the compressed space with high fidelity f8 priors. Crucially, we propose vector field distillation in the native f32 space. Theoretically, this compels the student to learn the conditional expectation of the teacher trajectory, effectively filtering out compression artifacts. Across the evaluated 1K to 4K settings, UltraDiff approaches f8 level quality while preserving f32 efficiency. With 20 sampling steps on a single A100 GPU, it generates a 2K image in 6.2 seconds over 40 times faster than our f8 baseline.

</details>


### [27] [SpaceCache: Intermediate Feature Reuse for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on Point Cloud Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21207)
*Dongheon Yang,Beomseok Kang,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpaceCache 是一种免训练的特征缓存方法，利用点云连续帧间深度特征语义一致性，跳过重复区域的 transformer 块计算，以加速点云流分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有点云分割网络对每帧从头计算，但连续帧高度重叠，存在大量冗余计算；同时观察到 transformer 中间特征在深度阶段对同一空间区域跨帧保持语义一致，具备复用潜力。

Method: 免训练特征缓存：已观测区域 token 跳过若干 transformer 块并直接取用缓存特征，仅计算剩余 token，再恢复完整 token 布局用于稠密预测；采用轻量缓存管理（限制条目年龄、淘汰低置信度条目）保证可靠性；按编码器阶段执行一次缓存操作，token 选择开销极小。

Result: 在 nuScenes、Waymo、ScanNet 等室内外基准，搭配 Utonia 与 LitePT-B 两种 transformer 骨干，取得最高 1.65x 加速，mIoU 下降不足 1 点，且持续优于 token merging 方法。

Conclusion: 跨帧特征复用可在免训练条件下显著加速点云流分割，并以极小精度损失优于 token 合并类方法。

Abstract: Point-cloud streams are central to autonomous driving and robotics, yet existing segmentation networks process every frame from scratch, although consecutive frames largely overlap. We observe that the intermediate features of point-cloud transformers remain semantically consistent across frames for the same spatial region, especially in deep stages. Building on this, we present SpaceCache, a training-free feature cache that reuses these features across frames. Tokens of previously observed regions skip a sequence of transformer blocks and take their cached features, only the remaining tokens are computed, and the full token layout is restored for dense prediction. Lightweight cache management keeps reused features reliable by limiting each entry's age and evicting low-confidence entries. Unlike token merging, SpaceCache selects tokens at negligible cost and runs its cache operations once per encoder stage. On both outdoor and indoor benchmarks, such as nuScenes, Waymo, and ScanNet, with two transformer backbones of Utonia and LitePT-B, SpaceCache achieves up to 1.65x speedup with less than 1-point mIoU drop and consistently outperforms token-merging methods.

</details>


### [28] [DLOSAC: Joint Spatial-Geometric Image Estimation via Delaunay-Guided Local Optimization RANSAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21215)
*Yu Liu,Meiqi Zhou,Zipei Fan,Guanyuan Feng,Xuan Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DLOSAC局部优化框架，基于Delaunay三角剖分联合建模几何一致性与空间分布，实现几何估计的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RANSAC类方法以残差为中心，即使试图约束空间均匀性，也因串行两阶段结构将分布优化与几何精化解耦，难以取得有效折中。

Method: 在候选内点上构建Delaunay三角剖分显式编码邻域拓扑；几何模块引入边一致性度量评估几何误差；空间模块由三角形面积与边属性导出分布描述子量化内点聚集程度；最终联合边级几何约束、空间分布正则与点级几何约束优化参数。

Result: 在六个公开真实数据集、覆盖三类几何估计任务上取得state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 以拓扑结构为纽带将空间分布与几何一致性统一到单一优化框架，可有效替代串行两阶段范式，提升噪声匹配下的几何估计鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reliable image geometric estimation from noisy matching points is typically addressed using RANSAC, often combined with local optimization to refine inliers and model parameters. However, existing paradigms are predominantly residual-centric; even heuristic attempts to enforce spatial uniformity suffer from a sequential, two-stage nature that inherently decouples distribution optimization from geometric refinement, preventing an effective trade-off. In this paper, we propose DLOSAC, a local optimization framework that jointly incorporates both geometric consistency and spatial distribution information. We begin by constructing a Delaunay triangulation over candidate inliers to explicitly encode neighborhood topology. The geometric module introduces an edge-based consistency metric to evaluate geometric errors, while the spatial module derives distribution descriptors from triangle areas and edge attributes to quantify the clustering of inliers. Finally, we combine edge-based geometric constraints, spatial distribution regularization, and traditional point-level geometric constraints to improve the quality of geometric parameters. Extensive experiments on six publicly available real-world datasets, covering three types of geometric estimation tasks, achieve state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [29] [A large-scale climate-aware satellite image dataset for domain adaptive land-cover semantic segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21238)
*Songlin Liu,Linwei Chen,Li Zhang,Jun Hu,Ying Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个气候感知的卫星图像数据集CASID，用于域自适应地表覆盖语义分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地表覆盖语义分割数据集忽视了不同气候区域间地理景观的显著差异，导致遥感图像存在域间差异（domain gap），分割模型泛化性能严重下降。

Method: 构建CASID数据集：980幅5000×5000像素卫星图像，采自亚洲30个区域，覆盖超24,500平方公里，分属温带季风、亚热带季风、热带季风、热带雨林四个气候带，形成四个子域；并从全局图像特征、纹理、类别分布、光谱值、目标形状等方面对四个气候区样本进行对比分析；在CASID上评测最新语义分割与无监督域自适应方法。

Result: CASID为首个多域气候感知地表覆盖语义分割数据集；气候差异导致显著的域间差异；所评测方法结果构成稳健基线。

Conclusion: 气候因素是地表覆盖分割泛化的重要影响因素，CASID为气候感知的域自适应研究提供数据基础与基线，数据集将公开。

Abstract: A few well-annotated datasets for land-cover semantic segmentation have recently been introduced to advance the field of earth observation technologies. However, these datasets overlook the significant diversity among geographic areas with different climates, which can greatly impact and diversify land cover. Consequently, this leads to a domain gap in remote sensing images and severe performance degradation of the segmentation models. To enhance land-cover semantic segmentation with improved generalization ability, we conducted the first investigation into the impact of climate on this task. In this paper, we present a unique large-scale Climate-Aware Satellite Images Dataset (CASID) specifically designed for domain adaptive land-cover semantic segmentation. It consists of 980 satellite images with a size of 5000 x 5000 pixels, collected from 30 different regions around Asia, covering over 24,500 square kilometers. These images are gathered from four distinct climate zones, namely temperate monsoon, subtropical monsoon, tropical monsoon, and tropical rainforest. It includes four sub-datasets/domains, each representing one of the aforementioned climate zones. This characteristic makes CASID the first climate-aware land-cover semantic segmentation dataset with multiple domains. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the samples from the four climate zones, emphasizing differences in global image features, image texture, category distribution, spectral value, and object shape. These analyses offer valuable insights for subsequent research in this field. Moreover, we conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the latest semantic segmentation and unsupervised domain adaptation methods on the CASID dataset. These results serve as a robust baseline for future research endeavors. Our dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Linwei-Chen/CASID.

</details>


### [30] [FocusOPD: Structure-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21250)
*Xinrui Lin,Shumin Wang,Suqi Song,Fan Li,Yanyong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文发现多教师on-policy蒸馏中教师-学生特征错配集中于深层Transformer块与早期去噪步，据此提出FocusOPD，仅在深层与早期步上做逐token方向性特征对齐，显著提升能力迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师on-policy蒸馏（OPD）可将多个任务专用能力合并到单一rectified-flow学生模型中，但仅匹配输出不足以保证内部表示对齐；且事先并不清楚在哪里、何时施加额外特征监督最有效。

Method: 分析Transformer各块与各去噪时间步上的教师-学生特征错配分布；在基础OPD目标上增加逐token的方向性特征对齐损失，并限定于深层Transformer块与早期去噪步（FocusOPD）。

Result: 在两个rectified-flow骨干与多种OPD目标下均改善组合生成、文本渲染及偏好评估的能力迁移；主基准上GenEval由0.953升至0.967，PickScore由23.797升至23.944，LAION-Aesthetic由6.052升至6.199。消融显示选择性的深层+早期监督优于全网络、全轨迹对齐，且更高效。

Conclusion: 输出匹配无法消除特征错配，深层早期区域的错配在OPD后仍残留；有选择性的逐token方向性特征对齐（FocusOPD）是实现高效、有效能力迁移的关键设计。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation enables rectified-flow models with diffusion-transformer architectures to combine task-specific capabilities within a single student. However, matching model outputs does not guarantee that their internal representations are aligned, and it remains unclear where and when additional feature supervision is most useful. We analyze the teacher-student feature mismatch across Transformer blocks and denoising timesteps, and find that the mismatch is concentrated in deeper Transformer blocks during early denoising and persists after OPD distillation, indicating ineffective distillation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce FocusOPD, which augments the base OPD objective with token-wise directional feature alignment restricted to deep layers and early denoising steps. Across two rectified-flow backbones and multiple OPD objectives, FocusOPD improves capability transfer in compositional generation, text rendering, and preference-based evaluation. On the primary benchmark, it improves over DiffusionOPD from 0.953 to 0.967 on GenEval, from 23.797 to 23.944 on PickScore, and from 6.052 to 6.199 on LAION-Aesthetic. Ablations show that selective deep and early supervision is more effective and efficient than alignment over the full network and trajectory.

</details>


### [31] [Do VLAs Really Follow Instructions? Diagnosing How-Level Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21251)
*Sangwu Park,Wonjoong Kim,Yeonjun In,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有VLA模型只关注"What-level"（做什么任务）指令，忽略"How-level"（怎么做）指令。作者诊断发现How-level指令反而降低任务成功率，并提出分段级指令增强训练方法及新的评测基准SIMPLER-IN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型被期望像其语言骨干一样遵循指令，但已有工作聚焦于指定任务的What-level指令，而非指定执行方式的How-level指令。作者希望探究当前VLA模型对How-level指令的遵循能力及其瓶颈。

Method: 1) 诊断实验：测试现有VLA在How-level指令下的表现；2) 假设每段episode仅配一条指令限制了How-level指令遵循，采用segment-level enriched instructions进行训练；3) 提出SIMPLER-IN基准，要求成功必须满足仅在指令中给出的条件，以在标准基准之外评测How-level指令遵循。

Result: 当前VLA对How-level指令无帮助甚至降低任务成功率；分段级丰富指令训练使动作能够响应此类指令，但并未一致提升任务成功率；SIMPLER-IN显示所获得的响应能力无法泛化到高难度或分布外（OOD）的How-level指令。

Conclusion: How-level指令遵循仍是开放挑战。仅靠数据增强带来的响应性不足以应对复杂及OOD的How-level指令，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [32] [TRACER: A Multimodal Harness for Patient Care in Hospitals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21266)
*Zane Durante,Paul Tang,Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran,Amit Kaushal,Shrinidhi Kowshika Lakshmikanth,Feolu Kolawole,Yu Jun Zheng,Yifan Geng,Shobhit Agarwal,Kevin Schulman,Juan Carlos Niebles,Ehsan Adeli,Arnold Milstein,Li Fei-Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练多模态框架 TRACER，将连续视频构建为分钟级动作记录并与临床记录整合为小时级报告，通过 LLM agent 多工具检索实现长时程行为理解，并构建两个基准进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住院期间患者行为的理解需要连续视频与临床记录互补；核心难点在于既要表征整个住院期间的行为，又要保留对细粒度视觉与临床证据的可访问性，同时避免在受保护健康数据上训练。

Method: TRACER 为 training-free 的多模态 harness：从视频构建分钟级动作记录，与临床记录融合成小时级报告，形成层次化结构；为 LLM agent 配备工具以查询该层次结构、检视相关视频片段并检索临床记录。构建两个基准：一个含跨 15 类原子动作的 397 个标注一分钟片段，另一个为基于两名 ICU 患者 264 小时视频与临床记录的 144 道临床医生参与设计的多选题。

Result: 动作检测准确率达 84.8%，问答准确率 61.0%，显著优于同骨干网络下最强基线 49.3%；在约 60,000 摄像机小时、280 名患者中，TRACER 发现住院期间谵妄评估阳性的患者其目的性活动显著少于阴性患者（p < 0.0001）。

Conclusion: 连续视频与临床记录的结合可在无需在受保护健康数据上训练的前提下，支持对个体随时间变化的行为以及跨患者队列的行为理解。

Abstract: Continuous video and clinical records provide complementary information for understanding how patient behavior evolves over a hospital stay. A central challenge is how to represent behavior across the entire stay while preserving access to fine-grained visual and clinical evidence. We introduce TRACER, a training-free multimodal harness that constructs minute-level action records from video and combines them with clinical records into hourly reports. The harness equips an LLM agent with tools to query this hierarchy, inspect relevant video, and retrieve clinical records. To evaluate TRACER, we construct two benchmarks. The first contains 397 annotated one-minute clips spanning 15 atomic actions; the second poses 144 clinician-informed multiple-choice questions, grounded in 264 hours of video and clinical records from two ICU patients. TRACER achieves up to 84.8% accuracy for action detection and 61.0% QA accuracy versus 49.3% for the strongest baseline using the same backbone. Across 280 patients spanning approximately 60,000 camera-hours, TRACER identifies significantly less purposeful activity in patients with a positive delirium assessment during their stay than in those without (p < 0.0001). Our results show that combining continuous video with clinical records can support understanding of patient behavior over time and across patient cohorts without training on protected health data.

</details>


### [33] [ReState: Noise-Level-Aware State Correction for Training-Free Object Removal in Few-Step Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21287)
*Donghwan Lee,Sanghyun Jo,Sihyun Kim,Ziseok Lee,Kyungsu Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReState，针对少步蒸馏扩散模型中"物体形状残差"问题，通过在首次前向将掩码内的干净预测校正为背景证据，实现免训练目标移除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练物体移除靠重导向自注意力远离目标区域，但在少步蒸馏扩散模型上常残留物体形状痕迹。作者发现时序错配：结构化预测在第一次前向就在掩码内形成，而短轨迹之后很少有机会修正，注意力重导向主要作用于后续步。

Method: 通过四个蒸馏骨干上的幅度匹配单次前向干预实验，证明"背景导向的状态校正"对最终结果的影响大于注意力重导向。据此提出ReState：利用噪声水平感知权重，将掩码内的干净预测向从输入检索的背景证据校正，该权重在最后一次前向消失；同时保留排除目标的注意力作为互补约束，且不增加去噪器评估次数。

Result: 在两个配对基准和两个少步骨干上，ReState在免训练方法中取得最佳掩码PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS，PSNR平均较最强基线提升3.17 dB。在OBER-Test上，三项指标均超过50步attention-forcing参考，且延迟低6.7倍。相同配置无需重调即迁移到另外两个蒸馏骨干。

Conclusion: 在少步蒸馏扩散模型中，早期状态校正比注意力重导向更关键；ReState以零额外去噪评估、高效率和良好迁移性实现高质量免训练物体移除。

Abstract: Training-free object removal commonly redirects self-attention away from the target region, but on few-step distilled diffusion models this often leaves object-shaped residuals. We identify a temporal mismatch: a structured prediction forms inside the mask at the first forward, and the short trajectory offers few later chances to revise it, while attention rerouting acts mainly in later steps. Across four distilled backbones, magnitude-matched single-forward interventions show that background-directed state correction affects the final result more than attention rerouting. We therefore propose ReState, which corrects the masked clean prediction toward background evidence retrieved from the input using a noise-level-aware weight that vanishes at the final forward. ReState retains object-excluding attention as a complementary constraint and adds no denoiser evaluations. Across two paired benchmarks and two few-step backbones, ReState achieves the best masked PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among training-free methods, improving PSNR by 3.17 dB on average over the strongest baseline. On OBER-Test, it also outperforms the 50-step attention-forcing reference on all three metrics at 6.7x lower latency. The same configuration transfers to two additional distilled backbones without retuning. Project page: https://tdrlee.github.io/ReState

</details>


### [34] [GeoPano: Towards Geometrically Accurate 3D Reconstruction from a Single Panorama](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21297)
*Jing OU,Zidong Cao,Liaoyuan Fan,Zhuoxiao Li,Shuai Zhang,Yinrui Ren,Dongli Wu,Haoang Li,Hui Xiong,Wufan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoPano，一个前馈式单视图全景3D重建框架，从单张全景图恢复几何精确且一致的点云。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景3D重建对机器人与AR/VR有重要价值，但ERP图像存在球面畸变；常见做法是将全景分解为无畸变透视视图，但独立处理各视图会引入跨视图几何不一致。

Method: 两点创新：(1) 全景感知注意力聚合器，采用精简注意力架构与Pano-Attention机制，显式利用全景内在球面几何引导跨视图交互以抑制几何不一致；(2) 混合监督策略，在透视空间约束细粒度局部细节，在球面空间约束全局结构一致性。

Result: 实验表明该方法在重建精度、几何一致性和视觉保真度上显著优于以往SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 显式建模球面几何并结合透视-球面混合监督，可有效缓解ERP畸变与跨视图不一致问题，实现高质量单视图全景3D重建。

Abstract: Panoramic 3D reconstruction enables the holistic recovery of complete 360 $^\circ$ scene geometry, offering significant benefits for robotics and AR/VR applications. However, directly estimating geometry from ERP images is inherently challenged by spherical distortions. To reduce spherical projection distortions, a common strategy is to decompose panoramas into distortion-free perspective views, but independently processing these views often introduces cross-view geometric inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we introduce GeoPano, a feed-forward framework for single-view panoramic 3D reconstruction that recovers a geometrically accurate and consistent point cloud from a single panorama. Our approach is driven by two key innovations: First, we propose a panoramic-aware attention aggregator, featuring a streamlined attention architecture equipped with a novel Pano-Attention mechanism, which explicitly exploits the intrinsic spherical geometry of the panorama to guide cross-view interactions, thereby suppressing geometric inconsistencies. Furthermore, we formulate a hybrid supervision strategy to jointly enforce fine-grained local details in perspective space and global structural coherence in spherical space. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches in reconstruction accuracy, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.

</details>


### [35] [Dusting the Phantom: Gaussian Allocation for Fading Dynamic Content](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21302)
*Minhyeok Roh,Minseo Lee,Jun Young Jeong,Byeonghyeon Lee,Lucas Yunkyu Lee,Jaesik Park,Eunbyung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出动态高斯表示的瓶颈在于高斯的"何时何处分配"而非表示容量，提出Seed Injection与Temporal Biased Relocation两种互补策略，在固定高斯预算下提升高动态区域重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态高斯方法难以重建小而快速运动的物体及高动态区域的精细纹理，且单纯延长训练或增加高斯数量仍无法解决。作者认为瓶颈不在表示容量，而在高斯基元的分配位置与时机：现有分配策略依赖高斯的当前位置，忽略了重定位高斯的时空去向。

Method: 提出两种互补策略，且不改变底层表示、维持固定高斯预算：(1) Seed Injection：利用时序外观变化与重建误差识别欠重建的动态区域，并通过多视角观测在几何合理的3D位置初始化新高斯，独立于已有高斯位置；(2) Temporal Biased Relocation：利用时间分辨的优化信号引导重定位高斯的时空放置。

Result: 在多个动态场景数据集上的实验表明重建质量提升，尤其在高动态区域，能够恢复小而快速运动的物体与细粒度外观细节。

Conclusion: 高斯的分配位置与时机是动态高斯重建的关键瓶颈；通过在固定高斯预算下引入时序驱动的种子注入与偏置重定位，可有效改善高动态区域的重建质量。

Abstract: Dynamic Gaussian representations have made high-quality, real-time volumetric video increasingly practical, yet challenging motion can still break their reconstruction: small fast-moving objects may disappear, and fine textures in highly dynamic regions are often lost. In particular, simply training longer or using more Gaussians may still fail to recover small, fast-moving objects. We argue that the key bottleneck is not representational capacity itself, but where and when Gaussian primitives are allocated. Existing allocation strategies rely on current Gaussian locations and often overlook the spatiotemporal destinations of relocated Gaussians. To address these limitations, we introduce two complementary strategies. First, Seed Injection identifies under-reconstructed dynamic regions using temporal appearance changes and reconstruction errors, and initializes new Gaussians at geometrically plausible 3D locations through multi-view observations, independent of existing Gaussian locations. Second, Temporal Biased Relocation uses time-resolved optimization signals to guide the spatiotemporal placement of relocated Gaussians. Both strategies maintain a fixed Gaussian budget without modifying the underlying representation. Experiments across multiple dynamic-scene datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction quality, particularly in highly dynamic regions, recovering small, rapidly moving objects and fine-grained appearance details.

</details>


### [36] [VLA-$Δ$: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21306)
*Qi Lu,Jiarun Li,Ce Zhang,Miao Pan,Yi Pan,Xu Wang,Wenqi Zhang,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLA-Δ以当前状态与未来状态间的物理变化作为显式学习目标，构建大规模预训练数据集与物理状态转注标签，推理时无额外开销，在LIBERO、RoboTwin达SOTA水平，真机实验优于π_{0.5}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型直接将观测映射到示教动作，缺乏对中间物理状态变化的显式监督，易过拟合于观测-动作对应关系；已有方法虽引入语言、视觉或隐空间中的中间推理或未来状态预测，但未显式监督物理状态转移本身。

Method: 提出VLA-Δ通用框架，以当前状态与未来状态之间的物理变化（Δ）为显式学习目标；为此构建大规模预训练数据集，并派生覆盖任务相关语义与视觉运动变化的物理状态转注（state-transition）标注，为连续动作生成提供更直接的监督；推理阶段直接由当前观测生成动作，无额外推理开销。

Result: 在LIBERO与RoboTwin基准上取得与当前SOTA相当的性能；真机实验中优于π_{0.5}。代码已开源（ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta）。

Conclusion: 显式建模物理状态变化可作为VLA的有效监督信号，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升动作生成的泛化性与真机表现。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-$Δ$, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-$Δ$ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta

</details>


### [37] [Loud and Clear: Making Visual Evidence Count in Multimodal Document RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21318)
*Eunchan Jo,Seounghyun Jang,Sangwoo Mo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 多模态文档RAG的瓶颈不在检索，而在"检索到的页面如何喂给生成器"：视觉证据利用不足。作者提出两条需求——Loud（充分利用视觉token容量）与Clear（精炼页面使证据突出），实现为LoC方法，在三个基准上显著超越八个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态文档RAG主要关注检索环节，但答案质量取决于视觉语言模型对检索页面的"阅读"能力。实验发现：即使检索到正确页面（SciEGQA oracle pages），证据仍未被充分利用——页面预算从1K提升到32K可带来15.22点增益，在16K下加入真值裁剪区域再提升3.75点。因此需要研究生成器从页面中到底需要什么。

Method: 将需求抽象为两条：Loud——用满视觉token容量（提高token预算或图像分辨率/视觉保真度；全页缩放优于重复与切块）；Clear——精炼页面使证据突出（抑制周边内容、并加入查询相关区域的OCR文本）。据此实现LoC：高分辨率页面 + 查询相关区域OCR，无需真值标注或额外训练。

Result: 在SciEGQA、ViDoRe-v3、MMLongBench-Doc上超越八个已有方法；在相同检索器与生成器下，分别比最强的ColQwen3提升8.88、3.09、4.22点；在相同视觉token预算下也优于其page-only变体。

Conclusion: 瓶颈位于检索之外，即检索页面呈现给生成器的方式；Loud与Clear两原则可有效指导多模态文档RAG的生成端设计。

Abstract: Multimodal document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has focused largely on retrieval, yet its answers depend on how well a vision-language model reads the retrieved pages. We find that evidence in retrieved pages remains underused even when the correct pages are retrieved. On SciEGQA oracle pages, five prior methods give the generator 0.7K to 2.7K visual tokens per query on average under a common image processor, yet raising the page-only budget from 1K to 32K improves accuracy by 15.22 points. At a fixed 16K budget, adding ground-truth crops improves accuracy by 3.75 points over page-only input. We study what the generator needs from retrieved pages through two requirements: Loud, making full use of visual token capacity, and Clear, refining the page so that its evidence becomes prominent. For Loud, increasing either the visual token budget or visual fidelity, the image resolution those tokens preserve, improves accuracy with the other held fixed, and full-page scaling outperforms repetition and tiling at matched budgets. For Clear, suppressing surrounding content improves accuracy without enlarging selected regions, and adding OCR of these regions to page images outperforms either input alone. We implement both as Loud and Clear (LoC), which combines higher-resolution pages with OCR from query-relevant regions without ground-truth annotations or additional training. LoC outperforms eight prior methods on SciEGQA, ViDoRe-v3, and MMLongBench-Doc, improving over the strongest, ColQwen3, by 8.88, 3.09, and 4.22 points with the same retriever and generator. It also outperforms its page-only variant under the same visual token budget. These results locate a bottleneck beyond retrieval: how the retrieved pages are given to the generator.

</details>


### [38] [ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21320)
*Hao Shi,Jiafeng Wang,Yuzhuo Fu,Tao Zhang,Jian Bai,Juelu Zhang,Qing Cui,Chao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZoomCap 将细粒度图像描述重构为"可恢复的视觉信息迁移"：用教师模型在有限观测预算下主动补齐缺失证据，并配套 FactCycle 事实验证指标分离"编造"与"生成损失"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 详细描述虽能向视觉-语言模型提供更多视觉监督，但质量常被长度掩盖：长单遍输出仍会漏掉小目标、文字与空间关系，还会把不确定观察升级为自信断言。因此需要以"信息是否真正被恢复并可复用"而非长度来衡量描述质量。

Method: ZoomCap：以草稿描述驱动条件式知识检索、OCR 敏感读取、覆盖缺口恢复与自适应视觉缩放；仅对最复杂的合格区域分配更深的裁剪，基于 grounded 几何推导空间关系，并融合非重复证据。FactCycle：将描述分解为原子断言，在两个盲锚点上打分——源图像（真实性）与重建（可实现性），逐条区分编造与生成器损失；辅以人工与多评委对比。

Result: 对比 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 描述，小 10 倍以上的教师模型取得 81.9% 的 tie-adjusted 人类偏好分；FactCycle 统计每图 52.4 条有效迁移断言（ScaleCap 为 31.5）。迁移效果：持续预训练中 ZoomCap-450K 使 11 项基准均值较最强竞争语料提升 1.31–2.38 分，Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 在生产文档/OCR 监测套件上提升 1.4 分（感知 1.5 分，60B tokens）；医学预训练中 264 万 ZoomCap 描述图像使 5 项 VQA 基准提升 3.04 分（同图 Gemini-3.1-Pro 描述为 1.76）。

Conclusion: 细粒度描述的价值在于可恢复、可验证的证据迁移而非输出长度；以事实级评分与多锚点校验替代长度代理，可在更小教师模型下获得更高偏好的监督信号，并在通用与领域预训练中稳定转化为下游收益。

Abstract: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication from generator loss claim by claim; human and multi-judge comparisons complement this fact-level view. Against Qwen3.5-397B-A17B captions, ZoomCap achieves an 81.9% human tie-adjusted preference score with a teacher over 10x smaller, and FactCycle counts 52.4 transferred claims per image vs. 31.5 for ScaleCap. The evidence also transfers: in continual pre-training, ZoomCap-450K improves the 11-benchmark average by 1.31-2.38 points over the strongest competing corpus and Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 gains 1.4 points on a production document/OCR monitor suite (1.5 on perception) at 60B tokens; in medical pre-training, 2.64M ZoomCap-captioned images improve five VQA benchmarks by 3.04 points (vs. 1.76 for same-image Gemini-3.1-Pro captions).

</details>


### [39] [CoViG: Coarsened Vision GNN for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21321)
*Martial Guidez,Stefan Duffner,Christophe Garcia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoViG，在ViG的Grapher模块中引入MinCUT图粗化池化，降低中间图节点数，在ImageNet上以约51%的FLOPs达到与原ViG相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViG将图像视为节点集合并在k-NN图上做图卷积，分类精度高但计算开销较大；图神经网络优化中的图粗化思想尚少用于视觉图模型，作者希望借此降低推理成本。

Method: 在ViG中间块的Grapher组件内加入MinCUT pooling进行图粗化，简化中间图结构、减少特定块的节点数量，从而在保持图卷积表达的同时压缩计算量。

Result: 在ImageNet上用多种ViG架构评测，CoViG取得与原始ViG相当（equivalent）的精度，FLOPs仅约为原来的51%。

Conclusion: 图粗化与ViG的结合可在基本不损失精度的前提下显著降低推理计算成本，为视觉图模型的高效化提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Although Graph Neural Networks are widely used in various domains, they remained mostly unexplored in computer vision. Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers were leading the field, until the quite recent introduction of Vision Graphs (ViG) that treat images as a set of nodes and apply graph convolution on their k-NN graphs. ViGs show impressive accuracy on image classification but their computational cost remains relatively high. Inspired by optimization methods for GNNs, we present CoViG, a novel approach combining graph coarsening and ViGs. Our method introduces an additional MinCUT pooling step within the Grapher component of intermediate ViG blocks. By simplifying the intermediate graphs and thus decreasing the number of nodes of specific blocks, our approach considerably reduces the computational cost of ViG during inference. We evaluated our approach on ImageNet with several ViG architectures, and we obtained accuracies equivalent to the original ViG models with only about 51\% of FLOPs.

</details>


### [40] [AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21323)
*Xinran Nicole Han,Yiyang Lu,Katelyn Gan,Todd Zickler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaLoop 让视觉编码器根据问题在冻结主干权重的条件下进行多轮迭代复用，实现问题条件化的视觉递归，并在新提出的 VisRO 基准上优于标准微调与单次前向基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）普遍把视觉编码器当作静态特征提取器：图像只编码一次且与问题无关，后续推理全部交给语言模型。但不同问题往往需要不同的视觉操作与计算深度，静态单次编码难以满足这类视觉中心推理需求。

Result: 在 VisRO 的六个任务上，在训练数据与优化器更新次数匹配的条件下，AdaLoop 优于标准微调和问题条件化单次前向基线；该增益在三个 VLM 系列以及分布内与分布外样本上均成立。

Abstract: Most vision-language models (VLMs) treat the vision encoder as a static feature extractor: it encodes an image once, independently of the question, and leaves subsequent reasoning to the language model. Yet different questions may require different visual operations and processing depths. We also introduce VisRO, a procedural dataset and generation pipeline for training and evaluating vision-centric reasoning. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. Specifically, \certex\ stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that \certex\ returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, \certex\ is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.

</details>

Abstract: Generative low-light enhancers recover plausible texture but may hallucinate structure; restoration networks preserve structure but can leave regions under-enhanced, and neither advantage is spatially uniform.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Healthcare institutions routinely accumulate high-dimensional computed tomography (CT) volumes, but only a fraction can be annotated by experts. We present L2GSSL, a local-to-global self-supervised learning framework that leverages unlabeled volumes by decomposing pretraining into intra-slice and inter-slice representation spaces. A slice encoder learns view-invariant local features, and a global encoder aggregates the resulting tokens to model volumetric context. The stop-gradient isolates the local space from the global objective, while slice-wise execution and a three-phase schedule support training under constrained GPU memory. On LIDC-IDRI lung nodule malignancy classification, L2GSSL reaches $0.9229$ AUROC with only $10\%$ of the labels and $0.9377$ with $25\%$, exceeding the volume-level VICReg by $0.0229$ and $0.0294$, respectively. With all labels, the strongest supervised baseline exceeds L2GSSL by only $0.0044$ AUROC, consistent with self-supervised pretraining providing its greatest value when annotations are limited. Without adaptation to the external LNDb cohort, a model fine-tuned on $25\%$ of LIDC-IDRI obtains $0.8138$ AUROC and $0.7589$ AUPRC, improving over the strongest evaluated self-supervised baseline by $0.1130$ and $0.0954$. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单样本字体生成（OFG）需从单个参考字形迁移风格并保持目标字符结构。单个字形所含风格信息有限，对复杂文字系统更甚，现有方法难以准确捕捉字体风格。

Conclusion: 多层级风格-内容解耦结合渐进式协调可有效提升单样本字体生成的风格保真度与结构保持能力，且对多样文字系统具备通用性。

Abstract: One-shot Font Generation (OFG) aims to synthesize a target glyph by transferring the stylistic characteristics of a single reference glyph while preserving the structure of the target character. However, accurately capturing font style from a single reference image remains challenging due to the limited stylistic information available in a single glyph, and this challenge is further amplified for complex scripts. We propose CoDeFont, a script-agnostic OFG framework that addresses this challenge through multi-level style-content factorization and progressive style-content reconciliation. CoDeFont independently aggregates complementary style and structural information across multiple spatial levels to obtain factor-specific representations, while a contrastive objective explicitly encourages separation between style and content embeddings. During reconstruction, the disentangled representations are progressively injected through multi-level style conditioning, enabling stylistic information to be incorporated at different decoding resolutions while preserving the underlying glyph structure. We evaluate CoDeFont on structurally distinct Bengali and Latin scripts across seen and unseen font styles. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses demonstrate consistent improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed framework for OFG across diverse writing systems.

</details>


### [46] [SATOR: Backpropagation-Free 3D Test-Time Adaptation via Sample-Adaptive Token Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21367)
*Inseok Kong,Geunyoung Jung,Jiyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免源、免反向传播的3D点云测试时自适应框架SATOR，通过样本自适应token路由替代预定义剪枝尺寸搜索，在三个3D损坏基准上取得SOTA精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免反向传播的token剪枝TTA方法依赖预定义的剪枝尺寸候选集，需对每个样本多次前向传播来搜索，导致推理开销显著增加。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates the performance degradation of source-pretrained models on unlabeled test data under distribution shifts. Recent backpropagation-free token-purging methods address 3D point cloud distribution shifts by filtering unreliable tokens. However, their reliance on predefined purge-size candidates requires multiple forward passes per sample and increases inference cost. We propose SATOR (Sample-Adaptive TOken Routing), a source-free and backpropagation-free 3D TTA framework that eliminates this search by deriving both the partitioning threshold and routing decision directly from each sample. SATOR computes token abnormality scores from complementary attention and geometric relation graphs. It then derives a sample-specific partition into retained and pruned tokens via Otsu-based separability, without evaluating candidate sizes. Keep-ratio-calibrated routing then selects the pruned prediction only when its entropy, penalized by the keep ratio, is lower than that of the original prediction. Experiments on ModelNet40-C, ScanObjectNN-C, and ShapeNet-C demonstrate that SATOR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three 3D corruption benchmarks.

</details>


### [47] [Perception or Reasoning? Diagnosing and Tackling Reinforcement Learning Bottlenecks in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21380)
*Zeyuan Yang,Zhuohao Chen,Jiaben Chen,Yao Zhang,Maohao Shen,Chuang Gan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PARA（感知与推理归因）度量每个模型-基准对剩余的感知与推理提升空间，发现RL收益随感知空间增大而减小、随推理空间增大而增大，说明现有RL更善于利用推理空间而非感知空间；据此提出GRAD——组相对注意力蒸馏目标，用组内最优rollout直接引导较弱rollout的视觉注意力，在两个模型规模、七个基准上稳定提升并可与现有RL方法互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习显著提升了语言模型推理能力，但在视觉任务上的改进不稳定。核心难点在于视觉任务失败来源不同：同一基准对某模型可能受限于感知，对另一模型则受限于推理，而缺少一种显式区分并量化这两类瓶颈的手段来解释RL收益的差异。

Result: PARA与现有基准的预期特性总体一致，但揭示出显著的模型特定差异；RL增益随感知headroom增大而减小，随推理headroom占比提高而增大。GRAD在两个模型规模、七个基准上均取得一致的性能提升，并与现有RL方法形成互补。

Conclusion: 视觉任务中的失败需按感知与推理分别归因；现有RL主要利用推理空间，对感知空间的挖掘不足源于其奖励/ token级信号只能间接调节视觉注意力。GRAD通过注意力层面的直接蒸馏弥补这一缺口，是一种与现有RL正交、可叠加的改进方向。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has brought strong gains to language model reasoning, but its improvements on visual tasks remain less consistent. One difficulty is that visual task failures can arise from different sources: the same benchmark may be limited by perception for one model and by reasoning for another. We introduce Perception and Reasoning Attribution (PARA), which measures the remaining perceptual and reasoning headroom of each model--benchmark pair by comparing how many current errors are recovered with more accurate visual information versus a stronger reasoner. Across 4 vision-language models and 17 multimodal benchmarks, PARA broadly agrees with the expected characteristics of existing benchmarks while revealing substantial model-specific variation. More importantly, it shows that RL gains become smaller as perceptual headroom increases, but larger when reasoning explains more of the recoverable errors, suggesting that current RL exploits reasoning headroom more effectively than perceptual headroom. Motivated by this gap, we analyze how existing RL objectives affect visual perception and find that reward- and token-level signals influence visual attention only indirectly. We therefore propose GRAD, a group-relative attention distillation objective that uses the best rollout in each group to directly guide the visual attention of weaker rollouts. GRAD consistently improves performance across two model scales and seven benchmarks, and further complements existing RL methods.

</details>


### [48] [CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21409)
*Masaki Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出上下文线辅助描述子CLAD，利用线对应提供的全局几何上下文进行关键点匹配，在重复纹理场景中提升匹配可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SIFT、ORB等传统关键点描述子基于局部图像块计算，在重复模式或弱纹理场景中，不同位置的图像块外观相似，导致描述子不可靠、匹配歧义大。

Conclusion: 将全局线结构上下文引入关键点描述是缓解局部描述子歧义的有效途径，CLAD以低计算代价实现了几何一致的匹配，可作为传统描述子的补充。

Abstract: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.

</details>


### [49] [Where, How, and When: Query-Guided Grounding for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21422)
*Yogesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究三种查询引导的视频定位任务（物体级、关系级、时刻级），分别提出QDETRv/TOViT、少样本指代关系方法（T-partite随机场+元学习关系网络）和MATR，推动多粒度查询引导的视频理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解视频内容需要在多个粒度上推理：从识别物体，到解释其交互，再到定位特定动作发生的时间点。现有方法尚不能由查询引导地在空间、关系与时间三个层面统一完成定位，因此论文针对物体级、关系级、时刻级三类grounding任务展开研究。

Method: (1) 物体级：QDETRv为Detection Transformer的查询引导扩展，用于视频中未见物体的一次性定位，结合query-context融合、保持时序一致性的记忆模块及合成物体轨迹上的无监督预训练；TOViT用于少样本视频物体检测，基于语言对齐的开放集视觉编码器并跨帧传播高置信度物体特征。(2) 关系级：提出视频少样本指代关系，给定(subject, predicate, object)查询及少量共享该谓词的支撑视频，通过元学习关系网络优化T-partite随机场，含查询条件平移嵌入、Global Semantic Aggregation、Local Localization Aggregation与基于置信传播的消息传递。(3) 时刻级：MATR用于视频到视频时刻检索，采用双阶段Dynamic Time Warping进行融合前/后对齐、可学习查询做边界预测、带时间增强的自监督预训练，并扩展到文本到视频时刻检索。

Result: MATR扩展至文本到视频时刻检索时性能可比或优于现有SOTA；QDETRv与TOViT分别实现一次性和少样本视频物体检测中的查询引导定位，关系级方法实现少样本指代关系定位。

Conclusion: 三项贡献在空间、关系与时间grounding上推进了查询引导的视频理解，形成覆盖多粒度的统一研究框架。

Abstract: Understanding video content requires reasoning at multiple levels of granularity, from identifying objects to interpreting their interactions and localizing when specific actions occur. This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks that answer where key objects are (object-level grounding), how they interact (relationship-level grounding), and when specific moments occur (moment-level grounding). For object-level grounding, we present QDETRv, a query-guided extension of the Detection Transformer for one-shot localization of unseen objects in videos, which combines query-context fusion, a memory module for temporal consistency, and unsupervised pretraining on synthetic object trajectories. We further propose the Temporal Object-Aware Vision Transformer (TOViT) for few-shot video object detection, which builds on a language-aligned open-set vision encoder and propagates high-confidence object features across frames. For relationship-level grounding, we introduce few-shot referring relationships in videos: given a (subject, predicate, object) query and a few support videos sharing the predicate, the entities are localized by optimizing a T-partite random field using a meta-learned relation network with query-conditioned translational embeddings, Global Semantic Aggregation, Local Localization Aggregation, and belief-propagation-based message passing. For moment-level grounding, we propose the Moment Alignment Transformer (MATR) for video-to-video moment retrieval, which uses dual-stage Dynamic Time Warping for pre- and post-fusion alignment, learnable queries for boundary prediction, and self-supervised pretraining with temporal augmentations; MATR also extends to text-to-video moment retrieval with performance comparable to, or better than, the state of the art. These contributions advance query-guided video understanding across spatial, relational, and temporal grounding.

</details>


### [50] [ManiFusion: Unlocking the High-Throughput Generation via Superposition in Manifold Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21433)
*Minkyu Kim,Baekseung Kim,Junhoo Lee,Jangho Kim,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出骨干无关的多样本生成框架 ManiFusion：在去噪主干前将多个样本融合至融合空间共同计算、之后解融合，并配合轨迹融合调度（TFS）动态调整融合因子，在几乎不损失质量的前提下显著提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型因需在多个时间步上迭代去噪而计算开销大；现有加速方法主要降低单样本时延（per-sample latency），但这一维度的收益已趋于饱和，因此需要探索正交的、面向吞吐的方向——在一次去噪评估中处理多个样本。

Method: ManiFusion 在进入去噪主干前将多个样本融合、之后通过 unfusion 分离，实现单次前向中的多样本联合计算；文中给出几何视角，说明多样本如何共享融合表示同时保留引导各自生成轨迹所需的信息；并采用 Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS) 在采样过程中动态调整融合因子，使融合分配与去噪阶段对齐。

Result: 方法可泛化至不同扩散家族，涵盖像素空间与潜空间中的 U-Net 与 Transformer 主干；且能与现有加速方法组合使用，达到此前方法无法企及的吞吐区间，质量退化极小。

Conclusion: 通过融合空间计算将加速维度从单样本时延转向批量吞吐，ManiFusion 提供了一种骨干无关、可与既有加速技术叠加的通用多样本生成方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. To better align fusion allocation with denoising stages, ManiFusion uses Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling (TFS), which dynamically adjusts fusion factors throughout sampling. ManiFusion generalizes across diffusion families, including both U-Net and transformer backbones in pixel and latent spaces. We further show that ManiFusion composes with existing acceleration methods and reaches throughput regimes unattainable by prior approaches with minimal quality degradation.

</details>


### [51] [RLDF: A Region-Level Deepfake Dataset and Benchmark for Partial-Face Manipulation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21438)
*Shukesh Reddy,Abhijit Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出首个区域级深度伪造数据集RLDF，包含超200万张局部换脸图像，并系统性评测现有检测器在局部篡改下的泛化缺陷，进一步提出mask-guided cross-attention基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型均建立在“完整换脸或整脸合成”的篡改图像之上，缺乏对“篡改仅局限于局部脸面子区域”情形的考察，因此作者提出核心问题：现成检测器能否在局部区域篡改下仍有效检测。

Method: 构建RLDF（Region-Level Deepfake）数据集：提出region-aware partial swap合成模型，基于8种换脸方法生成超200万张局部换脸图像；覆盖7个面部区域（4个离散区域：眼、鼻、嘴、眉；4个复合区域：眼+鼻；眼+鼻+嘴；眼+鼻+嘴+眉；全脸）。定义三种评测协议，在5个标准跨数据集评测、DF40及RLDF上基准测试12种SOTA检测器，并提出mask-guided cross-attention模型作为基线。

Result: 现有检测器无法在部分面部区域上一致泛化，区域级评测下AUC整体下降10.5%、准确率下降10%；所提出的mask-guided cross-attention基线可有效检测区域级篡改。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了现有深度伪造检测器在局部区域篡改场景下的泛化短板，提供RLDF数据集与统一评测协议，并给出有效的基线方法，数据集、代码与模型权重均已公开。

Abstract: Existing deepfake detection models are built upon manipu- lated images that are tampered with either exclusively fully swapped or fully synthesised faces, which leads us to an open question: Can off-the-shelf deepfake models detect manipulation effectively while tampering is confined to a local facial sub-region? To fill this gap, we introduce RLDF (Region-Level Deepfake), the first dataset for region-level deepfake evaluation. Employing the proposed region-aware partial swap synthesis model, we generate over 2M par- tial face-swap images by using eight face-swapping meth- ods. Altogether, we considered seven face regions, among which there are four discrete regions (eye, nose, mouth and eyebrow) and four composite facial regions (eye and nose; eye, nose and mouth; eye, nose, mouth and eye- brow; and full face). In addition, we define three evalu- ation protocols and benchmark 12 state-of-the-art detectors across the five popular standard cross-dataset evaluations, DF40, and the proposed RLDF, providing a comprehen- sive audit of where and why existing detectors underper- formed. Our evaluation reveals that existing detectors fail to generalize consistently across partial facial regions, re- sulting in an overall drop of 10.5% AUC and 10% accu- racy under region-level evaluation. Further, we propose a mask-guided cross-attention model as a baseline approach that can effectively detect region-level manipulation. The proposed dataset, code, and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RLDF-Dataset/RLDF.

</details>


### [52] [PET Quantification-Preserving Registration for Longitudinal Whole-Body PSMA PET/CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21451)
*Fryderyk Kögl,Anna Reithmeir,Daniel M. Lang,Emily Chan,Rickmer Braren,Julia A. Schnabel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将LapIRN粗到细微分同胚配准架构适配到Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg挑战的纵向全身PSMA PET/CT配准，并引入PET生物标志物保持损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对纵向全身PSMA PET/CT配准任务，需要在多模态形变配准中保持PET定量生物标志物（MTV、TLG）的准确性，同时处理骨骼结构刚性特点，而通用配准方法缺乏此类结构约束。

Method: 方法由三部分组成：仿射预配准、多模态形变配准（基于粗到细的LapIRN微分同胚架构）、测试时实例优化（test-time instance optimization）。此外引入PET生物标志物保持损失，包括针对代谢肿瘤体积（MTV）与总病灶糖酵解（TLG）的损失项及基于Jacobian的约束，并对骨骼结构施加逐结构刚性正则化。

Result: 提交配置在自建评测协议下取得81.0% DSC与6.17 mm HD95，MTV误差3.3%，TLG误差3.3%。

Conclusion: 该方法在纵向全身PSMA PET/CT配准中兼顾几何精度与PET定量指标保持，验证了生物标志物保持损失与骨骼刚性正则化的有效性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We adapt the diffeomorphic coarse-to-fine LapIRN architecture for longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge. The method combines affine pre-registration, multi-modal deformable registration, and test-time instance optimization. We further introduce PET biomarker preservation losses for metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG), including Jacobian-based constraints, and a per-structure rigidity regularization for skeletal structures. The submitted configuration achieved 81.0% DSC and 6.17 mm HD95, with MTV and TLG errors of 3.3% and 3.3%, respectively, on our evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/koegl/psmareg.

</details>


### [53] [Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21459)
*Wenkai Li,Wenyi Hong,Zhuoyi Yang,Jie Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出知识迁移探测（KTP）协议，验证图像生成训练可使统一多模态模型获得新知识并通过纯文本问答访问，并进一步用文本对齐与图文交错对齐提升其可及性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在图像生成监督中接触到了文本未完整记录的信息，但"学习生成图像能否扩展预训练模型的知识"这一问题尚未被系统研究，且视觉监督到语言的可及性尚不清楚。

Method: 设计KTP受控协议：通过图像生成训练注入新知识，再用纯文本问答检测其可及性；覆盖七类知识与三个UMM；依次引入文本对齐（Textual Alignment）与图文交错对齐（Interleaved Image–Text Alignment），以共享知识和交错响应连接生成与问答；并对特定实体进行引导而不使用QA监督。

Result: 观察到视觉监督到语言存在直接但不均衡的迁移；对选定实体的引导可在无QA监督下改善其他实体的知识获取，交错对齐带来额外增益；图像中正确重现的知识往往在文本侧更易访问，但两种访问形式之间仍存在显著差距。

Conclusion: 视觉生成可作为文本监督之外的知识来源；为使该知识更广泛可及，需联合研究训练数据设计与模型架构。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? We introduce Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), a controlled protocol that supplies new knowledge through image-generation training and tests its accessibility through text-only question answering. Across seven knowledge categories and three UMMs, we observe direct but uneven transfer from visual supervision to language. Motivated by these observations, we successively introduce Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image--Text Alignment, which connect generation and answering through shared knowledge and interleaved responses, respectively. Guidance on selected entities can improve knowledge access on other entities without QA supervision, with additional gains from interleaved alignment. Further analysis shows that knowledge correctly reproduced in images is often more accessible through text, although substantial gaps remain between the two forms of access. These findings support visual generation as a source of knowledge beyond textual supervision, and motivate joint investigation of training data design and model architecture to make this knowledge more broadly accessible.

</details>


### [54] [Cross-Prompt Inference Mitigates Rare-Class Suppression in Imbalanced VLM Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21470)
*Emanuel Ben Baruch,Sivan Biham,Alon Shoshan,Yochai Zvik,Avi Ben-Cohen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在类别不平衡数据上微调视觉语言模型后，推理时复用微调提示词（matched prompt）反而比换用另一描述性提示词（cross-prompt）更容易丢失稀有类召回；该现象源于训练-评估提示交互，机制上表现为减轻对微调计算（TuCo分解）的依赖、回归预训练成分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调后的VLM在类别不平衡数据上稀有类召回可能远低于其自身零样本水平；作者关注推理提示选择这一常被忽视的因素，追问标准做法（沿用微调提示）是否最优。

Method: 提出cross-prompt inference策略：推理时改用不同于微调提示的描述性提示。在6个数据集、多种VLM上对比匹配提示与交叉提示；控制提示质量与非描述性提示变化以区分"训练-评估交互"与单纯提示质量；用Tuning Contribution（TuCo）将模型计算分解为预训练部分与微调部分，并人为削弱微调贡献做因果验证。

Result: 交叉提示推理一致地恢复稀有类召回，常见类召回存在不同程度的权衡；效应仅出现在描述性提示替换下，且在类别不平衡与视觉混淆导致稀有类被强烈压制时最强、无压制时消失；TuCo分析显示交叉提示降低对微调计算的依赖并转向预训练成分，削弱微调贡献后交叉提示优势显著减小。

Conclusion: 不平衡微调所压制的稀有类知识并未丢失，而是在特定提示下被遮蔽；推理提示是缓解不平衡微调稀有类退化的低成本手段，且该效应可由预训练/微调计算的相对贡献解释。

Abstract: When a vision-language model is finetuned on class-imbalanced data, rare-class recall can fall well below the model's own zero-shot performance. In this regime, we uncover a surprising matched-prompt penalty whereby the standard choice of reusing the descriptive finetuning prompt at inference can yield lower rare-class recall than using a different descriptive prompt. We call this inference-time strategy cross-prompt inference. We evaluate diverse VLMs across six datasets and find that cross-prompt inference consistently recovers rare-class recall, with varying trade-offs in frequent-class recall. The effect reflects a train-eval prompt interaction rather than prompt quality alone, and does not arise with non-descriptive prompt changes. It is strongest when imbalance and visual confusability produce substantial rare-class suppression, and is weak or absent when such suppression does not occur. Using Tuning Contribution (TuCo), which decomposes a model's computation into pretrained and finetuning parts, we find that cross-prompt inference reduces reliance on finetuning-induced computation and shifts the model toward its pretrained component. Reducing that finetuning contribution also substantially reduces the cross-prompt advantage. These results show that rare-class knowledge suppressed by imbalanced finetuning can remain accessible under a different inference prompt.

</details>


### [55] [GRASE: Geometry-native Real-to-sim Agentic Scene Modeling from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21498)
*Zhaorui Lin,Haohan Liu,Zhen Chen,Xiangru Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRASE：以多视角视频观测为常驻参考的agentic闭环框架，将真实视频转为可编辑3D场景，显著优于SOTA（含GPT6-Astra直接转换）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有real-to-sim方法采用"一次性、松耦合"范式，各阶段仅从前序阶段获得有限反馈，误差逐级传播且难以可靠纠正，最终场景不一致。

Method: 将捕获的多视角视频作为贯穿建模全程的参考，不锁定中间估计，渲染证据与捕获不一致时即修正当前假设。流程：1) 由深度与多视角线索拟合建筑外壳及其开口（门窗）；2) agent在共享坐标系中摆放生成资产并校验空间关系；3) 迭代优化每个资产的几何与位姿以提升跨视角一致性。通过反馈耦合各步骤，仅定位并修正导致结构偏差的组件。

Result: 生成场景忠实于输入、跨视角一致且适用于仿真；实验中大幅超越其他SOTA方法，包括使用GPT6-Astra的直接real-to-sim转换。

Conclusion: 以观测为常驻参考的闭环agentic建模可有效替代固定中间假设的传统流水线，实现高保真、可编辑、可用于仿真的真实场景重建。

Abstract: Real-to-sim conversion aims to turn a captured video of a real environment into an editable 3D scene while preserving the geometry and layout of what was observed. Existing methods often follow a one-pass, loosely coupled paradigm: each stage receives only limited feedback from previous stages, allowing errors to propagate without reliable correction and leaving the final scene inconsistent. We present GRASE, an agentic framework that closes this loop by treating the captured multi-view video observations as a standing reference throughout scene modeling. Instead of committing to intermediate estimates, GRASE revises its current hypothesis whenever rendered evidence disagrees with the capture, overcoming the fixed intermediate assumptions of conventional pipelines. Specifically, GRASE first fits the architectural shell and its openings from depth and multi-view cues. An agent then places generated assets in a shared coordinate frame while checking their spatial relationships. Finally, each asset's geometry and placement are refined iteratively to improve agreement across the observed views. By coupling these steps through feedback, GRASE localizes structural discrepancies and revises only the responsible components, while preserving cross-view consistency. The resulting 3D scenes are faithful to the input, consistent across views, and suitable for simulations. In our experiments, GRASE substantially outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, including a direct real-to-sim conversion using GPT6-Astra.

</details>


### [56] [FilterFusion: Prior-Guided Adaptive Filter Fusion for Efficient Video Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21505)
*Wenlong Yang,Weihang Yuan,Canran Jin,Jiahao Li,Henrik Turbell,Lifeng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FilterFusion：先用低分辨率控制器预测引导信号，再在原始分辨率上自适应混合一组可解释去噪滤波器（高斯、中值等），实现109K参数、0.18 GFLOPs的实时视频去噪，1080p单CPU线程17.9ms/帧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通信系统实际场景的视频去噪需同时应对传感器噪声、压缩伪影和运动不一致等混合退化，并受严格时延约束。纯深度模型精度高但计算代价大，经典滤波器高效稳健但自适应不足，二者难以兼顾。

Method: 提出先验引导的多帧去噪框架：将时序感知的学习特征与可解释去噪分支库结合；在低分辨率下由轻量控制器预测低成本引导信号，并把时序方差与空间方差线索显式注入控制器；该引导信号用于在原始分辨率上自适应混合一组紧凑的去噪响应（高斯模糊、中值、加权和），滤波器组操作简单规整，合成路径可用编译型C实现。

Result: CRVD真实传感器噪声数据集上达34.72 dB PSNR、0.9330 SSIM，仅0.18 GFLOPs（仅网络）；1080p下合成路径C实现单CPU线程17.9ms/帧（55.9 FPS），超过实时要求，并比需每帧2秒以上的轻量CNN基线快122–252倍。

Conclusion: 低分辨率控制加显式滤波器合成的路线在质量—效率—速度间取得良好折中，为实时视频去噪提供了可行工程途径，并说明可解释滤波器库与学习式引导可有效互补。

Abstract: Real-world video denoising for communication systems must handle mixed degradations such as sensor noise, compression artifacts, and motion-induced inconsistency while remaining deployable under tight latency budgets. Purely deep models often achieve high accuracy but come with significant computational cost, whereas classical filters are robust and efficient but insufficiently adaptive. Because the filter-bank operations are simple and regular (Gaussian blur, median, weighted sum), a straightforward compiled C implementation of the synthesis path achieves 17.9ms per frame (55.9 FPS) on a single CPU thread at 1080p---exceeding real-time and 122--252 times faster than lightweight CNN baselines that require over 2 seconds per frame.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We study Text-and-Image-to-Image (TI2I) flow matching methods for controllable image editing.
