SparK-SAR makes three core technical contributions: (i) ConvNeXt-RS, a domain-adapted encoder that halves the stem stride (4x to 2x) to produce 14x14 feature maps at stride 16x, providing 4x more spatial tokens at identical parameter count; (ii) a lightweight ConvNeXt-512 reconstruction decoder with PixelShuffle upsampling that reduces pretraining VRAM by 7.5-8.5% per GPU relative to a UNet-128 baseline while matching its accuracy; and (iii) an empirical characterization of FP16 mixed-precision pretraining instability in the standard SparK UNet-768 decoder on S1GRD data, complemented by a finding that finetuning with layer-wise learning rate decay (LLRD) improves downstream performance of pretrained encoders. On four Copernicus-Bench S1GRD tasks, our finetuned 27.8M-parameter ConvNeXt-RS encoder improves over a non-pretrained baseline by +4.7, +5.0, +5.8, and +1.4 pp on EuroSAT-S1, BigEarthNet-S1, DFC2020-S1, and Flood-S1 respectively, and outperforms the Copernicus-FM ViT (139M parameters, frozen) on three of four tasks at roughly 5x fewer parameters. A pretraining data-scaling study reveals task-dependent data efficiency: classification saturates with as little as 10-25% of the SSL4EO-S12 v1.1 corpus, while dense prediction continues to improve significantly up to 25-50%. The study also includes a CKA representation analysis and a geographic de-collision experiment.

</details>


### [92] [Visual Sanad: Auditing Vision-Language Models for False Acceptance of Qur'anic Citations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22009)
*Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi,Reyana Shahid,Evan Maksud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Visual Sanad 基准，用 2,400 张不同视觉排版的《古兰经》经文—参考文献配对图像，检验视觉语言模型是否会错误接受错误的经文归属，发现闭源模型与开源模型间存在明显的能力分化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地用于解读宗教、教育及文化敏感的视觉内容，但其在引文核验上的可靠性尚未被充分研究；尤其是当同一引文—参考文献对以不同视觉框架呈现时，模型是否存在"自证式"误接受尚不清楚。

Method: 构建受控基准 Visual Sanad：基于 100 条英文《古兰经》经文，每条经文设 4 种事实状态、6 种视觉条件（从纯文本到装饰化与权威化排版），共生成 2,400 张渲染图像；所有引文—参考文献对在渲染前经来源核查与人工审核；共进行 24 组完整模型—提示词运行。

Result: 观察到显著的能力分化：闭源 API 视觉语言模型从近乎完美的引文核验到中等程度的错误接受不等；较新的开源权重模型往往区分能力弱，在多数图像上默认判为 VALID。去偏提示可降低错误接受率，但多以决策阈值向 INVALID 偏移为代价，而非真正提升引文辨别能力。

Conclusion: Visual Sanad 揭示了一种根植于文化语境的多模态事实性失效：流畅的视觉语言模型在缺乏强引文核验能力时，倾向于把呈现出来的宗教引文当作自证有效。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret religious, educational, and culturally sensitive visual content, yet their reliability on citation verification remains underexplored. We introduce Visual Sanad, a controlled benchmark for testing whether VLMs falsely accept incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when the same quote-reference pair is rendered under different visual framings. The benchmark contains 2,400 rendered images built from 100 English Qur'an verses, four factual states per verse, and six visual conditions ranging from plain text to decorative and authority-framed layouts. All quote-reference pairs were source-checked and human-audited before rendering. Across 24 full model-prompt runs, we observe a sharp capability split. Proprietary API-served VLMs range from near-perfect citation verification to moderate false acceptance, whereas recent open-weight VLMs often show weak discrimination and default to VALID on most images. De-biased prompting can reduce false acceptance, but often by shifting the decision threshold toward INVALID rather than by producing strong citation discrimination. Visual Sanad therefore exposes a culturally grounded multimodal factuality failure: fluent VLMs may treat displayed religious citations as self-authenticating unless they have strong citation-verification ability.

</details>


### [93] [When Models Misread Ink: Auditing VLMs for Arabic Calligraphy Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22018)
*Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi,Evan Maksud,Reyana Shahid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文构建含1,195张图像、六类阿拉伯书法笔体的基准，审计12个视觉语言模型（VLM），发现最佳数值提示准确率仅60.9%（闭源/API）与47.2%（开放权重）；核心失败模式为"默认标签坍缩"（单一标签占33–63%预测，多数类基线18.8%），提示策略效果不均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯书法对相关社群具有高度文化重要性，但现有VLM评测很少检验其细粒度的书体传统差异。作者将其作为紧凑、文化扎根的VLM鲁棒性压力测试，用以衡量哪些视觉传统能被自动化系统"读懂"（legible）。

Method: 在清洗后的六分类基准（1,195张图像）上审计12个VLM，采用三类提示：数值型（numeric）、视觉线索型（visual-cue）、Diwani优先型（Diwani-first）；均为闭集设置，并对比闭源/API模型与开放权重模型，分析预测标签分布与默认坍缩现象。

Result: 最佳数值提示准确率为60.9%（闭源/API）与47.2%（开放权重）。主要失败为默认标签坍缩：所有数值型运行中单一标签占33–63%的预测，而多数类基线仅18.8%；12个模型中有8个的默认标签为Thuluth；GPT-4o将52.9%的图像判为Thuluth，而该类别仅占18.1%。提示效果不均：视觉线索使部分模型提升超10个百分点，却使另一些模型下降；将Diwani置于前景往往只是"迁移"默认标签而非消除它。

Conclusion: 阿拉伯书法识别可作为VLM鲁棒性与文化可读性的紧凑压力测试；当前模型在该任务上存在系统性标签先验偏置，提示工程只能部分缓解，需针对细粒度文化视觉传统改进评测与建模。

Abstract: Arabic calligraphy is a high-stakes cultural visual domain for Muslim communities, yet VLM evaluations rarely test its fine-grained script traditions. We audit 12 VLMs on a cleaned 1,195-image six-way benchmark using numeric, visual-cue, and Diwani-first prompts. In this closed-set setting, the best numeric-prompt accuracy is 60.9% for closed/API models and 47.2% for open-weight models. The main failure is default-label collapse: every numeric run is dominated by a single label taking 33-63% of predictions, against an 18.8% majority-class baseline. For 8 of 12 models the default is Thuluth; GPT-4o labels 52.9% of all images as Thuluth although it is only 18.1% of the set. Prompting helps unevenly: visual cues move accuracy by more than 10 points for some models but hurt others, and foregrounding Diwani often relocates the default rather than removing it. Arabic calligraphy recognition is therefore a compact, culturally grounded stress test for VLM robustness and for measuring which visual traditions become legible to automated systems.

</details>


### [94] [FeaTok: Feature-Loss Tokenization for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22060)
*Zhang Xiaofeng,Samuel Lavoie,Nicolas Beltran-Velez,Jianhao Yuan,Felix Friedrich,Jakob Verbeek,Aaron Courville,Michal Drozdzal,Adriana Romero-Soriano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出特征损失分词（FeaTok），让离散图像分词器通过重建预训练特征而非像素来训练，从而提升离散生成器的建模性能与质量-计算帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散图像生成器学习的是分词器输出的token分布，因此token表示本身应当易于生成模型建模，而不仅是能忠实重建图像。但现有分词器普遍以像素重建为目标训练，优先保证低层保真度，可能破坏对生成有用的表示结构。

Method: 受特征预测式自监督学习启发，FeaTok将离散token的训练目标由重建像素改为重建预训练特征；在SigLIP、SigLIP2、DINOv2、DINOv3上进行消融，验证该目标对生成性能的影响。

Result: 在四类特征骨干上的消融均显示FeaTok带来更好的生成性能。类条件生成中，FeaTok推进了质量-计算帕累托前沿：256×256下gFDr6相比最强离散基线最多降低29%，并以少38倍的采样计算量超过最强无引导连续基线（RAEv2）。此外，在未经奖励训练的情况下，其人类偏好奖励模型得分高于先前工作；预训练后仅需500次微调更新，即在三个基准上超过连续与离散的文本条件基线。

Conclusion: 生成导向的分词目标（重建特征而非像素）能显著改善离散生成的效率与质量，FeaTok在类条件与文本条件生成上均优于现有离散及连续基线。

Abstract: Discrete image generators learn the distribution of tokens produced by an image tokenizer. These token representations should be easy for generators to model, not merely enable faithful image reconstruction. Yet these tokenizers are commonly trained to reconstruct pixels, which prioritizes low-level fidelity and may disrupt representation structure useful for generation. Motivated by feature-predictive self-supervised learning, we introduce feature-loss tokenization (FeaTok), which trains discrete tokens by reconstructing pretrained features rather than pixels. Ablations across SigLIP, SigLIP2, DINOv2, and DINOv3 show better generative performance with FeaTok. In class-conditional generation, FeaTok advances the quality-compute Pareto frontier, reducing gFDr6 at 256x256 by up to 29 percent over the strongest discrete baselines and outperforming the strongest unguided continuous baseline (RAEv2) with 38 times less sampling compute. FeaTok also achieves higher human-preference reward-model scores than prior art without reward-based training and surpasses continuous and discrete text-conditional baselines on three benchmarks with only 500 fine-tuning updates after pre-training.

</details>


### [95] [Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22070)
*Zhuoming Liu,Jinhong Lin,Lin Zhang,Yiwu Zhong,Yin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MaLoW提出将流式视频历史上下文内部化为递推HyperNetwork生成的轻量LoRA权重更新，使"历史存于权重、当前观测作为输入"，从而避免历史记忆与当前观测争抢有限上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式VLM需持续整合历史信息并对当前观测与用户查询保持响应，但现有记忆机制（压缩、检索、缓存）会把历史重新注入输入上下文，导致历史记忆与当前观测在有限上下文窗口中相互竞争。

Method: 用递推（recurrent）HyperNetwork将陆续到来的视频观测增量式整合为固定尺寸的LoRA权重，历史信息以参数形式前向传递、无需回访完整视频流；同时构建MaLoW-Instruct大规模流式视频数据集（56K视频、381K问答对）支持训练。

Result: 在OVO-Bench、StreamingBench、StreamArena上表现强劲；OVO-Bench backward子集上较先前记忆方法在不同视频骨干下提升3.9%–11.8%，仅带来适度延迟开销；并可泛化到视觉-语言-动作模型，在Simpler WidowX上动作成功率提升9.3%。

Conclusion: 以权重承载历史、以输入承载当下的参数化记忆范式可有效缓解流式VLM的上下文竞争问题，并在流式视频理解与具身动作任务上展现良好效果与可迁移性。

Abstract: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.

</details>


### [96] [Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22075)
*Madhav Iyengar,Andreas Geiger,Hilde Kühne*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将深度循环（depth recurrence）改造引入预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）：剪枝语言骨干部分层并对剩余层做循环，配合线性适配器与三阶段恢复训练，在减少23.3%语言参数的同时超越同数据训练的未剪枝基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作证明深度循环可后插入预训练语言模型，本文希望把这一范式迁移到视觉理解任务上，用深度循环降低预训练VLM的参数量，同时尽量保持或提升性能。

Method: 对VLM语言骨干剪枝部分层，并对剩余层的子集进行循环；循环每步用线性适配器将该块输出与前面层的token表示融合，再投影回该块。因剪枝损害原模型性能，提出三阶段恢复训练：（1）语言-only预训练恢复语言骨干；（2）对齐视觉-语言投影器；（3）通过视觉指令微调做全参数微调。第一与第三阶段将预训练非循环模型的输出蒸馏到循环模型中。在TinyLLaVA-1.4B骨干上评估，改造过程不引入新的视觉语言数据。

Result: 改造后的循环模型在相同恢复数据下优于未剪枝基线，语言参数少23.3%；该改造式循环优于“把循环LM转换为VLM”的方案；消融显示循环间适配器、更大的循环块等设计带来性能提升；模型在推理类基准上获益，基础视觉理解基准与基线持平。

Conclusion: 深度循环可以作为降低VLM语言参数量的有效手段，配合适配器融合与三阶段蒸馏式恢复训练，可在不新增视觉语言数据的情况下实现参数更少且整体不劣于基线、并在推理类任务上更优的模型。

Abstract: Recent work shows that depth recurrence can be retrofitted into pretrained language models. In this work, we adapt this paradigm for visual understanding, using depth recurrence to reduce the parameter footprint of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). To this end, we prune layers from the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. At each step of the loop, a linear adapter merges the block's output with the token representations from the preceding layers and projects the fused representation back into the block. As the pruning impacts the original model performance, we propose a three-stage recovery training: first, we leverage a language-only pretraining to recover the performance of the language backbone, followed by an alignment of the vision-language projector, and a full fine-tuning of the model via visual instruction tuning. In the first and the last stage, we distill the outputs of the pretrained non-recurrent model into the recurrent model, which further improves the recovery. We evaluate the proposed approach on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone without introducing any new vision-language data during retrofitting. Our experiments demonstrate that the retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline trained with the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters. We further show that the proposed retrofitting recurrence outperforms the setup of converting a recurrent LM into a VLM on the same data. Additionally, our ablations show how design choices, such as the adapter between recurrences and a larger recurrent block, lead to the improved performance of our approach. Finally, we find that our proposed model gains on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas its performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline.

</details>


### [97] [Pathology foundation models for training-free case retrieval in salivary gland tumors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22087)
*Maximilian J. Roesel,Niklas Kiermeyer,Philipp Keyl,Frederick Klauschen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需任务特定训练的基于内容的病理图像检索方法：病理学家用全切片图像的感兴趣区域检索数字化档案中形态相似的病例（含ICD-O编码），评估四种病理基础模型在137例唾液腺肿瘤12类不平衡数据上的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理模式识别依赖长期训练形成的参照框架，面对罕见癌亚型仍显不足；既往已诊断肿瘤档案中存在可用先例，但检索最相关病例困难。作者试图以内容检索扩展个体参照框架至科室集体经验，辅助罕见癌诊断。

Method: 对全切片图像取ROI（可手动选择，或用门控注意力多示例学习模型自动选取），以ROI为查询在数字化档案中检索形态相似病例及其ICD-O编码与WSI。在137例唾液腺肿瘤（12个ICD-O形态类别、类别不平衡）上做留一病例交叉验证，比较Atlas2、Atlas2-B、Atlas2-S与UNI2h四种病理基础模型，并提出改进的Chamfer相似度用于候选匹配排序。

Result: Top-1/3/5检索准确率：Atlas2 62.5%/76.7%/81.3%，UNI2h 50.2%/66.6%/72.9%，Atlas2-B 52.3%/71.5%/77.6%，Atlas2-S 54.4%/65.2%/73.7%。在样本数≥10的五个类别上，宏平均F1从Atlas2-S的69.0%到Atlas2的76.6%。改进Chamfer相似度在Top-5中区分正确与错误匹配的能力，Atlas2（AUC 0.754）显著优于Atlas2-B（0.679，p=0.020）与Atlas2-S（0.653，p=0.003），与UNI2h（0.697，p=0.196）无显著差异。

Conclusion: 该方法无需额外训练或人工标注，即可用病理基础模型使科室档案可检索，为基于病例的鉴别诊断提供低门槛途径，并将个体参照框架扩展为科室集体经验；模型规模与检索性能正相关，相似度度量对候选可靠性判断有影响。

Abstract: In pathology, pattern recognition relies on a frame of reference built through extensive training and experience, which may still fall short when encountering rare cancer subtypes. Archives of previously diagnosed tumors often contain relevant precedents, yet identifying the most relevant cases remains challenging. Here we explore whether content-based retrieval with current pathology foundation models facilitates rare cancer diagnostics without any task-specific training. Pathologists can query a digitized archive using a region of interest (ROI) from a whole slide image (WSI) and retrieve morphologically similar cases, along with their ICD-O codes and corresponding WSIs. The ROI can be selected manually or automatically using a gated attention-based multiple instance learning model. We evaluate our approach by leave-one-case-out on an imbalanced dataset of 137 salivary gland tumor cases spanning 12 ICD-O morphology categories, comparing four pathology foundation models (Atlas2, Atlas2-B, Atlas2-S, and UNI2h). Top-1/3/5 retrieval was 62.5%/76.7%/81.3% for Atlas2, 50.2/66.6/72.9% for UNI2h, 52.3%/71.5%/77.6% for Atlas2-B and 54.4/65.2/73.7% for Atlas2-S. Macro-averaged F1 ranged from 69.0% for the smallest model Atlas2-S to 76.6% for the largest model Atlas2 across the five classes with at least ten cases. Our modified Chamfer similarity separated correct from incorrect matches among the Top-5 more reliably for Atlas2 (AUC 0.754) than for Atlas2-B (0.679, p = 0.020) and Atlas2-S (0.653, p = 0.003), but not UNI2h (0.697, p = 0.196). Requiring no additional training or manual annotation, this approach makes departmental archives searchable with pathology foundation models, providing a low-barrier route to case-based differential diagnosis and extending the individual frame of reference to the collective experience of the department.

</details>


### [98] [Beyond the Dominant Label: Recovering Coexisting Lesion Evidence with Multiple Instance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22091)
*Lubin Gan,Jing Zhang,Xinming Zhang,Chengpeng Xu,Siying Wu,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文将"弱监督仅标注最严重诊断"的整张切片场景形式化为支配标签多实例学习（dominant-label MIL），提出 DomSet-MIL 框架以对齐包级与实例级的标注机制，在保持主诊断预测 SOTA 的同时更好恢复潜在共病病灶证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 整张切片图像常同时存在多种病灶，但弱监督只提供最严重的那一个诊断。标准多类 MIL 把该标签当作完整 one-hot 描述，一旦主病灶与次要病灶共存，就会压制低严重度证据，造成标注机制与建模假设不匹配。

Method: DomSet-MIL 为标签感知框架，含三部分：(1) 支配标签删失似然（Dominant-Label Censored Likelihood），将报告诊断视为潜在病灶集合中最大严重度元素的删失观测，不断言未报告病灶不存在；(2) 严重度有序残差路由（Severity-Ordered Residual Routing），按严重度从高到低分配 patch 证据，并为次要发现保留残差支持；(3) top-q 池化，将局部路由得分与包级预测关联。

Result: 在自然与受控实验设置下，DomSet-MIL 在支配标签预测上达到 SOTA，并更有效地恢复潜在的共病病灶证据。

Conclusion: 对支配标签生成机制的显式建模，可在不牺牲临床有意义次要发现的前提下提升诊断预测性能。

Abstract: Whole-slide images may contain coexisting lesions, yet weak supervision typically provides only the most severe diagnosis. We formulate this setting as dominant-label multiple instance learning, where the observed label is the maximum-severity element of a latent lesion set. Standard multiclass MIL treats it as a complete one-hot description and therefore suppresses lower-severity evidence whenever it co-occurs with a dominant lesion. We propose DomSet-MIL, a label-aware framework that aligns the annotation mechanism across bag and instance levels. Dominant-Label Censored Likelihood models the reported diagnosis without declaring unreported lesions absent. Severity-Ordered Residual Routing assigns patch evidence from high to low severity and preserves residual support for secondary findings, while top-$q$ pooling links local routing scores to bag prediction. Experiments across natural and controlled settings show that DomSet-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in dominant-label prediction while more effectively recovering latent coexisting-lesion evidence. These findings demonstrate that modeling the dominant-label mechanism can improve diagnostic prediction without sacrificing clinically meaningful secondary findings.

</details>


### [99] [SCCL-DT: Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning with Dual-Rule Teacher Distillation for Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22094)
*Ting Liu,Haoran Lai,HaobinChen,Ming Liu,S Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出语义冲突感知对比学习（SCCL）：用EMA统计自适应阈值硬掩码假负样本，并通过双向跨模态排名蒸馏得到可部署学生模型SCCL-DT，在5个胸片数据集上零样本AUC均值0.850（基线0.837）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准对比式视觉-语言预训练把批内所有非对角图文对视为负样本，但放射学中不同患者常出现相同征象，实例不匹配不等于语义不相容，从而产生"语义冲突"式的假负监督；固定阈值会随相似度分布漂移而失准，软重加权又残留排斥梯度。

Method: 用EMA跟踪模态专属的相似度分布并导出自适应阈值，在softmax归一化前对判定为候选假负的样本硬掩码；以OR（inclusive）与AND（consensus）两种规则构造两个SCCL教师，将其双向跨模态排名通过标准蒸馏整合为单一学生模型SCCL-DT；辅以训练轨迹审计验证在线掩码所选样本富含报告衍生的征象一致性（仅为代理分析）。

Result: 在五个公开胸片基准上，SCCL-DT零样本平均AUC达0.850，优于最强基线0.837。

Conclusion: 自适应阈值加硬掩码可有效抑制语义假负监督，教师的双向排名蒸馏能够无损地整合为单一部署模型；但掩码依据的报告一致性仅为代理指标，尚不等同于临床等价性。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language pre-training supports zero-shot chest X-ray diagnosis, but standard objectives treat every off-diagonal image-report pair in a batch as a negative. In radiology, recurring findings across patients mean that instance mismatch need not imply semantic incompatibility, creating false-negative supervision that we term a semantic conflict. A training-trace audit shows that pair-observations selected by the online mask used during training are enriched for report-derived finding agreement, although this proxy analysis does not establish clinical equivalence. Fixed thresholds can become miscalibrated as similarity distributions evolve, while soft reweighting leaves residual repulsive gradients. We therefore propose Semantic-Conflict-Aware Contrastive Learning (SCCL), which tracks modality-specific similarity distributions with exponential-moving-average (EMA) statistics, derives adaptive thresholds, and hard-masks flagged candidates before softmax normalization. Inclusive (OR) and consensus (AND) rules define two SCCL teachers, whose bidirectional cross-modal rankings are consolidated through standard distillation into a single deployable student, SCCL-DT. Across five public chest X-ray benchmarks, SCCL-DT achieves a mean zero-shot AUC of $0.850$, compared with $0.837$ for the strongest evaluated baseline in our comparison. Code will be made publicly available soon.

</details>


### [100] [FALCON: FPGA-Accelerated Latency-Certifiable Occupancy Networks for Camera-Based Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22143)
*Haohua Que,Mingkai Liu,Handong Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FALCON——部署于AMD Kria KR260嵌入式FPGA的相机3D占用前端，通过PL周期可分析、推理实测包络与看门狗三层机制显式保证逐帧时延界；300k帧代理下全部在100ms+≤10.2ms内交付，尾延迟仅1.5–2.0倍中位数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 感知系统（如行人制动）需要的是每帧在截止期前交付，而非低平均时延；而商用边缘加速器因动态调度、OS抖动、热节流与资源争用只优化均值，其逐帧时延可测但不可界。

Method: 在KR260（空闲4.3W、推理峰值6.6W）上构建相机3D占用前端：PL计算做解析周期界；推理用100k帧轨迹测量包络；看门狗强制输出交付（迟到则发布上一帧并标记stale）。将DPU无法执行的视变换gather与双线性resize实现为固定trip-count的PL IP，并与软件参考数值对齐。截止期实验用固定工作量代理：每帧6次ResNet-50 DPU推理。

Result: 三次100k帧强制运行中，全部300k代理帧在100ms截止期加至多10.2ms内输出。完整六相机FlashOcc流水线约1.3s/帧，尚未达10Hz。Occ3D-nuScenes验证集上mIoU 29.88，为DPU无法运行的FP32基线的92.8%。100k帧ResNet-50探针下KR260尾延迟为中位数1.5倍（代理为2.0倍），Jetson Orin为4.4倍，最差数据中心GPU（NVIDIA L4）为23.6倍。

Conclusion: 逐帧时延可通过分层显式设计在商用嵌入式FPGA上获得可度量的界，并显著优于GPU类加速器的尾延迟表现；但完整占用网络端到端仍需进一步优化以满足10Hz实时性。部署配方、HLS源码与原始时延轨迹已开源。

Abstract: A perception system that must brake for a pedestrian does not need a low average latency. It must deliver an answer before the deadline on every frame, the worst case included. Commodity edge accelerators optimize the mean through dynamic scheduling, OS jitter, thermal throttling, and contention, so their per-frame latency can be measured but not bounded. We build FALCON, a camera-based 3D occupancy front-end on the AMD Kria KR260, an embedded FPGA drawing 4.3 W idle and up to 6.6 W under inference, and make the latency guarantee layered and explicit: programmable-logic (PL) compute is cycle-bounded analytically; inference is a measured envelope over 100k-frame traces; and a watchdog enforces output delivery, publishing the previous output flagged stale when a frame is late. The deadline runs use a fixed-work proxy of six ResNet-50 DPU inferences per frame, not the full occupancy network: across three 100k-frame enforced runs, all 300k proxy frames delivered an output within the 100 ms deadline plus at most 10.2 ms, the worst of the three runs. The full six-camera FlashOcc pipeline composes to about 1.3 s per frame on the board and is not yet a 10 Hz system. The two operations the DPU cannot run, a view-transform gather and a bilinear resize, become fixed-trip-count PL IPs numerically matched to their software references. On the full Occ3D-nuScenes validation set the board reaches mIoU 29.88, 92.8% of an FP32 baseline the DPU cannot run. On a ResNet-50 probe over 100k frames the KR260 tail stays within 1.5 times its median (2.0 times for the six-inference proxy), where Jetson Orin reaches 4.4 times and the worst datacenter GPU run (NVIDIA L4) 23.6 times. The deployment recipe, HLS sources, and raw timing traces are released.

</details>


### [101] [Motion- and Gravity-Aware Feedforward 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22177)
*Shiyao Qian,Yuan Ren,Dongfeng Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种在LUPI范式下的运动与重力感知框架，训练时以残差光流和重力方向作为特权信息注入前馈Transformer骨干，推理时仅用标准视觉输入，在动态场景下提升多视图3D重建精度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈Transformer多视图3D重建方法主要依赖外观注意力，在存在动态物体、几何线索薄弱的场景中表现不佳；同时希望在不增加测试时开销的前提下引入运动与物理先验。

Method: 采用Learning Using Privileged Information范式：训练阶段将残差光流与重力方向作为特权信号，通过轻量的架构改动注入Transformer骨干以引导几何表征学习；推理阶段模型仅使用标准视觉输入，保持前馈效率。并针对不同骨干分析最优注入阶段。

Result: 在标准基准上重建精度与鲁棒性均取得一致提升，尤其在含动态物体、结构歧义及困难相机运动的场景中更明显。消融/分析表明最优注入阶段依赖骨干：VGGT通常适合中层注入，π3则更适合后期阶段注入。

Conclusion: LUPI为前馈3D重建提供了一种实用途径，可在不增加测试时复杂度的前提下注入运动与物理先验，且注入阶段需视骨干结构而定。

Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have recently achieved strong performance in multi-view 3D reconstruction, but they still rely primarily on appearance-based attention and often struggle in dynamic scenes with weak geometric cues. In this work, we introduce a motion- and gravity-aware framework under the Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) paradigm. During training, residual optical flow and gravity direction are provided as privileged signals to guide geometric representation learning; during inference, the model uses standard visual inputs only.
  We integrate these priors into transformer backbones with lightweight architectural changes, preserving feed-forward efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show consistent gains in reconstruction accuracy and robustness, especially in scenes with dynamic objects, ambiguous structure, and challenging camera motion. Our analysis further shows that the optimal injection stage is backbone-dependent: middle-layer integration is generally preferable for VGGT, while late-stage integration is more effective for π3. These results suggest that LUPI offers a practical way to inject motion and physical priors into feed-forward 3D reconstruction without increasing test-time complexity.

</details>


### [102] [LAMP: Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors for Training-Free Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22182)
*Zhipeng Ye,Feng Jiang,Qiufeng Wang,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAMP 是一个免训练框架，通过按层自适应混合不同编码器层上的全局与区域预测器，实现少样本分类的互补特征利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本适配通常只依赖编码器的最终全局表示，中间层的互补信息被浪费；而直接融合中间层特征又面临维度不一致、各任务下有效性差异大的困难。

Method: 提出 LAMP：单次前向为每个视图提供所有描述子；全局预测器与经支持集校准的区域核预测器分别拟合同一标签残差，利用带标签验证数据在类得分空间选择混合权重，从而保留原生特征维度、无需学习投影。LAMP-F 进一步自适应文本锚定的类原型，用缓存响应精确更新固定核残差预测。

Result: 在 11 个数据集、ViT 与 ResNet 骨干上评估：LAMP 在 4/8/16-shot 下取得对比的已发表免训练 ResNet-50 方法中最佳平均准确率，16-shot 达 78.73%；五个支持集预算平均下，相对仅用全局特征的配对基线分别提升 1.14 与 1.59 个百分点（ViT-B/16、ResNet-50），LAMP-F 提升至 1.96 与 2.54 个百分点，16-shot 准确率分别为 83.57% 与 79.10%。

Conclusion: 消融实验表明多层整合是主要增益来源，并分析了池化、校准、验证标签与计算开销；结合各层特定预测可有效利用冻结编码器的互补特征提升少样本分类。

Abstract: Few-shot adaptation often relies on an encoder's final global representation, leaving complementary information in intermediate layers underused. Combining these features is challenging because their dimensions can differ and their usefulness varies across tasks. We propose LAMP, Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors, a training-free framework that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers. A single forward pass per view supplies all descriptors. Global and support-calibrated regional kernel predictors independently fit the same label residuals. Labeled validation data select their mixture in class-score space, preserving native feature dimensions without learned projections. LAMP-F further adapts text-anchored class prototypes, using a cached response to update the fixed-kernel residual predictions exactly. Experiments cover eleven datasets and ViT and ResNet backbones. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared published training-free ResNet-50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. Averaged across five support budgets, LAMP improves over a paired global-feature-only baseline by 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points on ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. LAMP-F reaches 16-shot accuracies of 83.57% and 79.10%, respectively. Controlled experiments identify multi-layer integration as the main source of improvement and examine pooling, calibration, validation labels, and computational cost. These findings show that combining layer-specific predictions can exploit complementary features from frozen encoders to improve few-shot classification.

</details>


### [103] [EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22186)
*Jiapeng Shi,Qiuxia Hou,Jiaqi Leng,Junke Wang,Yanhao Zhang,Haonan Lu,Ziyi Ye,Zuxuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EVA-Cap 框架，将音视频字幕分解为原子事件，通过 SFT 与 GRPO 实现事件中心对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态语言模型将音视频视频字幕视为无结构文本生成，忽视视频内在语义结构，导致细粒度音视频对齐不佳。

Method: 将字幕分解为原子音视频事件，把无结构文本监督转为事件中心对齐；在自建数据集 EVA-Data（带事件中心质量控制）上先做 SFT，再做 GRPO，并针对三个事件中心目标优化：全局事件完整性、事件内归因、事件间同步性。

Result: 在事件中心评测上显著优于现有方法（ChronusAV 平均提升 9.0%），在通用音视频字幕基准上具竞争力（WorldSense +3.3%）。

Conclusion: 事件中心的分解与对齐优化可有效提升音视频字幕的细粒度对齐能力，且不损害通用性能。

Abstract: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).

</details>


### [104] [OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22200)
*Hanzhang Zhou,Long Li,Quyu Kong,Lei Wang,Panrong Tong,Long Chen,Tianyu Xia,Gongjie Zhang,Xu Zhang,Chen Liu,Jianan Zhang,Chenglin Cai,Zhengwen Zeng,Steven Hoi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出开放全栈通用计算机使用智能体项目OpenGCUA首个版本，以代码执行为核心并引入"harness-to-model决策迁移"，在OSWorld-v2上使8个模型平均部分得分提升19.6分、每任务步骤减少53.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用正从纯GUI交互扩展到通过视觉与编程接口完成任务的系统，但前沿实现（如GPT-6 Astra的计算机使用系统）基本闭源，缺乏对设计要素的系统性研究，因此需要开放全栈以支持社区共建与可复现研究。

Method: 将通用计算机使用智能体（GCUA）定义为模型自主选择观察方式、行动方式并在视觉与编程接口间组织工作的系统；以代码执行作为关键设计特性，使中间结果驱动后续操作并直接复用模型既有编程能力；同时提出harness-to-model决策迁移，将部分观察与任务状态决策从固定harness规则转移到模型自身。

Result: 在OSWorld-v2上，完整配置对全部8个被评估模型（含GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5）均提升任务得分，平均部分得分+19.6，每任务报告步骤相较批处理式纯GUI执行平均减少53.0%；在真实macOS任务上，Qwen3.8-Max的报告推理token量约为GPT-6 Astra的19.4倍，显示真实设备执行效率的模型差异显著。

Conclusion: 开源发布实现与提示词、8个模型的评测轨迹，以及真实设备harness与跨设备SDK的初步版本：harness应对基准未覆盖的真实设备挑战，SDK为计算机、移动端与浏览器提供统一编程接口；项目为持续演进的开放全栈GCUA研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.

</details>


### [105] [MagiC: Evaluating Multimodal Cognition Toward Grounded Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.07297)
*Chengfei Wu,Ronald Seoh,Bingxuan Li,Liqiang Zhang,Fengrong Han,Dan Goldwasser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MagiC基准，用于评测视觉语言模型的"有据多模态认知"，同时考察答案正确性、逐步推理质量与视觉证据对齐，并对15个7B–70B模型进行四维诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在VQA和多模态推理上表现亮眼，但尚不清楚其是否真正基于视觉证据进行推理，还是依赖表层模式与数据集偏差；已有评测多只关注最终答案，缺乏对推理过程与视觉接地质量的系统评估。

Method: 构建MagiC基准：约5,500条由强模型输出生成的弱监督QA样本，以及900条人工精标样本（含答案、推理依据rationale与边界框接地标注）。对15个7B–70B参数的视觉语言模型，从四个维度评估：最终答案正确性、推理有效性、接地保真度、自我纠错能力；并设置对抗性视觉线索的诊断场景以考察鲁棒性与内省式纠错。提出MagiScore与StepSense等新指标。

Result: 给出15个模型的四维评测结果与诊断分析，揭示当前方法在有据视觉推理上的关键局限；具体数值未在摘要中给出。

Conclusion: 现有LVLM在接地视觉推理方面仍存在明显不足，仅凭答案准确率不足以反映真实推理能力；MagiC及配套指标为过程级、证据对齐的评测提供了可行框架，并指出改进机会。

Abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models have led to impressive performance in visual question answering and multimodal reasoning. However, it remains unclear whether these models genuinely perform grounded visual reasoning or rely on superficial patterns and dataset biases. In this work, we introduce MagiC, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate grounded multimodal cognition, assessing not only answer accuracy but also the quality of step-by-step reasoning and its alignment with relevant visual evidence. Our benchmark includes approximately 5,500 weakly supervised QA examples generated from strong model outputs and 900 human-curated examples with fine-grained annotations, including answers, rationales, and bounding box groundings. We evaluate 15 vision-language models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters across four dimensions: final answer correctness, reasoning validity, grounding fidelity, and self-correction ability. MagiC further includes diagnostic settings to probe model robustness under adversarial visual cues and assess their capacity for introspective error correction. We introduce new metrics such as MagiScore and StepSense, and provide comprehensive analyses that reveal key limitations and opportunities in current approaches to grounded visual reasoning.

</details>


### [106] [TRACE: Topology-Aware Reconnection via Prediction-Adaptive Connectivity Enforcement for Thin-Structure Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22210)
*Junho Moon,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TRACE：一种拓扑感知、预测自适应的骨架目标函数，用目标骨架定义必需的局部连接，并在当前预测下为每条连接寻找最易实现的有效重连，对其瓶颈与对应骨架点联合监督；还引入保留前景与类特定拓扑的骨架载体。在6个2D/3D基准上提升连通性与拓扑质量，分割精度保持良好且训练开销低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细长结构对连通性错误极度敏感，少量局部分割错误即可打断本应连续的路径；而现有基于骨架的目标函数只监督固定的中心线位置，不考虑能恢复连通性的其他局部路径，监督僵化、缺乏适应性。

Method: TRACE为拓扑感知且预测自适应的目标函数：以目标骨架定义所需的局部连接；对每条连接，在当前的预测结果中识别最容易实现的有效重连路径，并将其瓶颈点与对应骨架点进行联合监督，使监督随预测演化而自适应，而非固定于中心线。另引入拓扑感知骨架载体，同时保留前景拓扑与类特定拓扑，以可靠定义上述连接。

Result: 在六个2D与3D基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TRACE在保持较强分割精度的同时改善了连通性与拓扑质量，且训练额外开销较低。

Conclusion: 将骨架监督从“固定中心线”转为“连接约束下的自适应瓶颈监督”是提升细长结构连通性与拓扑正确性的有效途径；拓扑感知骨架载体为其提供了可靠基础。代码将在接收后公开。

Abstract: Thin, elongated structures are particularly sensitive to connectivity errors, as even a few local segmentation mistakes can disrupt otherwise continuous paths. Existing skeleton-based objectives typically supervise fixed centerline locations and do not account for alternative local routes that may restore connectivity. We propose TRACE, a topology-aware, prediction-adaptive objective that uses a target skeleton to define required local connections. For each connection, TRACE identifies the easiest valid reconnection under the current prediction and jointly supervises its bottleneck with the corresponding skeleton point. The supervision thus adapts to the evolving prediction rather than remaining fixed to the centerline. We further introduce a topology-aware skeleton carrier that preserves both foreground and class-specific topology, enabling reliable definition of these connections. Extensive experiments across six 2D and 3D benchmarks show that TRACE improves connectivity and topology while maintaining strong segmentation accuracy with low training overhead. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [107] [FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22215)
*Daniel Grimm,J. Marius Zöllner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FutureLift：将多模态轨迹提案表示为异质未来图并进行单次双向残差修正的骨干无关精化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有精化器要么压缩完整提案、要么逐段顺序更新，导致完整未来提案无法作为显式关系上下文用于纠错；且不同预测骨干结构差异大，缺乏统一精化接口。

Method: 构建异质未来图：空间落地的时序节点与智能体历史、地图元素、备选模态及联合预测下其他智能体未来轨迹相连；采用双向时序边使后段证据可在单次前向中修正前段；更新后的节点回归坐标与置信度残差。仅需提案、分数与场景上下文，与骨干无关。

Result: 在Argoverse2与Waymo Open Motion Dataset上稳定提升冻结提案，在边缘与联合预测上优于原生及专用精化器；WOMD榜单标准输入方法中minADE 0.5049m、minFDE 0.9942m排名第一，Soft mAP 0.4874，且未使用LiDAR或集成。

Conclusion: 以未来图作为显式关系上下文、双向单遍修正的通用精化范式，可跨骨干一致增益，验证了全局关系建模相对压缩/顺序更新的优势。

Abstract: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.

</details>


### [108] [Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22217)
*Yuqi Xiong,Chunyi Peng,Zhipeng Xu,Qing Yang,Zhenghao Liu,Zulong Chen,Yu Gu,Ge Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SCOPED：先独立训练能力专精专家，再用奖励引导反思抽取显式技能，通过在策略蒸馏让学生模型内化这些能力，推理时无需显式技能，在八个多模态基准上优于基座与混合能力强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习可激发视觉语言模型（VLM）的专门视觉能力，但联合优化异构目标时易出现跨能力梯度冲突。独立训练专家虽可缓解干扰，但直接奖励优化会让专门知识纠缠奖励黑客偏差。

Method: SCOPED（Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation）：1）分别训练能力特定专家；2）通过奖励引导反思抽取显式技能；3）在策略蒸馏中，显式技能仅用于指导专家监督，不对统一学生模型可见，迫使学生内化程序性知识，推理阶段不使用显式技能。

Result: 在八个多模态基准上持续优于基座模型与混合能力强化学习方法。分析表明：联合能力优化存在干扰；技能增强可促进更一致的专家轨迹、更强关注任务相关视觉证据，并在统一学生中更好保留专门专长。

Conclusion: 技能解耦的在策略专家蒸馏可有效整合独立获得的多项能力，为缓解异构目标梯度冲突与奖励黑客偏差提供可行方案；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.

</details>


### [109] [How Much Physics Can Vision Learn from Audio? Probing and Distilling Damping Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22221)
*Zainab Afolabi,Vadim Selyutin,Zhao Gao,Babs Khalidson,Mohamed Ghoneim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文探究材料阻尼（以品质因数 Q 度量）在音频与视觉表征中的可推断性，发现音频编码器可强有力地排序 Q（Spearman ρ=0.73），单帧 CLIP 仅 0.28；并通过将冻结音频教师蒸馏至冻结 CLIP 骨干的投影头，在留一材料协议下将四帧视觉输入的 ρ 从 0.234 提升至 0.338。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理属性理解对决策至关重要，但视觉模型难以推断阻尼等决定材料行为的属性。音频因记录撞击后的声学衰减而直接编码此类属性，故研究希望定位该信号的来源，并评估视觉能在多大程度上恢复这一优势。

Method: 以品质因数 Q 为探针目标，用 Spearman 秩相关 ρ 评价冻结编码器嵌入对撞击的排序能力；对比音频嵌入与 CLIP 单帧嵌入；再通过训练投影头将冻结音频教师蒸馏至冻结 CLIP 骨干；采用留一材料协议（被留出材料既不参与投影头训练也不参与探针训练）评估，并扩展为四帧跨撞击的视觉输入。

Result: 音频嵌入达 ρ=0.73，且在未见材料上仍保留大部分优势；CLIP 单帧仅 ρ=0.28。留一材料协议下，四帧蒸馏将相关从 0.234 提升至 0.338（相对匹配四帧基线 +0.053，17 种材料中 14 种获益），该增益无法由类别层面的策略产生；扩展至四帧在不损失声学性能的情况下贡献了约一半的改进。

Conclusion: 阻尼等物理属性在音频中表征更强；视觉可经音频蒸馏部分恢复该优势，且部分缺失信息源于单帧无法捕捉的可见动态，四帧输入即是佐证。留一材料协议揭示了池化相关被类别身份主导的问题，为更严谨的物理属性评估提供了方案。

Abstract: Physical understanding is crucial for decision making, yet vision models struggle to infer properties such as damping that govern how materials behave. Audio encodes such properties directly, because an object's acoustic response to impact reveals its damping through measurable decay. We probe frozen encoders for the quality factor $Q$, a dimensionless measure of how many oscillations an object completes before its ring dies away, and report how well each embedding orders impacts by $Q$ using the Spearman rank correlation $ρ$, for which $ρ=1$ is a perfect ordering and $ρ=0$ an unrelated one. Audio embeddings reach $ρ=0.73$ and retain most of that advantage on materials withheld from training, while a single video frame taken at the moment of impact, encoded by CLIP, supports only $ρ=0.28$. Having established where the signal lives, we ask how much of that gap vision can recover. We distill a frozen audio teacher into a frozen CLIP backbone through a trained projection head and find that this recovers a useful fraction of the audio advantage. Because pooled correlations on this task are dominated in practice by category identity, we also evaluate under a leave-one-material-out protocol in which the held-out material is withheld from the projection head as well as the probe. Distillation with a four-frame input improves the correlation there from 0.234 to 0.338 (+0.053 over the matched four-frame baseline, 14 of 17 materials), a gain that no category-level strategy can produce. Widening the visual input to four frames spanning the impact supplies half of that improvement at no acoustic cost, which indicates that part of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics.

</details>


### [110] [WaveLLM: Wavelet-Domain LLM Entropy Modeling for Lossless Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22232)
*Yue Yu,Bowei Kang,Changsheng Gao,Dong Liu,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WaveLLM：将图像分解为多级小波子带，把异构的熵建模问题转化为多个更同质、更可预测的子问题，配合数值接口与任务自适应提示，用LLM做无损图像压缩熵模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM无损压缩方法只强调模型容量，却直接把图像序列化为像素或残差序列，使异质信号模式纠缠在同一预测流中，影响可预测性与熵建模效果。作者认为有效熵建模不仅取决于模型容量，还取决于输入表示的可预测性。

Method: 基于小波域的多级子带分解，将异质预测问题拆成结构化、统计同质的子问题以适配自回归概率估计；设计数值接口（值嵌入+系数预测头）把数值编码符号桥接到LLM原生文本token空间；并引入任务自适应提示，使单一共享模型在统一框架下适配不同子带。骨干为Llama-3.2-3B，采用LoRA适配。

Result: 在Kodak、CLIC.pro、DIV2K上分别达到2.51、2.24、2.27 bpsp，较采用相同小波变换的PixelCNN类编解码器分别优0.43、0.36、0.46 bpsp，并在三个基准上均优于近期LLM类无损压缩器。

Conclusion: 通过提升输入表示的可预测性而非仅依赖模型容量，小波域表示结合LLM熵建模可显著提升无损图像压缩性能，且单一模型可统一处理多子带。

Abstract: Lossless image compression fundamentally relies on accurate entropy modeling, driving a recent shift toward large language model (LLM)-based methods. However, existing approaches mainly emphasize the modeling capacity of LLMs while directly serializing images into pixel or residual sequences, leaving heterogeneous signal patterns entangled within a single prediction stream. In this paper, we argue that effective entropy modeling depends not only on model capacity, but also on the predictability of the input representation. Motivated by this insight, we propose WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM-based entropy model for lossless image compression. By decomposing an image into multi-level wavelet subbands, WaveLLM converts a heterogeneous prediction problem into a set of more structured and statistically homogeneous subproblems that are more amenable to autoregressive probability estimation. To bridge numerical coding symbols with the LLM's native text token space, we introduce a dedicated numerical interface featuring value embeddings and a coefficient prediction head. Furthermore, a task-adaptive prompting strategy is designed to enable a single shared model to adapt to diverse subbands within a unified framework. Built on Llama-3.2-3B with LoRA adaptation, WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively, outperforming the PixelCNN-based codec using the same wavelet transform by 0.43, 0.36, and 0.46 bpsp, and surpassing recent LLM-based lossless compressors on all three benchmarks.

</details>


### [111] [MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22240)
*Huanyao Zhang,Jiepeng Zhou,Jiaye Lin,Ontai Tang,Jingtian Hao,Mugeng Liu,Ru Peng,Lang Mei,Xiaohan Yu,Liyan Liu,Chong Chen,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MMSearch-OPD，用可控数据精炼扩展推理链，并结合强化学习与在线策略蒸馏训练长时程多模态深度搜索智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态深度搜索正从短查询转向长时程、持续获取证据的调研式任务，但训练此类智能体受限于两问题：缺乏有挑战性的训练问题，以及缺少过程级反馈。

Method: 两条主线：(1) Refine数据管线——对现有简单多模态问题所衍生的推理链做定向扩展，通过参数化变换控制搜索深度与跨模态证据需求，同时复用已有图文问答对；(2) 训练——强化学习以答案奖励加轻量行为惩罚引导，在线策略蒸馏则以奖励差距调制token级教师指导，作用于学生不完美的轨迹，并采用指数衰减的蒸馏系数，随训练推进降低对教师的依赖。整体在SFT之后进行联合训练。

Result: 实验显示数据精炼带来性能提升，SFT后联合训练进一步提升，表明长时程多模态深度搜索能力增强。

Conclusion: 可控数据精炼与RL+OPD联合训练相结合，可在复用现有数据的前提下有效缓解训练数据与过程反馈不足，提升长时程多模态深度搜索能力。

Abstract: Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback.
  We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds.
  Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.

</details>


### [112] [FPG-Seg: Annotation-free Retinal Vessel Topology Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22259)
*James Willoughby,Irina Voiculescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FPG-Seg是一种无需人工标注的视网膜血管分割流程，结合经典血管性滤波、贝叶斯深度学习与拓扑感知图重建，在四个基准数据集上达到0.74-0.78的clDice，为全监督基线的86-98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优视网膜血管分割方法依赖大量人工标注，标注过程耗时且需临床专业知识，构成数据获取瓶颈。

Method: 提出FPG-Seg无标注流程：融合经典血管性滤波（vesselness filtering）生成伪标签/先验，贝叶斯深度学习提供不确定性建模，拓扑感知图重建（topology-aware graph reconstruction）以刻画血管拓扑结构；训练与超参数调优均不使用人工标注。

Result: 在四个常用视网膜血管分割基准数据集上取得clDice 0.74-0.78，相当于等效全监督基线性能的86-98%；并在FIVES数据集上给出首个无标注血管分割方法的性能基准。

Conclusion: 无标注流程可在不使用人工标注的条件下逼近全监督性能，验证了传统滤波、贝叶斯不确定性与拓扑图重建组合的有效性，并为无标注血管分割提供了可参考的基准。

Abstract: State-of-the art approaches to retinal vessel segmentation typically require extensive annotations, a highly time-consuming process, reliant on clinical expertise. We present FPG-Seg, an annotation-free pipeline for retinal vessel segmentation combining classical vesselness filtering, Bayesian deep learning and topology-aware graph reconstruction to segment retinal vessel topology without manual labels. Tested across four widely used benchmark datasets for retinal vessel segmentation, FPG-Seg attains a clDice of $0.74{-}0.78$, representing $86{-}98\%$ of the performance of an equivalent fully-supervised baseline, despite using no manual annotations for training or hyperparameter tuning. As part of this work, we also provide, to our knowledge, the first performance benchmark of an annotation-free vessel segmentation method on FIVES.

</details>


### [113] [SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22264)
*Yufei Jiao,Jinfa Huang,Zeyue Xue,Tianyu Xie,Yuexiao Ma,Rongrong Ji,Xiawu Zheng,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCOPE 是一种基于 GRPO 的目标函数，将更新权重与提示词中的语义片段（span）对齐，增强语言模型改写提示词以提升冻结 T2I 生成器的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 提示词改写方法将图像信号施加到单个子词 token 上，但对象、计数、属性、关系实际构成连贯的语义片段，token 级更新与语义结构不匹配。

Method: 改写器同时生成增强提示词及其语义划分；在每个 span 内对策略对数概率的变化做池化，得到该 span 内 token 损失共享的系数，同时保留每个 completion 的单一 advantage。方法无需独立 span 奖励，也无需额外图像渲染。

Result: 在 Qwen-Image、SD3、FLUX.1-dev 上，相较 vanilla GRPO，GeneVal 平均相对提升 9.48%，T2I-CompBench 提升 7.62%。消融显示语义边界与 span 内池化均有贡献。

Conclusion: 语义结构可作为 RL 提示词工程的有效归纳偏置。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.

</details>


### [114] [Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22267)
*Kwanyoung Lee,SeungJu Cha,Yebin Ahn,Sungho Koh,Dong-Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DetNO 将多样化 T2I 生成建模为初始噪声上的 RKHS 体积最大化，通过最大化一步 Tweedie 预测的 RBF Gram 矩阵对数行列式，配合锚点保真项与拉格朗日松弛，在无需训练和采样器修改的情况下提升批次多样性与下游合成数据增强效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强引导的 T2I 扩散采样会收敛到条件分布高密度模态，使独立噪声坍缩为近乎相同的视觉原型，限制需要分布覆盖度的任务（尤其合成数据增强）。多样性是整批集合的集体属性：集合可保持所有成对距离却仍坍缩到低维子空间，现有成对噪声优化与排斥目标对此高阶失效响应弱。

Method: 提出 DetNO：1）在初始噪声上做 RKHS 体积最大化，最大化基于一步 Tweedie 预测的 RBF Gram 矩阵的对数行列式，该集合级泛函等于批次体积平方，坍缩时排斥最强、多样性达成时自我衰减；2）引入基于锚点的保真项使噪声停留在合理区域；3）用拉格朗日松弛得到两项目标，以单一超参数 λ 控制多样性-质量权衡，无需训练或修改采样器。

Result: 在 SD1.5、SDXL、SD3 三个骨干上，DetNO 在 VendiScore 与 Mean Self-Similarity 的批内多样性指标上领先；下游少样本分类实验证实更广的模态覆盖在低样本场景带来统计显著的准确率提升。固定流程仅替换批次目标时，两种 RBF 聚合器均优于 InfoNCE，对数行列式在两个基准上取得最佳下游准确率；其相对 InfoNCE 的多样性优势随批次增大而扩大。

Conclusion: DetNO 以集合级体积目标有效缓解强引导下的模式坍缩，兼顾多样性与保真度，且具备即插即用、单超参数、无需训练的优势，下游合成数据增强收益显著。

Abstract: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.

</details>


### [115] [Unsupervised Clustering of Public Transport Vehicles Using Deep Morphological Features and Color Histograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22270)
*Juan Irving Vasquez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无监督聚类方法，将冻结的DINOv2形态特征与手工HSV颜色直方图按65%/35%加权早期融合，经UMAP降维与K-Means聚类，从大量无标注城市道路监控视频中将公交车按线路/车型分组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市道路监控摄像头产生大量无标注视频，可用于公共交通监测；但不同线路公交车车身结构相似、主要靠涂装配色区分，人工标注成本高，缺乏无监督的车辆分组手段。

Method: 融合两类特征：冻结的DINOv2 Vision Transformer提取的形态特征，与手工设计的HSV颜色直方图，采用加权早期融合；随后进行UMAP投影与K-Means聚类。在墨西哥城一条主干道约1,460小时视频中提取的7,972张公交图像上评估，目标是在无监督条件下分离出该市公共公交网络（RTP）的车辆；融合权重为65%形态特征+35%颜色特征。

Result: 该流程产生14个簇，可区分不同线路与车型；相较于仅使用形态特征，融合颜色特征后目标簇的精确率得到提升。

Conclusion: 颜色特征能够补充自监督特征以实现线路级聚类，前提是颜色不能在表征中占据主导地位；这验证了加权早期融合策略在无监督公共交通车辆分群中的有效性。

Abstract: Surveillance cameras along urban roads produce large volumes of unlabeled video that could support the monitoring of public transport, but grouping the observed vehicles into meaningful categories without manual annotation remains challenging, since buses from different routes often share the same body structure and differ mainly in their color schemes. This study presents an unsupervised clustering methodology for public transport vehicles that combines morphological features extracted with a frozen DINOv2 Vision Transformer and handcrafted HSV color histograms through weighted early fusion, followed by UMAP projection and K-Means clustering. The method was evaluated on 7,972 bus images extracted from about 1,460 hours of video of an arterial road in Mexico City, with the goal of isolating the buses of the city's public bus network (RTP) without supervision. With a fusion of 65\% morphological and 35\% color features, the pipeline produced 14 clusters that separate distinct routes and vehicle types, and it increased the precision of the target cluster with respect to morphological features alone. These results show that color complements self-supervised features for route-level clustering, provided that it does not dominate the representation.

</details>


### [116] [MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22276)
*Luozheng Qin,Yuhan Zhu,Changhai Zhou,Qian Qiao,Jun Gao,Yuhua Zhou,Harry Zhang,Xiangyu Zeng,Yuxuan Liu,Kaijie Chen,Andrew Chen,Pony Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MJev-Spatial，将三类空间理解任务（选择、数值、2D 点预测）统一为分类框架，用骨干预训练 query/key 投影对候选打分，无需新增参数，也不生成答案 token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间智能中的判断（空间关系、距离、放置位置）需在交互速率下完成，而 VLM 以自由文本自回归生成这些答案，输出空间本应紧凑（少数选项/标量/2D点），却付出解码与答案解析开销。

Method: 把每个候选视为一个类别，利用骨干预训练的 query 和 key 投影打分，不增加参数；选择任务候选为给定选项，数值与点预测通过粗到细分类使用数值分箱与图像区域。推理时每次分类决策仅一次前向、不生成 token。训练上对所有粗到细阶段用 teacher forcing 在一次前向中联合监督，并结合长度感知全局分批与跨 GPU 负载均衡。

Result: 基于 Qwen3.5-4B、在 12.3M 问答对上训练；八模型总体最高分 65.64%，12 个基准中 7 项第一，12 项全部超过未修改的自回归基座；速度比最快自回归基线快 2.5 倍、比基座快 5.6 倍；训练吞吐较原分批策略提升 30.8%。

Conclusion: 将空间理解建模为统一分类、"System 1"式单次前向决策，可在精度与延迟上同时优于自回归 VLM 范式，是空间智能高效推理的可行路线。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.

</details>


### [117] [Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22282)
*Qiuhong Shen,Yiding Yang,Yuxin Zhang,Xinwei Huang,Minxuan Lin,Bo Liu,Hao Kang,Haotian Yang,Yizhi Wang,Chongyang Ma,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RPO将注意力路由作为随机探索动作，在不改变原始确定性采样器的前提下实现强化学习对齐，训练效率较Flow-GRPO类方法提升近4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有score-function类RL方法通过在反向去噪轨迹上施加扰动引入随机性，需大量rollout，优化代价高昂；作者希望把随机探索内嵌于生成器内部，同时保持原有采样器不变。

Method: 在少数选定去噪层级上，将注意力路由设为随机动作：每个query block保留自身block，并按生成器原生注意力质量采样额外的key block（或保持稠密注意力）；采样的路由扰动该步速度场，用稠密速度附近的高斯似然以score-function目标打分。进一步采用受控双rollout估计：两次rollout共享prompt、初始隐变量、路由去噪层级和稠密锚定层，仅注意力路由不同，其奖励差给出路由转移的优势信号。因似然对稠密速度本身求导，路由移除后更新仍有效；推理时恢复稠密注意力并保留原确定性采样器。

Result: 在文本到图像与文本到视频生成任务上，RPO在提升生成质量的同时，训练效率比Flow-GRPO类方法高约4倍。

Conclusion: 以路由随机性替代轨迹扰动，可在保持原始采样器与推理结构不变的情况下实现高效奖励对齐，为视觉生成器的强化学习微调提供了低成本方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.

</details>


### [118] [Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22295)
*Jay N. Paranjape,Jurijs Nazarovs,Rohan Sarkar,Yue Guo,Lipeng Ke,Sankar Venkataraman,Vishal M. Patel,Nataraj Jammalamadaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition（GHADAR）任务，即给定视频中每个人的位置，描述其特征与活动；并构建基于AVA-Actions的新数据集（含开放集描述）、提出约束VLM跨注意力掩码的训练方法，以及整体性VLM评估方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多人视频数据集将问题简化为接地群体活动识别、单人活动识别或闭集活动识别，模型泛化性受限，难以满足真实场景对"描述视频中每个人特征与活动"的需求。

Method: 1）定义GHADAR任务：依据人物位置接地，输出每个人的属性描述与开放集活动描述；2）基于AVA-Actions生成人物描述与活动的开放集caption构建新数据集；3）训练时利用接地信息约束VLM中的cross-attention mask以提升性能；4）提出整体性VLM评估方案，直接在视频与生成预测之间比较概念，作为视频层面评估补充。

Result: 所提方法在该任务上优于SOTA视觉语言模型（VLM）；实验同时表明现有评估指标过度依赖人工标注与精确文本匹配，存在局限。

Conclusion: 工作构建了GHADAR的完整框架（数据集、新方法与评估方案），为该方向后续研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Understanding characteristics and activities of individuals in complex multi-person environments is crucial for real-world applications. However, existing datasets often simplify this problem to grounded group activity recognition, single-person activity recognition, or close-set activity recognition, thus limiting the generalizability of models trained on these datasets. In this work, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR), which involves describing the characteristics and activity descriptions of \textbf{every} person in a video, provided the location of the person in the video, which is more practical for real-world applications. To facilitate this, we introduce a new dataset derived from AVA-Actions by generating open-set captions for the person description and activity. In addition, we propose a novel method to effectively utilize the information contained in grounding during training by constraining the cross-attention masks during training in VLMs to improve performance for this task. Our experiments show that our method outperforms SOTA VLMs on this task. Finally, we demonstrate the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, which are overly reliant on human-annotations and exact text-text matching. As an added video-based evaluation, we propose a holistic VLM-based evaluation schema that compares concepts {\em directly} between the video and the generated predictions. Thus, in this work, we develop a complete framework for GHADAR, including a dataset, a novel method and an evaluation schema, thereby establishing a strong foundation for future research in this domain.

</details>


### [119] [ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22306)
*Girish Kumar Adari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ARC-SORT 是一个无需训练、可实时运行的检测驱动多目标跟踪器：用 IMM 卡尔曼滤波的预测协方差驱动逐轨迹自适应搜索区域（Expansion IoU），在轨迹交叉时基于分配代价不确定性做一次性纠错换 ID，离线重识别仅用外观关联；SportsMOT 测试集达 81.82 HOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体育广播场景的跟踪有两大难点：运动员高速且急变向，摄像机同时平移与缩放。现有跟踪器难以在剧烈运动与相机运动叠加下稳定关联，且需要训练或复杂模块。

Method: 核心设计原则是"跟踪器测量自身不确定性，并据此调整行为"。1) 用 Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) 卡尔曼滤波为每条轨迹提供预测协方差，将其转化为逐轨迹搜索区域：运动预测越不可靠，允许匹配的检测区域越大（不确定性自适应的 Expansion IoU, EIoU）；实验表明该协方差的"连续耦合"用法是关键，作为硬 Mahalanobis 门限在各阈值下均变差，更丰富的协方差摘要也无增益。2) 交叉时利用分配代价本身判断决策是否接近，将这类轨迹对置于复查中，仅当交叉后外观证据显示首次决策有误时执行至多一次纠正性 ID 交换。3) 对长时间出画目标，运动外推无信息，离线重识别放弃运动门限，仅按外观连接轨迹片段（tracklets）。

Result: SportsMOT 测试集 81.82 HOTA，截至 2026 年 8 月 69 个榜单条目中 ID switch 最少，MOTA 97.09（并列第三）；DanceTrack 测试集 62.1 HOTA，关联设置相同；在 Deep-EIoU 的公开检测与嵌入上达 80.31 HOTA（+3.1）；纠错换 ID 在 SportsMOT 与 DanceTrack 测试集上均带来 +1.0 HOTA，开销低于 1 ms/帧；笔记本 RTX 3060 上约 50 FPS。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 以预测协方差显式驱动搜索区域大小、以分配代价不确定性触发保守纠错、并以纯外观关联处理长时遮挡，是无需训练即可在体育场景取得 SOTA 级精度与实时速度的有效路径；不确定性应连续耦合进关联过程，而非作为硬门限。

Abstract: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.

</details>


### [120] [Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22311)
*Qiuhong Shen,Shizun Wang,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Velox：一种免训练的区域级注意力路由方法，利用流式几何中的视锥板（frustum slab）对应关系选择历史上下文，缓解分块视频扩散模型中随 rollout 增长而变慢的 KV 缓存问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型需要响应式生成长时程 rollout，且必须保留已生成内容的视觉记忆；分块视频扩散模型通常用不断增长的 KV 缓存保留上下文，导致后续 chunk 逐渐变慢。

Method: Velox 用带深度区间的相机视锥板表示历史块，通过 recency-priority multiwarp 得到当前块深度；对覆盖良好的区域，以视锥板重叠软性调制各层模型导出的块重要性，未覆盖区域保持模型原始路由不加几何偏置；采用固定 token 块粒度以匹配 FlashAttention 式分块执行，并在同一 H200 上与去噪异步构建视锥板。

Result: 在 chunk 48 时注意力加速 4.36 倍、去噪加速 2.43 倍；在完整 158 例 WBench 导航划分上，仅落后稠密 LingBot-Fast-Cam 0.15 API-free 平均分以内。

Conclusion: Velox 免训练即可显著降低随 rollout 长度增长的注意力开销，同时几乎不损生成质量，为交互式视频世界模型提供高效上下文选择方案。

Abstract: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.

</details>


### [121] [Not Just a Subject: Capturing Adaptive Scene-Specific Variance for Visual Storytelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22320)
*SeungJu Cha,Ye-Chan Kim,Kwanyoung Lee,Dong-Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EOS-Story：无需训练的可控视觉叙事框架，在文本与视觉空间同时协调身份一致性与场景自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉叙事方法侧重身份保持，难以适配多样场景变化，导致语义错位与结构僵硬。

Method: 文本空间将叙事解耦为身份子提示与场景子提示，并用跨上下文桥接将短语级外观残差软注入场景的<EOS>嵌入；视觉空间用自适应身份保持（身份锚定+身份感知自注意力）解决尺度不匹配导致的token重复迁移与结构伪影。

Result: 在Consistory+与扩展的Consistory+_+（含多样取景场景）上取得有竞争力或更优的表现。

Conclusion: 解耦提示并结合跨空间特征注入与尺度对齐，可在无需训练条件下兼顾身份一致性与场景灵活性。

Abstract: Recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-image generation, enabling their application to visual storytelling, where coherent image sequences are generated from narrative prompts. However, existing methods primarily focus on identity preservation and often fail to adapt to diverse scene variations, resulting in semantic misalignment and structural inflexibility. We propose EOS-Story, a training-free framework that harmonizes identity consistency with scene-specific adaptation across text and vision spaces. In the text space, we decouple the narrative into identity and scene sub-prompts to prevent information dilution, but this leaves the scene without access to appearance cues. To bridge this gap, we introduce Cross-Contextual Bridging, which softly injects a phrase-level appearance residual into the scene's <EOS> embedding. In the vision space, we find that scale mismatch between identity and scene subjects causes a few identity tokens to be repeatedly transferred, producing structural artifacts. We address this with Adaptive Identity Preservation, which anchors identity features at the scene-specific scale (Identity Anchoring) and integrates them via Identity-Aware Self-Attention. To evaluate performance under varied spatial compositions, we extend the Consistory+ benchmark with diverse framing scenarios (Consistory+_+). Extensive experiments show that EOS-Story achieves competitive or superior performance on both benchmarks.

</details>


### [122] [AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22321)
*Yuruo Wu,Kaihang Pan,Kai Shen,Jiacheng Li,Shuyuan Tu,Jisheng Dang,Li Tuoyu,Juncheng Li,Siliang Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以事件为中心的音视频一致性评估框架，并实例化为可训练奖励模型 AVC-Reward，配合 AVC-Benchmark 基准，在人类判断对齐上达到 SOTA，且可作为在线强化学习信号提升生成一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频联合生成模型已能产生多事件组合、多层音频混合与非对称跨模态关系等复杂场景，但当前评估方法多沿用早期简单、单向任务的指标，将整段音视频作为整体评估并依赖预定义的简单关系，无法适配日益复杂的场景。

Method: 提出以事件为中心的评估框架：在事件层面解耦音频事件与视觉事件，独立分析每个事件，跨模态交叉验证其关系，并将判断聚合为粗到细的三级一致性指标（全局叙事和谐、事件级时间同步、细粒度属性对齐）。将其实例化为可训练的音频-视频奖励模型 AVC-Reward，并构建 AVC-Benchmark（由多类音视频生成模型生成的正负样本构成）。

Result: 在自动评估方法中，AVC-Reward 与人类判断的对齐程度达 SOTA；能提供可解释的推理依据以定位失败之处；作为在线强化学习信号用于联合生成模型时，可提升其音视频一致性。

Conclusion: 以事件为中心的解耦与跨模态交叉验证思路，为多样生成设置与跨模态关系提供通用的音视频一致性评估公式，兼顾可解释性与可训练性，并可反向用于生成质量优化。

Abstract: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

</details>


### [123] [Dense4D: Pixel-Level 4D Human Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22325)
*Rıza Alp Güler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dense4D是首个无需人体模板、面向单目RGB图像序列的前馈式密集4D对应模型，通过预测Human Point Maps实现身体、衣物与头发的跨帧密集对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D人体运动重建需要在关节运动、形变与可见性变化下识别同一表面点，现有方法难以在无模板条件下实现密集对应。

Method: 以人物为中心裁剪图像并利用已知的图像到裁剪变换联合处理，预测每帧的Human Point Map（HPM）与深度；HPM为每个人体像素赋予其在公共参考时刻的3D位置，从而支持跨帧补全被遮挡点的非模态对应；在裁剪间匹配HPM坐标建立对应关系，无需预测相机位姿或大尺度场景位移，再由逐图深度将匹配提升为3D轨迹。

Result: 在真实人体数据上，跟踪精度显著优于所比较基线，且与扫描表面更吻合；不同帧的点可汇聚为参考位姿下连贯的人体几何，直观验证了跨关节运动与衣物形变的密集对应一致性。

Conclusion: Dense4D证明了无需模板的前馈式密集4D对应在人体上的可行性，HPM作为中间表示可有效桥接遮挡补全与3D轨迹构建。

Abstract: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. Trained specifically for human geometry, Dense4D jointly processes person-centred crops with known image-to-crop transforms to predict Human Point Maps (HPMs) and depth for each image. An HPM assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a common reference time. These maps support amodal correspondence: points hidden in the reference image can be localised from observations in other frames. Matching HPM coordinates across crops establishes correspondence without predicting camera poses or large scene displacements; per-image depth then lifts the matches into 3D tracks. Experiments on real people demonstrate substantially higher tracking accuracy and closer agreement with scanned surfaces than the evaluated baselines. Points from different frames assemble into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, providing visible evidence of consistent dense correspondence through articulation and clothing deformation. Additional qualitative results, videos, and an interactive viewer are available at https://alpguler.com/dense4d.

</details>


### [124] [ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22328)
*Sara Dorfman,Nir Goren,Gal Barak,Daniel Cohen-Or,Or Patashnik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Forcing 式训练方案，使图像编辑模型在多轮编辑中稳定，显著缓解累积分布漂移导致的退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像编辑模型单次编辑效果良好，但多轮连续编辑质量持续下降：每一轮引入的微小分布偏移在迭代中累积，造成训练与多轮推理间的输入分布鸿沟。

Method: 在训练中强制编辑器作用于自身前序轮次的输出（将 Self-Forcing 思想引入图像编辑）。针对自生成轨迹偏离真实轨迹、直接监督不可靠的问题，采用蒸馏目标：学生模型在自输出上顺序编辑时，教师模型固定锚定原始干净图像并接收复合编辑指令（非对称条件），从而提供可靠训练信号。

Result: 在长多轮序列上退化大幅降低，同时保持编辑质量与指令遵循能力。

Conclusion: 通过自输出训练结合非对称条件蒸馏，可有效抑制多轮编辑的累积漂移，实现稳定且高质量的多轮图像编辑。

Abstract: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. We address this challenge through a distillation objective that leverages a teacher image editor to provide a reliable training signal when the model operates on its own previous outputs. We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme: while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs, the teacher remains anchored to the original clean image and receives a compound editing instruction. Experiments show substantially reduced degradation over long multi-turn sequences while maintaining editing quality and instruction adherence.

</details>


### [125] [3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22341)
*Yipeng Gao,Ziyao Zeng,Jinfa Huang,Yijiang Li,Haolin Xiong,Wang Qin,Xinlei Yu,Youheng Yao,Jie Zhang,Kun-Yu Lin,Rong Liu,Yinyuan Zhao,Yajie Zhao,Meiqi Guo,Jiebo Luo,Lei Shu,Yunhao Ge,Xinyu Hu,Laurent Itti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出3DCodeVerse研究生态，包含2M规模可执行3D代码数据集、多智能体DAG生成-验证框架与系统实证分析，微调开源模型可显著提升3D编码能力，框架在成对人类评估中对Claude Design取得90%胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使编码智能体能够大规模生成可编辑、可验证的3D内容，弥补3D代码数据与自动验证手段的缺失。

Method: 1）构建3DCodeVerse-2M：通过开源数据收集、专用表示转换、智能体生成三种途径获得独立可执行3D代码，每程序打包源文件、资产、描述与验证记录；2）3DCodeVerse Harness：多智能体DAG框架，利用执行检查、空间测量与视觉反馈在无人工反馈下自动评估并修订程序；3）系统实证研究，微调开源模型建立基线，并对框架做组件级消融分析。

Result: 在本数据集上微调显著提升开源模型的3D编码能力；成对人类评估中，使用同一基座模型（Claude Opus 5.5）时，该框架对Claude Design（3D Object）取得90%胜率。

Conclusion: 数据、验证框架与实践指南一体化可有效支撑规模化可编辑3D内容生成，并以自动化验证替代人工反馈。

Abstract: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation.
