Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.

</details>


### [126] [GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22343)
*Hongchang Liu,Jian Liu,Yujuan Ding,Liang Peng,Xun Jiang,Fei Ma,Xing Xu,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoState 提出一种视角解耦的几何表示，用于预测式 3D 世界建模，将场景状态演化与相机相关观测分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 世界模型使用几何基础模型（GFM）特征作为预测世界状态，但这类特征具有视角依赖性，使场景动态与相机引起的观测变化纠缠，导致状态演化更难预测。

Method: 场景 tokenizer 将多视角 GFM 特征聚合为视角解耦的场景状态；几何解码器通过相机射线查询该状态；自回归世界模型预测未来场景状态，相机运动单独建模。预测状态可在预测或外部指定相机下解码，且整个 rollout 中保持单一上下文导出的尺度，无需逐帧尺度对齐。

Result: 在 Waymo 上优于既有 3D 世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视角查询，并零样本泛化到 KITTI 与 nuScenes。

Conclusion: 通过将场景状态与相机观测解耦，GeoState 提升了预测式 3D 世界建模的可预测性与几何一致性，并具备良好泛化能力。

Abstract: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

</details>


### [127] [Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22347)
*Hyunwook Choi,Seungryong Kim,Dongyoon Han,Sangdoo Yun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Speculative Forcing 框架，将少步自回归视频生成中中间的去噪估计视为"草稿"，逐 token 预测何时可安全提前接受，从而跳过冗余去噪步；在保持全步采样质量的同时显著降低计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成器虽支持流式生成，但对每个 token 都执行最终去噪步，无论其实际需要多少细化。作者发现这种统一计算往往不必要：部分 token 在初始步就与全步输出高度接近，而另一些则需细化到最后。

Method: 提出 Speculative Forcing：把中间干净估计当作草稿，并预测单个 token 何时可被提前接受。一旦接受，该 token 即冻结为最终输出、不再去噪，但其缓存的 key/value 仍作为后续 token 的上下文。设计两种验证器：（1）免训练型，基于与干净内容的相似度及跨步稳定性；（2）学习型，读取冻结生成器的中间特征来估计每个 token 到全步输出的剩余差距。

Result: 在短视频、长视频与世界生成任务上均保持全步采样质量并大幅降低计算。LongLive 上以约 1.7 步/token 匹配四步生成器，速度提升 1.5 倍以上，达 41.7 与 37.8 fps；在镜头运动持续改变可见内容的 Lingbot-World 2.0 上，以约 2.5 步/token 保持质量，速度提升 1.35 倍，达 24.5 fps。

Conclusion: 逐 token 自适应终止去噪可在自回归视频扩散中有效去除冗余计算，且对内容变化剧烈的场景仍具鲁棒性，为高效流式视频/世界生成提供了通用且可扩展的加速范式。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generators enable streaming generation, yet they run every token through the final denoising step, regardless of how much refinement it needs. We find this uniform computation is often unnecessary: many tokens already closely match their eventual full-step outputs in the initial steps, while others require refinement until the end. We introduce Speculative Forcing, a framework that treats intermediate clean estimates as drafts and predicts when individual tokens can be safely accepted early. Once accepted, a token is frozen as its final output and undergoes no further denoising, while its cached keys and values remain available as context for the remaining tokens. We explore two alternative verifier designs: a training-free one based on similarity to clean content and stability across steps, and a learned one that reads the frozen generator's intermediate features to estimate each token's remaining gap to its full-step output. Across short-video, long-video, and world generation, Speculative Forcing preserves the quality of full-step sampling while substantially reducing computation. On LongLive, it matches the four-step generator with ~1.7 denoising steps per token, running over 1.5x faster at 41.7 and 37.8 fps. On Lingbot-World 2.0, where camera motion continually changes the visible content, it maintains quality with ~2.5 denoising steps per token and runs 1.35x faster at 24.5 fps.

</details>


### [128] [SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22352)
*Chen Yang,Jiemin Fang,Fanpeng Meng,Zihao Huang,Jichen Pang,Guanjun Wu,Zhikuan Bao,Qi Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SUPRA-Tex 通过解耦可见材质估计、表面对齐与观测引导的3D补全，实现单图3D网格的可重光照材质生成，在可见区域达到"所见即所得"保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图3D生成方法在融合多视角不一致预测时产生伪影，或通过隐式图像特征条件难以保留细节，因此需要一种更可靠的材质估计与补全范式。

Method: 将任务解耦为三部分：1) 先用基于MLLM的图像编辑模型在参考视角预测光照分离的PBR贴图；2) 将贴图投影到可见表面，用预训练材质VAE编码为与生成目标共享潜空间的"原生观测潜变量"；3) 采用交错流变换器，将这些潜变量作为固定只读锚点，交替进行未观测区域与全表面更新以生成完整材质潜变量。

Result: 仅使用公开数据集训练，SUPRA-Tex 在几何条件纹理化与端到端资产生成上均达到SOTA，在真实图像上可媲美甚至超越领先商业系统。

Conclusion: 通过显式分工，使受限于3D数据量的生成器专注于保留可见证据与补全未观测表面，从而实现与参考图像超对齐的高保真可重光照材质生成。

Abstract: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

</details>


### [129] [DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22356)
*Han Su,Meng Tian,Tianyu Huang,Mingyu Gao,Lennox Wei,Dongxu Li,Jianhua Han,Hang Xu,Xiaohe Wu,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DK-VLM，用双核注意力（语义核+几何核）将3D几何以"位置"而非融合特征的形式注入注意力，并引入参考系组合（RC）监督训练跨步参考系更新，在六个空间基准上取得最高平均分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型难以理解跨视角3D空间关系，也难以在观察者移动时更新空间判断。常见做法是把3D重建特征融合进视觉token，但在有限空间监督下难以与预训练语义表示对齐。

Method: DK-VLM采用Dual-Kernel Attention：语义核保留预训练模型的原生注意力与位置编码；几何核利用估计的3D点与相机位姿，通过点位移和相对视角变换直接调制注意力；两者输出由学习门控融合。几何以位置形式进入注意力。另提出Reference-Frame Composition（RC）监督，由已验证的单步标注推导逐步的转向与朝向目标，训练模型在连续判断中更新参考系。

Result: DK-VLM-8B在六个空间基准上取得最高平均分，VSI-Bench总体得分最高（74.33），ReVSI-32最高（58.28）。RC监督进一步提升多步空间推理，完整模型保持通用视频理解能力。

Conclusion: 将几何作为注意力中的位置信号比融合重建特征更有效地对齐预训练语义表示；RC监督可显著增强跨步空间推理且不损害通用视频理解，为3D空间理解提供了可扩展方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.

</details>


### [130] [Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22360)
*Shuanglin Li,Jiaying Lin,Shuquan Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出以"验证反馈"为核心构建可靠的3D系统，发布3DVerifierBench基准（10项任务）、14,126条带矛盾解释与配对反事实的训练数据管线，并验证验证器可用于3D生成的候选选择与递归精化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型与3D生成已显著提升视觉逼真度，但基于3D证据的任务特定"正确性"仍未被解决。作者主张可靠3D系统不仅需要更强的生成与推理，还需要能识别未满足需求并解释违规原因的验证反馈，使系统可自我反思与修正；且该反馈须融合多视角观测，区分真实不一致与投影造成的表象差异。

Method: 三项工作：(1) 提出3DVerifierBench，覆盖10项任务，评测判定、拒绝解释以及对规格与候选受控变化的响应；(2) 按细粒度事实类别分析验证，揭示数值与目标绑定错误，并构建多视角事实抽取＋受控3D编辑＋原生标注的可扩展管线，产出含矛盾解释与配对反事实的训练样本；(3) 将验证用于3D生成，考察候选选择与递归精化两种机制。

Result: 人类研究显示人类与最强被测模型GPT-6 Astra存在21.6个百分点差距，解释感知分析暴露拒绝可靠性不足。在人工标注的16候选池中，Oracle选择将完整事实成功率由26.7%提升至90.0%；在8输入研究中，人类引导的递归精化对每个输入均满足全部7项需求，而并行Oracle@8仅满足3项。

Conclusion: 基准、分析与数据管线共同为模型通过可靠验证反馈对3D内容进行反思奠定基础，表明验证是连接3D理解、生成与正确性的关键环节。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.

</details>


### [131] [Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22363)
*Zirui Wu,Chen Guo,Tianjian Jiang,Zeren Jiang,Zeming Li,Lingchen Yang,Longteng Duan,Ying Xue,Handi Yin,Shenyuan Gao,Martin R. Oswald,Jun Zhang,Ping Tan,Jie Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 P3-WAM，一个统一的 world action model，通过 Perceive/Predict/Plan 三种互补模式联合学习3D感知、动作条件预测与目标导向规划，实现第一视角灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将3D手部重建、动作条件视频预测与操作规划分割为独立任务或专用模型，缺乏统一的表示与训练框架，难以在三者之间共享知识并相互增益。作者希望用一个统一的 world action model 同时建模感知、动力学预测与规划。

Method: 将紧凑的结构化3D动作表示注入预训练视频扩散Transformer，采用 mixture-of-transformers 架构：共享基权重、模态特定适配、双向视觉-动作注意力；并通过随机化模态可见性，使视频与3D动作在三种模式下可任意作为条件上下文或预测目标，实现统一训练。

Result: 统一训练相较单模式训练在三项能力上均有提升，包括在VLM评测下规划质量的提升；在四个数据集上，3D手部重建与动作条件视频预测均优于专用基线；生成的目标导向操作视频在指令遵循度与动作推进性上优于视频生成基线。

Conclusion: 统一的多模式 world action model 能有效整合感知、预测与规划，模态间共享训练带来跨任务正迁移，为第一视角灵巧操作提供可扩展的统一建模范式。

Abstract: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

</details>


### [132] [SoftCache: Adaptive Step Size Caching for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22369)
*Shimon Malnick,Nadav Orenstein,Ohad Fried,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SoftCache：利用动态缓存中"staleness 信号相对阈值的余量(headroom)"作为连续控制量，调节缓存步的推进距离，实现免训练软缓存，在 FLUX、HunyuanVideo、Wan2.1 上以 3.5×–6.9× 加速并在四项保真度指标上全面超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型生成成本主要来自每步对整个大网络的完整前向；现有免训练动态缓存方法采用"硬缓存"：把网络输入的廉价探针累积成 staleness 信号，仅作二值开关（刷新/复用），且无论刷新还是复用都按固定步长推进，信息利用不足。

Method: 观察到 staleness 信号低于阈值的幅度（headroom）可预测复用所引入的误差。SoftCache 据此做软缓存：以 headroom 连续决定每个缓存步的推进幅度——headroom 大时采样器跳过多个预定节点，接近刷新时步长逐步收缩回原步长；由此产生的自适应跳跃可能落在预定节点之间，使采样脱离固定网格。方法无需训练、无逐骨干超参。

Result: 在图像模型 FLUX 与视频模型 HunyuanVideo、Wan2.1 上，3.5×–6.9× 加速下，SoftCache 在全部四项保真度指标上均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: staleness 信号蕴含的连续信息可被显式利用，将缓存刷新决策从二值开关推广为步长调制，是提升免训练加速质量的有效且通用的方向。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models generate a sample over iterative steps, each a full pass through a large network, and that pass dominates generation cost. Training-free caching accelerates them by reusing activations from recent evaluations instead of recomputing them. Dynamic caching methods decide when to refresh by accumulating a cheap probe of the network input into a staleness signal and spending a fresh evaluation once it crosses a threshold. They perform hard caching: the signal is a binary switch between refresh and reuse, and every step, fresh or cached, advances by the prescribed step size. We observe that the signal carries much more than this switch. How far it sits below the threshold, its headroom, predicts the error induced by reuse. We propose SoftCache, which performs soft caching: instead of a binary switch, the headroom sets how far each cached step goes. Where the headroom is large, the sampler jumps past several scheduled nodes, and as a refresh nears, its steps shrink back toward the original step. These adaptive jumps may land between the scheduled nodes, taking the sampler off its fixed grid. SoftCache requires no training and adds no per-backbone settings: on FLUX for images and on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1 for video, at speedups from $3.5\times$ to $6.9\times$, it is ahead of every baseline on all four fidelity metrics.

</details>


### [133] [Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22370)
*SeungJu Cha,Ye-Chan Kim,HyunGee Kim,Sungho Koh,Dong-Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的动态感知Token合并框架DaTMe，利用Tweedie去噪估计构建融合时序与结构信号的token重要性图，自适应划分锚点与可安全合并token，在PixArt-α和FLUX上保持全图视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有token合并方法以“文本提示对齐的前景区域”为保留准则，忽略了提示未提及的背景物体与局部细节，导致结构连贯性下降。作者主张token重要性应反映其在去噪过程中是否尚未收敛、以及是否承载结构信息。

Method: DaTMe为免训练框架：基于Tweedie去噪估计构建动态感知重要性图，由时序信号（相邻步预测干净图像的变化）与结构信号（局部高频内容，如边界与细节）组合而成；在给定压缩比下自适应分配角色——重要token作为锚点保留，时序已稳定且结构同质的token作为安全合并候选。

Result: 在PixArt-α与FLUX上的实验表明，DaTMe在整个图像范围内维持视觉保真度，优于以文本相关性为准则的合并策略。

Conclusion: 扩散动力学可作为有效的token级合并决策依据，兼顾推理加速与全图生成质量。

Abstract: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.

</details>


### [134] [Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22371)
*Yitong Xia,Zeren Jiang,Chuanxia Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gen4P 是统一框架，把预训练视频生成器改造为前馈 4D 感知器，单次编码器前向即可从单目视频恢复 4D 几何与运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型蕴含丰富的几何与运动先验，但从生成模型到 4D 感知通常依赖迭代去噪过程，效率低；同时需要统一框架同时处理点跟踪、深度与相机位姿等多任务。

Method: 基于 on-demand querying：对干净视频 latent 做单次编码器前向，用轻量 cross-attention 解码器按请求预测 4D 属性；on-demand query 支持灵活空间采样，continuous-time query 提供时间灵活性；并将预训练 video-depth LoRA 作为冻结的几何先验（plug-in 方案）增强几何知识，且不增加可训练参数。

Result: 在 3D 点跟踪、视频深度和相机位姿估计任务上取得 SOTA 或竞争力性能；in-the-wild 视频的定性结果显示能跟踪复杂运动并保持精细结构。

Conclusion: 结果表明视频生成预训练可用于统一 4D 感知，具备前馈、无需迭代去噪的效率优势与较强的泛化能力。

Abstract: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.

</details>


### [135] [WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20731)
*Wenhao Yan,Haodong Li,Xiaotong Li,Yaxin Luo,Zhengrong Yue,Jialv Zou,Xu Huang,Haojin Yang,Nan Jia,Yan Feng,Peng Pei,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出将多模态生成模型能力划分为四级层次，并构建 WorldCast 基准（8类320个手工设计案例）评估12个模型在多步世界状态预测上的表现，发现高层任务仍发展不足，模型间差距显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态生成系统已能整合多模态上下文并合成反映世界变化的视觉输出，但该方向缺乏能力层级化梳理与系统性评测；作者希望刻画这一新兴趋势，并明确高层能力（如多步世界状态预测）相对未被充分探索的现状。

Method: 作者首先将模型能力组织为四级层次结构；随后聚焦"多步世界状态预测"这一高层任务——要求模型从多模态观测与多样参考中预测连续的未来世界状态，需同时具备理解与生成的纠缠能力及丰富世界知识。为此构建 WorldCast 基准，含8大类共320个手工设计案例，评测12个代表性模型。

Result: 实验得出三点：前沿模型正快速拓展智能世界建模边界，GPT-Image-2.5 System 得72.8，在真实任务上展现初步视觉状态预测能力；模型间差距显著，Nano Banana Pro 仅42.8，最佳开源模型20.1，在复杂上下文、纠缠参考与重推理任务上存在缺陷；强生成模型能有效借用其底层语言模型的能力。

Conclusion: 研究强调需要兼具动态规划与推理能力、且深度统一的多模态生成模型，以忠实模拟真实世界状态；WorldCast 为高层世界建模能力提供了可量化评测手段。

Abstract: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. We introduce WorldCast, a benchmark comprising 320 manually designed cases across eight categories, and evaluate 12 representative models. The conducted experiments yield three key insights: (a) advances in frontier models are rapidly pushing the boundaries of intelligent world modeling, with the GPT-Image-2.5 System scoring 72.8 and demonstrating early-stage visual state prediction capabilities on real-world tasks; (b) WorldCast reveals substantial gaps between models: even Nano Banana Pro reaches only 42.8 and the best open-source model scores 20.1, with deficits in handling complex context, entangled references, and reasoning-heavy tasks; (c) strong generative models effectively draw on the capabilities of their underlying language models. These findings highlight the need for multimodal generative models that are capable of dynamic planning and reasoning while also being deeply unified to faithfully simulate real-world states.

</details>


### [136] [Purify Before You Align: Improving Representation Alignment for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20761)
*Yingheng Wang,Yaoqiang Li,Yaqin Wu,Junwen Bai,Jiatao Gu,Christopher De Sa,Volodymyr Kuleshov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出局部外观纯化（LAP）：通过对齐目标去除局部可预测内容、只对齐残差，无需改动扩散训练/推理即可提升生成质量，并使MAE等编码器成为更有效的对齐目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准表征对齐只追求匹配预训练编码器的表征，未区分哪些信息对生成更有用，导致对齐目标包含大量易预测的局部冗余信息。

Method: LAP仅修改对齐目标：去除局部可预测内容并对齐其残差。理论层面给出标准对齐的变分解释，并在固定局部预测器下推导出以局部外观为条件的逐token信息上界之和；另提出一种精确的常数读出检验（constant-readout test），在扩散训练前度量目标在不使用扩散模型隐状态时可被匹配的程度。

Result: 在五种预训练表征（MAE、AIMv2、CLIP、DINOv2、DINOv3）上均提升生成质量，MAE增益最大：ImageNet-256上SiT-B/2的FID由53.1降至42.3；增益在更强对齐配方与tokenizer下依然存在；常数读出分数可预测纯化收益（13个编码器上Spearman ρ=0.94）。

Conclusion: 有效对齐取决于目标所强调的信息而非信息总量；LAP作为即插即用的目标改造手段，可显著提升扩散生成质量，且其收益可由训练前计算的常数读出分数预测。

Abstract: Representation alignment improves and accelerates diffusion training by encouraging intermediate features to match a pretrained visual encoder. However, standard alignment matches pretrained representations without distinguishing what information may be more useful for generation. We introduce local appearance purification (LAP), which improves generation quality and makes encoders such as MAE more effective alignment targets by removing locally predictable content and aligning to the residual. LAP modifies only the alignment target, and requires no changes to diffusion training or inference. Through controlled interventions within a fixed encoder, we show that effective alignment depends on what information the target emphasizes, not simply how much image information it contains. Our theory gives a variational interpretation of standard alignment and, for fixed local predictors, a sum of token-wise information bounds conditioned on local appearance. To understand why purification benefits some encoders more than others, we derive an exact constant-readout test that measures how well the target can be matched without using the diffusion model's hidden state. LAP improves generation quality across five pretrained representations (MAE, AIMv2, CLIP, DINOv2, DINOv3), with the largest gain for MAE: on ImageNet-256 with SiT-B/2, it reduces FID from $53.1$ to $42.3$. Its gains persist with stronger alignment recipes and tokenizers. Computed before diffusion training, the constant-readout score predicts the benefit of purification (Spearman $ρ=0.94$ across 13 encoders).

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [137] [Real-time Chatbot Romance Scam Detection in Stage Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20631)
*Yi-cheng Liu,Guan-ru Lai,Yi-cheng Lai,Lyn Chao-ling Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文开发了一个基于 Line Messaging API 的实时聊天机器人，利用大语言模型按社会科学中的七阶段理论检测"恋爱诈骗"所处阶段，并在检测到诈骗时给出阶段解释与防范建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体的普及使恋爱诈骗成为严重问题，而人工智能的进步使伪造身份变得更容易，因此需要能在真实场景中实时识别恋爱诈骗的实用工具。

Method: 基于 Line Messaging API 构建聊天机器人；以社会科学领域关于恋爱诈骗的七阶段理论为分析框架，通过大语言模型判断对话当前所处的诈骗阶段；一旦检测到诈骗，再由大语言模型生成阶段说明与防范建议。

Result: 实现了可实时运行的恋爱诈骗检测与干预聊天机器人原型，能够识别诈骗阶段并提供解释与预防建议。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了具有实用价值的应用，可部署于真实场景以降低恋爱诈骗风险；摘要未报告量化评估结果。

Abstract: Romance scam has become a serious problem via social media, and the improvement of artificial intelligence enable to fake identify easily. In the study, a chatbot has developed to detect romance scam in real-time through Line Messaging API. Using the seven stage theories in the social science field, the stages of romance scam can be detected through large language model. In addition, once a romance scam is detected, the chatbot provides explanations of the stage and prevention advices through large language model. The contribution of the work provides a practical application, and can be used in real scenario for reducing the risk of romance scam.

</details>


### [138] [Context Injection and Long-Horizon Reliability: Separating Duplicate Recognition, Local Processing, and Counter Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20633)
*Thomas Serval*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文对400步账本任务逐步做组件级评分，发现长程失败并非均匀分布：重复识别错误在回合后段显著上升（0.0019→0.011），而无关内容插入会特异性地使计数器失效（20/20种子），且计数器状态可被精确外部提醒在1–2步内重置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对语言模型长程失败的度量多为端任务成功率或"horizon长度"，这类聚合指标掩盖了不同组件（记忆检索、局部处理、状态写入）各自的失效模式与时序结构，无法定位错误来源。

Method: 构建400步账本任务：每步单独看都很简单，模型自身回答回注入上下文。逐步、分组件评分三项：识别5–300步前出现过的记录、局部处理当前记录、写入每步自增的计数器。模型为Qwen3-8B（非思考模式，20个种子，跨第二台机器与后端复现）。另设三项预注册后续实验：注入损坏值、每消息前重复精确外部提醒、以及无关内容块下由oracle提供精确紧凑状态提醒（含长度匹配中性文本对照）。

Result: （1）重复识别错误在episode后段上升，每风险步从0.0019升至第200步后的0.011，源于长距离召回错误与虚警同时上升；计数器在8000步中零错误，局部处理描述性稳定。（2）每步前插入无关内容块使计数器在每台机器20/20种子中失败（无插入时为零），对局部处理影响小且与无影响不可区分。后续实验：损坏值在每个种子中持续不被纠正；每消息前重复的精确外部提醒可在1–2步内重新对齐；无关块下oracle精确紧凑提醒使出错种子从15降至0（20种子中），并优于长度匹配中性文本；单一提醒是否充分尚无定论，其他组件未受损亦未被证实。

Conclusion: 长程失败具有组件特异性和时间局部性，计数器对上下文中的无关内容高度敏感而可被精确状态提醒修复；聚合或互斥式错误分类会掩盖此类差异，应改用逐步、分组件的评分框架。

Abstract: Long-horizon failures of language models are usually measured as end-task success or as a horizon length. We instead score, step by step, three components of a 400-step ledger task in which every step is easy in isolation and the model's own answers are re-injected into its context: recognising a record already seen 5 to 300 steps earlier, processing the current record locally, and writing a counter incremented at every step. On Qwen3-8B (non-thinking, 20 seeds, replicated on a second machine and backend), with every step scored component by component, two results hold. First, duplicate-recognition errors rise late in the episode -- from 0.0019 to 0.011 per step at risk across step 200 -- while the counter makes no error in 8,000 steps and local processing is descriptively stable; the rise combines long-distance recall errors and rising false alarms. Second, a block of irrelevant content inserted before each step makes the counter fail in 20 of 20 seeds on each machine, against none without it, while its effect on local processing is much smaller and not distinguishable from none. Three pre-registered follow-ups probe the counter. Its value depends on the value present in the response history: a corrupted value persists without correction in every seed, and an exact external reminder, repeated before each message, re-aligns it within one to two steps. Under the irrelevant block, no counter error was observed when an exact compact reminder of the state, supplied externally by an oracle, preceded each message (0 of 20 seeds with an error, against 15 without it), and this reminder outperformed a length-matched neutral text; whether a single reminder suffices was not conclusive, and the absence of damage to the other components was not established. An aggregate or exclusive error classification can hide the difference we report.

</details>


### [139] [Jev-as-a-Judge for RAG Claim Verification: Confidence-Gated Cascading Between a Non-Generative Verifier and a Frontier LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20634)
*Alden Do Rosario,Kirollos Atef*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在495条人工标注的RAG事实核查claim上，非生成式决策模型的分类准确率与前沿LLM在统计上无差异（配对差-0.56分），但成本相差187倍；二者结论一致掩盖了错误结构不同——廉价模型对"不支持"claim的误接收率为23.2%（LLM为14.1%），且基于置信度的级联路由所获收益主要来自升级比例而非概率质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG流水线中"证据是否支持该claim"本质是1-bit判定，但多数系统用文本生成器获取该答案并为生成的自然语言付出高昂代价。作者据此质疑生成式LLM在该二元分类任务上的必要性，并指出传统单一准确率指标会掩盖部署层面的关键差异（误接收未支持claim的比率），进而探讨廉价模型与前沿模型的错误是否可组合以降低开销。

Method: 在LLM-AggreFact的495条人工标注claim上做within-item配对比较：一侧为从声明枚举返回类型化取值、带原生概率且不输出文本的非生成式决策模型；另一侧为按工程部署方式配置为二分类器的前沿LLM。报告配对差异、不一致率、假接收率（错误放行"不支持"claim的比例），并构建基于置信度阈值的级联路由（阈值out-of-fold选取），与同等预算的随机升级控制组对比。

Result: 常规指标上二者无显著差异（Jev减去Astra为-0.56分，成本相差187倍）；不一致率达15.2%，廉价模型误接收23.2%的不支持claim，前沿模型为14.1%。级联路由达74.10（每千claim 2.92美元），优于前沿模型单独使用的73.83（8.93美元）。但匹配预算的随机升级控制在in-sample阈值下表现相当，说明节省来自升级比例而非升级选择的质量。相对其构建基座，级联成本高61倍仅换得0.83分（95% CI [-3.36, 4.86]），且作为防护更宽松。

Conclusion: 准确率相等掩盖了错误的不相等：面向部署的事实核查组件应以"误接收不支持claim的比率"而非headline准确率评估；前沿LLM在该1-bit判定任务上的生成开销缺乏对应回报；置信度级联的收益来自预算分配方式而非概率排序能力，且相对廉价基座性价比不高。作者公开全部预测、提示词、定价与代码。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation asks one question at volume: does this evidence support this claim? The answer is one bit, yet most pipelines obtain it from a text generator and pay generation prices for the prose wrapped around it. We compare a non-generative decision model, which returns a typed value from a declared enumeration together with a native probability and no text, against a frontier LLM configured as an engineer would deploy it for binary classification. Both answer the same 495 human-labelled claims from LLM-AggreFact, so every comparison is within-item. We report three things. First, the two systems are statistically indistinguishable on the metric this task is conventionally scored by, a paired difference of -0.56 points, Jev minus Astra, at a 187-fold cost difference. Second, that tie carries almost no information about deployment: the systems disagree on 15.2% of claims, and the cheaper one admits 23.2% of the claims annotators marked unsupported against the frontier model's 14.1%. A component whose job is to catch unsupported claims should be judged on that rate, and the conventional headline hides it. Third, because the errors differ they compose: routing the claims the cheap model is confident about and escalating the rest reaches 74.10 at USD 2.92 per thousand claims against 73.83 at USD 8.93, with the threshold chosen out of fold. But a matched random-escalation control at in-sample thresholds, spending the same budget by coin flip, does as well, so what buys the saving is the escalation share and not the probability that picks what to escalate. Measured against the cheap model it is built from, the cascade costs 61-fold more for 0.83 points, 95% CI [-3.36, 4.86], and it is the more permissive guard of the two. Equal accuracy conceals unequal errors. All predictions, prompts, pricing and code are released.

</details>


### [140] [Exploring the Design Space of Permutation Diffusion LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20635)
*Zhe Xu,Mingfu Liang,Kavosh Asadi,Jean-Pascal Billaud,Tianyi Chen,Yanhui Guo,Christina Huang,Baekjin Kim,Jimmy Kim,Yufei Li,Daqi Sun,Jiachen Sun,Dian Yu,Zaiwei Zhang,Kaushik Rangadurai,Frank Shyu,Sandeep Pandey,Xi Liu,Luke Simon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文比较了三种面向排列生成的扩散语言模型参数化方式（硬分配、软分配、直接排序打分），在Amazon三领域重排任务（候选规模10/20）上系统评估其约束放置、目标函数与采样器的耦合关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排列生成需要文本条件排序与候选—输出位置之间的全局一对一匹配，而扩散语言模型可采用多种参数化方式来施加排列约束；这些方式在约束施加阶段、训练目标和采样流程上各不相同，缺乏统一比较，因此需要厘清“扰动—参数化—目标—解码器”应如何协同设计。

Method: 对比三种扩散LLM参数化：(1) 对打乱后的候选索引序列做硬分配预测；(2) 在双随机矩阵上做软分配预测；(3) 直接预测排序分数后排序。在三组Amazon领域推荐重排数据、候选集大小10与20上评测，以约束掩码扩散为基线，按函数评估次数考察Recall@1与排列有效性。

Result: 单次函数评估下，硬分配与软分配变体的Recall@1与约束掩码扩散基线相当；直接排序分数预测无需匈牙利分配或Sinkhorn归一化即可保证输出为合法排列。增加函数评估次数并不能一致提升排序质量，其效果强烈依赖状态表示与训练目标。

Conclusion: 排列扩散语言模型的有效性并非由单一组件决定，扰动方式、预测参数化、训练目标与解码器需联合设计；直接排序打分在保证排列合法性上具有结构性优势，而额外计算投入的收益不具备稳健性。

Abstract: Permutation generation with language models requires both text-conditioned ranking and a global one-to-one assignment between candidates and output positions. We study this problem through three diffusion-LLM parameterizations: hard-assignment prediction over shuffled candidate-index sequences, soft-assignment prediction over doubly stochastic matrices, and direct ordering-score prediction followed by sorting. The three families place permutation constraints at different stages of prediction and decoding and therefore support different training objectives and sampling procedures. We evaluate these designs on recommendation reranking across three Amazon domains with candidate sets of size 10 and 20. At one function evaluation, the hard- and soft-assignment variants achieve Recall@1 comparable to a constrained masked-diffusion baseline, whereas direct ordering-score prediction guarantees valid permutations without Hungarian assignment or Sinkhorn normalization. Additional function evaluations do not consistently improve ranking quality, and their effect depends strongly on the state representation and training objective. These results show that corruption, prediction parameterization, objective, and decoder should be designed jointly for permutation diffusion with language-model denoisers.

</details>


### [141] [AbridgeKV: Compressing Long Reasoning into the KV Cache of Learned Pause Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20641)
*Jack Cai,Lijie Yang,Vasilis Kontonis,Dimitris Papailiopoulos,Shivam Garg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AbridgeKV 通过训练模型将已生成文本块的 KV 缓存压缩为少量可学习的 pause token 的 KV 条目，在保留 1/4 缓存预算下达到全 KV 模型的精度与输出长度，并在 vLLM 中实现 3.5 倍缓存缩减与 3.2 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维（long chain-of-thought）解码是内存受限的：KV 缓存随测试时计算量线性增长。简单地驱逐（evict）缓存条目无效，因为模型未在"被删条目"的缓存上训练过，会生成更长输出，常达长度上限。

Method: 改为训练模型压缩自身输出：每个已完成的生成文本块被压缩为少数可学习 pause token 的 KV 条目（pause token 为带训练嵌入、不产生输出的额外输入 token）；编码完成后释放该块原始缓存，后续 token 转而注意 pause token 的 KV 条目。三项关键设计：(1) pause token 的 KV 条目占据其所替换块内部的位置；(2) 按各层条目的实测价值在层间分配缓存预算；(3) 在较大的块上执行压缩。

Result: 在 AIME、HMMT、AMC、BRUMO、CMIMC、SMT 的 446 道竞赛题上（32K token 生成），保留 1/4 生成缓存时，精度与输出长度均匹配同训练的全 KV 模型；同等预算下最强已发表驱逐方法输出长得多，最接近的训练式压缩器在同数据重训后损失 10 分。在 vLLM 部署下，每序列缓存缩小 3.5 倍，饱和 H100 上解题速度快 3.2 倍。

Conclusion: 训练模型自我压缩输出（以 pause token KV 条目替代原块缓存）是缓解长 CoT 解码内存瓶颈的有效且实用的方案，可在显著降低缓存占用与延迟的同时保持精度。

Abstract: Long chain-of-thought decoding is memory-bound: the KV cache of the generated tokens grows linearly with the test-time compute being spent. Evicting cache entries does not fix this, because a model never trained on a cache with entries removed generates longer, often up to the length limit. We instead train the model to compress its own output. AbridgeKV compresses each completed block of generated text into the KV entries of a few learned pause tokens. These are extra input tokens with trained embeddings that produce no output. Once the pause tokens have encoded the block, AbridgeKV frees the block's original cache; subsequent tokens attend to the pause tokens' KV entries in its place. Three novel choices make this work: the pause tokens' KV entries take positions inside the block they replace, the cache budget is allocated across layers according to the measured value of each layer's entries, and compression operates on relatively large blocks. On 446 competition problems from AIME, HMMT, AMC, BRUMO, CMIMC and SMT with 32K-token generations, keeping a quarter of the generated cache matches an identically trained full-KV model in accuracy and output length; the strongest published evictor at a matched budget writes far longer, and the closest trained compressor, retrained on the same data, loses 10 points. Served in vLLM, the cache is 3.5x smaller per sequence and a saturated H100 finishes a problem 3.2x faster than with full KV.

</details>


### [142] [CoTS: Competitive Token Selection for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20642)
*Jie Yu,Yuxi Sun,Zhaoxu Li,Chunxiao Liu,Xudong Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CoTS将潜空间推理干预从二元模式选择重构为令牌级的连续分配，利用top-2候选概率竞争自适应平衡离散承诺与软探索，训练免费且无需额外前向计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜推理方法对潜干预的处理存在局限：要么用全局软激活，要么基于不确定性阈值硬切换，把潜干预当作"全有或全无"的决策，无法随解码步连续调节强度。而实际上不同解码步对潜推理的需求不同——高置信预测适合离散承诺，模糊步则需要保留多个候选路径。

Method: 提出Competitive Token Selection（CoTS）训练免费框架。核心是用最高与次高两个候选token的概率竞争来衡量当前离散选择的稳定性：当某一候选明显占优时，输出表示贴近采样到的离散token以保持稳定轨迹；当竞争加剧时，增大软表示权重以保留合理备选。该分配无需人工设定切换阈值或混合系数，也不引入额外前向传递。

Result: 在六个推理基准上，CoTS一致优于标准CoT以及当前最优的训练免费潜推理方法。

Conclusion: CoTS表明以top-2概率竞争作为稳定性信号，可实现无需调参的令牌级连续潜干预，是离散承诺与软探索之间的有效自适应折中，为训练免费的潜推理提供了简洁高效的范式。

Abstract: Recent latent reasoning methods move beyond discrete Chain-of-Thought (CoT) by replacing sampled tokens with continuous soft embeddings or hidden states, enabling richer intermediate representations and preserving alternative reasoning paths. However, the need for latent reasoning varies across decoding steps: confident predictions favor discrete commitment, whereas ambiguous steps benefit from preserving multiple plausible alternatives. Existing approaches typically handle this variation through either global soft activation or hard switching based on uncertainty thresholds, treating latent intervention as an all-or-nothing decision rather than continuously adapting its strength. To address this limitation, we propose Competitive Token Selection (CoTS), a training-free framework that reframes latent intervention from binary mode selection into continuous allocation at the token level. CoTS uses the probability competition between the two most likely candidates to dynamically balance discrete commitment and soft exploration at each reasoning step. The second candidate represents the strongest alternative to the model's preferred continuation, so the separation between the two directly reflects the stability of the current discrete choice. When one candidate clearly dominates, CoTS keeps the representation close to the sampled discrete token to preserve a stable reasoning trajectory; as the competition strengthens, it increases the contribution of the soft representation to retain plausible alternatives. This competition-based allocation requires neither manually tuned switching thresholds nor mixing coefficients, and introduces no additional forward passes. Experiments across six reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that CoTS consistently outperforms standard CoT and state-of-the-art training-free latent reasoning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/OkinoYu/CoTSReasoning.

</details>


### [143] [Does Personalization Break Trust? Open-Set Rejection Calibration Under Few-Shot On-Device Intent Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20652)
*Vaibhav Prajapati,Pushp Garg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示少样本LoRA个性化会损害助手的OOS拒识能力，并证明部分退化源于置信度评分器失准、部分为真实的嵌入间隔收缩，提出用Mahalanobis距离替代softmax置信度可在无需重训练下恢复大部分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常在线虚拟助手越来越多地通过少样本微调（如LoRA）在设备端个性化以适应新的用户特定指令，但现有评估几乎只关注是否学会了新指令，而忽略了助手能否识别不匹配任何意图的输入，即OOS拒识问题。作者旨在系统评估个性化对OOS拒识的影响并给出低成本修复方案。

Method: 在五个公开意图分类基准上各用五个随机种子，比较朴素少样本LoRA个性化前后的OOS拒识AUROC与域内准确率；通过评分器不变性检查区分失准假象与真实效应；用池化Spearman相关分析嵌入间隔收缩与退化程度的关系；提出以Mahalanobis距离替代softmax置信度作为免训练的部署级修复，并与两个OOD评分基线对比，在shot数、LoRA秩和第二编码器上验证泛化性。

Result: 朴素少样本LoRA个性化在全部五个基准上使OOS拒识AUROC下降（均值降幅0.055–0.258），而域内准确率基本保持；评分器不变性检查表明部分下降是标准置信度评分器在适配下自身失准的假象，但在任意评分器下仍存在较小真实效应，并归因于已知意图区域周围嵌入间隔的可测收缩（池化Spearman rho=0.61）；Mahalanobis评分在5个数据集中的3个上恢复大部分损失质量且无准确率代价，并优于两个OOD评分基线。

Conclusion: 少样本LoRA个性化会削弱OOS拒识能力，其中既有评分器失准的假象也有真实的嵌入间隔收缩效应；以Mahalanobis距离替代softmax置信度是部署成本低的有效缓解手段，但作者如实报告了其局限性，并公开全部代码以保证可复现性。

Abstract: Always-on virtual assistants increasingly personalize on-device to new user-specific commands via few-shot fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), but this adaptation is evaluated almost exclusively on whether it learns the new commands, not on whether the assistant can still recognize an input that matches none of its intents - the out-of-scope (OOS) rejection problem. We show that naive few-shot LoRA personalization degrades OOS-rejection AUROC (area under the ROC curve) on every one of five public intent-classification benchmarks (mean drop $0.055$--$0.258$, five seeds each), while in-scope accuracy is preserved. A scorer-invariant check shows part of this drop is an artifact of the standard confidence scorer's own miscalibration under adaptation, though a smaller, genuine effect remains under any scorer; we trace it to a measurable shrinkage of the embedding margin around known-intent regions (pooled Spearman rho=0.61$). A deployment-cheap fix is scoring rejection by Mahalanobis distance instead of softmax confidence without extra training/retraining recovers most of the lost quality on 3 of 5 datasets at no accuracy cost, beats two further OOD scoring baselines, and generalizes across shot count, LoRA rank, and a second base encoder. We report honestly where the fix falls short and release all code for reproducibility.

</details>


### [144] [Reference-Guided Turn-Taking Style Transfer for Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20763)
*Yuxuan Chen,Yang Xiao,Jack Sun,Chak Sun,Brick Li,Sam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文识别出全双工语音语言模型中控制"是否发言"的单个晚层残差流方向——initiative vector，可在无训练无标注条件下从模型自身对话中提取，并能读取、移动该决策，进而按说话人参考音频实现个性化的轮次转换风格迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音模型每一帧都要决定是否取得发言权，从而形成一种"对话人格"，但每套权重只编码一种人格，而人类说话者的风格是可"括起"（bracket）而非共享的。现有控制多从外部施加，且无人识别出决定模型说话多少的那个量。

Method: 从模型自身对话中、无需训练或标注，提取一个晚层残差流方向（initiative vector）；该方向既可"读取"发言决策（提前至多800 ms预测话轮起始），又可在生成时按比例缩放以"移动"该决策。进一步用一段短的参考录音将该说话人的轮次转换风格迁移到模型。

Result: 缩放该方向可使语音占比从6–12%提升至42–61%（无引导时为21–30%），且在不同对话、权重与语料上一致；短参考录音即可完成说话人风格迁移，且迁移具有参考特异性——替换为他人参考时匹配变差的比例达93–98%，而最佳统一剂量与不做引导难以区分。

Conclusion: 轮次转换风格并非冻结在权重中，而是一个可被读取、移动并按人校准的方向。

Abstract: Full-duplex spoken language models decide at every frame whether to take the floor, defining a conversational personality -- yet each set of weights encodes exactly one, which human speakers bracket rather than share. Existing controls mostly act from outside; none identifies the quantity that sets how much the model speaks. We identify it: a single late-layer residual-stream direction, the initiative vector, extracted from the model's own conversations without training or annotation. The same direction reads the decision, anticipating onsets up to 800 ms ahead, and shifts it: scaled during generation, it moves speech ratio from 6-12% to 42-61% (no steering: 21-30%), consistently across conversations, weights, and corpora. A short reference recording suffices to transfer a speaker's turn-taking style to the model, and the transfer is reference-specific: swapping in another speaker's reference worsens the match in 93-98% of cases, whereas the best uniform dose is indistinguishable from no steering. Turn-taking style is not frozen into the weights but a direction that can be read, shifted, and calibrated per person. Audio examples are available at https://elpsykongloo.github.io/initiative-vector/.

</details>


### [145] [Verdict: Encode Once, Decide Many](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20778)
*Avdhesh Singh Chouhan,Jack Perry*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Verdict-MQ：一种“一次编码、多问题作答”的开放编码器，通过结构化注意力掩码保证状态编码与问题无关、问题互不影响、选项顺序无关，在类型化决策基准上优于同类专门模型，在多选/阅读理解基准上表现分化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织自动化需要对同一状态回答多个小型类型化问题（是否需回复、紧急程度、归属谁），且概率需足够可靠以无人干预决策。现有开放模型（如标准 cross-encoder）对每个问题各做一次输入前向，效率低且无结构保证。

Method: 提出 Verdict-MQ 编码器：对每个案例只读一遍，用结构化注意力掩码使状态编码独立于问题、问题之间互不干扰，并使选项顺序在构造上无关；在截断后保留状态 token 一致的前提下进行评估（每个报告案例均验证）。与 421M Laya 专门模型对比（五个新种子、KL 与 Brier、逐系统温度缩放）；在 RACE、BoolQ、MultiRC 上与匹配微调基线对比，并自测零样本参考（含闭源通用系统 Jev）；另做受控对比：为每个问题提供问题感知的状态副本。

Result: 395M Verdict-MQ 在五个新种子上对软金标签匹配更好：KL 0.080 vs 0.117，Brier 0.045 vs 0.061，经温度缩放仍保持；准确率 0.801 vs 0.767（超出基准饱和点，解读为更贴近标注教师）。RACE/BoolQ/MultiRC 中胜 MultiRC，负于 RACE 与 BoolQ（BoolQ 训练不稳定）；闭源通用系统 Jev 优于所有微调编码器。问题感知状态副本在 RACE 与 MultiRC 上提升 0.9–3.5 点，代价为 1.4–2.5 倍延迟，类型化决策上无可测收益，且不变性保证不变。

Conclusion: 共享状态的多问题单次编码在类型化决策上是高效且可靠的，且具备构造性不变性；但对阅读理解和问答类任务（尤其 BoolQ 稳定性）存在代价，按问题复制状态仅在部分任务上带来小幅收益，需权衡延迟。

Abstract: Automating organizational work means answering many small typed questions about one piece of state (does this email need a reply, how urgent is it, who owns it) with probabilities good enough to act on without a human. The open typed-decision model we compare against, like a standard cross-encoder, answers each question with a separate pass over the input. We present Verdict-MQ, an open encoder that reads a case once and answers all of its questions: given identical retained state tokens after truncation (verified on every reported case), a structured attention mask makes the state encoding independent of the questions, keeps questions from influencing each other, and makes option order irrelevant by construction. On the typed-decisions benchmark, a 395M Verdict-MQ matches the soft gold labels significantly better than the released 421M Laya specialist on all five fresh seeds (KL 0.080 vs 0.117, Brier 0.045 vs 0.061), an advantage that survives per-system temperature scaling; its higher accuracy (0.801 vs 0.767) lies past the benchmark's own saturation point, so we read that margin as closer agreement with the benchmark's labelling teacher. On RACE, BoolQ and MultiRC, against a matched fine-tuned baseline it wins on MultiRC and loses on RACE and on BoolQ, where its training is unstable; we measure zero-shot references ourselves, including a closed general system (Jev) that beats every fine-tuned encoder. A controlled comparison measures what the shared state costs: giving each question its own question-aware copy of the state gains 0.9-3.5 points on RACE and MultiRC at 1.4-2.5x the per-case latency, and nothing measurable on typed decisions, with the invariance guarantees unchanged.

</details>


### [146] [APRiL: An Open-ended Benchmark for Chinese Social Awareness in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20785)
*Tian Lan,Han Zhang,Shanshan Wang,Yahan Yu,Jiang Li,Yugo Murawaki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出APRiL，一个面向中文社会意识的开放式基准，含2196个评测实例、六类场景与两项互补任务（社会情景分析、社会意识回应），并采用实例级评分标准；对6个家族12个模型的实验揭示出一致的"理解—回应"差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型日益参与社会交互，恰当回应需要识别隐含线索、推断心理状态、识别冲突并考虑潜在后果；但现有基准多聚焦单一社会能力、受限任务形式或特定交互场景，对多样化情境下的社会意识覆盖不足。

Method: 构建开放式中文社会意识基准APRiL：包含2196个社会意识评测实例，覆盖六个类别；设计两项互补任务——社会情景分析（考察对社会线索、心理状态与冲突结构的理解）与社会意识回应（考察能否将理解转化为恰当自然的回应）；每个实例配备定制化评分标准（instance-specific rubrics）。

Result: 在6个模型家族共12个模型上的实验显示：普遍存在一致的"理解—回应"差距（understanding-to-response gap）；高质量的情景分析能提升回应质量，而较弱的分析反而可能降低回应质量。

Conclusion: APRiL为推进中文语境下具有社会意识的语言模型提供了系统性资源，数据与代码已公开。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in social interactions, where appropriate responses require recognizing implicit cues, inferring mental states, identifying conflicts, and considering potential consequences. However, existing benchmarks often focus on specific social abilities, constrained task formats, or particular interaction settings, offering limited coverage of social awareness across diverse contexts. To address this gap, we introduce APRiL, an open-ended benchmark for Chinese social awareness with instance-specific rubrics. APRiL contains 2,196 Social Awareness Evaluation Instances across six categories and two complementary tasks: Social Scenario Analysis evaluates models' understanding of social cues, mental states, and conflict structures, while Socially Aware Response assesses whether they can translate this understanding into appropriate, natural responses. Experiments on 12 models from six families reveal a consistent understanding-to-response gap. Higher-quality scenario analyses improve responses, while weak analyses may reduce response quality. APRiL provides a systematic resource for advancing socially aware language models in Chinese contexts. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/APRiL-05DE/.

</details>


### [147] [PRISM: Transfer and Limits of Activation Interventions in Tool-Calling Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20808)
*Giovana Kerche Bonás,Thales Sales Almeida,Marcelo da Silva Reis,Rodrigo Nogueira,Marcos Meideiros Raimundo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PRISM 框架，利用低资源设置（NF4 量化标签、跨语言迁移）来暴露并缓解语言模型"文本拒绝但工具调用不安全"的隐藏漏洞，安全干预可跨语言、跨规模迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献表明，模型在文本层面"拒绝"时仍可能伴随不安全的工具调用，这种隐藏漏洞未被充分评估；作者希望系统研究激活干预在不同精度、语言和模型规模间的可迁移性。

Method: 构建 PRISM 评估框架，跨精度（NF4 量化 vs 全精度）、跨语言（五语言监督）与跨模型规模评估激活干预迁移；使用 NF4 副本产生的行为标签估计干预方向，并通过配对良性激活将安全干预映射到更大模型（至 70B）。

Result: NF4 标签在极少场景下即可稳定估计干预；五语言 NF4 监督方向可迁移至未参与训练的阿拉伯语，使 Llama-3.1-8B 的不安全违规率下降 21.95 个百分点且无需目标语言微调；配对良性激活方法可将干预迁移至 70B 规模模型。

Conclusion: 来自压缩模型与多语言数据的辅助监督能够揭示并缓解跨模型家族的危害性工具调用行为；作者公开代码、实验产物及交互式结果浏览器。

Abstract: Recent literature shows that unsafe tool calls can often accompany textual refusals in language models. To investigate this hidden vulnerability, we introduce PRISM, a framework for evaluating the transfer of activation interventions across precision, languages, and scales. Our findings demonstrate that leveraging lower-resource settings (specifically quantized NF4 labels and cross-lingual transfer) offers a robust pathway to expose and improve model alignment. Notably, using behavioral labels from an NF4 copy enables stable intervention estimation even with very few scenarios. Furthermore, these alignment improvements transfer effectively across languages: five-language NF4-supervised directions successfully transfer to held-out Arabic, reducing unsafe violations in Llama-3.1-8B by 21.95 percentage points without target-language tuning. By mapping paired benign activations, we also successfully transfer these safety interventions to much larger models (up to 70B parameters). Ultimately, PRISM highlights how auxiliary supervision from compressed models and multilingual data can uncover and mitigate hazardous tool-calling behaviors across different model families. We release all experimental code and supporting artifacts at https://github.com/GiKerche/prism, alongside an interactive explorer of recorded model responses and experimental results at https://gikerche.github.io/prism/.

</details>


### [148] [Wolof-Adapted Industry-Ready Open-Weight Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20824)
*Gwénolé Lecorvé,Delphine Charlet,Pierre Adam,Floriane Behanzin,Lionel Delphin-Poulat,Johannes Heinecke,Géraldine Damnati,Pelin Kaytmaz,Nourredine Khaous,Charbel Kindji,Meriam Maadi,Abdoulaye Mbaye,Claire Perroux,Ismaël Rousseau,Papa Séga Wadé,Gilles Xiberras,Olivier Zhang,Malek Zitouni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向沃洛夫语（Wolof）的0.6B–14B开源权重语言模型，通过指令微调、偏好对齐与模型合并构建，在63项公开与自建任务上表现良好，8B/14B版本可与远大于自身的商业系统竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沃洛夫语使用者约2300万（主要在塞内加尔），但开源权重模型对其支持薄弱；而API商业模型在成本、治理与本地部署主权方面存在约束，因此需要本地可部署的沃洛夫语开源模型。

Method: 采用指令微调（instruction tuning）、偏好对齐（preference alignment）与模型合并（model merging）三阶段流程，构建0.6B至14B规模的模型族，并配套介绍数据与训练流水线。

Result: 在63项公开与内部任务上的大量实验显示，模型在沃洛夫语理解与生成上表现良好，同时保持其他语言及跨语言能力的有效性；8B与14B模型相对规模大得多的商业系统具有明显竞争力。模型已在内部客服试点中评估，并发布于Hugging Face（Orange/wolof-lm集合）。

Conclusion: 开源权重、多尺寸的沃洛夫语模型可在受限资源与主权要求下提供可行的本地化方案，并具备实际部署（客服试点）潜力；后续工作聚焦于试点验证与生态开放。

Abstract: Wolof is spoken by 23M people, mostly in Senegal, but remains weakly supported by open-weight language models, while API models raise cost, governance, and sovereignty constraints for local deployments. In this paper, we present 0.6B-14B open-weight models adapted to Wolof through instruction tuning, preference alignment, and model merging. After presenting the pipeline and data, extensive experiments on 63~public and in-house tasks show good performance on Wolof understanding and generation while remaining effective on other languages and cross-lingual skills, with the 8B and 14B models being particularly competitive with substantially larger commercial systems. The models are currently being evaluated in internal customer-care pilots and are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Orange/wolof-lm .

</details>


### [149] [CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20828)
*Zinan Tang,Zhuoshi Pan,Kairui Chen,Ze Yan,Shaomian Zheng,Yukun Zhang,Gang Wang,Biqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 CoTranslator，将逆向 CoT（RCG）响应翻译为接近经拒绝采样验证的正向响应分布，以低成本生成学生训练数据。六个数学基准上较语义抑制平均提升最多 5.82 个百分点；两个 4B 学生在保留拒绝采样 95.0% 平均精度的同时仅用约 35.9% 估算算力，并可零训练迁移到新数据集、新教师和 STEM 任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理蒸馏依赖带正确答案的 CoT 数据，但高效获取困难：正向 CoT 生成加拒绝采样（RS）可得到经核实、仅含问题的响应，但难题需大量教师调用；逆向 CoT 生成（RCG）以已知答案为条件因而更便宜，却易产生事后合理化，且与学生无答案推理的设定存在分布错配。

Method: 训练一个"翻译器"学习将逆向 CoT 响应转换为接近经拒绝采样验证的正向响应分布；训练集仅为少量成对的逆向响应与 RS 正向响应，训练后支持对学生训练数据进行大规模生成与验证。

Result: 六个学生模型 × 六个数学基准上，相较语义抑制（semantic suppression）平均精度最高提升 5.82 pp；两个 4B 学生保留 RS 平均精度的 95.0%，仅消耗其约 35.9% 的估算算力。无需重训练即可迁移到新数学数据集、不同教师及 STEM 问题，4B 与 8B 学生 STEM 平均精度分别提升 4.88 与 4.31 pp。

Conclusion: CoTranslator 在保持 RS 验证质量的同时显著降低数据生成成本，并具备良好的跨数据集、跨教师与跨领域可迁移性，为推理蒸馏提供了一种高效可迁移的数据合成路径。

Abstract: Reasoning distillation requires chain-of-thought (CoT) data with correct answers, but obtaining such data efficiently remains challenging. Forward CoT generation (FCG) followed by rejection sampling (RS) produces verified, question-only responses, yet may require many teacher calls for difficult problems. Reverse CoT generation (RCG) is cheaper because it conditions on the known answer, but access to this answer can lead to post-hoc rationalization and a mismatch with the student's answer-free inference setting. We propose CoTranslator, which learns to translate reverse CoT responses toward the distribution of verified forward responses. Trained on a small set of paired reverse and rejection-sampled forward responses, it supports large-scale generation and verification of student training data. Across six student models evaluated on six mathematics benchmarks, CoTranslator improves average accuracy over semantic suppression by up to $5.82$ percentage points. For two 4B students, it retains $95.0\%$ of rejection sampling's average accuracy while using $35.9\%$ of its estimated compute. Without retraining, the same translator transfers to a new mathematics dataset, a different teacher, and STEM problems, improving average STEM accuracy by $4.88$ and $4.31$ percentage points for 4B and 8B students, respectively. These results show that CoTranslator offers an efficient and transferable approach to reasoning distillation.

</details>


### [150] [PEDBench: Can Speech Models Detect Phonetic Errors?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20830)
*Zhonghao Shi,Zackary Rackauckas,Jasmine Yip,Savannah Halpern,Simon Campos,Lauren Brace,Emma Yang,Tiantian Feng,Xuan Shi,Shrikanth Narayanan,Teresa Satterfield,Ying Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出首个音素级错误检测(PED)基准 PEDBench，涵盖自然、受控与合成三类语音数据，评测13个主流语音模型，发现其细粒度音素错误检测能力普遍不足；基于合成数据微调的语音语言模型在词级PED上优于商业与开源基线，但仍存在仿真到真实的域差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PED对教育与临床言语评估至关重要，但现有语音模型在音素识别上的进展并不能保证其可靠检测细粒度音素错误；核心障碍在于缺少高质量、标注可靠的评测数据。

Method: 构建 PEDBench 基准，包含三类数据：儿童真实发音错误录音(N=334)、人类演员按脚本产生的错误发音(N=1,188)、以及基于音素条件TTS生成的合成错误发音(N=1,083)；全部音素标注由两名受过音素转写训练的标注者转写与核验。随后评测13个SOTA语音模型，并微调语音语言模型用于词级PED。

Result: 13个SOTA模型即使在被控语音(演员与合成语音，声学变异性降低)条件下也无法可靠检测音素错误；且精确率低，常将发音正确的音素误判为错误。基于合成数据微调的语音语言模型在词级PED上超过商业与开源基线，但仍存在sim-to-real域差。

Conclusion: PEDBench 揭示了现有语音模型在细粒度音素错误检测上的显著短板，并提供可复现的数据与方案；作者将公开代码、recipes及演员与合成数据集，以推动更准确的PED系统研发。

Abstract: Phonetic error detection (PED) aims to identify phoneme-level substitutions, deletions, and insertions and is essential for educational and clinical speech assessment and intervention. Despite recent advances in speech models for phoneme recognition, their ability to reliably detect fine-grained phonetic errors remains unclear because of a lack of high-quality evaluation data. To address this gap, we introduce PEDBench, the first PED benchmark spanning a continuum from natural to controlled speech. It comprises real-world recordings of spoken errors made by children (N=334), scripted error productions by human actors (N=1,188), and synthetic error productions generated using phone-conditioned text-to-speech (N=1,083). All phonetic annotations were transcribed and verified by two phonetically trained annotators. Our evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art speech models shows that they fail to reliably detect phonetic errors, even under controlled conditions with acted and synthetic speech, where acoustic variability is reduced. The models also exhibit low precision, frequently misclassifying correctly pronounced phonemes as errors. Our speech-language models, fine-tuned on synthetic data, outperform commercial and open-source baselines on word-level PED, although a sim-to-real domain gap remains. We plan to publicly release our code and recipes, along with our acted and synthetic datasets, to support the development of more accurate PED systems.

</details>


### [151] [Does Morphological Correctness Matter for Tokenization? A Scrambled Control Study in Tagalog](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20859)
*Abdul Rehman Antall,Baidya Nath Saha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建将词根与中缀分离编码的分词器 MorphAustro-Tok，在33组实验中较匹配BPE提升他加禄语机器翻译0.84/1.49/3.40 chrF++点；增益既非Token数也非参数量所致，且打乱语素分析后增益变化小于种子间波动，故在小规模下未检测到"形态学正确性"本身的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型学感知分词器通常以"尊重语素边界可保留频率驱动分词所破坏的信息"为前提，但既有研究把"是否按语素切分"与"切分是否语言上正确"混为一谈。他加禄语用中缀表语态（s-um-ulat / s-in-ulat），词根不连续，任何BPE合并序列都无法还原词根，为解耦这两个因素提供理想测试场景。

Method: 构建 MorphAustro-Tok：将词根输出为连续单元，并后接位置化的中缀Token。对照设置包括语料匹配的BPE基线，以及在三档fertility中的两档上设置的"打乱语素"控制组——该控制组保持语素数、可逆性与按类型的切分一致性，但随机化伪中缀的位置。共33组运行，以句级chrF++评估。

Result: MorphAustro-Tok在三个层级的fertility下分别较匹配BPE提升 0.84、1.49、3.40 平均句级chrF++。Token数不能解释增益（分词越粗Token越多，增益反而增大）；容量也不能解释（最粗层级下打乱组参数更多但得分更低）。在两档受控层级上，打乱形态分析带来的增益变动小于种子间离散度，即在此规模下未检测到形态学正确性的贡献。

Conclusion: 增益来源于把不连续语素做位置化、可逆的重新编码（即"结构解耦"），而非语素边界的语言学正确性；在此实验规模下，形态学正确性对下游翻译无显著贡献。研究提示类型学感知分词的有效性宣称需与"语言学正确性"解耦检验。

Abstract: Typology-aware tokenizers are motivated by the claim that segmentation which respects morpheme boundaries preserves information that frequency-driven segmentation destroys. Studies routinely establish that it helps while assuming the boundaries must be linguistically correct. We separate them. Tagalog marks voice with infixes (s-um-ulat 'wrote', s-in-ulat 'was written'), so the root is not contiguous and no sequence of BPE merges can recover it. We build MorphAustro-Tok, a tokenizer that emits the root as a contiguous unit followed by a positional infix token, and compare it against a corpus-matched BPE baseline and, at two of three fertility levels, against a scrambled-morpheme control that preserves morph count, invertibility and per-type consistency while randomising the pseudo-infix. Across 33 runs, MorphAustro-Tok improves Tagalog machine translation over matched BPE by 0.84, 1.49 and 3.40 mean sentence-level chrF++ points. Token count does not explain the gain, since it grows as segmentation coarsens, and neither does capacity: at the coarsest level the scrambled arm carries more parameters and scores lower. Scrambling the analysis moves the gain by less than between-seed dispersion at both controlled levels, so we detect no contribution from morphological correctness at this scale.

</details>


### [152] [Prune the Summary, Not the History: Source-Judged Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20927)
*Guanghui Min,Chen Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示上下文压缩摘要中混入了压缩器自身推理（无环境来源）的内容，并提出免训练的 Source-Judged Compaction (SJC)，用非生成式判别模型 Jev 逐条判断摘要条目的来源并删除无源条目，在不增加 token 消耗的前提下提升跨运行可靠性 2.1%–8.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体依赖上下文压缩，压缩摘要不仅记录事实，还因压缩提示要求"决策与下一步"而混入压缩器生成的推理，智能体事后无法区分。对广泛使用的结构化压缩器分析显示，83% 的失败运行可追溯到执行了某条摘要条目的动作，且其中多数无环境输出支持。因此需要一种机制甄别无来源的摘要条目。

Method: 提出 Source-Judged Compaction（SJC）：一种免训练的后处理步骤，对每条摘要条目打分，判断其是否能在环境输出或上一版摘要中找到来源，并删除无来源条目；不修改智能体与压缩器，每次压缩仅增加一次低成本判定请求。判定器为 Jev，一个非生成式决策模型，以校准概率而非文本回答来源问题。

Result: 在 AppWorld 与 OfficeBench 上，针对两种智能体模型，SJC 相较底层压缩器将跨运行可靠性提升 2.1%–8.9%，且不增加智能体的 token 使用量。

Conclusion: 上下文压缩摘要会引入不可溯源的内容，是长程智能体失败的重要来源；通过轻量的来源判定后处理即可显著提升可靠性，且无需训练、不改动现有智能体与压缩器，具有良好的即插即用性。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents rely on context compaction: when the interaction history outgrows the context window, a compressor replaces it with a natural-language summary. We show that these summaries contain more than a record of what happened. Compaction prompts ask for decisions and next steps, so each summary mixes facts established by the environment with reasoning written by the compressor, and the agent cannot tell the two apart afterwards. In an analysis of a widely used structured compressor, 83% of failed runs trace back to an action that carries out a specific summary entry, most of which no environment output supports. We propose Source-Judged Compaction (SJC), a training-free post-processing step that scores each summary entry for whether it has a source in the environment outputs or the previous summary, and removes the entries that do not. It changes neither the agent nor the compressor and adds one inexpensive judge request per compaction. The judge is Jev, a non-generative decision model that answers the source question with a calibrated probability instead of text. On AppWorld and OfficeBench with two agent models, SJC improves cross-run reliability over the underlying compressor by 2.1%-8.9% without increasing the agent's token usage.

</details>


### [153] [Same Context, Different Agents: A Behavioral Study of Semantic Layers, Orchestration and Compaction in Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20959)
*Zhivar Sourati,Marianne Menglin Liu,Zheng Wang,Rongguang Wang,Sai Ashish Somayajula,Tao Sheng,Kyu J. Han,Sujith Ravi,Dan Roth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统分析三种上下文工程方法（语义层、编排、压缩）在数据智能体上的单独与组合效果，发现其收益取决于智能体行为类型，并提出按行为选择方法的指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据智能体需整合文件、数据库、文档与网页等异构证据，其成功高度依赖上下文；已有研究仅单独验证各上下文工程技术，未考察智能体行为如何影响其效果。

Method: 在五个基准的1,514个长程任务上，用七种大语言模型对语义层、编排、压缩三种技术做单独与组合的全面分析，评估行为、准确率与成本。

Result: 无上下文工程技术的智能体呈现三类行为：调查者、未检查数据即作答的过早作答者、以及放弃的提前停止者；每种技术虽带来已知收益（更多调查、更短提示等），但只有与行为类型匹配时才转化为准确率提升；对调查者而言这些技术反而有害（语义层抑制探索、编排致过度自信损失5个百分点、压缩导致步骤重复）；组合技术的增益与损失均小于各自之和。

Conclusion: 上下文工程技术的效果由智能体行为调制，应依据智能体行为、任务需求及准确率-成本权衡来选择技术。

Abstract: Answering questions over heterogeneous data means combining evidence from files, databases, documents and the web. Data agents automate this, but their success depends on context. Three context-engineering techniques (CETs) help by shaping it: semantic layers describe the data, orchestration splits work among agents, and compaction condenses interaction history. Existing studies validate each CET alone, leaving open how agent behavior shapes its effect. We present a comprehensive analysis of the three CETs, alone and combined, with seven large language models (LLMs) on 1,514 long-horizon tasks from five benchmarks, covering behavior, accuracy and cost. We find that data agents without CETs form three behavior groups: investigators, premature answerers that answer without inspecting data, and early stoppers that give up. Each CET delivers its known benefit, from more investigation to smaller prompts, but only the behavior group it matches turns that benefit into accuracy, such as premature answerers under orchestration. For investigators, the same CETs can hurt: the semantic layer stops them from looking, orchestration makes them overconfident, costing 5 percentage points, and compaction makes them repeat steps. Combining CETs yields smaller gains and losses than their sum. We derive guidance for choosing CETs by agent behavior, task demands and accuracy-cost trade-offs.

</details>


### [154] [One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20993)
*Hyunjong Ok,Minjae Park,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出用"池化选择率标准差"(pooled SD)统一刻画选择题的selection bias与order sensitivity，并将其精确分解为翻转率(flip rate)与位置偏斜(positional skew)两个无标签因子，据此区分不同缓解手段的作用机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重排选项会改变模型答案，此前研究分两条线：一是selection bias（偏好某些选项字母），二是order sensitivity（不同排序下答案变化）。二者度量口径不一、缺乏联系，难以判断各类缓解方法究竟在修正什么，也难区分"稳定"与"正确"。

Method: 以池化选择率标准差作为统一指标；在每道题各选项在每个位置等频出现的条件下，证明pooled SD恰等于flip rate（跨排序中选中选项发生改变的题目比例）与positional skew（这些题目中选项字母选择率的标准差）之积。在41个checkpoint、12个benchmark上，分析两因子与准确率、输出不确定性、估计的选项符号先验的关系；比较prior correction（选择偏差先验校正）与"排序与其逆序聚合"两类缓解方法对两因子的影响，并考察二者组合、正确选项字母间准确率跨度及模型排名反转数。

Result: flip rate随准确率与输出不确定性变化，positional skew则随估计的选项符号先验变化；prior correction主要降低positional skew，逆序聚合主要降低flip rate；两者对"按正确选项字母的准确率跨度"的收窄幅度相近，但聚合造成的模型排名反转更少；先校正再聚合可同时降低两因子并进一步收窄该跨度。但聚合部分是通过把题目"锁定"到同一个错误选项来降低flip rate的。

Conclusion: 建议同时报告flip rate与positional skew以区分不同缓解机制的作用，并辅以准确率以区分稳定性与正确性；评估中不应仅凭稳定性指标判断模型优劣。

Abstract: Reordering multiple-choice options can change a model's answer, an effect studied as selection bias (a preference for certain option letters) and as order sensitivity (changes in answers across option orderings). We connect these perspectives through the pooled selection-rate standard deviation (pooled SD), which measures how unevenly option letters are selected across questions and orderings. When every option of each question appears equally often at each position, the pooled SD is exactly the product of two label-free factors: the flip rate and the positional skew. The flip rate is the fraction of questions whose chosen option changes across orderings; the positional skew is the standard deviation of option-letter selection rates among those questions. Across 41 checkpoints and 12 benchmarks, the flip rate tracks accuracy and output uncertainty, while the positional skew tracks the estimated option-symbol prior. Prior correction for selection bias mainly reduces the positional skew. Aggregating each ordering with its reversal, a mitigation for order sensitivity, mainly reduces the flip rate. Both reduce the range of accuracy across correct-answer letters by similar amounts, but aggregation leaves fewer model-rank reversals. Applying prior correction before aggregation reduces both factors and further narrows this accuracy range. However, aggregation lowers the flip rate partly by settling questions on the same wrong option. We therefore recommend reporting both factors to distinguish mitigation effects, alongside accuracy to distinguish stability from correctness.

</details>


### [155] [Can LLMs Anticipate Their Cruxes?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21006)
*David Reber,James Reber,Ari Holtzman,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究如何从语言模型的长文本输出中提取决定模型推荐某行动的"关键点"(crux)，即模型多次采样输出间存在分歧、且改变其取值可能改变结论的子问题。比较三种成本递增的策略：先验询问、单次生成后提取、多次 rollout 比较提取，并用 reranker 使多 rollout 方法可行。实证表明低成本方法不足，高风险决策必须采用多 rollout 策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用语言模型辅助决策时，需要理解其输出背后的理由。虽然模型会在文本中给出理由，但文本量过大，实际难以使用。作者希望提取真正驱动模型在多个行动中做出取舍的关键点(crux)，以便理解与审计模型的决策过程。

Method: 将 crux 定义为模型 rollout 分布上的子问题：模型在该子问题上存在分歧，且改变其取值可能改变最终结论，因此 crux 是分布层面的属性而非单条 rollout 的属性。提出三种计算成本递增的策略：(1) 先验地直接询问模型决策的关键点；(2) 模型先完整生成回答，再从推理过程中提取关键点；(3) 生成大量 rollout，通过跨 rollout 推理比较提取关键点。为使第三种方法可行，使用 reranker 廉价调用替代 judge，估计计算量少约 86 倍。

Result: 跨领域、跨模型的广泛实证评估显示：模型先验给出的关键点与事后实际识别出的重要因素关联很弱；仅使用单条 rollout 有所改善，但仍不足以识别完整的关键点集合；多 rollout 比较能更全面地覆盖关键点。

Conclusion: 低成本策略无法充分提取驱动模型决策的关键点，对于高风险决策以及理解语言模型决策空间而言，多 rollout 提取流程不可回避。

Abstract: To use language models to help us make decisions we would like to understand the rationale behind the language model's outputs. In principle, the language model provides its rationale as part of its text output. However, the sheer volume of text makes this hard to use in practice. In this paper, we are interested in extracting the cruxes that lead a model to recommend one action over another. We take a crux to be a sub-question that a model's rollouts disagree on, where changing its value may have altered the conclusion. A crux is therefore a property of the distribution of a model's rollouts, not of any one rollout. We consider three strategies of increasing computational cost. First, we just ask a model to identify, a priori, what the cruxes of a decision will be. Second, we have the model actually go through the process of generating a response and then extract the cruxes that arose in its reasoning. Finally, we generate many responses and extract the cruxes by comparing the reasoning across the rollouts. We make this last procedure computationally tractable with cheap calls to a reranker, an estimated 86 times less compute than a judge. We then conduct an extensive empirical evaluation to assess whether the computationally inexpensive options are sufficient. They are not. Across domains and models, we find that a model's a priori assessment of the cruxes has little relation to the factors that are actually identified as important a posteriori. Using a single rollout helps, but is still inadequate for identifying the full set of cruxes. Accordingly, for high-stakes decisions (and to understand the space of language model decision making) the many rollout procedure is unavoidable.

</details>


### [156] [Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21025)
*Matteo He,William F. Shen,Alex Iacob,Andrej Jovanovic,Xinchi Qiu,Nicholas D. Lane*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出仅凭输出token判断能力涌现时间会混淆"模型编码了什么"与"readout表达了什么"，提出参数轨迹交叉编码直接追踪readout，并证明早期行为时间点反映的是readout学习而非模型习得能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发育式研究通常以模型何时产出正确token来界定能力获得时间，但该预测需经unembedding矩阵（readout），而readout在预训练中仍在学习。作者认为隐藏状态可能先于readout编码任务信息，因此从输出读出的时间线会把编码与表达混为一谈。

Method: 提出parameter-trajectory crosscoding：对每个checkpoint、每个token的readout行拟合同一个稀疏字典，直接追踪readout的演化（不同于作用于激活的crosscoder，仅需checkpoint权重）。据此定位readout重组窗口，并用隐状态上的线性探针比较编码与表达的时间差；再从零预训练仅readout学习率不同的小模型做因果检验。

Result: 在Pythia预训练进程0.4–1.1%的狭窄早期窗口内，readout发生重组，WordNet词类可由其行解码；此时隐状态线性探针已能解码模型输出尚未体现的任务信息。提高readout学习率使readout更早发展、差距更快闭合，且对最终loss影响很小。

Conclusion: 训练早期（许多发育转变被定date之处）的行为时间点可能反映readout学会表达任务信息的时刻，而非模型真正习得该信息的时刻；评估能力涌现需区分编码与读出。

Abstract: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode task information that the model's own outputs do not yet show. To test whether such gaps depend on how fast the readout learns, we pretrain small models from scratch that differ only in the readout's learning rate. We find that raising it makes the readout develop earlier and the gap close sooner, with little effect on final loss. Together, these results imply that early in training, where many developmental transitions are dated, a behavioral date can reflect when the readout learns to express task information and not when the model learns it.

</details>


### [157] [ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21042)
*Zhaoqian Xue,Shaoze Zhou,Xuexin Li,Junting Mu,Haozheng Liu,Zhongyin Wang,Yichun He,Renkai Ma,Hao Zhou,Sarah Bratt,Siyuan Ma,Chen Chen,Lingyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出对话式多智能体系统 ReviewPilot，自动化 PRISMA 从文献筛选到信息抽取的流程，每条筛选决策附理由、每个抽取值附来源，并在流行病学专家综述上超越单提示 LLM 与 AgentSLR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述需遵循 PRISMA 流程进行文献筛选与证据抽取；现有基于 LLM 的深度研究工具虽能检索与总结文献，却不记录哪些研究被排除、抽取数值来自何处，缺乏可追溯性与流程完整性。

Method: 构建对话式多智能体系统 ReviewPilot，通过对话定制筛选标准与抽取模式（schema），并用项目级记忆保存配置与修订记录；实现筛选决策附理由、抽取值附来源的可追溯机制；在两个不同领域与多个 LLM 上进行评估，并设置单提示 LLM 与 AgentSLR 作为基线，配合案例研究与人工标注对比。

Result: 在流行病学专家综述上，ReviewPilot 在三种 LLM 下均优于单提示 LLM 与 AgentSLR，筛选宏 F1 最高达 0.776，抽取 F1 最高达 0.788；生物医学与人机交互案例研究中与人工标注者高度一致。

Conclusion: ReviewPilot 可将 PRISMA 工作流端到端自动化并保持决策与证据的可追溯性，且具备跨领域迁移潜力。

Abstract: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.

</details>


### [158] [PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21046)
*Dingjie Song,Zhiling Yan,Ziqian Zhang,Yuxuan Zhang,Lichao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出ReviewFact基准，用于标注评审意见中的事实性错误，并提出融合大模型与判定模型的PremiseCheck框架，在保持接近前沿LLM准确率的同时显著降低成本和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投稿量增长使同行评审承压，人类或AI撰写的评审意见可能歪曲论文内容（事实性错误）；现有前沿LLM核查准确但需每次通读全文、代价高，而廉价判定模型难以处理包含多个隐含断言的整体评语。

Method: 构建ReviewFact基准：在NLP、机器学习与自然科学三个领域以统一定义标注评审意见中的事实性错误，并同时度量准确率、成本与延迟。提出PremiseCheck框架：由LLM在不读论文的情况下将每条评语改写为显式前提（premises），再由廉价判定模型逐个前提对照论文核查。

Result: 在逐条核查评语时，PremiseCheck在三个领域均达到与GPT-5.5相当的准确率，成本约为其一半；在NLP评审上成本约为四分之一、延迟不足一半。

Conclusion: 将"整体评语核查"分解为"前提抽取+逐项验证"可在不损失准确率的前提下大幅降低成本与延迟，说明任务分解是提升事实核查性价比的有效途径。

Abstract: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. We introduce ReviewFact, a benchmark that labels such factual errors in review comments under one definition across NLP, machine learning, and the natural sciences, and that measures cost and latency alongside accuracy. A frontier LLM checks comments well but must read the whole paper for each check, while cheap decision models, which score whether a statement holds in a text, fall far short on whole comments that mix several implicit assertions. PremiseCheck is a framework that combines the two. An LLM rewrites each comment as explicit premises without reading the paper, and a decision model checks each premise against the paper. When each comment is checked on its own, PremiseCheck reaches accuracy comparable to GPT-5.5 across all three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of its cost and less than half its latency.

</details>


### [159] [SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21048)
*Kai Chen,Guisi Ni,Albert Cheu,Kassem Fawaz,Yuzheng Hu,Ryan McKenna,Peter Kairouz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文将差分隐私（DP）洞察形式化为可复用的表示，用于回答分析型查询，并据此构建通用效用评估基准；提出SHIP方法（查询到属性映射、层级混合分类体系、DP合成表发布）及以QA性能与结构保真度为主的评估协议，实验显示其优于已有私有洞察基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从文本数据中提取洞察同时保护用户隐私日益重要，但现有方法产出的私有洞察形式多样、面向不同分析目的，导致效用难以评估与横向比较；同时回答分析查询需要细粒度细节和跨属性统计，而现有表示往往缺失这些信息。

Method: 将DP洞察重构为可复用表示以支撑分析查询回答，作为效用评估的共同基础；提出SHIP：自动将查询映射到属性，构建层级混合分类体系（hierarchical hybrid taxonomy），并发布DP合成表供后续分析；设计以QA性能和结构保真度（structured fidelity）为主的评估协议。

Result: 实验表明SHIP在QA性能与结构保真度两项指标上相较现有私有洞察基线均表现强劲，同时识别出结构化表示仍具挑战性的一类查询。

Conclusion: 以“可复用表示+查询回答”为共同基础可有效比较私有洞察的效用；SHIP通过查询-属性映射与层级混合分类体系生成DP合成表，兼顾细粒度与跨属性统计信息，但结构化表示对部分查询类型仍有局限。

Abstract: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit.
