</details>


### [400] [GraphBEAT: Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation Over Time for Early Risk Stratification of Gastrointestinal Cancers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22014)
*Leo Y. Li-Han,Chris Varghese,Elizabeth B. Habermann,Mark J. Truty,William R. G. Perry,Cornelius A. Thiels,Hojjat Salehinejad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphBEAT：将临床事件分桶构建患者特异的有向时序图，用时间衰减消息传递+多头注意力池化预测胃肠癌，性能超GNN/Transformer/LSTM且算力低两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向EHR同时含诊断与实验室信息，但存在不规则、稀疏、异质、不完整等问题，直接建模困难；且现有序列模型参数量与计算开销大。目标是实现早期胃肠癌风险分层。

Method: GraphBEAT（Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation over Time）时序图表示学习框架：将临床事件按时间桶聚合为患者特异、时序有向图；节点编码特征身份、观测值与时间位置；采用上下文感知、时间衰减的消息传递建模相邻桶间转移；最后用多头注意力池化得到患者级表示。

Result: 在多站点纵向诊断编码与实验室检验数据上，针对胰腺癌、肝癌、肠癌在12/24/36个月诊断提前期进行训练与评估；所有设置下均优于GraphSAGE、GAT、GCN及Transformer、LSTM；每患者FLOPs比Transformer/LSTM少250倍以上，参数量少20倍以上。

Conclusion: GraphBEAT在稀疏、异质纵向健康记录的癌症风险分层中兼具高精度与高计算效率，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) contain complementary diagnostic and laboratory information about patient health. However, irregularity, sparsity, heterogeneity, and incompleteness in documentation complicate EHR modeling. To address the problem, we introduce GraphBEAT (Graph-based Bucketized Event Aggregation over Time), a temporal graph representation learning framework that groups clinical events into time buckets and transforms observed features into patient-specific, temporally directed graphs to enable early risk stratification for gastrointestinal cancers. Each node in an EHR graph encodes feature identity, observed value, and temporal position of clinical events. A context-aware, time-decay message-passing mechanism models transitions between successive buckets, followed by multi-head attention pooling to generate patient-level representations. GraphBEAT was trained and evaluated on multi-site longitudinal diagnosis codes and laboratory tests to predict pancreatic, liver, and intestinal cancer at 12-, 24-, and 36-month diagnostic lead times. In all experimental setups, GraphBEAT consistently outperformed baseline graph neural networks (GraphSAGE, GAT, and GCN) and sequence modeling approaches (Transformer and long short-term memory [LSTM]). GraphBEAT also required over 250x fewer floating-point operations per patient and over 20x fewer parameters than the Transformer and LSTM baselines. These results support GraphBEAT as an accurate and computationally efficient approach for cancer risk stratification from sparse, heterogeneous longitudinal health records.

</details>


### [401] [EEG-Based Prediction of Music Enjoyment Using Deep Learning with Explainable Temporal Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20795)
*Parshav Singla,Simranjit Kaur,Maanya Walia,Niharika*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在MUSIN-G数据集上将音乐愉悦度预测建模为EEG回归问题，采用被试间划分协议比较六种深度学习模型，并对TCN进行可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐愉悦体验主观且随乐曲推进而变化，难以理解；已有EEG研究多将音乐情绪处理为分类标签或依赖黑箱模型，缺乏可复现的跨被试回归基准与解释性分析。

Method: 使用MUSIN-G公开数据集（20名听者、128通道EEG、歌曲级愉悦度评分），将愉悦度预测形式化为回归问题；采用被试间协议（15人训练与验证、5人测试）比较六种深度学习模型（DeepConvNet、CNN-LSTM、GNN-CNN、TCN等）；用梯度法与遮挡法解释，对全部留出窗口求平均，定位每个2秒窗内最影响TCN预测的时间片段。

Result: DeepConvNet、CNN-LSTM与GNN-CNN取得最低平均绝对误差（1–5量表上0.97–0.99）；TCN与评分的皮尔逊相关最高（r=0.21）。

Conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的跨听者EEG愉悦度回归基准，并表明可解释性分析与标准指标互为补充。

Abstract: Understanding why listeners enjoy music is difficult because the experience is subjective and changes as a piece unfolds. Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a non-invasive way to study neural responses during listening, yet earlier work has mostly treated music emotion as a categorical label or relied on black-box models. We formulate enjoyment prediction as a regression problem on the public MUSIN-G dataset, which contains 128-channel EEG from 20 listeners together with song-level enjoyment ratings. Six deep learning models were compared under a participant-wise protocol, in which 15 listeners were used for training and validation and 5 were held out for testing. DeepConvNet, CNN-LSTM and GNN-CNN reached the lowest mean absolute error (0.97 to 0.99 on the 1 to 5 scale), while the temporal convolutional network (TCN) had the highest Pearson correlation with the ratings (r = 0.21). Gradient-based and occlusion-based explanations, averaged over all held-out windows, identify the time segments within each two-second window that most influence the TCN predictions. The study provides a reproducible cross-listener benchmark for EEG-based enjoyment regression and shows how explainability analysis complements standard metrics.

</details>


### [402] [Optimal Explicit and Implicit Regularization Strengths in High-Dimensional Continual Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20804)
*Gilad Karpel,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究高维情形下持续线性回归的泛化损失，推导出固定每任务梯度步数训练时的闭式泛化损失表达式，证明最优固定步长按 ln T / T 衰减并等价于最优各向同性 L2 正则，并进一步刻画对角正则下最优正则器为各向同性的充要条件及有限步长区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中以固定步长顺序更新参数时，步长既是优化超参又充当隐式正则，但其在多任务、高维场景下与显式正则的关系及随任务数的缩放规律缺乏精确理论刻画，因此需要给出可解析的泛化损失分析以指导步长与正则设计。

Method: 在高维持续线性回归框架下，对每个任务执行固定步数的梯度下降，针对任意教师（单教师及 i.i.d. 教师）推导泛化损失的显式闭式表达；分析最优固定步长随任务数 T 的缩放；将其与最优调优的各向同性 L2 正则进行渐近等价性比较；并推广到具有对角正则矩阵的广义岭回归，给出泛化损失的闭式刻画及最优正则器为各向同性的充要条件；最后识别最优步长在 T→∞ 时仍保持有限的任务差异性区间。

Result: 得到任意教师下 GD 训练的泛化损失闭式解；证明最优固定步长近似按 ln T / T 衰减，且该缩放下泛化损失渐近等价于最优调优的各向同性 L2 正则；给出对角正则广义岭回归的泛化损失闭式表征与各向同性最优性的充要条件；发现当任务变异性较大时最优步长在 T→∞ 时保持有限，揭示任务可变性与隐式正则之间的非平凡权衡，与 i.i.d. 教师缩放形成对比；线性模型与神经网络实验均验证理论预测。

Conclusion: 该工作为持续学习中的步长选择与正则化设计提供了精确的理论依据：固定步长可作为隐式各向同性正则，其最优缩放为 ln T / T；在任务高度可变时有限步长仍为最优，说明任务多样性与隐式正则之间存在可利用的权衡，对持续学习系统设计具有实践指导意义。

Abstract: We study continual linear regression in a high-dimensional regime, where a learner observes a sequence of tasks and updates its parameters sequentially. In this setting, we derive an explicit closed-form expression for the generalization loss of a model trained with gradient descent for a fixed number of steps per task, which holds for arbitrary teachers. We prove that the optimal fixed step size decays nearly inversely with the number of tasks, specifically as $\ln T / T$, for a single teacher and, more generally, i.i.d. teachers. Under this scaling, we show that the resulting generalization loss is asymptotically equivalent to that achieved by optimally tuned L2 (isotropic) regularization. Furthermore, we extend our analysis to generalized ridge regression with diagonal regularization matrices, obtaining a closed-form characterization of the generalization loss and identifying necessary and sufficient conditions under which the optimal regularizer is isotropic. Finally, we identify a regime where the optimal step size remains finite even as the number of tasks tends to infinity, thus revealing a non-trivial tradeoff between task variability and implicit regularization, in contrast to the i.i.d. teacher scaling. Our theoretical predictions are corroborated by experiments on both linear models and neural networks, providing practical guidance for the design of continual learning systems.

</details>


### [403] [Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20814)
*Xuanchang Zhang,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GGPO，用对数均值指数对比（无需学习者-行为策略重要性权重）处理离线/陈旧行为策略下的KL正则化策略优化，并给出理论保证与参考模型刷新机制，实验优于GRPO与AGRO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习常在"陈旧或不同行为策略"生成的响应上训练语言模型，用学习者-行为策略重要性权重做修正会给长响应带来高方差。

Method: GGPO在同提示的多条响应间最小化KL调整奖励的log-mean-exp对比损失，不使用学习者-行为重要性权重；由KL正则化策略优化推导，on-policy时总体损失即KL正则化最优性间隙；通过精确Gibbs目标组合刻画参考模型刷新，并在局部参考控制与逐token行为失配下给出有限数据最终策略奖励界。

Result: 消融：固定参考的GGPO在五基准问题加权平均得32.96，默认刷新调度为46.58；数学推理实验中在训练-推理失配及固定离线数据下均优于GRPO与AGRO，且在受控策略陈旧度增大时性能保持稳定。

Conclusion: GGPO提供了无需重要性权重的低方差KL正则化目标，具备理论保证与必要的参考刷新机制，对训练-推理失配与策略陈旧具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often trains language models on responses generated by a different, possibly stale behavior policy. Correcting this mismatch with learner-to-behavior importance weights can introduce high variance for long responses. We introduce Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization (GGPO), which minimizes a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards among responses to the same prompt, without learner-to-behavior importance weights. We derive GGPO from KL-regularized policy optimization: on policy, its population loss is exactly the KL-regularized optimality gap, and under suitable coverage the learner's single-response expected reward is at least the behavior policy's best-of-$K$ reward, minus terms for the raw finite-group loss, regularization, and finite training data. We characterize reference refresh through exact Gibbs-target composition and a finite-data final-policy reward bound under local reference control and tokenwise behavior mismatch. This refresh is empirically important: in an ablation, fixed-reference GGPO scores $32.96$ on the five-benchmark problem-weighted average, versus $46.58$ with the default refresh schedule. Experiments on mathematical reasoning further show that GGPO outperforms GRPO and AGRO under training-inference mismatch and on fixed offline data, while maintaining its performance as controlled policy staleness grows.

</details>


### [404] [O-RAN-Native Jamming Detection Under Network Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20816)
*Sneihil Gopal,Fernando J. Cintrón,Richard A. Rouil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统计集成方法（SEM）用于O-RAN架构下基于KPI的射频干扰检测，融合MAD基线检测、计数型异常检测与突变检测的加权投票；在冷启动（无需标注）与监督两种模式下运行。基于8个异构5G环境的约25小时日志，采用单环境与多环境留一验证，与5种ML分类器和5种DL序列模型对比。结果表明分布漂移下学习模型召回下降、漏检干扰，而SEM即便冷启动仍能保持检测能力（以虚警为代价）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射频干扰威胁蜂窝网络运行，O-RAN的E2接口可提供每UE的遥测数据，使基于KPI的干扰检测无须专有硬件；但实际部署要求检测方法能跨异构网络泛化。现有学习型方法在训练未覆盖的分布漂移条件下易失效，故需一种可快速部署、跨环境泛化的检测方案。

Method: 提出统计集成方法（SEM），由三部分组成并以加权投票融合：(1) 基于自适应中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的基线检测；(2) 基于计数的异常检测；(3) 突变检测。SEM支持冷启动模式（无需标注数据即可部署）与监督模式（随标注数据积累，通过网格搜索离线精调参数）。实验使用约25小时、涵盖8个异构5G环境的测试床日志，采用单环境与多环境留一（LOO）验证，与5种ML分类器和5种DL序列模型进行对比。

Result: 在训练未遇见的分布漂移条件下，学习型（ML/DL）模型倾向于失去召回率、漏检干扰事件；而SEM即使在冷启动模式下仍能维持检测能力，代价是虚警率升高。SEM的参数优化可映射为O-RAN Non-RT RIC中的rApp，实现持续精调。

Conclusion: SEM为异构O-RAN网络中的射频干扰检测提供了可泛化、可即时部署的统计方案；运营方可先以冷启动模式上线，待语料覆盖充分后再平滑过渡到学习型方法，并通过rApp机制在Non-RT RIC中持续优化参数。

Abstract: Radio-frequency jamming threatens cellular network operations in contested environments. The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture exposes per-User Equipment (UE) telemetry through the E2 interface, enabling Key Performance Indicator (KPI)-based jamming detection without proprietary hardware. However, operational deployment demands detection methods that generalize across heterogeneous networks. We propose a Statistical Ensemble Method (SEM) combining adaptive Median Absolute Deviation (MAD)-based baseline detection, count-based anomaly detection, and abrupt change detection through a weighted voting system. SEM operates in two modes: a cold-start mode requiring no labeled data for immediate deployment, and a supervised mode where parameters are refined offline via grid search as labeled data accumulates. We evaluate SEM against five machine learning (ML) classifiers and five deep learning (DL) sequence models using approximately 25 hours of testbed data comprising logs from eight heterogeneous 5G environments, employing both single-environment and multi-environment leave-one-out (LOO) validation. Our analysis indicates that under conditions not encountered during training (distribution shift), learning-based models tend to lose recall and miss jamming events, whereas SEM, even in cold-start mode, maintains detection capabilities at the cost of false alarms. Furthermore, SEM's parameter optimization can be mapped to O-RAN's Non-RT RIC as an rApp for continuous refinement, allowing operators to transition to learning-based alternatives once corpus coverage is sufficient.

</details>


### [405] [Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20826)
*Yifan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文检验MoE语言模型的逐层、逐任务阶段专家路由统计能否指导routed-expert FFN张量的分层混合精度量化；结论是路由引导的重分配在固定平均比特预算下未优于均匀基线，路由统计是未经验证的量化代价代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型分层混合精度量化需要逐层敏感度信号来分配比特预算。一个诱人的假设是：专家路由行为统计（路由熵、专家选择稳定性等）能反映各层量化敏感度。作者检验该假设是否成立。

Method: 在ik_llama.cpp中为Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B搭建路由捕获与profiling流水线，获取逐层、逐任务阶段（prompt/reasoning/response）的路由统计；由路由熵/决断性、变异系数CV、Jaccard/阶段脆弱性、top-1专家强度构造复合敏感度分数；用坐标下降在固定平均bpw预算下求解层分配。实验对比约4.0 bpw均匀（flat）、约2.7 bpw陡峭预算（steep）与约2.7 bpw随机分配对照。

Result: 各质量档内重分配均未超过均匀基线。flat档重分配统计中性（z约0.9）；steep档随机重分配与路由引导重分配差距在1个标准误内，说明该质量档的结构性损失源于强制降级与KLD尾部注入；该激进预算条件下的决定性损失（z>4SE）在三个独立权重向量上复现。

Conclusion: 路由行为统计不能可靠预测逐层量化代价；更根本的问题是此类统计只是未经证实的代理指标。方法层面：profiling流水线可推广至标准top-k MoE架构；未来应建立直接、可验证的逐层量化代价度量，而非依赖路由行为推断。

Abstract: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. In the flat regime, reallocation is statistically neutral (z about 0.9). For the steep tier, the random reallocation performs within 1 SE of the routing-guided reallocation at the same tier, indicating a structural loss at this quality rung caused by mandatory downgrades and Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) tail injection. This aggressive-budget condition shows a decisive loss (z greater than 4 SE) replicated across three independent weight vectors. We argue that the deeper issue is that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.

</details>


### [406] [Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20832)
*Anita Kriz,Antonin Berthon,Nicolás Astorga,Mihaela van der Schaar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过信息增益奖励显式训练LLM的推理过程，将序列贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销到LLM中，使其习得可泛化的信息采集推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽具广泛预训练知识与强推理能力，但在实验设计任务中难以自适应地主动采集信息，缺乏系统性的信息寻求策略。

Method: 将序列贝叶斯实验设计摊销进LLM：实验生成模型独立于LLM自身信念设定，从而可基于自选模型优化期望信息增益；用信息增益奖励显式训练动作选择的推理。系统考察摊销的设计选择，包括替代生成模型构造、奖励估计、假设空间设定、多步目标，以及与训练期/推理期BED基线的计算成本对比。

Result: 在Twenty Questions任务上，所得策略提升了信息获取与任务表现，以显著更低的计算成本优于推理期与训练期BED基线，并能泛化到未见类别；且从Twenty Questions训练到Medi-Q真实临床对话基准存在正向迁移。

Conclusion: 信息采集可作为LLM中一项可泛化的推理技能被学习获得。

Abstract: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.

</details>


### [407] [Denoising Score Matching in Diffusion Models: The Effect of Rank Constraints on Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20850)
*Anand Jerry George,Nicolas Macris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究秩约束评分网络的架构偏置：训练误差随秩增加单调下降，但测试误差取决于样本量与数据维数；作者用低维子空间高斯数据下的随机特征模型给出精确的学习曲线，并识别出数据子空间正交补维数作为自然秩阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评分网络的秩约束（瓶颈）等架构偏置限制了可表示函数类，但其对泛化的影响机制尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对"秩—样本量—数据维数"交互作用的定量刻画。

Method: 以带秩约束非线性项加线性跳连的评分网络做去噪评分匹配；在嵌于球面的数据上用可训练三层网络做数值实验；理论部分对低维子空间支撑的高斯数据构造秩约束随机特征评分模型，通过截断SVD刻画最优秩约束估计量，并在 n、p、D、r 与环境维数 d 成比例增长下推导渐近精确的训练与测试误差。

Result: 谱刻画区分了改善经验拟合的特征模与改善总体精度的特征模；发现数据子空间正交补的维数是自然的秩阈值；理论学习曲线定性复现了实验中的秩依赖过拟合现象。

Conclusion: 秩约束/瓶颈可通过谱机制正则化评分估计，其有效性由数据维数与样本量共同决定，为架构偏置的泛化效应提供了可解析的解释。

Abstract: Architectural biases restrict the class of functions that a diffusion score network can represent, but their effect on generalization remains poorly understood. We study denoising score matching with score networks having a rank constrained non-linear term and a linear skip connection. Numerical experiments with trainable three-layer networks on data supported on an embedded sphere show that increasing rank lowers training error, but its effect on test error depends on sample size and data dimension. To explain this behavior, we analyze a random-feature score model under rank constraint with Gaussian data supported on a low-dimensional subspace. We characterize the optimal rank-constrained estimator through a truncated singular value decomposition and derive asymptotically precise limiting training and test errors when sample size $(n)$, feature width $(p)$, data dimension $(D)$, and rank $(r)$ scale proportionally with the ambient dimension $(d)$. The resulting spectral characterization distinguishes eigenmodes that improve the empirical fit from those that improve population accuracy. It also identifies the dimension of the orthogonal complement of the data subspace as a natural rank threshold. The theoretical learning curves qualitatively reproduce the observed rank-dependent overfitting, providing a tractable account of how bottlenecks or rank constraints can regularize score estimation and why their effectiveness depends on data dimension and sample size.

</details>


### [408] [Long-Context Drafting Does Not Require Long-Context Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20865)
*Aref Jafari,Vansh Bhatia,Matt Qin,Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury,Ben Lee,Vikram Appia,Ali Ghodsi,Mehdi Rezagholizadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 冻结已发布的短上下文草稿模型，仅通过两种推理时机制（限制注意力缓存、重定位RoPE索引），即可在4k至200万token的超长上下文上保持与短上下文相同的投机解码加速比，无需训练长上下文草稿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长上下文下，需对完整前缀做注意力的草稿模型继承了目标模型的上下文相关开销，导致投机解码加速先衰减后反转。常规做法是训练/微调长上下文草稿模型或使用目标检查点内置的多token预测头，成本高。作者主张这并不必要：草稿模型本身是以目标为条件的，读取的是目标在整个前缀上算出的隐状态，远处上下文无需草稿自身注意力即可到达，验证环节会纠正其遗漏。

Method: 冻结已发布的短上下文草稿模型，直接在远超其训练长度上运行，采用两种推理时机制：(1) 限制草稿可见的注意力缓存（bound attention cache），固定其成本；(2) 将RoPE位置索引重基（re-basing）回训练范围。不更新任何权重，唯一可调参数很快饱和，因此单一vLLM侧配置即可覆盖4k到200万token。理论上证明了公共索引平移何时使草稿计算完全不变，并将接受率分解为两个可测量的间隙并给出紧界。

Result: 在三对目标-草稿模型组合、五个语料库上，冻结草稿模型在短上下文能达到的加速比可一直保持到200万token；短上下文处损失至多0.16x加速。移除任一机制则该平坦性消失。结论关注的是加速比的"平坦性"而非倍数本身，且增益以投机每输出token成本低于匹配的目标单独成本为条件。

Conclusion: 长上下文投机解码无需长上下文草稿模型；目标条件化的短上下文草稿配合缓存界与RoPE重基两种推理时机制，即可在极长上下文下维持加速比的平坦性。

Abstract: Speculative decoding pairs a cheap drafter with parallel verification against the target. At ultra-long context it stops paying, because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, so the speedup it was meant to provide first erodes and then reverses. The standard response is to build a long-context drafter, by training or fine-tuning one, or by using a multi-token-prediction head shipped inside the target checkpoint. We argue this is unnecessary, because the drafters in use are target-conditioned, reading hidden states the target computed over the entire prefix, so distant context already reaches them without their own attention, and verification corrects what they miss. We therefore freeze released short-context drafters and run them far past their training length under two inference-time mechanisms, one bounding the attention cache they see, which fixes their cost, and one re-basing their rotary position indices into the trained range. No weight is touched and the only tunable saturates early, so one vLLM-side configuration spans 4k to two million tokens, costing at most 0.16x of speedup at short length. We prove when a common index shift leaves the drafter's computation exactly unchanged, and decompose acceptance into two measurable gaps with sharp bounds. Whatever speedup a frozen drafter delivers at short context, it retains out to two million tokens, across three target-drafter pairs and five corpora. The claim concerns the flatness rather than the multiple, and removing either mechanism eliminates it. The gain is conditional on the speculative cost per emitted token staying below the matched target-only cost.

</details>


### [409] [SHRED: Self-Play for Heterogeneous Road-Users without Expert Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20866)
*Wei-Jer Chang,Zhouchonghao Wu,Akshay Rangesh,Weixin Li,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SHRED框架，通过大规模异构自博弈（车辆、行人、骑行者联合）从随机初始化训练，无需人类驾驶示范数据，即可涌现真实交互行为，在WOSAC与InterPlan基准上超越对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通仿真与自主规划方法主要依赖大规模人类驾驶示范来学习真实交互行为。作者探究：此类行为能否完全通过自博弈自发涌现，从而摆脱对示范数据和轨迹回放的依赖。

Method: SHRED将车辆、行人、骑行者统一纳入闭环异构自博弈训练；结合类型特定的动力学与目标函数、程序化场景生成以及逐智能体随机化，使多样化行为在交互中涌现。

Result: WOSAC上联合控制三类道路使用者，优于最接近的无示范自博弈基线与采用示范训练参考策略的既有自博弈方法；仅用nuPlan地图几何训练的策略在Waymo零样本评估下保持相当真实性；InterPlan规划基准上优于所有对比规划器。消融显示异构性同时提升仿真真实性与规划性能，交互密集场景增益尤大。

Conclusion: 异构程序化自博弈是一种可扩展、无需示范的范式，可学习真实且具交互性的交通行为。

Abstract: Realistic traffic simulation and autonomous planning both depend on modeling interactions among heterogeneous road users whose dynamics, constraints, and behaviors differ fundamentally. Existing approaches predominantly learn realistic interaction behavior from large-scale human driving demonstrations. In this work, we ask whether such behavior can instead emerge purely through self-play. We present SHRED, a framework that jointly trains vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists through large-scale heterogeneous self-play from random initialization, without demonstrations or logged-trajectory replay. SHRED combines type-specific dynamics and objectives with procedural scenario generation and per-agent randomization, allowing diverse behaviors to emerge through closed-loop interaction. On the Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge (WOSAC), SHRED jointly controls all three road-user types and outperforms both the closest demonstration-free self-play baseline and prior self-play methods that use demonstration-trained reference policies. Policies trained only on nuPlan map geometry retain comparable realism under zero-shot evaluation on Waymo. For planning, SHRED outperforms all compared planners on the interaction-heavy InterPlan benchmark. Controlled ablations show that heterogeneity in self-play improves both traffic realism and planning performance, with particularly large planning gains in interaction-heavy scenarios. Together, these results establish heterogeneous procedural self-play as a scalable, demonstration-free paradigm for learning realistic and interactive traffic behavior.

</details>


### [410] [Clinically Interpretable Biological Age Estimation Using CatBoost and SHAP with Continuous and Categorical Features from NHANES](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20868)
*Yanni Sun,Zheng Qu,Kevin Ren,Zhanglin Lin Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究基于NHANES大样本构建CatBoost模型估计生物学年龄，并将SHAP依赖图的定性解读扩展为预设的自动化定量分析流程，输出特征取值区间、效应幅度与零交叉阈值，提升模型的可解释性与可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物学年龄（BA）的机器学习估计多依赖连续实验室指标，数据来源单一；且SHAP依赖图通常仅作视觉定性解读，缺乏可复现的定量刻画，限制了模型的临床可解释性与透明度。

Method: 使用NHANES 2011—2020年3月共24,983名成人数据，纳入人口学、实验室、体格检查与生活方式共44个异质性临床预测变量；以CatBoost回归估计实际年龄并定义模型估计年龄为BA；采用SHAP进行多层级解释，并在标准可视化基础上实施预设的自动化程序，直接作用于SHAP依赖图以量化BA贡献最低/最高的特征取值区间、对应调整幅度及零交叉阈值。

Result: 模型估计BA与留出测试集实际年龄强相关（Pearson r = 0.798，P < 0.001）。群体层面SHAP显示尿素氮、血糖、剧烈休闲活动、红细胞分布宽度和丙氨酸氨基转移酶为主要预测因子，且有3个分类变量进入前25位；自动化定量SHAP分析给出了各预测因子的取值区间、效应量与拐点，瀑布图实现个体层面解释。

Conclusion: 该框架将SHAP的定性视觉解读拓展为跨异质临床数据的可复现定量指标，增强了模型透明度，为生物学衰老研究与精准健康提供了可扩展的方法学基础。

Abstract: Biological age (BA) captures inter-individual variation in physiological aging beyond chronological age (CA). Although machine-learning models have advanced BA estimation, many rely primarily on continuous laboratory biomarkers, and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) dependence plots are typically interpreted visually. We developed a clinically interpretable machine-learning framework for BA estimation using heterogeneous clinical data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES 2011-March 2020, N = 24,983 adults aged >= 18). A CatBoost regression model incorporated 44 demographic, laboratory, physical examination, and lifestyle predictors to estimate CA, defining model-estimated age as BA. SHAP provided multi-level interpretability. Crucially, building on standard visual inspection, we implemented a prespecified automated procedure directly on SHAP dependence plots to quantify feature-value ranges associated with lowest and highest BA contributions, corresponding adjustment magnitudes, and zero-crossing thresholds. Model-estimated BA strongly correlated with CA in held-out testing data (Pearson r = 0.798, P < 0.001). Population-level SHAP identified blood urea nitrogen, serum glucose, vigorous recreational activity, red cell distribution width, and alanine aminotransferase among the leading predictors, with three categorical variables ranking among the top 25. Automated quantitative SHAP analysis mapped predictor-specific ranges, effect sizes, and inflection points, while waterfall plots enabled individual explanations. By extending qualitative visual interpretation to reproducible quantitative metrics across heterogeneous clinical data, this framework enhances transparency and provides a scalable methodological foundation for biological aging research and precision health.

</details>


### [411] [CogDrift-4D: Hierarchical Multimodal Modeling of Temporal Behavioral Decay for MCI Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20877)
*Sankalp Vaish,Sumukh Veeramalla,Rishank Singh,Caroline Summerour,John A. Batsis,Xiaohui Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出跨18个月、7次非脚本多模态交互的行为数据集并组织为4D张量（Batch×Session×Time×Feature），据此设计分层4D Transformer框架CogDrift-4D，通过会话内与跨会话双层次建模刻画认知衰退轨迹，实现MCI检测准确率0.733。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻度认知障碍（MCI）早期检测是痴呆照护的关键瓶颈，需要可规模化、能捕捉细微行为退化（行为疲劳与长期漂移）的工具；现有方法难以显式保留会话内局部动态与跨会话长期变化。

Method: 构建7次非脚本多模态交互、跨18个月的行为数据集，形式化为4D张量（Batch×Session×Time×Feature）。模型CogDrift-4D为分层4D Transformer：会话内层用局部最小二乘回归斜率量化面部动作单元与声学能量的急性"衰减"；跨会话层用递归交叉注意力反馈编码器作为累积疲劳累加器，建模行为漂移；并以局部Quality Gate动态过滤低质量特征以抑制环境噪声与跟踪失败，最终进行融合语义与原始物理动态的early fusion。

Result: 在结构化言语与语言交互上，MCI检测准确率0.733±0.13，F1为0.716±0.14，优于先进基线方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为居家、实时痴呆筛查提供了数学严谨、可扩展且鲁棒的基础。

Abstract: Early detection of mild cognitive impairment remains a critical bottleneck in dementia care, demanding scalable tools capable of capturing subtle behavioral decay. To capture the subtle temporal changes of cognitive decline, we introduce a behavioral dataset collected across seven unscripted multimodal interactions over an 18-month horizon. This dataset formalizes continuous, multi-session interactions into a dense 4D tensor (Batch * Session * Time * Feature) that explicitly preserves concurrent local dynamics alongside long-term changes. To effectively process these complex behavioral patterns, we propose CogDrift-4D: a novel, hierarchical 4D Transformer framework. To capture the complex trajectory of cognitive decline, CogDrift-4D implements a dual-level behavioral fatigue and drift modeling architecture. At the intra-session level, the model computes localized least-squares regression slopes to quantify the acute ``fading'' of frame-level facial action units and acoustic energy. At the inter-session level, a recursive cross-attention feedback encoder acts as a cumulative fatigue accumulator, mapping the patient's continuous behavioral drift across successive sessions. To mitigate environmental noise and track failures across sessions, a localized Quality Gate dynamically filters low-integrity features before final fusion, also an early fusion that integrates semantic insights with raw physical dynamics. Evaluated on structured verbal and linguistic interactions, our architecture successfully detects MCI with a classification accuracy of 0.733 +- 0.13 and an F1-score of 0.716 +- 0.14, outperforming advanced baselines. The framework provides a mathematically rigorous, scalable, and robust foundation for home-based, real-time dementia screening.

</details>


### [412] [Do Emergent Misalignment Models Share a Circuit?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20887)
*Muhammad Haseeb,Muhammad Tahir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct的三个有害任务LoRA微调模型进行方向性激活追踪，发现三个共享的注意力头位置，替换其贡献可将涌现性失配（EM）显著降低，表明表征汇聚延伸到共享的、具因果作用的注意力头组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究发现独立微调的模型间存在共享的"失配相关表征"，但尚不清楚这些模型是否依赖共同的计算组件，本文旨在检验EM中表征层面的汇聚是否对应共享的因果性计算单元。

Method: 基于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct构建三个LoRA微调体（有害医疗建议、高风险理财建议、极限运动推荐）；采用方向性激活追踪，在三者各自排名前五的注意力头中识别出三个共享头位置；将各微调体的五个选中头贡献替换为基座模型贡献，并与层匹配的随机干预对比；进一步做跨微调体激活迁移实验考察固定回复偏好。

Result: 替换共享头贡献后，自由生成EM从医疗38.9%降至22.9%、金融50.7%降至12.5%、运动41.7%降至11.1%，优于层匹配随机干预且未降低连贯性评分；跨微调体激活迁移显示共享头在固定回复偏好上呈部分可互换效应。

Conclusion: EM的表征汇聚可延伸到同一架构内共享且具因果作用的注意力头组件，为失配的机制定位与针对性干预提供了证据。

Abstract: Fine-tuning language models on narrowly defined harmful tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM) across unrelated domains. While prior work has identified shared misalignment-associated representations across independently fine-tuned models, it remains unclear whether these models rely on common computational components. We investigate this question using three LoRA fine-tunes of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct trained on harmful medical advice, risky financial advice, and extreme-sports recommendations. Using direction-based activation tracing, we identify three attention-head locations shared among the five highest-ranked heads of all three organisms. Replacing each organism's five selected head contributions with Base contributions reduces free-generation EM from 38.9% to 22.9% for medical, 50.7% to 12.5% for finance, and 41.7% to 11.1% for sports, outperforming layer-matched random interventions without reducing judged coherence. Cross-organism activation transfer further shows that the shared heads exhibit partially interchangeable effects on fixed-response preference. These findings provide evidence that representational convergence in EM extends to shared, causally relevant attention-head components within a common model architecture.

</details>


### [413] [Wrong Votes, Right Gradients: Why Majority-Vote Rewards Track Verifiable RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20898)
*Dylan P. Wilson,Chengsong Huang,Jiaxin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出自生成标签（如对模型自身样本做多数投票）之所以能复现可验证奖励训练的大部分增益，关键在于"批级更新"而非"提示级视角"：多数投票误差在各提示间方向不一致时，其误导分量随批大小消失，从而与金标准更新方向等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从传统的提示级视角看，多数投票只能返回模型众数答案，无法提供关于正确性的新信息，因此自生成标签能接近可验证奖励训练效果这一现象令人困惑。作者希望从批级更新的角度解释这一"悖论"，并厘清自生成标签何时可替代真实验证。

Method: 作者论证在参数共享下，单条提示自身梯度在实际批大小下仅占该提示输出变化的不到1%，故错误标签只有当误差方向在提示间一致时才重要。随后将多数投票更新分解为"收缩"分量与"误导"分量（相对于金标准更新），并证明误差在提示间不一致时误导分量随批大小趋于零。作者在五个模型上测量逐响应梯度，并与随机奖励零假设、两次独立金标准更新的一致度进行对比；同时进行随机翻转标签实验与共享规则翻转对比实验。

Result: 实验发现：多数投票误差的不一致程度与随机奖励零假设相当；多数投票更新与金标准更新的一致程度与两次独立金标准更新之间的一致程度相当；其误差校正余弦相似度在误差范围内为1。随机翻转最多30%的金标准标签仍保持更新方向不变，而由共享规则翻转同样比例则破坏方向；在每条提示上都偏好某类响应的奖励（如学习到的奖励模型）明显不足。

Conclusion: 该等价性在所检验的每个检查点均成立，但仅为局部性质：金标准奖励训练在留出集多数准确率上最终仍领先。决定自生成标签能否替代验证的是误差的"一致性"（coherence）而非误差率。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with self-generated labels, such as majority vote over a model's own samples, often recovers most of the gain of training with verifiable rewards. This is puzzling from the usual prompt-level view, in which majority vote only returns a model's modal answer and cannot add information about correctness. We argue that the relevant unit is the batch-level update. Because parameters are shared, a prompt's own gradient accounts for less than 1\% of the change in that prompt's output at practical batch sizes, so a wrong label matters only to the extent that label errors share a direction across prompts. We decompose the majority-vote update into shrinkage and misdirection relative to the gold update, and show that misdirection vanishes with batch size whenever errors are incoherent across prompts, however often the labels are wrong. Measuring per-response gradients on five models, we find that majority-vote errors are as incoherent as a random-reward null, that the majority-vote update agrees with the gold update as closely as two independent gold updates agree with each other, and that its noise-corrected cosine with the gold update is 1 within error. Randomly flipping up to 30\% of gold labels leaves the update direction intact, while the same fraction flipped by a shared rule destroys it, and rewards that favor a kind of response on every prompt, such as a learned reward model, fall measurably short. The equivalence holds at every checkpoint we examine but is local: gold-reward training still ends ahead on held-out majority accuracy. Error coherence, not error rate, determines when self-generated labels can stand in for verification.

</details>


### [414] [Sign Betting for Misspecified Regression: Variance Adaptivity and Optimal Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20903)
*Yinan Li,Han Han,Kwang-Sung Jun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究模型误设下有界回归的 $L_1$ 风险，分析 sign-betting 回归（Baraud & Maillard 2025 的 min-max 估计器），证明其高概率 $L_1$ oracle 不等式，并刻画 proper learning 的最优通用逼近因子为 3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 $L_2$ 评估不适合 bandits、强化学习等下游决策问题，$L_1(P_X)$ 距离更自然；但误设下 $L_1$ 回归的高概率 oracle 界与最优性尚不清楚。

Method: 分析 sign-betting regression（基于符号投注的 min-max 估计器），推导误设下的高概率 $L_1$ oracle 不等式；分析可实现情形下对平均条件方差的适应性；给出通用逼近因子的下界论证（反例构造证明因子小于 3 不可能）；将上界分析推广到非有限函数类。

Result: sign-betting 回归获得误设下的高概率 $L_1$ oracle 不等式；可实现时界自适应于平均条件方差，恢复 Li et al. (2026) 的方差自适应速率；证明 sign betting 达到逼近因子 3，且无任何 proper learner 能在分布无关的高概率 $L_1$ oracle 不等式中实现严格小于 3 的通用逼近因子。

Conclusion: sign-betting 回归在 $L_1$ 准则下达到最优的通用逼近因子 3，兼具方差自适应性与误设鲁棒性；理论上推广至非有限类，并在合成与真实模型选择任务上得到实验验证。

Abstract: We study bounded regression under model misspecification, evaluating a function $f$ by its $L_1(P_X)$ distance to the conditional mean $η(x)=\mathbb{E}[Y\mid X=x]$, rather than the standard $L_2(P_X)$. This $L_1$ metric is natural for downstream decision problems such as bandits and reinforcement learning. We analyze the min--max estimator of Baraud & Maillard (2025), which we call \emph{sign-betting regression}. Our main results show that sign-betting regression achieves high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequalities under misspecification. Under realizability, our bound adapts to the average conditional variance and recovers the variance-adaptive rate of Li et al. (2026). We further characterize the optimal universal approximation factor for proper learning by showing that sign betting achieves factor 3, while no proper learner can satisfy a distribution-free, high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequality with a universal approximation factor strictly below 3. We extend the upper-bound analysis beyond finite classes and complement the theory with experiments in synthetic and real-world model-selection tasks.

</details>


### [415] [Task-Centric Multimodal Learning for Cognitive Impairment Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20906)
*Sankalp Vaish,Rishank Singh,Sumukh Veeramalla,Caroline Summerour,John A. Batsis,Xiaohui Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无接触多模态（视频/音频/文本）痴呆早期筛查框架，基于与Amazon Alexa的结构化语音互动采集信号；多模态融合模型在各任务上表现稳定（准确率0.76），优于单模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球痴呆患者众多，临床外环境早期检测困难；传统模型仅依赖文本或语音，忽略人类表达的多模态本质，难以全面刻画认知状态。

Method: 无接触多模态筛查框架，采集参与者与Alexa进行结构化语音交互时的视频、音频、文本信号，涵盖语音模式、嗓音特征、面部表情与语言结构；受试完成三项探测自发言语、理解与回忆的对话任务；研究目标为（1）评估哪项任务认知信号最丰富，（2）比较单模态模型效果，（3）评估多模态融合收益。

Result: 任务级分析：视频模型在Command-Reading最佳，准确率0.65（AUC 0.69）；音频模型在Question-Answering最佳，准确率0.67（AUC 0.73）；多模态模型跨任务表现稳定，Command-Reading准确率0.76（AUC 0.75），Question-Answering准确率0.76（AUC 0.73）。

Conclusion: 自然交互中获取的多模态行为线索可可靠区分MCI与健康老化，揭示传统诊断范式的局限，支持向多模态、真实世界认知评估框架转变。

Abstract: Dementia affects millions of older adults worldwide, yet early detection remains difficult outside clinical settings. Traditional models primarily rely on text or voice-based responses, capturing only a limited view of human cognition despite the inherently multimodal nature of human expression. This work proposes a contactless, multimodal screening framework that leverages video, audio, and text signals collected during structured voice-based interactions with Amazon Alexa. By incorporating these modalities, our approach captures a more holistic representation of human behavior encompassing speech patterns, vocal characteristics, facial expressions, and linguistic structure, which may enable more accurate detection of cognitive decline. Different participants completed three conversational tasks designed to probe spontaneous speech, comprehension, and recall. We pursued three objectives: (1) evaluate which of the three Alexa tasks provides the most informative cognitive signals, (2) compare the effectiveness of unimodal models, and (3) assess the benefits of multimodal fusion models. Task-level analysis shows that the video model achieves its best performance on Command-Reading, with an accuracy of 0.65 (AUC 0.69), while the audio model performs best on Question-Answering, reaching an accuracy of 0.67 (AUC 0.73). In contrast, the multimodal model demonstrates consistently stable performance across tasks, achieving an accuracy of 0.76 (AUC 0.75) on Command-Reading and 0.76 (AUC 0.73) on Question-Answering. These findings demonstrate that multimodal behavioral cues captured through naturalistic interactions can reliably distinguish MCI from healthy aging, highlighting the limitations of traditional diagnostic paradigms and supporting the shift toward multimodal, real-world cognitive assessment frameworks.

</details>


### [416] [Replicable Dueling Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20908)
*Rohan Deb,Aadirupa Saha,Udaya Ghai,Karan Singh,Arindam Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究可复现决斗赌博机（replicable dueling bandits）：在共享内部随机性、独立比较结果下，两次执行每轮以至少 1-ρ 概率选择同一有序臂对。基于 Beat-the-Mean 框架，提出首批具有次线性遗憾的可复现算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决斗赌博机依据历史噪声结果选择比较对，导致相同偏好下两次运行可能比较不同臂对，缺乏可复现性。现有可复现学习研究多集中于标准赌博机，决斗场景尚属空白，且 Beat-the-Mean 的分数随臂淘汰而变化、未必将最优臂排最高，直接套用困难。

Method: 以 Beat-the-Mean 为基础，处理其动态分数与淘汰机制，设计三条算法：(1) 在参数 γ≥1 的松弛随机传递性与随机三角不等式下，给出期望遗憾 Õ(γ⁸K⁴H_p/ρ²) 的算法，其中 H_p=Σ(P_{1i}−1/2)^{-1}；(2) 在强随机传递性下，基于同步淘汰改进 K 的依赖，达 Õ(K²H_p/ρ²)；(3) 针对线性决斗赌博机，给出 Õ(d³√T/(c_μρ)) 遗憾的算法。

Result: 理论上分别取得 Õ(γ⁸K⁴H_p/ρ²)、Õ(K²H_p/ρ²) 与 Õ(d³√T/(c_μρ)) 的遗憾界；合成数据与语言模型偏好实验显示算法具备可复现性，并保持次线性遗憾。

Conclusion: 该工作首次为决斗赌博机建立可复现性与次线性遗憾兼具的理论保证，覆盖松弛/强随机传递性及线性结构三类设定，并通过实验验证可复现性与次线性遗憾。

Abstract: Dueling bandits choose each comparison based on earlier noisy outcomes, so two runs on the same preferences can compare different pairs. We study replicable dueling bandits, where two executions with shared internal randomness and independent comparison outcomes must select the same ordered pair in every round with probability at least $1-ρ$. Building on Beat-the-Mean, whose scores change as arms are eliminated and need not rank the best arm highest, we design the first such algorithms with sublinear regret. Under relaxed stochastic transitivity with parameter $γ\ge 1$ and the stochastic triangle inequality, we design an algorithm that achieves expected regret $\widetilde{O}(γ^8 K^4 H_{\mathrm{p}}/ρ^2)$, where $H_{\mathrm{p}}=\sum_{i=2}^{K}(P_{1i}-1/2)^{-1}$. Under strong stochastic transitivity, we design an algorithm based on simultaneous elimination that improves the dependence on $K$ and achieves $\widetilde{O}(K^2 H_{\mathrm{p}}/ρ^2)$ regret. For linear dueling bandits, we design an algorithm that achieves regret $\widetilde{O}(d^3\sqrt{T}/(c_μρ))$. Experiments on synthetic and language-model preferences show replicability, with sublinear regret.

</details>


### [417] [Recursive Offline Distillation via Entropy Gain Sampling and Answer Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20914)
*Andrey Goncharov,Daniil Vyazhev,Simon Epanov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种递归离线蒸馏方法，结合基于熵的采样（选择性蒸馏）与答案混合，在无法获得教师模型内部表示时提升小模型推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将大语言模型的推理链蒸馏到小模型中常用，但研究者通常无法完全访问教师模型及其内部表示，导致蒸馏性能受限。

Method: 递归离线蒸馏，包含两部分：(1) 熵驱动采样——借助70-72B辅助中等模型，按与学生模型的熵差对推理链加权采样；(2) 答案混合——在思维轨迹后补充单token的标准答案。在三个3-4B开源模型上逐轮迭代执行，并比较分析蒸馏轨迹的生成与归一化方法。

Result: 在可比数据预算下持续优于朴素蒸馏（平均57.15±1.01 vs 51.61），且学习曲线更陡峭。

Conclusion: 在黑盒教师条件下，熵加权采样与答案混合相结合的离线蒸馏能显著提升小模型推理能力，效率更高。

Abstract: Distillation of reasoning chains from Large Language Models (LLMs) into their smaller siblings is a standard training approach. Frequently, researchers do not have full access to a teacher model and its internal representations, which limits the resulting performance. We propose a recursive offline distillation method combining two components: entropy-based sampling for selective distillation and answer mixing. Specifically, for three open models (3-4B), at each epoch, we sample reasoning chains weighted by entropy difference with an auxiliary medium model (70-72B) and, next, supplement thinking traces with single-token ground truth answers. Our approach consistently outperforms naive distillation with comparable data budgets ($57.15 \pm 1.01$ vs 51.61 on average) and offers a much steeper learning curve. Additionally, we present a comparative analysis of methods to generate and normalize distillation traces.

</details>


### [418] [How to Train Your Little Dragon: Teaching a Small Language Model to Construct and Refine GPU Optimization Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20980)
*Annabelle Sujun Tang,Wei Tang,Songyao Jiang,Tianhui Li,Shengzhe Xu,Jiin Woo,Kaan Ozkara,Youngsuk Park,Zhen Jia,Hadi Esmaeilzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"Little Dragon"训练方法,训练8B小模型生成并改进TVM MetaSchedule优化脚本,在正确率与核性能上超过六个前沿大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU核优化本质是搜索能保持语义不变并提升性能的编译器变换组合,变换间相互影响;直接排序候选或生成核代码的范式存在局限,且前沿大模型参数量巨大、任务特定训练不可得或代价高。

Method: 让模型生成完整优化脚本而非核代码;设计紧凑无损的脚本表示,其确定性解码可重建精确编译器trace,保留变换参数与依赖。基于TVM MetaSchedule在54,116个工作负载上构建108,594个样本(60,236个"从零构造"、48,358个"改进已有脚本")。先监督微调,再加入带塑形奖励的强化学习:奖励结合正确性与实测性能,仅对数值正确核给予延迟奖励。

Result: 8B模型单次尝试正确率:构造91.27%、改进92.01%;RL在88/102个构造任务和145/170个改进提示上优于监督训练;单次正确率与核性能均超过GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3等六个前沿大模型(数百亿至万亿参数)。

Conclusion: 以脚本生成为接口、无损表示+监督微调+塑形RL的策略可使小模型在编译器优化任务上超越巨型通用模型,表明任务特定、表示感知的训练是高性价比路径。

Abstract: Compiler transformations interact, making GPU kernel optimization a search for combinations that preserve the computation while improving performance. We introduce HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON, a training method that teaches a small language model both to construct complete optimization scripts and to improve existing ones. Instead of ranking candidates or generating kernel code, our model generates optimization scripts. We devise a compact, lossless representation whose deterministic decoding reconstructs the exact compiler trace, preserving its transformation parameters and dependencies. We use a compiler framework TVM MetaSchedule to build training data on 54,116 distinct workloads, and construct 108,594 examples in two training sets: 60,236 teach the model to generate an optimized script from an unoptimized kernel, while 48,358 teach it to produce a better script given the kernel and a somewhat optimized script. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to construct and improve optimization scripts from these search-derived examples. We then add reinforcement learning with a shaped reward that combines correctness with measured performance, awarding a latency-based bonus only to numerically correct kernels. We apply this training method to a model with 8 billion parameters. After supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, the model achieves per-attempt correctness of 91.27% for construction and 92.01% for refinement, while reinforcement learning produces faster kernels than supervised training on 88 of 102 construction tasks and 145 of 170 refinement prompts. With only 8B parameters, our LITTLE DRAGON achieves higher per-attempt correctness and better kernel performance than six frontier LLMs: GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Kimi-K3, and GLM-5.3 among them, each with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, for which task-specific training is unavailable or expensive.

</details>


### [419] [Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20989)
*Frank F. Yang,Kefei Yan,Yiren Wang,Yiyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文控制性比较了on-policy蒸馏(OPD)与过滤式SFT，发现OPD只有在教师模型对学生生成轨迹仍保持可靠时才有效；否则会把教师的不完整/失败模式迁移给学生，甚至抹掉SFT已学到的完成行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM推理能力提升常依赖更强模型的监督后训练，主要有SFT（在教师演示上训练）与OPD（教师对学生自身生成轨迹给出反馈）。二者孰优、教师的逐状态监督如何塑造学生行为尚不清楚，尤其在不同数据预算与教师可靠性差异下缺乏受控对比。

Method: 在多个数据预算与教师可靠性不同的任务上，对OPD与过滤式SFT进行控制性对比实验；分析二者对学生准确率与回答完成率的影响，并考察从SFT学生初始化OPD、以及仅按完整性过滤教师演示的效果。

Result: ChartQA上教师完成率99%，仅用10%数据的OPD与全量SFT差距仅1.4个准确率点；Geometry3K上教师有22%的解未完成，OPD比SFT低7.9点，差距主要来自不完整回答。以SFT学生初始化OPD会把完成率从76%降至62%，抹掉SFT学到的完成行为；仅按完整性过滤教师演示即可恢复SFT的大部分优势。

Conclusion: on-policy监督不仅传递教师知识，还会把教师在学生访问状态上的持续性失败模式一并迁移；教师可靠性是决定OPD是否优于SFT的关键因素。

Abstract: Improving the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) often relies on post-training with supervision from stronger models. Two common strategies are supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which trains on teacher-generated demonstrations, and on-policy distillation (OPD), which provides teacher feedback on trajectories generated by the student itself. While OPD can be more data-efficient by supervising student-generated trajectories, it is unclear how the teacher's supervision at each state affects the student's learned behavior. To study this question, we conduct a controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT across data budgets and tasks where the teacher exhibits different levels of reliability, and analyze how these differences shape student accuracy and completion behavior. Across the two tasks, we find that OPD is effective only when the teacher remains reliable on student-generated trajectories. On ChartQA, where the teacher completes 99% of its solutions, OPD trained on only 10% of the data comes within 1.4 accuracy points of full-data SFT. In contrast, on Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of its solutions, OPD underperforms SFT by 7.9 points, with most of the gap explained by incomplete responses. More strikingly, starting OPD from an SFT student reduces its completion rate from 76% to 62%, effectively erasing the completion behavior learned through SFT. Filtering teacher demonstrations for completeness alone recovers much of SFT's advantage. These results show that on-policy supervision can transfer not only teacher knowledge but also persistent failure modes on student-visited states. Code is available at https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm.

</details>


### [420] [Halve-Then-Greedy: Adaptive Sampling for Posterior Success with Near-Optimal Instance Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20997)
*Yinan Li,Kwang-Sung Jun,Kapilan Balagopalan,Tuan Nguyen,Yao Zhao,Abbas Zaidi,Houssam Nassif*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究固定预算自适应实验，目标是最大化"推荐设计的后验证据足以表明其均值超过目标阈值"的概率，并提出 Halve-Then-Greedy (HTG) 算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该目标不同于最优臂识别（best-arm identification）：并不需要找到最佳设计，而只需获得足够的后验证据证明推荐设计的均值超过目标。为此需要设计在固定样本预算下高效的自适应采样策略。

Method: 针对高斯先验下的高斯bandit，提出 HTG 算法：先进行一次大规模均衡初始分配，随后进行逐次减半（successive halving），最后采用后验贪心采样（posterior-greedy sampling）。理论上推导了依赖于实例结构的有限预算指数型后验失败概率上界，并对"单有利臂"族给出渐近样本复杂度下界；同时分析均匀采样与逐次减半作为对照。

Result: 所证指数上界同时刻画了与不利臂的分离度以及存在多个有利臂的情形；在单有利臂族上，HTG 与渐近下界在相差对数因子的意义下匹配。分析表明，均匀采样和逐次减半在某些区间分别需要多出线性因子和对数因子的样本量；仿真验证了 HTG 的样本效率优势及其对实例结构的依赖。

Conclusion: HTG 在固定预算下针对"获得充分后验证据"这一目标具有近乎最优的样本复杂度，优于均匀采样与逐次减半，且其优势程度取决于问题的实例结构。

Abstract: We study fixed-budget adaptive experimentation aimed at maximizing the probability of obtaining sufficient posterior evidence that a recommended design's mean performance exceeds a target. Unlike best-arm identification, this objective does not require finding the best design. For Gaussian bandits with a Gaussian prior, we propose \emph{Halve-Then-Greedy} (HTG), which combines a large initial balanced allocation, successive halving, and posterior-greedy sampling. We prove instance-dependent, finite-budget exponential bounds on posterior-failure probability that capture both separation from unfavorable arms and the presence of multiple favorable arms. On one-positive-arm families, we establish an asymptotic sample-complexity lower bound that HTG matches up to a logarithmic factor. We further analyze uniform sampling and sequential halving, revealing regimes where they require more samples than HTG by linear and logarithmic factors, respectively. Simulations illustrate HTG's sample-efficiency advantages and their dependence on instance structure.

</details>


### [421] [Imperfect Is Perfect: Learned Column Prefilling for Branch-Price-and-Cut](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21001)
*Haoran Liu,Yu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文反驳"初始列有害"的列生成传统观点,指出关键在于列"以正确的方式不完美":预载最优根LP支撑反而在过半困难算例上失败,而预载不要求最优的普通路径池并按当前平滑对偶定价可加速根节点。作者用神经网络边打分器在数秒内构建列池、用第二个网络从实例文件预测Wentges平滑初始中心,并围绕支配检验为GPU重构bucket-graph labeling、在CPU上认证。在RouteOpt上,95个300–1000客户算例以原根定价时间13.2%达到同一认证根界(仅预载为26.1%,最优情形快17.5倍);在不相关并行机调度精确求解器中,预载+平滑+学习中心认证全部25个算例,比原列生成快12倍(后者仅认证20个)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 列生成folklore认为初始列会带偏对偶、拖慢branch-price-and-cut的根节点,故实践中倾向稀疏/惰性初始列。作者质疑这一直觉,探究列池的质量究竟取决于"是否最优"还是"是否以恰当方式非最优",并希望借此大幅降低精确求解根的定价时间。

Method: (1) 预载思想的对照实验:预载最优根LP支撑(理论上最好的列)对比预载不要求属于任何最优解的普通路径池(MASTER之外维护,按当前平滑对偶定价);(2) 由于列无需最优,列生成转化为学习任务:神经边打分器引导构造式生成器,秒级构建列池;(3) 第二个网络从实例文件预测Wentges平滑的初始中心,从而决定平滑定价查询方向,求解器自身更新保持不变;(4) 预载与中心就位后精确定价主导根定价时间,故围绕支配检验为GPU重构bucket-graph labeling,并在CPU上完成认证。

Result: 在RouteOpt(CVRP最先进精确求解器)上,95个300–1000客户算例达到相同认证根界,耗时仅为vanilla RouteOpt根定价时间的13.2%;仅预载为26.1%;最好情形加速17.5倍。在不相关并行机调度的精确branch-price-and-cut求解器中,预载+平滑+学习中心认证全部25个基准算例,比求解器自带列生成快12倍,而后者仅认证20个。

Conclusion: 初始列并非固有有害:只要列以恰当方式非最优(普通可行路径而非最优支撑),预载可显著加速根节点并改善对偶质量;结合学习式列池构建、学习的平滑中心与GPU加速的精确定价,可在大规模算例上以极小代价获得认证根界,且可推广到CVRP之外的调度问题。

Abstract: Column generation folklore warns that initial columns hurt: a warm start may bias the dual and slow the root of branch-price-and-cut. We show the opposite once the columns are imperfect in the right way. Preloading the support of the optimal root LP, the best columns one could know in advance, fails to finish on half of our hardest instances; a pool of ordinary routes that need not belong to any optimal solution, held outside the master and priced at the current smoothed dual, speeds the root up. Because the columns need not be optimal, producing them becomes a learning task: a neural edge scorer guides a constructive generator that builds the pool in seconds. A second network predicts the initial center of Wentges smoothing from the instance file, and with it the direction of the smoothed pricing queries; the solver's own updates run unchanged. With prefill and center in place, exact pricing dominates root pricing time, so we rebuild bucket-graph labeling around its dominance test for the GPU and certify on the CPU. Inside RouteOpt, the state-of-the-art exact solver for capacitated vehicle routing, the pipeline reaches the same certified root bound in 13.2% of vanilla RouteOpt's root pricing time over 95 instances with 300 to 1000 customers, prefill alone in 26.1%, and 17.5 times faster in the best case. In an exact branch-price-and-cut solver for unrelated parallel machine scheduling, prefill with smoothing and the learned center certifies all 25 benchmark instances, 12 times faster than the solver's own column generation, which certifies 20 of them.

</details>


### [422] [CausalEvo: Causal Skill Self-Evolution for Health LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21016)
*Yuchen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 CausalEvo：在冻结模型权重、固定反馈案例与规则数量的条件下，用配对技能替换实验估计技能集合的相对因果效应，从而决定保留或替换哪些文本技能，实现更省 token 且更准确的多任务技能自进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 医疗智能体可从任务反馈中积累可复用的文本技能（计算准则、测量时点、公式单位等），但“保留哪些技能”具有强后果性：有用规则提升后续回答，错误的过度泛化则会传播误差。现有技能优化方法缺乏对技能贡献的可控判别。

Method: 在每一步进化中，冻结 LLM 提出候选规则，与现有技能池合并，使当前集合始终为可选方案；对共享背景规则做配对技能替换，并在相同反馈案例上打分；用最小二乘将得分差转换为相对技能价值，保留排名靠前者（平局偏向现有技能）；并给出分解候选支持误差、近似误差与估计误差的决策损失界。

Result: 在 MedCalc-Bench-Verified 的六个任务、120 个留出案例上，准确率达 60.00%，对比 SkillOpt 55.83%、无技能 51.67%；在不同优化预算的训练配置下，训练 token 消耗比 SkillOpt 少 55.6%。增益集中于部分计算任务，同时在另一些任务上出现回退，配对准确率区间包含零。

Conclusion: CausalEvo 将任务反馈转化为关于技能保留与替换的受控决策，在保持模型与评估条件不变的前提下实现更高效的技能自进化；但收益不均匀且统计显著性有限，需进一步扩大验证。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for health can accumulate reusable textual skills from task feedback, such as calculation criteria, measurement time points, and formula units. Deciding which skills to retain is consequential: useful rules improve later answers, while faulty generalizations propagate errors. We propose CausalEvo, a method for causal skill self-evolution that estimates the relative effects of deliberately changed skill sets while holding the model weights, feedback cases, and rule count fixed. At each evolution step, a frozen LLM proposes candidate rules, which are pooled with the incumbent skills so that the current skill set remains a feasible choice. Paired skill replacements against shared background rules are scored on the same feedback cases; least squares converts the score differences into relative skill values, and the top-ranked rules are retained, favoring incumbents on ties. A decision-loss bound separates candidate support, approximation, and estimation errors. On six MedCalc-Bench-Verified tasks with 120 held-out cases, CausalEvo achieves 60.00% accuracy, compared with 55.83% for SkillOpt and 51.67% without skills. Across the recorded training configurations, which use different optimization budgets, it consumes 55.6% fewer training tokens than SkillOpt. Gains concentrate in particular calculations alongside regressions on others, and paired accuracy intervals include zero. CausalEvo turns task feedback into controlled decisions about skill retention and replacement. Project repository: https://github.com/txbrook/CausalEvo

</details>


### [423] [INCONVENIENT: A Benchmark to Assess LLM Generalization Capabilities from Convenience Samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21038)
*Sara Rezaeimanesh,Chad Klochko,Kundan Thind,Mohammad Ghassemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 INCONVENIENT 基准，通过直接扰动训练分布中的特征—目标关系、同时以原始总体分布作为部署环境，系统评估模型对便利样本偏差（convenience-sample bias）的鲁棒性，覆盖 200 个表格任务并生成约 15,500 个偏移训练分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格分布偏移基准多通过对自然领域划分观测来构造 OOD 设定，虽可能引起 P(Y|X) 变化，但偏移既未被显式控制也难以隔离，且评估分布本身往往不能代表更广泛的目标总体。而真实数据常因便利性、可得性或成本而采样，产生系统性采样偏差，扭曲特征—目标关系并损害泛化。

Method: 不依赖自然领域划分，而是直接在训练分布中扰动特征—目标关系，并保留原始总体分布作为部署环境；该设定提供对关系偏移方向与严重程度的显式控制，从而可系统评估鲁棒性。基准包含 200 个表格分类与回归数据集（跨多个应用领域），生成约 15,500 个偏移训练分布。

Result: 这些偏移训练分布导致下游性能显著退化，说明模型对便利采样偏差缺乏鲁棒性；该设定对 LLM 尤为重要，因其预训练可能编码超越偏差训练集所观测关系的总体层面知识。

Conclusion: INCONVENIENT 更贴近“从不具代表性的样本训练、再部署于更广泛总体”的现实场景，相较现有分布偏移基准在可控性与评估分布代表性上更优，为便利采样鲁棒性研究提供系统化测试平台。

Abstract: Machine learning models for tabular prediction typically assume that training data are representative of the population on which they will be deployed. In practice, however, data are often collected based on convenience, availability, or cost, resulting in systematic sampling biases that can distort feature--target relationships and undermine real-world generalization. Existing tabular distribution-shift benchmarks primarily construct out-of-distribution (OOD) settings by partitioning observations across naturally occurring domains. While such partitions may induce changes in P(Y | X), the resulting shifts are neither explicitly controlled nor isolated, and the evaluation distributions themselves are often not representative of the broader target population. We introduce INCONVENIENT, a benchmark designed to study robustness to convenience-sample bias. Rather than relying on naturally occurring domain partitions, INCONVENIENT directly perturbs feature--target relationships in the training distribution while preserving the original population distribution as the deployment environment. This setting more closely reflects real-world scenarios in which models are developed from unrepresentative samples and subsequently deployed on a broader population. The distinction is particularly relevant for large language models (LLMs), whose pretraining may encode population-level knowledge that extends beyond the relationships observed in a biased training dataset. Unlike existing distribution-shift benchmarks, INCONVENIENT provides explicit control over both the direction and severity of relationship shifts, enabling a systematic assessment of robustness to convenience sampling. The benchmark comprises 200 tabular classification and regression datasets spanning diverse application domains and generates around 15,500 shifted training distributions which lead to substantial downstream degradation.

</details>


### [424] [SALTO: Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators for Nonlinear Event Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21049)
*Qi Wang,Rylie Foster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SALTO框架，用Koopman提升空间中的线性传播算子及其转置构造可复用的"提升伴随"，实现有限幅度源的反演。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 习得动力学模型预测轨迹准确，但微分或转置时灵敏度不可靠，限制了其在反问题与科学决策中的应用；经典伴随提供精确局部导数，但单个伴随无法刻画系统对一族有限幅度扰动的非线性响应。

Method: SALTO在Koopman提升空间中用线性传播算子近似非线性动力学，其转置可一次求解将各传感器反向传播；施加三项结构约束：物理状态动力学锚定到模拟器的线性化传播算子、中心化学习可观测量使其在参考态处二阶消失、使用块三角提升传播算子。

Result: 在三个非线性PDE系统上，SALTO对有限幅度源测量预测误差2–8%，而经典伴随误差41–165%；从稀疏传感器恢复源位置与强度接近通过求解器反演的精度；以1/20成本匹配反应扩散系统上双源联合后验；单一模型支持新传感器布局与测量时刻的单次反向求解。

Conclusion: 结构约束保证幅度趋于零时模型退化为模拟器的切动力学与经典伴随，学习可观测量仅承载有限幅度修正，从而兼顾局部精确性与有限幅度非线性响应。

Abstract: Learned dynamical models can accurately predict trajectories while producing unreliable sensitivities when differentiated or transposed, limiting their use in inverse problems and scientific decision-making. Classical adjoints provide exact local derivatives, but a single adjoint cannot represent the nonlinear response of a system to a family of finite-amplitude perturbations. We introduce SALTO (Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators), a Koopman-based framework for inferring finite-amplitude sources. In the lifted space, the nonlinear dynamics are approximated by a linear propagator, and its transpose carries each sensor backward in a single solve. The result is a reusable lifted adjoint that predicts the measurement produced by any candidate localized event with one encoder pass and an inner product. To give the model the simulator's exact local behavior, SALTO imposes three structural constraints: it anchors the physical-state dynamics to the simulator's linearized propagator, centers the learned observables so that they vanish to second order at the reference state, and uses a block-triangular lifted propagator. These constraints guarantee that the model reduces to the simulator's tangent dynamics and classical adjoint as the amplitude vanishes, while the learned observables carry only the finite-amplitude correction. On three nonlinear PDE systems, SALTO predicts the measurements of finite-amplitude sources to within 2-8% where the classical adjoint is in error by 41-165%, recovers source position and intensity from sparse sensors nearly as accurately as inversion through the solver, and samples the joint posterior of two interacting sources, matching the solver's posterior on reaction-diffusion at a twentieth of its cost. One trained model serves new sensor layouts and measurement times with a single backward solve.

</details>


### [425] [Bellman-Consistent Trajectory RL for LLM Arithmetic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21060)
*Lianfa Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Bellman一致的轨迹强化学习方法TBRM-RLOO，将稀疏终端奖励转化为密集token级信号，在Countdown算术推理任务上显著优于GRPO及SFT/IPO/DPO/RLOO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM算术推理中终端奖励稀疏，导致优化困难与性能平台期；需要将稀疏奖励转化为更密集的训练信号以改善梯度学习。

Method: 提出Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM)，将稀疏奖励转化为密集的token级信号；结合RLOO分组策略降低Bellman残差的梯度方差；并采用hindsight goal relabeling加速中间过程学习，形成TBRM-RLOO框架。

Result: 在Countdown任务上，相比GRPO显著缓解优化瓶颈并稳定梯度方差；Pass@1提升至0.55--0.64，Pass@16达76.0--84.0%（SOTA），优于SFT、IPO/DPO和RLOO基线；展现优异的单样本效率，并通过test-time scaling规避标准性能平台期。

Conclusion: Bellman一致的轨迹RL方法能有效应对稀疏奖励下的LLM算术推理，兼顾梯度稳定性、样本效率与推理精度提升。

Abstract: To address sparse terminal rewards in LLM arithmetic reasoning, we propose a Bellman-consistent trajectory RL method. Our framework introduces Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization (TBRM) to transform sparse rewards into dense token-level signals. We integrate a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) group strategy to reduce gradient variance of Bellman residuals and use hindsight goal relabeling to accelerate intermediate learning. Evaluated on the Countdown task, our method alleviates optimization bottlenecks and stabilizes gradient variance significantly better than GRPO. The TBRM-RLOO framework boosts Pass@1 to 0.55--0.64 and achieves a state-of-the-art Pass@16 accuracy of 76.0--84.0\%, outperforming the SFT, IPO/DPO, and RLOO baselines. Our approach demonstrates exceptional single-sample efficiency and successfully circumvents standard performance plateaus via test-time scaling.

</details>


### [426] [StochLOB: Heavy-Tailed Score Matching for Robust Limit Order Book Trend Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21081)
*Arshia Abolghasemi,Seyed Reza Tavakoli,Parsa Naderi,Nazanin Mirzaei,Behrad Jahani,Saba Yousefzadeh,Tahereh Javaheri,Mohammad Hosein Rohban,Gholamali Aminian,Ali Habibnia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STOCHLOB：仅训练阶段改用跳跃-Lévy与截断α-stable重尾污染的前向扩散，保持部署预测器确定性，在LOB数据上尾部压力诊断更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于分数（score-based）的扩散模型通常以布朗高斯特噪声扰动数据，对应轻尾前向SDE；而限价订单簿（LOB）订单流具有重尾、突发性与跳跃特征，高斯SDE抽象不足，需在训练中引入重尾与跳跃结构。

Method: 提出STOCHLOB——仅训练用的分数匹配框架，替换前向加噪律但不改变部署时的确定性预测器。采用两种非高斯、受SDE启发的污染：复合泊松方差混合的跳跃-Lévy噪声，以及正稳定高斯尺度混合的截断α-stable噪声，将有限跳跃与重尾残差注入训练，且推理时无需逆向扩散采样。分数目标具解释性：径向因子h_t(r)为后验期望污染精度，大残差按最可能生成它的潜在污染尺度加权。

Result: 在按时间留出的Coinbase LOB数据上，所提变体在未污染的BTC与山寨币测试区间保持竞争力，并改善多项已实现尾部窗口压力诊断指标；另以飞书A股迁移做探索性研究，考察交易成本与交易规则约束下概率输出的可用性。

Conclusion: 用重尾/跳跃式训练污染替代布朗高斯污染，可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升LOB尾部稳健性，为金融时序的扩散式建模提供轻量、可解释的替代方案。

Abstract: Score-based diffusion methods usually perturb data with Brownian Gaussian noise, corresponding to a light-tailed forward stochastic differential equation (SDE). For market time series this SDE can be a poor abstraction: limit order book (LOB) order flow is heavy-tailed, bursty, and occasionally jump-like. We study STOCHLOB, a training-only score-matching framework that changes the forward diffusion corruption law while leaving the deployed predictor deterministic. Instead of Brownian-only Gaussian corruption, the noising process uses two non-Gaussian SDE-inspired alternatives: jump-Lévy noise through a compound-Poisson variance mixture, and clipped $α$-stable noise through a positive-stable Gaussian scale mixture. These corruptions inject finite jumps and heavy-tailed residuals into training without requiring reverse-time diffusion sampling at inference. The resulting score target has a useful interpretation: its radial factor $h_t(r)$ is the posterior expected corruption precision, so large residuals are weighted according to the latent corruption scale that most plausibly generated them. On chronologically held-out Coinbase LOB data, the proposed variants remain competitive on uncorrupted BTC and altcoin test horizons and improve several realized tail-window stress diagnostics. An exploratory Feishu A-share transfer study further tests whether the probability outputs remain usable under transaction costs and trading-rule constraints. Code and configuration files are available at https://github.com/ArshiAbolghasemi/Penny.

</details>


### [427] [SIEVE: Overcoming Topological Obstruction in Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21087)
*Jongann Lee,Sun Woo Park,Yun Young Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出3D点云掩码自编码与SE(3)等变网络存在理论上的不相容性，并提出SIEVE框架以规避该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准随机掩码会触发拓扑坍缩，迫使模型在无参考坐标系的情况下"幻觉"出朝向，导致3D点云掩码自编码与SE(3)等变网络不兼容。作者希望解决这一理论矛盾。

Method: 提出SIEVE（Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance），一个将点云几何压缩为不变标量嵌入的SE(3)等变自监督框架，核心是球面投影掩码：在保留全局位姿的同时混淆局部语义，从构造上绕过坍缩障碍。

Result: 实验表明SIEVE规避了预测的坍缩，而常数掩码与噪声掩码均失败；在下游任务中，其嵌入优于基于坐标的基线与手工几何描述子，且在泛化到未见形状类别时提升最大。

Conclusion: 通过球面投影掩码设计，可在保持SE(3)等变性的同时实现有效的自监督掩码学习，并带来更强的跨类别泛化能力。

Abstract: We identify a theoretical incompatibility between 3D point cloud masked autoencoding and SE(3)-equivariant networks. We prove that standard masking triggers a topological collapse, effectively forcing the model to hallucinate orientation without a reference frame. To resolve this, we introduce SIEVE (Scalar Invariant Extraction Via Equivariance), an SE(3)-equivariant self-supervised framework that compresses point cloud geometry into invariant scalar embeddings. At its core is the spherical projection mask, which preserves global pose while obfuscating local semantics, sidestepping the obstruction by construction. Experiments confirm that SIEVE circumvents the predicted collapse where constant and noise masks fail. On downstream point cloud tasks, the resulting embeddings improve over coordinate-based baselines and hand-crafted geometric descriptors, with the largest gains on generalization to unseen shape categories.

</details>


### [428] [Spectral-Spatial Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21114)
*Haotian Ma,Ruqi Yang,Philip Townsend*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI)，在每个空间位置对通道构造局部条件博弈并计算 Shapley 值，得到位置-通道全网格归因矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事后图像解释要么给空间热力图（where），要么给全局通道分数（which channel），两者割裂；对多光谱数据而言，通道相关性往往是空间局部化且具物理意义的，单一视角不足。

Method: 对每个空间位置 (g,c) 固定观测到的周围上下文，在该位置的通道上定义条件博弈，应用 Shapley 值，输出完整的光谱-空间归因矩阵；与基于相同分组但对外部空间联盟取平均的 Owen 式层次化归因形成对比。

Result: 在 HLS Burn Scar 上，SSI 以约 6% 的评估预算在保留归因指标上优于 MC-Owen 估计器；在 CUB-200、EuroSAT、HLS Burn Scar 上，逐通道均值与零基线两种设定下，SSI 在 dense、flat、rank-1 基线上取得最佳联合删除/插入 AUC，光谱命中率与通道删除最优，并在两个标注数据集上空间定位领先。

Conclusion: SSI 提供具局部解释性、位置内满足 Shapley 公平性、且通道归因聚合可精确还原位置级上下文对比的全网格光谱-空间归因，且计算高效。

Abstract: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI also differs from context-averaged Owen-style hierarchical accounting, which uses the same position-channel grouping but averages over external spatial coalitions. On HLS Burn Scar, SSI outperforms an MC-Owen estimator across retained attribution metrics while using only about 6% of its evaluation budget. Across CUB-200, EuroSAT, and HLS Burn Scar under both per-channel mean and zero baselines, SSI achieves the best joint deletion and insertion AUC over dense, flat, and rank-1 baselines, yields the strongest spectral hit rates and channel deletion, and leads spatial localization on both annotated datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/AtheavenMa/Spectral-Spatial-Interpretation.

</details>


### [429] [DST-Net: Decomposed Spatio-Temporal Network for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21123)
*Yaohua Zha,Hai Wu,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对趋势与季节分量归纳偏置不同的特点，提出解耦架构：趋势分支用隐图块捕捉跨通道全局拓扑依赖，季节分支用高斯多尺度注意力约束局部演化建模，在多个真实基准上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度时间序列预测模型虽普遍采用序列分解范式，但对所有子序列采用同构建模策略，忽视了不同分量固有的归纳偏置差异：趋势分量跨通道空间耦合强但时间冗余大，季节分量具有局部时间演化特性却易受注意力分散影响。

Method: 提出解耦架构，为各分量定制建模策略。趋势分支设计Latent Graph Block，通过隐图建模捕捉全局拓扑依赖与系统级协同运动；季节分支引入Gaussian Multi-scale Attention，注入可学习高斯先验施加结构约束，迫使模型聚焦多粒度局部上下文，过滤全局噪声并准确刻画局部演化相位。

Result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 按分量归纳偏置进行解耦、差异化建模，优于同构建模策略；跨通道图建模适配趋势、局部多尺度注意力适配季节，是提升分解式预测性能的有效路径。

Abstract: Series decomposition has emerged as a widely acknowledged paradigm in deep time series forecasting models. However, existing approaches predominantly employ a homogeneous modeling strategy for all subsequences, thereby overlooking the distinct inductive biases inherent in different components. We identify that the trend component exhibits dominant spatial coupling across channels but carries significant temporal redundancy, whereas the seasonal component is characterized by local temporal evolution but remains susceptible to attention distraction. To address this, we propose a novel disentangled architecture that tailors specific modeling strategies to align with the intrinsic properties of each component. For the trend branch, we design a Latent Graph Block, employing latent graph modeling to capture global topological dependencies and system-wide co-movements. Conversely, for the seasonal branch, we introduce a Gaussian Multi-scale Attention mechanism to mitigate attention distraction. By injecting learnable Gaussian priors, we impose structural constraints that compel the model to focus on multi-granular local contexts, effectively filtering out global noise and accurately capturing local evolutionary phases. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model.

</details>


### [430] [Noise-Space Reward Alignment for Few-Step Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21125)
*Woocheol Shin,Taeyoung Yun,Jiwon Sung,Hyeongyu Kang,Jeongmin Park,Jaewoo Lee,Kyuil Sim,Dohyun Kim,Yutong He,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出噪声策略优化 NPO，通过冻结生成器、在初始噪声空间学习摊销流策略实现少步生成模型的对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步生成模型虽高效，但仅依赖黑盒奖励对齐仍困难：直接 RL 微调易导致奖励过优化，测试时搜索则丧失少步生成效率优势。

Method: 保持生成器冻结，在初始高斯噪声空间学习摊销流策略，将噪声输运到奖励倾斜的噪声分布，使其经冻结生成器推前分布恰为奖励倾斜的输出分布；采用仅需采样端点的 ELBO 似然估计提升训练样本效率；推理仅增加轻量噪声采样步骤。

Result: 在图像、语言、蛋白质结构生成任务中，NPO 的奖励-质量权衡均优于直接微调，并以 16–549 倍更低推理成本匹配测试时搜索方法。

Conclusion: 在噪声空间做摊销对齐是少步生成模型对齐的有效范式，兼顾预训练知识利用、奖励-质量平衡与推理效率。

Abstract: Few-step generative models produce high-quality samples in one or a few evaluations. However, steering them toward desired properties remains difficult, especially when only black-box reward evaluations are available. While one could apply approaches developed for iterative diffusion and flow-based models, such as direct RL fine-tuning or test-time scaling, we find that neither transfers well to the few-step regime: direct fine-tuning suffers from severe reward over-optimization, and test-time scaling sacrifices the efficiency advantage of few-step generation. We propose Noise Policy Optimization (NPO), which explicitly targets the alignment problem for few-step generative models. The key idea is to learn an amortized flow policy over the initial noise space of the generator. The trained policy transports Gaussian noise to a reward-tilted noise distribution, whose pushforward distribution through the frozen generator is exactly the reward-tilted output distribution. By keeping the generator frozen, we can effectively utilize the knowledge encoded in the pretrained model, yielding a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning. The amortized policy moves the search cost into training, so inference adds only a lightweight noise sampling step on top of the pretrained model. To improve sample efficiency during training, we use ELBO-based likelihood estimation that requires only sampled endpoints rather than simulated trajectories. Across image, language, and protein structure generation, NPO consistently achieves a better reward-quality trade-off than direct fine-tuning, and matches test-time search methods with 16 to 549 times lower inference cost.

</details>


### [431] [Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21134)
*Abdul Raheem Shahzad,Jinxin Chen,Ming Zhang,Juan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建经整理的IVF/ICSI单中心数据集，提出混合注意力网络(HAN)与逻辑回归(LR)的组合模型，用于鲜胚移植前活产预测，在小样本临床数据上取得最佳AUC-ROC 0.710。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲜胚移植前预测活产可支持IVF/ICSI中的医患共同决策；但常规临床数据规模小、异质性强，且含路径依赖变量，易造成结局泄漏，需构建适配小样本表格临床数据的模型。

Method: 收集616个鲜胚移植周期(251活产/365非活产)，含临床、实验室与胚胎学预测因子，并将胚胎形态以ICM与滋养层差异加权方式编码；经KNN插补、稳健标准化并筛选50个特征后，构建HAN(可学习特征注意力门控+紧凑MLP)及验证集调权的HAN+LR集成模型，与经典机器学习、TabPFN、文本序列化语言模型在留出测试集上以AUC-ROC为主要指标比较。

Result: HAN+LR集成测试AUC-ROC最高(0.710；准确率0.710，F1 0.630)，优于HAN(0.700)、LR(0.667)、TabPFN+LR(0.666)与TabPFN(0.650)；文本序列化语言模型接近随机(AUC≤0.61)；差异加权的滋养层特征在各模型共识重要性中排名最高。

Conclusion: 在小型临床队列上，紧凑注意力网络与线性模型的组合优于各自单独组件及强基础模型基线；该整理数据集与HAN+LR集成为透明、可复现的IVF/ICSI活产预测基础，后续需开展外部验证。

Abstract: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical machine learning, TabPFN, and text-serialized language models on a held-out test set; AUC-ROC was the primary metric. \textit{Results:} The HAN + LR ensemble achieved the highest test AUC-ROC (0.710; accuracy 0.710, F1 0.630), ahead of the HAN backbone alone (0.700), logistic regression (0.667), the TabPFN + LR hybrid (0.666), and TabPFN (0.650). Text-serialized language models performed near chance (AUC $\le$ 0.61). The differentially weighted trophectoderm feature ranked highest by consensus importance across models. \textit{Discussion:} A compact attention network combined with a linear model outperformed both components and strong foundation-model baselines on a small clinical cohort. \textit{Conclusion:} The curated dataset and HAN + LR ensemble offer a transparent, reproducible basis for IVF/ICSI live-birth prediction; external validation is the next step.

</details>


### [432] [Language Models Share a Readout Bottleneck in Working Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21176)
*Dongyu Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在15个预训练LLM（三个家族，70M–14B参数）及从零训练的最小Transformer上，解离了N-back任务工作记忆信号背后的“精度”与“干扰”两种机制，发现限制在于受干扰下的读出而非定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在N-back任务上复现了人类工作记忆的典型行为特征（负载N增大时表现下降、错误集中于相邻位置的lure），但该共享行为特征是否对应共享机制尚不清楚。文献中存在两种竞争性解释：精度说（softmax注意力无法把权重集中于N位之前的项目，转而检索相邻项目）与干扰说（注意力选中了正确项目，但竞争项目的内容污染了决策）。作者希望区分二者。

Method: 在来自三个模型家族的15个预训练LLM（70M至14B参数）以及从零训练的最小Transformer上进行机制解离：(1) 分析承担任务的注意力头在漏报匹配试次中是否指向目标项；(2) 用线性探针解码匹配字母出现在目标位置还是lure位置，尤其关注模型对lure误报的试次；(3) 操纵实验——锐化注意力（检验精度说）与抑制非目标项目的字母身份（检验干扰说）；(4) 考察模型规模、任务在多头上的分布以及最小Transformer层数的影响。

Result: 在三个家族中，承担任务的注意力头在多数漏报匹配试次中仍指向目标项。线性探针几乎完美解码目标与lure位置的匹配信息，即使在该模型对lure误报的试次上也如此，而模型自身决策几乎无法区分二者。锐化注意力带来的收益可忽略，而抑制非目标项的字母身份在几乎所有“模型×负载”条件下均提升敏感度d'。更大模型中任务分布在更多注意力头上，且去除干扰的收益更大。最小Transformer中，精度限制仅存在于单层注意力，第二层即可解除该约束。

Conclusion: LLM的工作记忆容量限制源于在干扰条件下读出项目内容，而非在定位目标项目；这一结果与人类工作记忆的干扰理论一致，表明行为特征共享背后确有共享机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position. We ask whether this shared behavioral signature reflects a shared mechanism. The literature offers two candidate accounts. On a precision account, softmax attention cannot concentrate its weight on the item N positions back, so adjacent items are retrieved instead. On an interference account, attention selects the correct item, but the content of competing items corrupts the decision. We dissociate these accounts in 15 pretrained LLMs from three families (70 million to 14 billion parameters) and in minimal transformers trained from scratch. In all three families, the attention heads that carry the task attend to the target on most missed matches. Linear probes decode near-perfectly whether a matching letter occurred at the target or at a lure position, even on trials where the model false-alarms to the lure, although its own decisions barely distinguish the two. Sharpening attention yields negligible gains, whereas suppressing the letter identity of non-target items improves sensitivity (d') in nearly all model-by-load conditions. In larger models the task is spread over more heads, and removing interference helps more. In minimal transformers, precision limits a single attention layer, but a second layer removes this constraint. The working-memory limit of LLMs therefore lies in reading items out under interference rather than in locating them, consistent with interference accounts of human working memory.

</details>


### [433] [Judging the Judges: Confidence and Disagreement in Rubrics as Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21179)
*Michael Tian-Yue Liu,Anne Harrington,Trevor Darrell,Yutong Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RaRE（Rubrics as Rewards with Ensembles），一种用于 RaR 训练的评审集成策略，通过软-Likert 奖励和分歧丢弃掩码两个机制聚合多位评审，在两个基准上超越所有单评审变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有 RaR 工作主要聚焦于改进评分标准（rubric）或强化单一评审，而较少关注训练期间如何使用多个或不同评审。作者首先验证评审身份本身会导致显著分数差异，从而引出评审集成这一被忽视的轴线。

Method: 在 RaR-Medicine 和 RaR-Science 上用 Qwen3-4B-Base 对比五个前沿与开源评审，观察分数分布差异；随后提出 RaRE，含两个机制：(1) 软-Likert 奖励，利用评审的 logprobs 对更有信心的评审赋予更高权重；(2) 分歧丢弃掩码，将高分歧 rollout 从 GRPO 更新中排除。

Result: 评审身份单独即可造成明显的分数差异。简单平均各评审分数无法超越最佳单评审；而 RaRE 在 HealthBench 与 GPQA Diamond 上均优于所有单评审 RaR 变体，逐主题分析显示其继承了各组成评审的互补优势。

Conclusion: 评审集成是改进 RaR 的有效且值得关注的方向；关键在于加权与分歧处理的设计，而非简单分数平均。

Abstract: Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) extends reinforcement learning to non-verifiable domains by using an LLM judge to score responses against a structured rubric. Prior work has focused on improving the rubric or strengthening the single judge, with comparatively little attention to how different single or multiple judges might be used during RaR training. We first show that judge identity alone produces a substantial spread in scores when training Qwen3-4B-Base on RaR-Medicine and RaR-Science across five frontier and open-weight judges.
