We construct a class of nonlinear phase kernels that modify the energy landscape and retrieval dynamics, and prove that these kernels preserve exponential storage capacity and local fixed-point convergence under given conditions on kernel smoothness, memory separation, and memory distributions. The framework is instantiated by the Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop), which guarantees monotone energy descent and mitigates practical capacity loss. S-Hop has $8.3\times$ and $4\times$ gains in one-step noisy retrieval load over Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet respectively, and reaches a $50\times$ gain in first-failure load for ImageNet. The results demonstrate that phase kernels provide a principled route to robust dense associative memory.

</details>


### [468] [Activation-Adjacent Layer Normalization: Effects on Approximation Power](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21527)
*Yunhao Ni,Yuxin Guo,Jie Luo,Wenjun Wu,Lei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究激活后归一化(AN)与预激活归一化(PN)浅层网络逼近指定宽度N单隐层MLP的能力，借助宽度增广在紧致集上局部线性化RMSNorm/LN，给出宽度N+1、N+2及N+r的构造并证明其紧性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LN与RMSNorm依赖输入且在推断阶段保持非线性，置于激活旁会改变网络所表示的函数，因此需要刻画归一化架构的精确逼近能力与所需宽度代价。

Method: 将RMSNorm视为输入依赖缩放，通过宽度增广在紧致特征集上局部线性化归一化；AN网络用无界激活范围达宽度N+1、一般连续非恒定激活达N+r且误差O_f(r^{-1})；PN网络借助仿射参数或一次正齐次性恢复N+1，一般连续激活达N+r且误差趋于零；LN构造使用中心化坐标对，宽度分别为N+2与N+2r。

Result: 证明N+1(RMSNorm)与N+2(LN)亦是逼近的最坏情形下界，并将普通MLP的通用逼近定理迁移至归一化架构；数值实验在全部五种设定下复现预测的逼近速率，并展示shifted-ReLU的有限宽度障碍。

Conclusion: 归一化带来的非线性可被宽度增广精确补偿，其额外宽度代价为常数或随误差率增长，且界限紧致。

Abstract: Layer normalization (LN) and root mean square normalization (RMSNorm) depend on their inputs and remain nonlinear at inference. Inserting either next to an activation may therefore change the function a network represents. We study when shallow activation-normalized (AN) and preactivation-normalized (PN) networks can approximate a prescribed width-$N$ one-hidden-layer MLP. Viewing RMSNorm as input-dependent scaling, we use width augmentation to locally linearize normalization on compact feature sets. For AN networks, an unbounded activation range allows width $N+1$, while every continuous nonconstant activation admits width $N+r$ with error $O_f(r^{-1})$. For PN networks, affine parameters or, without them, degree-one positive homogeneity recover width $N+1$; general continuous activations admit width $N+r$ with error tending to zero. The corresponding LN constructions use centered coordinate pairs, yielding widths $N+2$ and $N+2r$, respectively. We prove that $N+1$ for RMSNorm and $N+2$ for LN are also the worst-case bound for approximations, and show that applicable universal-approximation theorems for ordinary MLPs transfer to these normalized architectures. Numerical experiments recover the predicted approximation rates for both normalizations across all five settings and illustrate the shifted-ReLU finite-width obstruction.

</details>


### [469] [Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21547)
*Vasileios Perifanis,Nikolaos Pavlidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该报告以可复现流水线研究「预训练模型经由联邦学习适配到用户端数据」这一范式的隐私与完整性：MobileNetV4-Conv-Small在ImageNet预训练、十个Quick, Draw!类别上集中微调（测试精度97.50%），再以仅头部FedAvg在十个non-IID客户端适配（客户端训练精度90.34%→91.49%）；随后评估四类攻击场景，发现单步梯度可泄露完整标签集但重建效果差（SSIM 0.130）、标签计数恢复随客户端增多而低于随机猜测、FedAvg下后门在30%/50%/100%恶意比例下ASR为21.9%/31.3%/54.7%、FLTrust可显著降低ASR但在全恶意场景失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习正从「从零训练」转向「把中心预训练的模型适配到端侧私有数据」，但其隐私泄露与模型完整性风险在该设置下的实证刻画不足；作者面向第四届Federated Machine Learning International Summer School，需要一个可复现、可教学演示的实验框架来系统量化隐私与鲁棒性。

Method: 采用可复现流水线：ImageNet预训练MobileNetV4-Conv-Small→在10类Quick, Draw!上集中微调→10个non-IID客户端上仅训练头部的FedAvg适配；设置四个对抗场景：(1) 诚实好奇服务器从单个单步客户端更新反演，(2) 从单轮FedAvg聚合做标签计数恢复，(3) 30%/50%/100%客户端投毒的后门与标签翻转攻击，(4) FLTrust（保留集中微调得到的root set）防御；并配以Indigma FedMaestro编排器的现场演练，代码在Google Colab可运行。

Result: 集中微调测试精度97.50%；FedAvg后客户端训练精度90.34%→91.49%且全局精度不降。单步更新可完整恢复私有标签集，但重建偏向类原型而非真实涂鸦（平均SSIM 0.130）。标签计数恢复率随客户端数从87.5%（1个客户端）降至75.0%（5和10个客户端），低于无信息均匀猜测的80.0%。FedAvg下后门ASR为21.9%/31.3%/54.7%（30%/50%/100%恶意），干净精度损失≤0.8个百分点；标签翻转仅当源类多数样本被重标注时有效。FLTrust在30%/50%恶意比例下将ASR降至1.8%/4.0%，标签翻转ASR由12.6%降至0.8%且无可见干净精度损失，但全体客户端恶意时无防护作用。

Conclusion: 预训练模型+头部FedAvg的适配范式并非天然安全：单步更新即可泄露标签、简单聚合易受后门影响，而基于root set的FLTrust能有效抑制部分恶意场景的ASR但不具备全恶意鲁棒性；该流水线为教学与复现提供了端到端基准。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises client training accuracy from 90.34% to 91.49% while preserving global accuracy. We evaluate four adversarial scenarios. First, from a single one-step client update, an honest-but-curious server recovers the complete private label set, but its reconstructions follow class prototypes rather than the private drawings (mean SSIM 0.130). Second, from a one-round FedAvg aggregate, label-count recovery falls from 87.5% with one client to 75.0% with five and ten clients, below the 80.0% of an uninformed uniform guess. Third, under FedAvg, a backdoor injected by 30%, 50%, and 100% of the clients reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of 21.9%, 31.3%, and 54.7% at a cost of at most 0.8 percentage points of clean accuracy, whereas label flipping is effective only when most of the source-class data are relabeled. Fourth, FLTrust with a root set retained from centralized fine-tuning lowers the backdoor ASR to 1.8% and 4.0% at 30% and 50% malicious clients and the label-flipping ASR from 12.6% to 0.8% without measurable clean-accuracy loss, but provides no protection when every client is malicious. The report closes with a live session in which participants draw, fine-tune, and poison the model through Indigma's FedMaestro orchestrator. Code and executed notebooks, runnable on Google Colab, are at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/fl-summer-school.

</details>


### [470] [Finite-Time Guarantees for Constrained Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21548)
*Valentina Zaccaria,Philip Jordan,Tingting Ni,Gian Antonio Susto,Maryam Kamgarpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究约束部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(CPOMDP)中的强化学习，将有限历史窗口视为CMDP状态，提出原始-对偶算法，首次给出同时约束平均奖励次优性与约束违反的非渐近保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPOMDP中状态不可完全观测，最优策略可能依赖任意长的观测-动作历史，导致规划与学习困难；已有方法缺乏对平均奖励次优性与约束违反的联合非渐近保证。

Method: 利用POMDP有限记忆近似的最新进展，将有限长度历史窗口表示为约束MDP的状态；在此基础上设计原始-对偶(primal-dual)算法进行学习与规划；在滤波稳定性(filter-stability)假设下，推导有限状态模型与原CPOMDP之间最优性与可行性的关系界。

Result: 该原始-对偶算法首次给出非渐近保证，可同时约束原CPOMDP中的平均奖励次优性与约束违反；近似误差随窗口长度呈几何衰减；在部分可观测网格世界实验中验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 有限历史窗口近似结合原始-对偶优化可在CPOMDP中实现带有联合性能保证的高效学习，且近似质量随窗口增长快速提升。

Abstract: We study reinforcement learning in constrained partially observable Markov decision processes (CPOMDPs), where an agent maximizes reward subject to a cost constraint using only incomplete information about the underlying state. The lack of state observability may require optimal policies to depend on arbitrarily long observation-action histories, making planning and learning challenging. We leverage recent advances in finite-memory approximations of POMDPs and represent finite history windows as states of a constrained MDP. We then develop a primal--dual algorithm that provides the first non-asymptotic guarantees that jointly bound average reward suboptimality and constraint violation in the original CPOMDP. A key challenge is that this finite-window approximation affects both reward values and the set of feasible policies. Under a filter-stability assumption, we derive bounds relating optimality and feasibility in the finite-state model to those in the original CPOMDP, with approximation errors that decay geometrically with the window length. Experiments in partially observable gridworlds demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [471] [Uncertainty Quantification in Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21554)
*Mohamed Karim Belaid,Maximilian Rabus,Eyke Hüllermeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向分类的成对差分学习（PDL），并给出适配的元学习技术；在此基础上，将总不确定性分解为偶然与认知两部分，提出多种将不确定性度量扩展到 PDL 的方法，并用大规模实验评估其预测精度与不确定性感知能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法直接学习实例到结果的映射；PDL 改为学习"两个实例之差"的函数，但分类场景与预测不确定性的忠实量化在该框架下尚缺乏系统处理。

Method: 构建 PDL 分类器：基学习器接收两实例并预测其结果的差分，查询预测由与所有训练样本的差分预测平均得到；为此设计合适的元学习训练策略。不确定性方面，借助近期关于总不确定性分解为偶然（aleatoric）与认知（epistemic）的工作，依据基学习器表示不确定性的方式与程度，提出多种度量扩展方案。

Result: 通过大规模实证研究，分析了该 PDL 分类器的预测准确率以及不确定性感知（校准与区分偶然/认知不确定性）的表现。

Conclusion: PDL 可作为分类的一种可行建模范式，且不确定性分解度量可被合理迁移至该框架，为忠实的不确定性量化提供途径。

Abstract: Instead of learning a mapping from instances to outcomes in the standard way, the key idea of pairwise difference learning (PDL) is to learn a function that takes two instances as input and predicts the difference between the respective outcomes. Given a function of this kind, predictions for a query instance are derived from every training example and then averaged. We propose a version of PDL for the task of classification and propose a suitable meta-learning technique for this purpose. Moreover, we address the problem of uncertainty quantification, i.e., of representing and quantifying the uncertainty of a PDL classifier's predictions in a faithful manner. Building on recent work on the decomposition of total uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components, we propose different ways of extending corresponding measures to the setting of PDL, depending on how and to what extent uncertainty is represented by the underlying base learner. In large-scale empirical studies, we analyze both the predictive accuracy and the uncertainty awareness of our PDL classifier.

</details>


### [472] [When Does Muon Actually Win? A Paired Data-, Time-, and Tuning-Budget Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21555)
*Mushir Akhtar,Hazem N. Nounou,Majdi Mansouri,Mohamed N. Nounou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文在固定数据、时间与调参预算下对比Muon与AdamW：Muon在等数据下显著优于AdamW（验证损失AUC降低3.25%–22.44%），但在时间归一化指标上仅在视觉任务占优，语言任务AdamW更优；且Muon优化器调用耗时占训练56.1%–69.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon因数据效率优势受到关注，但其收益多在不受限设置下报告；作者希望在显式的数据、墙钟时间与超参调优预算约束下，公平评估Muon相对AdamW的实际表现。

Method: 在单张A100 GPU上，使用参考版单设备Muon实现与AdamW对比，覆盖17.7M与33.6M参数的因果语言模型及2.70M参数的视觉Transformer；采用统一的23个候选配置开发预算，以5个匹配随机种子评估，记录完整验证轨迹、优化器步进计时，并使用冻结的一次性测试集；同时考察受限候选池下的期望遗憾。

Result: 等数据预算下Muon将验证损失AUC降低3.25%–22.44%，并在全部20个主要配对中降低测试损失；时间归一化损失面积上，视觉任务Muon提升19.68%–22.31%，语言任务AdamW领先3.38%–6.96%；含辅助AdamW更新的完整Muon调用占训练时间56.1%–69.6%（基线AdamW为6.1%–9.1%）；候选池受限时Muon期望遗憾更高。

Conclusion: 结果刻画的是小规模模型配合参考内核的情形；Muon的数据效率优势明确，但其墙钟时间优劣取决于任务与实现效率，现有计时排序不能推广到更大模型或经优化的实现。

Abstract: Muon's gains in data efficiency motivate evaluating its performance under explicit data, time, and tuning budgets. On a single A100 GPU, we compare a reference single-device Muon implementation with AdamW across 17.7M- and 33.6M-parameter causal language models and 2.70M-parameter vision transformers. A common 23-candidate development budget selects configurations evaluated with five matched seeds, full validation trajectories, optimizer-step timing, and a frozen one-shot test. Muon reduces validation-loss area under the curve by 3.25--22.44\% at equal data and lowers test loss in all 20 primary pairs. In this configuration, Muon improves time-normalized loss area} by 19.68--22.31\% on vision, while AdamW is better by 3.38--6.96\% on language. The full Muon optimizer call, including auxiliary AdamW updates, consumes 56.1--69.6\% of training time, compared with 6.1--9.1\% for the AdamW baseline. Muon also has higher expected regret under restricted access to these candidate pools. These results characterize small models with reference kernels; their wall-clock ordering does not establish a ranking for larger models or optimized implementations.

</details>


### [473] [A Quantum Machine Learning Approach to Content-Based Media Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21562)
*Mina Abbaszadeh,Ouissal Moumou,Anna Pearson,Bob Coecke,Rob Cooper,Alessandro Piscopo,Mehrnoosh Sadrzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于量子自然语言处理(QNLP)框架，将BBC iPlayer节目简介映射为变分量子电路，训练成内容推荐模型，在相似度学习任务上与BiLSTM基线性能相当但参数量仅约1/380，并在Quantinuum H2及模拟器上验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索变分量子电路在推荐任务中的潜力，寻求相较经典深度模型更具参数效率的、可实际部署的内容推荐方案。

Method: 采用QNLP框架，依据文本语义结构将节目简介映射为变分量子电路；以监督式成对相似度学习任务训练电路参数；与在同一数据和目标上训练的经典BiLSTM基线进行对比，并做参数预算受限的对照实验；最后用基于SWAP-test的协议在Quantinuum System Model H2及配套模拟器上执行训练好的电路。

Result: 两模型在相似度学习任务上性能相当，但量子模型参数量显著更少（47k vs. 17.8M）；将BiLSTM限制到同等参数预算后性能明显下降（MAP下降3.63个百分点）；在含噪声的真实硬件条件下相似度信号仍得以保留。

Conclusion: 结构化的量子表示在该场景下提供了高参数效率的替代方案，展示了变分量子电路用于推荐任务的潜力，并构成面向实际部署的实践性一步。

Abstract: We use quantum machine learning techniques to develop a content-based media recommender system and evaluate its performance on TV programmes using textual descriptions from one week of BBC iPlayer data. Grounded in the Quantum Natural Language Processing framework (QNLP), programme synopses are mapped to variational quantum circuits using their semantic structure. The parameters of these circuits are trained via a supervised pairwise similarity learning task.
  We benchmark the quantum recommender against a classical BiLSTM baseline trained on the same dataset and objective. While both models achieve comparable performance on the similarity learning task, the quantum model requires significantly fewer parameters (47k vs. 17.8M). When the BiLSTM is constrained to a matching parameter budget, its performance degrades substantially (by 3.63 percentage points in Mean Average Precision (MAP)), indicating that the structured quantum representation provides a highly parameter-efficient alternative in this setting. We demonstrate the feasibility of executing the trained models on quantum hardware by deploying the circuits on Quantinuum's System Model H2 (and accompanying emulator) using a SWAP-test-based protocol. The results confirm that the similarity signal is preserved under realistic, noisy conditions. Taken together, these findings highlight the potential of variational quantum circuits for recommendation tasks and represent a practical step toward their real-world deployment.

</details>


### [474] [Sharp and Stable Label-Free Calibration Certificates from Logical Coherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21567)
*Takahiro Kato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文针对逐条回答逻辑相关问题的查询条件概率预测器，在缺少标签的情况下，通过极小极大定理给出各类下注约束下校准残差的尖锐无标签下界，并构造可稳定、可随时有效的证书，在预注册实验中四预测器两数据集上七项确证性证书全部为正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询条件概率预测器逐条回答逻辑相关问题，但用于检验其校准性的标签常常缺失；因此需要不依赖标签、可计算的校准下界（证书），以判断预测器在最坏情况下有多差。

Method: 对每种关于下注者可使用的赌注（stakes）的限制，用极小极大定理在有限支撑的答案分布上导出对应的尖锐无标签校准残差下界；分析均值、边际、联合各阶段在多事件捆绑上的可分性；采用Lipschitz赌注构造对平滑校准残差尖锐且稳定的界；在i.i.d.流上使用固定节点的投影在线梯度上升给出固定视野证书（误差由网格、学习与统计项界定），并用可预测下注给出随时有效证书；最后进行预注册实证研究。

Result: 捆绑多个事件时，均值、边际与联合阶段的界可严格分离，且不接受关于其他问题的假设就无法把捆绑界归因于单个问题；尖锐边际界对答案不连续，且任何在Wasserstein距离下连续的无标签下界都无法与之保持常数因子接近；Lipschitz赌注给出稳定界，对平滑校准残差尖锐，且对任意正Lipschitz常数其正值性与尖锐边际界一致。预注册研究中四预测器两数据集共八对，七项确证性证书均为正（第八对未通过试点）。

Conclusion: 证书只表明校准至少差到该程度，零值仅意味着"未被反驳"；所提出的无标签极小极大框架在理论上给出尖锐、稳定且（在i.i.d.流下）随时有效的校准证书，并在预注册实验中提供正面证据。

Abstract: Query-conditioned probabilistic predictors answer logically related questions one at a time, and labels to check their calibration are often missing. For each restriction on what a bettor's stakes may use, a minimax theorem identifies, for finitely supported laws of the answers, the sharp label-free lower bound on the corresponding calibration residual. On bundles of different events its mean, marginal and joint stages can separate strictly, and a bundle's bound cannot be attributed to one question without assumptions on the others. The sharp marginal bound is discontinuous in the answers, and no label-free lower bound continuous in the Wasserstein distance stays within a constant factor of it. Lipschitz stakes give a stable bound, sharp for a smooth calibration residual and, for every positive Lipschitz constant, positive exactly when the sharp marginal bound is. On i.i.d. streams, projected online gradient ascent at fixed nodes gives fixed-horizon certificates whose shortfall is bounded by grid, learning and statistical terms, and predictable betting gives anytime-valid ones. In a preregistered study of four predictors on two data sets, all seven confirmatory certificates were positive (the eighth pair did not pass the pilot). A certificate shows only that calibration is at least this bad; zero means "not refuted".

</details>


### [475] [From Perception to Prediction and Intervention: Benchmarking Proactive Video Assistants in Real-Life Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21568)
*Boyu Cui,Junhao Luo,Zhihao Wang,Linghan Chen,Zejun Li,Jiwen Zhang,Siyuan Wang,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 P³IBench，一个面向真实流式场景的"主动式视频理解"基准，评估日常感知、风险预测与干预三类能力；对 12 个开源/闭源视频语言模型评测发现其响应决策校准不佳，并构建主动训练数据训练 P³I-Assistant-4B，在各任务上有所提升但增长不均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态视频理解基准主要评估模型能否"理解所观察到的视觉内容"，而真实场景中的助手还需预测需要何种帮助、并决定何时介入。这一"主动性"（proactive）能力缺口缺乏系统性评测手段。

Method: 构建 P³IBench 基准，聚焦真实生活流式场景，覆盖三项互补能力：日常感知（daily perception）、风险预测（risk prediction）与干预（intervention）；评测 12 个代表性开源与闭源视频语言模型，涵盖流式系统与改造后的非流式系统；并额外构造主动式训练数据，训练 P³I-Assistant-4B 模型。

Result: 现有模型难以做出良好校准（well-calibrated）的响应决策；P³I-Assistant-4B 在多项任务上取得提升，但各能力维度的增益不均衡（uneven）。

Conclusion: 有效的主动式辅助不仅依赖视觉理解，还需要精确的响应时机（precise response timing）与适当的克制（appropriate restraint）。

Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content. In real-world scenarios, assistants must additionally anticipate what assistance is needed and decide when to provide it. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{P$^3$IBench}, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios. It evaluates three complementary capabilities: daily perception, risk prediction and intervention. We benchmark 12 representative open-source and proprietary video-language models, including streaming and adapted non-streaming systems. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to make well-calibrated response decisions. Finally, we construct additional proactive training data and train \textsc{P$^3$I-Assistant-4B}, achieving improvements on several tasks, though gains remain uneven across capabilities. Together, these findings show that effective proactive assistance requires not only visual understanding, but also precise response timing and appropriate restraint.

</details>


### [476] [Learning to Search for Executable Patternmaking from Certified Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21579)
*Zhuotao Xu,Chi Zeng,Liying Yang,Xinxing Yu,Yanyan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SemDraft，首个从成对的“改前-改后”缝纫纸样中学习搜索可执行纸样制作编辑程序的框架，无需记录编辑步骤；经三重校验的证书程序用于训练动作排序模型，显著提升搜索认证成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（从图像或文本生成纸样、程序化表示使纸样可执行）只产出最终纸样，不建模“从一个纸样改造成另一个纸样”的过程。实际中新款式来自对已有纸样的编辑（加长衣身、移动省道、换袖子），而纸样档案只存结果、不存步骤。

Method: 观察到编辑步骤可通过在编辑动作空间上搜索至一纸样变为另一纸样而恢复；用确定性编译器使恢复的步骤可检验。具体地，有界搜索恢复编辑动作程序，并通过三项检查才予以认证：(1) 从头重新编译；(2) 对每一对动作分类为有序或可交换；(3) 独立重放得到相同纸样。认证后的程序用于训练模型，在同一搜索中对候选动作排序。

Result: 在两份冻结的、各含 80 个顺序敏感案例的抽样上，固定其他所有搜索组件，学习型排序器在 1,000 次搜索执行内分别认证 63 与 64 个案例，而非学习型排序器至多为 53 与 52。

Conclusion: 学习式动作排序可在固定搜索预算下显著提高可执行纸样编辑程序的认证数量，说明从成对纸样中逆向恢复纸样制作程序是可行且可验证的。

Abstract: Recent models generate sewing patterns from images or text, and program-based representations make these patterns executable. These systems produce a finished pattern and do not model how a patternmaker turns one pattern into another. In practice a new style is made by editing an existing pattern: lengthening the bodice, moving a dart, swapping a sleeve. Pattern archives record the results of such edits and none of the steps. We observe that the steps can be recovered by searching over editing actions until one pattern becomes the other. A deterministic compiler makes the recovered steps checkable. To this end, we present SemDraft, the first framework that learns to search for executable patternmaking programs from paired before-and-after sewing patterns without recorded editing steps. Specifically, a bounded search recovers a program of editing actions and certifies it only after three checks: it recompiles from scratch, every pair of its actions is classified as ordered or interchangeable, and an independent replay reaches the same pattern. The certified programs then train a model that ranks candidate actions inside the same search. On two frozen draws of 80 order-sensitive cases, with every other search component fixed, the learned ranker certifies 63 and 64 cases within 1,000 search executions, against at most 53 and 52 for non-learned rankers.

</details>


### [477] [Transfer Learning in Bandits from Unknown Adaptive Policies: Problem-Dependent Lower and Upper Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21582)
*Adrien Prevost,Timothee Mathieu,Waris Radji,Odalric-Ambrym Maillard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究历史数据来自未知策略的自适应决策过程这一更现实的迁移bandit设定，给出渐近下界并提出KL-UCB-Transfer算法，在源-目标均值偏差假设下实现带改进主常数（或退化）的对数遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机多臂bandit迁移学习通常假设先验数据是固定离线数据集或来自已知源策略；但实际中历史观测往往产生于策略未知的先前自适应决策过程，样本量随机且依赖数据，因此需要研究这一更贴近实际的设定。

Method: 对[0,1]有界奖励，设学习者在在线博弈前对每个臂k获得N'_k个来自未知分布ν'_k、由任意可能数据依赖策略采集的i.i.d.观测；假设源与目标均值满足|μ_k−μ'_k|<L_k（已知常数）。推导渐近问题相关下界，并提出KL-UCB-Transfer，将在线数据与历史数据结合构造置信上界进行臂选择；随后将假设放松为单侧条件μ_k−μ'_k<L_k以分析错配下的稳健性。

Result: 当μ'_a<μ_1−L_a时，KL-UCB-Transfer获得对数遗憾且主常数较经典KL-UCB有所改进；否则恢复KL-UCB的经典保证。在单侧假设放松（错配）下，对数遗憾仍可存活，并刻画了三种机制：改进、退化的对数界、以及保证失效。仿真验证了利用过程生成历史数据的实际收益。

Conclusion: 即使历史数据来自未知自适应策略且样本量随机，只要源-目标差异有界，历史数据即可被安全利用并带来问题相关常数的改进；单侧条件下的结果界定了迁移在何种偏离程度内仍有理论保证，为策略未知的历史数据迁移提供了理论刻画。

Abstract: Transfer learning in stochastic multi-armed bandits is typically studied assuming that prior data forms a fixed offline dataset or is generated by a known source. In practice, historical observations come from a previous adaptive decision process whose policy is unknown. We study this setting for bounded rewards in $[0,1]$.
  Before the online game starts, the learner receives, for each arm $k$, $N'_k$ observations drawn i.i.d.\ from an unknown distribution $ν'_k$, collected by an arbitrary and possibly data-dependent strategy, so the sample sizes $N'_k$ may be random. Source and target means satisfy $|μ_k-μ'_k|<L_k$ for known constants $(L_k)_k$.
  We derive an asymptotic problem-dependent lower bound and propose KL-UCB-Transfer, which combines online and historical data and achieves logarithmic regret with an improved leading constant whenever $μ'_a<μ_1-L_a$, and recovers the classical KL-UCB guarantee otherwise. Since bounding the source-target discrepancy is often unrealistic, we relax the assumption to the one-sided condition $μ_k-μ'_k<L_k$ and show that logarithmic regret can survive under misspecification, characterizing three regimes ranging from improvement to a degraded logarithmic bound to a loss of guarantee. Simulations illustrate the practical benefits of exploiting process-generated historical data.

</details>


### [478] [Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21601)
*Bingxi Hou,Guochao Jiang,Guofeng Quan,Weiqing Li,Wenfeng Feng,Guohua Liu,Yuewei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Waypoint-OPD，用同一 RL 训练过程中的中间检查点比较早期与晚期教师策略偏移的方向一致性，据此对端点策略偏移进行门控，实现选择性策略蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有策略偏移蒸馏仅使用教师 RL 前后对数概率差作为监督，但该端点偏移无法反映教师在训练过程中局部动作偏好是否一致演化；相同端点偏移可能由早期与晚期相互增强或部分抵消的偏移产生。

Method: 引入中间教师检查点（waypoint），在学生访问的前缀处比较早期与晚期相对动作偏好的方向；按两者方向一致性对端点偏移进行门控，方向相反时抑制该信号。相比纯端点迁移仅多一次冻结教师评分前向。

Result: 以 RL 训练的 Qwen3-4B 为教师，Qwen3-8B/14B/30B-A3B 为学生，在数学与代码推理的六个领域—学生组合中，Waypoint-OPD 均取得对比蒸馏方法中最高的领域平均分；Qwen3-8B 上的消融显示移除或打乱门控会降低数学推理性能。

Conclusion: 早期与晚期教师策略偏移的方向一致性可作为学生训练中端点偏移的有效加权依据，支持选择性策略蒸馏的可行性。

Abstract: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.

</details>


### [479] [Market Incentives for AI Safety Investment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21607)
*Nikita Tsoy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文用博弈论模型分析AI供应链中上游LLM提供商与多个竞争性下游企业，在利润最大化驱动下的安全投入水平，并与市场福利最优、行业利润最优基准比较；发现下游竞争通常使下游企业安全投入高于行业利润最优水平，而上游提供商因无法充分获取安全投入带来的剩余而可能投入不足，最后分析监管干预对激励、利润与模型安全水平的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统带来毒性内容、恶意使用与虚假信息等社会风险，其缓解不仅取决于技术可行性，也取决于开发与部署企业的激励。现有讨论多集中于技术层面，缺少对利润最大化如何塑造供应链各环节安全投入的经济学刻画，尤其是上下游激励错配问题。

Method: 构建AI供应链的博弈论模型：上游为单一LLM提供商，下游为多个相互竞争的企业。推导市场驱动（利润最大化）下的安全投入均衡水平，并将其与最大化市场福利、最大化行业利润两类基准进行比较；进一步引入不同监管干预，分析其对参与者激励、利润及模型安全水平的影响。

Result: 下游竞争通常促使下游企业安全投入高于行业利润最优水平；相比之下，上游提供商因不能充分获得安全投入所产生的剩余补偿，可能相对于市场福利与行业利润基准投入不足。监管干预会改变各参与方的激励与利润，并进而影响最终模型安全水平。

Conclusion: 市场驱动的安全投入在供应链上下游呈现方向相反的扭曲：下游过度投入、上游投入不足，单纯依赖市场激励难以达到福利或行业最优。监管设计需针对上游剩余攫取不足这一根源，协调上下游激励以提升整体模型安全水平。

Abstract: Despite their practical significance, modern AI systems pose significant societal risks, including toxicity, malicious use, and misinformation. Their mitigation depends not only on technical feasibility but also on the incentives of firms that develop and deploy these systems. We show how profit maximization shapes safety investment in an AI supply chain with an upstream LLM provider and several competing downstream firms. In our game-theoretic model, we derive the market-driven level of safety investment and compare it with the levels that maximize market welfare and industry profit. We find that downstream competition generally induces downstream firms to invest more in safety than the industry-profit-optimal level. By contrast, the upstream provider may underinvest relative to these benchmarks because it is not fully compensated for the surplus from safety investments. Finally, we analyze how different regulatory interventions affect the participants' incentives and profits, and the resulting levels of model safety.

</details>


### [480] [Local Temporal Contrasts on Human Motion Data Induce a Latent Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21630)
*Lourenço A. Rodrigues,Felix Putze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SemTAC：用时序邻域对比损失训练编码器，使表示轨迹具备可解释的几何结构，在截断序列判别任务上显著优于四类基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流基于注意力编码器加序列级池化的做法，使推理默认退化为单向量、逐点比较，丢弃了序列在表示空间中划出的轨迹；而人类运动等时间序列的多尺度结构需要在表示空间中得以保留以供下游使用。

Method: 不依赖预测式目标，仅用时间邻域对比损失训练编码器SemTAC：强制表示在各处满足局部一致性，从而诱导出连贯的全局结构，使推理可扩展到训练未见的时间尺度。评估采用五步运动序列判别任务，对比四项基线（同架构的分类目标、标准对比目标、TS-TCC、TS2Vec），并做超参对齐消融与新提出的位移平滑度指标检验。

Result: 完整序列长度下五种方法总体竞争力相当；在截断的不完整序列上SemTAC优势明显：序列完成前一步的中位F1为0.77，四基线为0.27–0.70。超参对齐消融将增益归因于时间对比目标本身。SemTAC的表示轨迹是五种方法中唯一呈现可解释几何结构者，在所提位移平滑度指标上超过无结构随机基线。

Conclusion: 其目标函数而非分类精度本身，产生了真正具有时序有序性的表示轨迹，说明局部时序一致性约束可恢复几何结构并支持跨时间尺度推理。

Abstract: Time series such as recordings of human motion data often encode structure across multiple temporal scales, and when a latent state determining this sequence evolves, this structure needs to survive in the representation space for downstream use. Yet the currently prevalent attention-based encoders paired with sequence-level pooling have made single-vector, pointwise comparison the default mode of inference, discarding the trajectory a sequence traces through the representation space. We propose recovering this geometric structure directly, without relying on forecasting-based objectives, by training an encoder model (SemTAC) with a temporal-neighborhood contrastive loss: representations that satisfy local consistency everywhere must give rise to a coherent global structure, letting inference happen at temporal scales beyond those seen during training. We evaluate SemTAC against four baselines on a five-step motion sequence discrimination task: the same architecture trained with a classification or a standard contrastive objective, and two established self-supervised time-series methods, TS-TCC and TS2Vec. At the full sequence length all five are broadly competitive, but on incomplete, truncated sequences SemTAC holds a large advantage: a median F1 of 0.77 one step before the sequence completes, against 0.27-0.70 for the four baselines. A hyperparameter-matched ablation attributes this effect specifically to the temporal-contrastive objective. SemTAC's representation trajectories are also the only ones among these five to exhibit interpretable geometric structures, exceeding a no-structure chance baseline on a displacement-smoothness metric which we introduce. This is evidence that its objective, not classification accuracy alone, produces genuinely temporally-ordered trajectories.

</details>


### [481] [ReFlow: Replay-Driven Decoupling for Efficient RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21640)
*Yukun Tian,Junwei Su,Haofeng Xu,Lansong Diao,Zhengping Qian,Weibo Zhao,Wenchao Zhou,Ruiting Zhou,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReFlow：面向LLM后训练的系统-算法协同设计RL框架，通过近期轨迹的经验回放实现样本复用，配合解耦自适应架构，训练吞吐较SOTA同步/异步系统提升最高2.06×且性能不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM RL（尤其多轮智能体负载）效率是瓶颈。现有系统依赖异步执行重叠rollout生成与策略优化，但存在固有矛盾：轻微策略陈旧带来的效率增益有限，激进异步则会损害模型质量且效率增益递减；且LLM RL与多轮负载的动态性使静态资源分配和生成策略低效。

Method: 关键洞见是：现有框架每条轨迹只消费一次，而对近期轨迹做经验回放可实现有效样本复用，摊薄rollout生成的高成本且不引入过度策略陈旧。据此提出解耦自适应架构，含三项设计：(1) 双回放数据循环，支持高效经验复用并平衡训练吞吐与优化稳定性；(2) 弹性资源池，动态放置资源以适配演化的RL负载；(3) 自适应调度器，协调生成策略与资源分配，提升利用率与生成吞吐。

Result: 在代表性单轮推���与多轮智能体RL任务上，ReFlow相较最先进的同步与异步RL系统将训练吞吐最高提升2.06×，同时保持相当或更优的模型性能。

Conclusion: 通过系统与算法协同设计、以经验回放复用近期轨迹并结合弹性资源与自适应调度，可在不牺牲（甚至改善）模型质量的前提下显著提升LLM RL后训练效率，为动态、多轮智能体RL负载提供了可行的系统方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient.
  This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-designed RL framework for efficient LLM post-training. Its key insight is that, unlike existing RL frameworks which consume each trajectory only once, experience replay of recent trajectories enables effective sample reuse, thereby amortizing the high cost of rollout generation without incurring excessive policy staleness. To fully exploit this opportunity, ReFlow adopts a decoupled and adaptive architecture with three key designs: a dual replay data cycle supports efficient experience reuse while balancing training throughput and optimization stability; an elastic resource pool enables dynamic resource placement to accommodate evolving RL workloads; an adaptive scheduler coordinates generation strategies and resource allocation to improve resource utilization and boost generation throughput. Experiments across representative single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic RL tasks show that ReFlow improves training throughput by up to $2.06\times$ over state-of-the-art synchronous and asynchronous RL systems, while maintaining comparable or better model performance.

</details>


### [482] [Efficient Pairwise Difference Learning: A Comparative Study of Encoding Strategies and Training Pair Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21644)
*Bernard Georges,Mohamed Karim Belaid,Manuel Rodrigues*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究成对差分学习分类（PDC）中输入表征与配对选择两项关键设计选择，发现提出的三元组绝对差编码器（φ_3dabs）平均F1最高，且仅用上三角配对可减少约40%计算时间而精度几乎不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDC通过在实例对上训练二分类相似性模型，将训练样本从n扩充到O(n²)，在低数据场景下有优势，但其实现细节（输入表征与配对选择策略）缺乏规范，影响性能与效率的可复现性。

Method: 在近200个基准分类数据集上，以决策树、多层感知机、高斯朴素贝叶斯和SVM为基模型，比较四种特征编码器（成对特征、含相对差的三元组、绝对差、以及新提出的含绝对差三元组φ_3dabs）与四种配对选择策略（从穷举到基于核稀疏化的方案）。

Result: φ_3dabs编码器取得最高平均F1；限制为上三角配对可降低约40%计算时间且精度损失可忽略；基于核稀疏化的选择未带来精度收益反而显著增加计算开销；PDC配置在94%的测试情形中优于基模型，但无单一配置普遍占优。

Conclusion: 输入表征与配对选择对PDC性能有实质影响，推荐使用φ_3dabs与上三角配对以兼顾精度与效率；由于不存在普适最优配置，面向数据集的自适应优化仍是待解决问题。

Abstract: Pairwise Difference Learning for Classification (PDC) enhances supervised learning in low-data regimes by training a binary similarity classifier on pairs of instances rather than individual samples, effectively inflating the training set from $n$ to $O(n^2)$ examples. However, the PDC framework leaves critical implementation choices underspecified, particularly regarding input representation and pair selection strategies. This work systematically investigates these design decisions through extensive empirical evaluation. We compare four feature encoders (paired features, triplet with relative difference, absolute difference, and a novel triplet with absolute difference) alongside four pair selection strategies ranging from exhaustive to kernel-thinning-based schemes. Experiments across nearly 200 benchmark classification datasets using Decision Tree, Multilayer Perceptron, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Classifier as base models reveal that the proposed triplet with absolute difference encoder ($φ_{\mathrm{3dabs}}$) achieves the highest average F1 scores. More notably, restricting training to upper-triangle pairs reduces computational time by approximately 40% with negligible accuracy loss. Kernel thinning-based selection provided no accuracy benefits while substantially increasing computational overhead. Overall, PDC configurations outperformed base models in 94% of tested cases, though no single configuration dominated universally, suggesting dataset-specific optimization remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [483] [Approaching Backpropagation Accuracy with Weight Perturbation on MNIST](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21665)
*Patrick Inoue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统考察权重扰动（WP）在MNIST全连接网络上的可达精度，证明其近似BP精度是"配置与预算相关"的可能性，而非等价效率或无条件保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WP仅用随机参数扰动与标量损失变化估计学习方向，无需反向传播导数，但缺乏对"WP能否、在何种条件下达到BP级精度"的清晰界定。作者希望厘清经验结果与理论保证之间的界限。

Method: 在浅层与深层全连接MNIST网络上做受控实验，变化batch size、训练轮数、学习率衰减及独立扰动更新的平均（估计器稳定化）；同时给出有限时域近似论证：在给定正则性条件下，总体WP可在任意固定有限深度下任意逼近固定的梯度下降轨迹，并借正分类间隔以任意高概率保持有限测试集上的参考预测。

Result: 浅层大batch训练WP约达97%测试精度，BP参照约97.5--98%；十轮预算下WP为90.2%，BP参照为97.4%，存在明显效率差距。batch size超过4000后收益递减。学习率衰减与多扰动平均可稳定深层网络，但未达BP水平。

Conclusion: WP接近BP精度是依赖于配置与训练预算的可能性，不能据此推论效率等价，也不存在跨深度的无条件精度保证；经验发现与有限时域理论近似结论需明确区分。

Abstract: Weight perturbation (WP) estimates learning directions from random parameter perturbations and a scalar change in loss, without backpropagating derivatives. We examine how batch size, training duration, and estimator stabilization affect its attainable accuracy in fully connected MNIST networks. In the shallow configuration, large-batch training reaches approximately 97\% test accuracy, compared with an early backpropagation (BP) reference near 97.5--98\%. The same comparison exposes a substantial efficiency gap: under a ten-epoch budget, shallow WP reaches 90.2\%, whereas the reported BP reference reaches 97.4\%. Epoch-indexed curves show diminishing returns from increasing batch size beyond 4,000. Learning-rate reduction and averaging independent perturbation-based updates also stabilize deeper networks, although their recorded results do not establish BP-level accuracy. We distinguish these empirical findings from a finite-horizon approximation argument: under stated regularity conditions, population WP can approximate a fixed gradient-descent trajectory arbitrarily closely at any fixed finite depth. Positive classification margins then suffice to preserve the reference predictions on a finite test set with arbitrarily high probability. Together, the results identify near-BP accuracy as a configuration- and budget-dependent possibility, rather than evidence of equal efficiency or an unconditional accuracy guarantee across depth.

</details>


### [484] [Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21672)
*Akinori Tanaka,Yukinao Akamatsu,Takuki Tomita,Yuji Hirono*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将扩散语言模型的连续时间前向/反向动力学嵌入开放量子系统框架，提出τ-leaping unraveling采样方案，实现超叠加提示(SoP)、超叠加思维(SoT)生成与量子启发式重掩码(QIR)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在离散token序列上反转经典扩散过程生成文本，其采样仅限于单一经典状态轨迹。作者希望借助开放量子系统理论把扩散采样推广到句子态的超叠加，并为改造生成动力学提供统一基础。

Method: 将扩散的连续时间前向与反向动力学映射为开放量子系统（与开放环境交互）的形式；构造τ-leaping unraveling方案，模拟这些态的随机轨迹并在每步同时更新多个token位置；由同一形式推导SoP、SoT（以超叠加提示/思维为条件的生成）以及QIR（对掩码扩散动力学施加扰动，得到基于置信度的已生成token修正规则）。

Result: 在预训练扩散语言模型上的实验表明：超叠加式生成能够保留最终测量未被选中的条件分量信息；QIR在生成的合适阶段应用时可提升LLM评估的文本质量。

Conclusion: 扩散语言模型与开放量子系统的形式联系可行且具实用价值，为超叠加采样与生成动力学改造提供了统一框架，并催生SoP、SoT、QIR等具体方法。

Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.

</details>


### [485] [Classical methods for modern applications: synthetic tabular data generation using lightweight discrete response continuous latent variable model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21674)
*Bartosz Barzdajn,Mateusz Krzysztoń*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级表格数据建模算法：用经验边缘分布与分位数函数把连续/离散变量映射到连续潜空间，估计多元高斯等分布；离散变量的连续表示导致"区域"歧义，自然导出 MCEM 框架，其辅助目标为加权潜空间似然，从而复用常规极大似然估计器，实现简单、少依赖、鲁棒训练与高效采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成模型虽强，但依赖多、实现复杂、训练不稳定。作者希望在现代计算生态中提供一种轻量、易实现、鲁棒且采样高效的表格数据（混合连续与离散变量）建模方法，同时保留复杂边缘分布与相关性。

Method: 利用经验边缘分布与选定分位数函数将数据变换到连续潜空间，在其中估计多变量高斯等分布；离散变量被连续化后单个观测对应潜空间中的一个区域而非点，由此构造蒙特卡洛 EM（MCEM）形式，其辅助目标写成加权潜空间似然，从而在高效稳健的优化流程中直接使用常规极大似然估计器。

Result: 变换能保留复杂边缘分布与相关性，得到高保真模型，尤其适用于单峰分布数据；实现简单、依赖少、训练/估计鲁棒、采样高效。

Conclusion: 该工作将经典统计方法与现代计算实践结合，给出轻量级表格数据生成建模方案；核心创新在于离散变量的连续表示及由此导出的加权潜空间似然 MCEM 表述。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables. The method uses empirical marginal distributions and a selected quantile function to transform the data into a continuous latent space, where a distribution of choice, e.g. a multivariate Gaussian, can be efficiently estimated and applied. While this approach is closely related to classical well-established machine learning methods, we present a novel adaptation that fits well within the contemporary computational ecosystem. Unlike in the case of deep architectures, it results in a simple implementation with few dependencies, robust training/estimation, as well as efficient sampling. The transformation preserves complex marginal distributions and correlations, providing high-fidelity models, especially for data with unimodal distributions. One of the key characteristics of the proposed approach is its continuous representation of discrete variables. While highly desirable, this introduces a significant challenge, since a single observation corresponds to a region rather than a point in the latent space. We show that this ambiguity naturally leads to a Monte Carlo expectation-maximisation (MCEM) formulation, whose auxiliary objective can be expressed as a weighted latent-space likelihood. This, in turn, allows conventional maximum-likelihood estimators to be used within an efficient and robust optimisation procedure.

</details>


### [486] [Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21682)
*Liangyao Jin,Zhixin Wang,Liming Liu,Mingjun Zhang,Zhengzhou Zhu,Fangcheng Fu,Jinlong Hou,Yuan Cheng,Xiaohe Hu,Ping Zhang,Siyuan Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对RL训练中的off-policy不一致问题，尤其是MoE模型中路由漂移带来的危害，作者指出R3路由重放会因丢失训练路由器选中而rollout路由器未选中的专家贡献而引入梯度偏差，转而提出Router Drift Control（RDC），以路由分歧作为off-policy陈旧度信号，在序列级过滤高漂移样本来消除梯度偏差并保留原生专家选择与学习信号；实验显示RDC在策略陈旧度增大时收益更大，异步RL中与TIS结合后在AIME 2024/2025平均峰值验证准确率上分别较TIS和R3提升5.5和4.5个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL因训练-推理不匹配、小批量更新与异步训练而天然产生off-policy性。该不匹配在MoE模型中尤为有害：rollout与训练的差异会改变路由决策，引发router drift。现有的R3通过重放rollout阶段的专家选择来缓解不匹配，但会牺牲训练路由器自身的专家选择，产生梯度偏差，因此需要一个既能消除偏差又能保留原生路由学习信号的方案。

Method: 先理论分析R3路由重放的梯度偏差来源：训练路由器选中而rollout路由器未选中的专家贡献被丢弃。进而提出RDC：以rollout与训练路由器之间的路由分歧程度作为off-policy陈旧度信号，在序列级别选择性拒绝高漂移的响应，保留样本则使用原生专家选择，不做重放。

Result: 策略陈旧度越大，RDC相对基线收益越明显；在异步RL中依然有效。异步训练下RDC结合Truncated Importance Sampling（TIS），在AIME 2024与AIME 2025的平均峰值验证准确率上较TIS提升5.5个百分点，较R3提升4.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 路由分歧可作为有效的off-policy陈旧度度量，序列级过滤是规避重放梯度偏差的可行替代路径；RDC在同步与异步RL中均优于TIS与R3，且优势随陈旧度增加而扩大。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. Experiments show that RDC achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous RL. In asynchronous training, RDC combined with Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) improves the average peak validation accuracy across AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 points over R3.

</details>


### [487] [ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21695)
*Oguzhan Buyuksolak,Osman Erman Okman,Mehmet Gorkem Ulkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ShiftQAT量化感知训练流程，在MAX7800x固定功能CNN加速器的严格数值契约（二次幂、逐张量、对称scale，8位激活/偏置，纯整数运算，每层单一静态shift）下按构造生成合规网络，是ai8x-training默认训练路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定功能CNN加速器虽高效，但只执行满足精确数值契约的网络；该契约的二次幂/对称量化、8位偏置预算与单静态shift等约束使通用QAT难以直接适配，需要专门的训练流程保证网络从构造上即合规。

Method: ShiftQAT：解决残差、拼接和权重共享的依赖关系，使激活scale可静态传播、每层重量化退化为一个离线配置的移位；在满足8位偏置预算的联合二次幂网格上训练权重与偏置。

Result: 在对比方法中，仅ShiftQAT满足契约全部缩放约束（含有符号8位激活存储）；ImageNet上其W8A8精度下降与约束更宽松的QAT方法相当，W4A8下与FP32差距在2.9个百分点内；MAX78002芯片上MobileNetV2与ResNet-18单张推理分别为14.6 ms/5.1 mJ和8.4 ms/2.8 mJ。

Conclusion: 通过按构造满足硬件数值契约的QAT流程，可在不牺牲精度的前提下于固定功能加速器上实现快速、低能耗的边缘推理。

Abstract: Fixed-function CNN accelerators make edge inference fast and energy-efficient, but they execute only networks that obey a precise numerical contract. On the MAX7800x family, this contract requires power-of-two, per-tensor, symmetric scales, 8-bit activations and biases, integer-only arithmetic, and one statically configured shift per layer. We present ShiftQAT, the quantization-aware training (QAT) flow we developed for this family, which produces networks satisfying the contract by construction. It is the default training path of ai8x-training, the family's open-source training toolchain. ShiftQAT resolves residual, concatenation, and weight-sharing dependencies so that activation scales propagate statically and each layer's requantization reduces to one offline-configured shift. It also trains weights and biases on a joint power-of-two grid that fits the 8-bit bias budget. Among the compared methods, only ShiftQAT satisfies all of the contract's scaling constraints, including signed 8-bit activation storage. Even so, on ImageNet it matches the W8A8 accuracy drop of less constrained QAT methods and stays within 2.9 percentage points of FP32 at W4A8. On MAX78002 silicon, ShiftQAT-trained MobileNetV2 and ResNet-18 classify ImageNet images in 14.6 and 8.4 ms at 5.1 and 2.8 mJ per inference.

</details>


### [488] [Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21708)
*Cesare Zavattari,Alessandro Tommasi,Giuseppe Prencipe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将人类干预视为"失败计算的可测标签"，在受控LLM智能体环境中定位过度追问的因果机制并提出门控干预，发现该修复可解释为"地图而非规则"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类对LLM智能体的干预通常被丢弃或仅作回放训练数据，浪费了其作为"指向内部失败计算"的测量信息；作者希望把干预当作标签，对具体失败行为做机制层面的因果定位与修复。

Method: 在受控智能体环境中研究单一失败模式（请求已明确时仍追问澄清）；用规则型监督者产生干预标签，并以盲测人类判断验证。对13个模型中5个合格模型（Qwen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4）学习残差流方向，在训练数据上选定层级与剂量，测试留出集翻转率并与随机方向对照；用可解码性/因果干预检验"信念—决策"分离；对探针读数门控转向评估监督负担与合法提问保留；再以LoRA将修复固化进权重并与同数据行为克隆对比。

Result: (1) 追问—行动决策在所有合格模型族中可因果定位：干预标签学得的方向在确定残差流深度可翻转72–100%的留出过度追问，随机方向最多翻转一个样本。(2) 两种机制签名：四族中模型可解码地"知道"请求无歧义（信念可解码、因果惰性、与决策正交）却仍追问；第五族中罕见过度追问对应不同的世界表征。(3) 基于探针读数门控的转向消除大部分模拟监督负担且合法提问得以保留（bootstrap 95%区间排除零），而提示指令反而加剧问题。(4) 将修复固化为权重得到"地图而非规则"：一个模型上限制于因果带的LoRA通过全部预设判据、同数据行为克隆损害保持性；三族相反；第五族随种子跨越边界。预先写下的几何预测规则在两个族外测试上失败，作者如实报告而未拟合替代规则。

Conclusion: 人类干预可作为有效的机制级测量信号；过度追问存在可因果定位的决策方向且呈两种机制签名；探针门控转向是有效的可部署修复；但将修复固化入权重时结果依模型族而异、不可由单一几何规则预测，需按模型族实证判别。

Abstract: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.

</details>


### [489] [FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21720)
*Reeyansh Shah,Maram Hasan,Subhasis Chaudhuri,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FIRM，一种单轮、基于Fisher统计的联邦LLM遗忘服务器端聚合框架，通过Fisher归一化基础合并与二阶保持投影抑制幅度爆炸，在保持遗忘效果的同时提升保留效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦LLM遗忘中，遗忘数据与保留数据分布在私有客户端且服务器不可见，各客户端本地训练出的适配器编码相互冲突的目标，使聚合本质区别于常规联邦优化。主要失效模式是幅度爆炸：未归一化的跨客户端聚合会放大合并更新幅度，在更强遗忘下损害保留效用。

Method: FIRM利用客户端本地Fisher统计作为统一敏感性信号：(1)构造Fisher归一化的基础合并；(2)对保留敏感参数施加显式控制，通过二阶保持投影实现，该投影具有唯一的最小距离解，其对偶规模随保留客户端数量而非模型维度增长；整体为单轮服务器端聚合框架。

Result: 在Zephyr-7B与Llama-3-8B上针对WMDP、TOFU与MUSE-HP的实验显示：在WMDP与MUSE-HP上于可比遗忘水平下取得效用提升，TOFU上存在依赖指标的权衡；受控对比支持基础合并与额外保持校正组合在特定工作点的收益。

Conclusion: FIRM为联邦LLM遗忘提供了一种稳定、保持感知的单轮聚合方案，缓解幅度爆炸问题，并在多个基准上验证了效用-遗忘权衡的改善，但效果在TOFU上依指标而有所取舍。

Abstract: Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with the number of retain clients rather than the model dimension. Experiments across WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-HP using Zephyr-7B and Llama-3-8B show utility gains at comparable forgetting on WMDP and MUSE-HP, with metric-dependent trade-offs on TOFU. Controlled comparisons support benefits of the combined base merge and additional retention correction at selected operating points.

</details>


### [490] [Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21742)
*Gengcheng Lyu,Manuel Röder,Frank-Michael Schleif*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Smooth-L1 正则化 ESN（SL1ESN），在读出层诱导稀疏且保持二次可微，兼容牛顿法，兼顾集中式训练与二阶联邦聚合，实现 75–95% 稀疏并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 ESN 计算高效，但稠密读出层使存储模型体积和单样本推理开销偏大，不利于资源受限的边缘/IoT 部署；需要在不牺牲可微性与优化效果的前提下实现读出层稀疏化。

Method: 采用二次可微的 Smooth-L1 近似作为读出层正则项，替代不可微的 L1，从而支持基于梯度的牛顿法优化；同一正则项同时用于集中式训练与一种二阶（牛顿步）联邦聚合方案；所有数据集与两种设置共用同一固定收缩阈值。

Result: 在 7 个时间序列分类基准上，集中式设置读出稀疏度 77–95%，联邦设置 75–95%；集中式下 7 个基准中有 5 个与最强稠密基线的精度差距在 0.7 个百分点内，联邦设置下同样 5 个基准差距在 1.6 个百分点内；二阶联邦更新仅需数轮即收敛；稀疏化使存储模型、单样本推理开销及服务器到客户端广播量按相近比例压缩。

Conclusion: 稀疏读出层在保持精度的同时显著压缩模型与通信/推理成本，对边缘计算与 IoT 部署具有实用价值；Smooth-L1 正则化与二阶联邦聚合是可行且有效的组合方案。

Abstract: Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are $77$--$95\%$ sparse in the centralized setting and $75$--$95\%$ sparse in the federated one, while staying within $0.7$ accuracy points of the strongest dense baseline on five of the seven benchmarks in the centralized setting and within $1.6$ points on the same five in the federated one, and the second-order federated update converges in only a few rounds. The resulting sparsity compresses the stored model, the per-sample inference cost, and the server-to-client broadcast by a comparable factor. These results demonstrate the practical value of sparse readouts for edge computing and IoT deployments.

</details>


### [491] [Pairwise AUC Optimization Needs Corrective Power: A Unified View](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21743)
*Jia Chen,Zhiyong Yang,Shilong Bao,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"矫正力(Corrective Power)"概念，从pairwise梯度的U统计量退化性质出发，解释了直接成对AUC代理训练为何在度量对齐下仍可能失效，并据此解释平方hinge损失、交叉熵warm-up与PEFT三类经验现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接成对AUC代理训练在类别不平衡下实现了训练目标与评测度量的对齐，但作者认为这种度量对齐并不保证随机训练始终具有"矫正性"，即不保证对更严重的正负排序错误产生更强、更可靠的更新。因此需要识别并解释度量对齐与优化动态之间的这一缺口。

Method: 以"矫正力"为分析视角，考察mini-batch成对更新对严重排序错误的改进强度与可靠性；通过分析成对梯度所构成U统计量的退化性质，给出训练进入"严重错误密集但不再产生有效矫正运动"区域的机理刻画，并据此推导对损失函数选择、warm-up策略与参数高效微调的三项可检验预测。

Result: 理论分析给出与三类经验模式一致的机制解释：(a)平方hinge损失常是有效的AUC代理；(b)交叉熵warm-up有助于从较差起点进入AUC阶段的模型；(c)基于预训练模型的参数高效微调因起点更接近有利排序几何而降低warm-up需求。在8个CV任务与8个NLP任务上，使用ResNet50、DenseNet121、DistilBERT-base和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的实验支持上述预测。

Conclusion: 仅靠度量对齐不足以保证有效的成对训练动态；矫正力不足与U统计量退化提供了统一解释，并为损失设计、warm-up与微调策略提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Direct pairwise AUC-surrogate training is attractive because it trains toward the ranking metric used at test time, especially under class imbalance. This creates a direct alignment between the training objective and the evaluation metric, but such metric alignment alone does not guarantee that stochastic training remains corrective. We study this gap through Corrective Power: whether pairwise mini-batch updates produce stronger and more reliable improvements for more severe positive-negative ranking errors. Our main observation is that direct pairwise training can enter regions where severe errors remain common but no longer produce useful corrective motion. In such regions, even the mini-batch noise that would normally help SGD move along the steepest severe-error correction direction can become much weaker. In this paper, we seek a theoretical explanation for this by exploring the degenerate property of the U-statistics formed from the pairwise gradients therein. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for several empirical patterns: (a) squared-hinge loss is often an effective AUC surrogate; (b) cross-entropy warm-up can help models that enter the AUC phase from a poor starting region; and (c) parameter-efficient fine-tuning from a pretrained model can reduce that need by starting closer to a favorable ranking geometry. Experiments on 8 CV tasks and 8 NLP tasks, using ResNet50, DenseNet121, DistilBERT-base, and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, support these predictions.

</details>


### [492] [Harmful Partial Interventions and Benign Leakage in Concept-based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21750)
*Gregory Verghese,Christopher J. Soelistyo,Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga,Alessandro Barp,Christopher R. S. Banerji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 概念干预可能反而损害下游预测（"干预危害"）。本文证明充分性与局部化不足以保证干预有益，提出补全概念监督缺陷并引入"单调干预目标"，与端点干预目标联合训练可显著降低部分干预危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险场景下AI系统需要可进行有意义人类监督的模型，概念模型（CM）通过可理解中间概念支持用户检查与干预。但概念干预会反常地恶化下游预测，且现有"泄漏无害"论点（充分性+局部化）缺乏对部分干预情形的保障。

Method: 形式化区分"全部概念干预后的危害"与"部分干预下的危害"；理论上证明充分性与局部化两个条件不足以保证干预改善下游性能；在受控与真实场景中实证分析概念监督完备性与干预危害的关系；提出直接惩罚部分干预轨迹上任务损失上升的"单调干预目标"，与已有端点干预（泄漏缓解）目标联合训练。

Result: 概念监督不完全性与干预危害增加相关；已有端点泄漏缓解目标能降低端点危害，但不能可靠防止有害的部分纠正；端点干预+单调干预联合训练在保持概念与任务预测性能的同时，显著降低部分干预危害的发生率与幅度。

Conclusion: 充分性与局部化不构成干预有益性的充分条件；需同时约束干预轨迹的单调性与端点行为，才能在保留概念模型可解释优势的同时实现可靠的人类干预收益。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems deployed in high-risk settings increasingly require models that support meaningful human oversight. Concept-based models (CMs) offer a promising framework by enabling users to inspect and intervene on intermediate, human-understandable concepts. However, concept interventions can counterintuitively worsen downstream predictions, a failure mode we formalise as intervention harm. We distinguish harm after all concepts have been intervened on from harm under partial interventions, the more likely practical use case. Modern CMs often achieve high accuracy by encoding, or leaking, additional task-relevant information in their intermediate concept representations. Recent work argues that such leakage can be benign with respect to intervention harm when concept representations satisfy two conditions: sufficiency and localisation. We prove that these criteria are not sufficient to guarantee that concept interventions improve downstream performance. Across controlled and real-world settings, we find that concept supervision incompleteness is associated with increased intervention harm. Importantly, optimising the model when all concepts are intervened on, a previously proposed leakage mitigation objective, reduces endpoint harm but does not reliably prevent harmful partial corrections. Hence, we introduce a complementary monotonic intervention objective that directly penalises increases in task loss along partial intervention trajectories. Combining endpoint and monotonic intervention training substantially reduces the prevalence and magnitude of partial intervention harm while preserving concept and task predictive performance.

</details>


### [493] [Q($γ_H$): Entropy-Guided Horizon Mixing in Multi-Discount Q-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21764)
*Arwa Albelaihi,Abdulrahman Altahhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Q(γ_H)：多折扣头 Q-learning 框架，按策略置信度自适应混合短/长视界头，无需改动 Bellman 更新即可实现自适应规划视界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定折扣因子使整个训练共享单一规划视界，无法兼顾早期探索（宜短视界）与长期信用分配（宜长视界），且折扣因子需人工设定。

Method: 维护多个对应不同折扣因子的 Q 头；在控制阶段用熵导出的置信信号自适应组合各头输出，得到状态相关的混合权重；随策略置信度上升，控制权由短视界头逐步移向长视界头。个体 Bellman 更新保持不变，视界自适应与学习更新解耦。

Result: 在经典控制与深度强化学习基准上优于强固定折扣基线，在延迟信用分配任务上提升最显著。

Conclusion: Q(γ_H) 是一个轻量框架，避免人工选择折扣因子，与标准价值学习方法兼容，为自适应规划视界控制提供了可行途径。

Abstract: A fixed discount factor in Q-learning imposes a single planning horizon throughout training, despite the differing demands of early exploration and long-term credit assignment. We propose Q($γ_H$), a multi-horizon Q-learning framework that maintains multiple discount-specific heads and adaptively combines them at control time using an entropy-derived confidence signal. The resulting state-dependent mixing weights shift control from shorter- to longer-horizon heads as policy confidence increases, enabling adaptive horizon mixing without modifying individual Bellman updates. Across classical control and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks, Q($γ_H$) shows its strongest improvements on delayed-credit tasks relative to strong fixed-discount baselines. By decoupling horizon adaptation from the underlying learning updates, Q($γ_H$) provides a lightweight framework for adaptive planning-horizon control in reinforcement learning, avoiding the need for manual discount-factor selection while remaining compatible with standard value-learning methods.

</details>


### [494] [N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21810)
*Donghoon Han,Minseop Jung,Dong Woo Kwak,SeungJae Lee,Junhoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件程序（Conditional Program, CP）压缩表示，仅按输入请求重构所需行，将条件记忆表存储从203GB降至51GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件记忆通过选择性查找扩展语言模型容量，但完整嵌入表必须在每次可能的输入下保持可用，存储开销巨大。

Method: CP用短码加局部尺度表示每一行，并共享跨表的重构程序；以高斯格（Gaussian trellis）、范数恢复与可独立解码的行记录实现该表示。

Result: 两比特码相较2-bit round-to-nearest将输出KL降低41–63%；在三类n-gram记忆族上，等存储预算下共享格优于拟合码本与低秩残差变体；DeepSeek上表存储由203GB降至51GB。

Conclusion: 高斯型坐标统计与行间学习到的关系共存；CP为GPU上保留大表并支持更大工作负载提供可行空间。

Abstract: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.

</details>


### [495] [Measuring the local shape of learning-rate transfer curves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21814)
*Satoki Ishikawa,Rio Yokota,Ryo Karakida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两个关系式来刻画学习率-性能曲线的梯度（LR梯度）：一个在稳定性边缘成立的理论公式，一个将LR梯度近似为超参数梯度的表达式，并据此给出曲线梯度的下界、归一化层特定条件下的零梯度结论，还能将LR梯度分解到逐层以量化特定层的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合适的LR大小依赖于学习动力学、网络结构及其隐含偏置，因此对LR依赖性的理解仍然有限；随着跨设置（如模型规模）LR迁移实验的增多，亟需定量刻画LR曲线形状的方法论。

Method: 给出两个经验上能良好解释LR迁移曲线梯度的关系式：(1) 稳定性边缘处成立的理论公式；(2) 把该梯度朴素视为超参数梯度所得的近似表达式；二者互补使用进行理论推导并开展广泛实验验证与逐层分解。

Result: 理论上给出曲线梯度的下界，并证明归一化层在特定条件下梯度为零；近似表达式在广泛实验设置下适用，可将LR梯度分解为逐层分量，量化特定层对曲线形状的强贡献。

Conclusion: 该工作为定量刻画LR曲线提供了理论工具与分析框架，构成理解LR依赖内部机制的基础。

Abstract: Understanding the learning-rate (LR) dependence of trained model performance is essential for better optimization of neural networks, but the appropriate size of the LR depends on learning dynamics, architecture, and their hidden biases, and thus our understanding of this complex dependence remains limited. The behavior of the loss curve as a function of the LR has recently been observed in extensive experiments on LR transfer across different settings, such as model sizes, and it is becoming more important to explore methodologies for quantitatively characterizing the shape of this LR curve. In this work, we provide two relational equations that give a good empirical explanation of the gradient of the LR transfer curve, i.e., the LR gradient. One is a theoretical formula that holds at the edge of stability, and the other is an approximate expression obtained by naively treating this gradient as a hyper-parameter gradient. Using these two relational equations in a complementary manner, we show a lower bound on the gradient of the curve and a zero gradient under specific conditions for normalization layers in theory. The approximate expression also applies to a wide range of experimental settings and allows us to decompose the LR gradient into layer-wise components and quantify the strong contribution of specific layers to the curve shape. Thus, this serves as a foundation for better understanding the internal mechanisms of LR dependence.

</details>


### [496] [A Closed Form Depth-Width Law for Neural Collapse in Deep Linear Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21820)
*Pankhil Gawade,Kirsten Fischer,Guy Wolf,Ewa Szczurek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文在可解析的特征学习框架下，用闭式解刻画网络深度与宽度对表示几何（神经坍缩 NC1–NC3）的影响，并推导出以深度-宽度比 L/N 为变量的表示级标度律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通常深度与宽度如何塑造学到的表示只能在训练后经验性观察，缺乏理论解释；作者希望将这种依赖关系直接以闭式形式给出，而非训练后拟合。

Method: 以神经坍缩作为表示几何的探针，将 NC1–NC3 直接用学到的特征核表示：把 NC1 的已知恒等式推广到 NC2 的角向部分，并在岭读出下推广到 NC3；对具有可交换类结构的深度线性网络，求解所得核方程。

Result: 核方程给出类内变异逐层演化的几何律（理论内精确）；大宽度下累积压缩成为深度-宽度比 L/N 的函数，其速率由数据、先验与架构自洽确定；数值实验支持对深度、宽度与信噪比的依赖。

Conclusion: 得到一条源自特征学习理论、而非训练后拟合的表示级标度律，说明表示几何可由深度-宽度比闭式刻画。

Abstract: How depth and width of neural networks shape learned representations is usually studied only after training. We show that, in a tractable feature-learning setting, this dependence can instead be obtained in closed form. Using neural collapse as a probe of representation geometry, we express NC1--NC3 directly in terms of the learned feature kernel, extending an identity known for NC1 to the angular part of NC2 and to NC3 under a ridge readout. For deep linear networks with exchangeable class structure, the resulting kernel equations yield a geometric law, exact within the theory, for the layerwise evolution of within-class variability. At large width, the accumulated compression becomes a function of the depth-to-width ratio $L/N$, with its rate determined self-consistently by the data, prior and architecture. Numerical experiments support the derived dependence on depth, width and signal-to-noise ratio. The result is a representation-level scaling law derived from feature-learning theory rather than fitted after training.

</details>


### [497] [Local Epochs as Optimal Stopping: Theory and Evidence in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21832)
*Ke Xiao,Qiyuan Wang,Christos Anagnostopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将本地训练建模为有限期最优停止问题，提出基于单步前瞻阈值的自适应本地轮数规则FedStop，在不损失平均精度的前提下显著提升最差十分位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习普遍采用固定、人工调参的本地epoch数，但额外一个epoch只有在"其减少的损失超过其引入的客户端漂移"时才有益，因此需要一种自适应决定每个客户端训练多久的准则。

Method: 把本地训练形式化为有限期最优停止：当下一epoch的期望损失下降超过其"定价的"平方漂移时继续训练；证明在停止决策嵌套时该单步前瞻阈值最优，推导几何型与幂律型收益下的闭式解，并分析估计式规则的效用损失仅来自符号错误的决策；给出FedStop规则。

Result: epoch级证据支持模型结构（几何型递减收益、加性漂移），并发现"由训练阶段而非客户端决定预算"的规律。FedStop平均精度比调优FedAvg低不超过1个点；在预算变化处，其最差十分位精度比调优FedAvg和自适应间隔基线高4–8个点，Holm校正后仍显著；相比ALT、FLASH，在CIFAR-10每个种子上最差十分位最高，其余持平；在逐客户端早停失效的场景下保持稳定，且每次停止决策为常数时间。

Conclusion: 以"损失下降 vs 漂移代价"的停止准则可在几乎不牺牲平均精度的条件下改善尾部鲁棒性，且计算开销低、稳定性好，优于现有客户端侧停止规则。

Abstract: How long should each client train before communicating? Federated learning usually answers with a fixed, hand-tuned number of local epochs, yet an extra epoch helps only while the loss it removes outweighs the client drift it adds. We cast local training as finite-horizon optimal stopping: a client trains while the next epoch's expected loss reduction exceeds its priced squared drift. We prove that this one-stage look-ahead threshold is optimal whenever stopping decisions are nested, derive closed forms for geometric and power-law returns, and show that an estimated rule loses utility only through wrong-signed decisions. Epoch-level evidence supports the model's structure (geometric diminishing returns and additive drift) and reveals a simple regularity: the stage of training, not the client, sets the budget. The resulting rule, FedStop, is never more than one point below tuned FedAvg in mean accuracy. Where its budgets vary, it raises worst-decile accuracy by 4-8 points over tuned FedAvg and an adaptive-interval baseline, and every one of these gains remains significant after a Holm correction. Against the client-side stopping rules ALT and FLASH, it has the highest CIFAR-10 worst decile on every seed and is level elsewhere. It stays stable where per-client early stopping collapses, and each stopping decision takes constant time.

</details>


### [498] [Physics-Aware Distillation of a Grid Foundation Model for Real-Time Edge Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21833)
*Vlad Alexandru Sănduleac,Shahariya Rasheed Rayamarakkarveettil Puthanpurayil,Noman Khan,Remus Teodorescu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将20.1M参数、12层GridFM教师模型蒸馏为0.62M参数、6层学生模型（参数减少32.5倍），结合输出、物理残差、隐状态与注意力迁移目标；在可再生IEEE 118母线场景上验证，蒸馏使有功调度误差最多降低48%，物理残差项则始终有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GridFM在潮流计算上比迭代求解器快数个数量级，但其体量面向数据中心推理；低惯量电网运行趋势要求边缘侧、批大小为1、单个PMU上报帧内的推理能力，因此需要大幅压缩模型。

Method: 采用带掩码潮流目标的图Transformer（GridFM）作为教师，以掩码潮流损失与输出匹配、物理残差、隐状态、注意力四类迁移项的组合目标蒸馏出更浅更小的学生模型；在IEEE 118母线可再生能源变体（26台同步机被逆变器型可再生电源替换、配电池灵活性与IEEE 1547无功限值）生成的97,529个AC-OPF可行场景上，消融全部八种迁移项组合，分别评估对真值的精度与对教师的保真度。

Result: 蒸馏在所有四个预测量上降低学生误差，有功调度最多降低48%；每个蒸馏学生模型在无功调度上均优于教师；增益主要由输出匹配项贡献；层聚合形式的物理残差项因对母线级残差场做空间平均而持续产生负面影响。

Conclusion: 学生模型参数量减少32.5倍、消息传递深度减半，精度反而提升，可作为后续边缘设备基准测试的候选模型；物理残差迁移在typed电力图上的聚合方式仍需重新设计。

Abstract: Grid foundation models (GridFMs) are graph transformers pretrained on a masked power-flow objective, and evaluate power flow orders of magnitude faster than an iterative solver. Their size, however, targets data-centre inference, whereas low-inertia operation increasingly asks for inference at the edge, next to the measurement, at batch size one and within a single synchrophasor (PMU) reporting frame. We distil a 20.1M-parameter, 12-layer GridFM teacher into a 0.62M-parameter, 6-layer student, a $32.5\times$ parameter reduction at half the message-passing depth, using an objective that combines the masked power-flow loss with output, physics-residual, latent-state and attention transfer. The physics-residual term, which matches the teacher's power-residual profile, has not previously been applied to typed power-grid graphs. We evaluate on a renewable variant of the IEEE 118-bus benchmark grid in which 26 of the conventional (synchronous) generators are replaced by inverter-based renewables with battery flexibility and standardised reactive-power limits (IEEE 1547), giving $97\,529$ physically valid (AC-OPF-feasible) operating scenarios, and we ablate all eight combinations of the transfer terms, reporting accuracy against ground truth and fidelity to the teacher separately. Distillation lowers student error on all four predicted quantities, by up to $48\%$ on active-power dispatch, and every distilled student is more accurate than its teacher on reactive-power dispatch. The gain is largely carried by the output matching term. The physics-residual term, in the layer-aggregated form used here, is consistently harmful, which we attribute to the spatial averaging it applies to a bus-level residual field. The resulting student is $32.5\times$ smaller in parameter count and has half the message-passing depth, making it a candidate for subsequent edge-device benchmarking.

</details>


### [499] [Lethe: Link Inference Attacks For Evaluation of Edge Unlearning Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21869)
*Andrea D'Angelo,Francesco Gullo,Davide Mottin,Sayan Ranu,Giovanni Stilo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个边遗忘（EU）基准 Lethe，含15种方法与8个数据集，强调大图、难度分级任务和基于链接推断攻击的评估指标，揭示现有评估的两大缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图遗忘（GU）旨在不重训练即可移除特定训练数据对GNN的影响；边遗忘（EU）因彻底消除一条边的影响更难而成为独立问题并受关注。但除在Cora、Citeseer等节点特征丰富的图上孤立评估外，尚无专门的EU基准，而这些图中GNN主要利用节点特征而非图结构，导致评估失真。

Method: 作者指出现有EU评估存在两项系统性缺陷：专用EU方法可能比重训练更慢；由于边移除影响可忽略，精度类指标缺乏信息量。为此构建Lethe基准：整合15种方法与8个数据集，侧重大规模图，设计不同难度的评估任务，并提出基于链接推断攻击（link inference attacks）的经验性度量以替代代理精度指标。

Result: 通过全面的实证分析，验证了现有EU评估的上述不足，并展示Lethe在更大规模图和更难任务下对方法性能的区分能力，以及基于链接推断攻击指标的表征有效性。

Conclusion: Lethe是首个全面的边遗忘基准，弥补了EU评估空白；作者将其作为可复现、可扩展的基准发布，推动EU方法的规范评测。

Abstract: Graph Unlearning (GU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a Graph Neural Network without retraining anew. While most methods address removal of nodes and features, Edge Unlearning (EU), aiming at forgetting edges, has recently attracted dedicated attention as a standalone problem due to the hardness of completely removing the impact of an edge in the model. Despite this, no dedicated benchmark for EU exists besides isolated evaluations on feature-rich datasets such as Cora and Citeseer where GNNs exploit node features rather than graph structure. As such, we show two systematic limitations in existing evaluations: dedicated EU methods can be slower than retraining anew, and accuracy metrics are uninformative due to the negligible impact of edge removal. To address this gap, we introduce Lethe, the first comprehensive benchmark for Edge Unlearning, featuring 15 methods and 8 datasets. Our benchmark emphasizes large graphs, introduces evaluation tasks of varying difficulty, and proposes empirical measures based on link inference attacks rather than proxy accuracy metrics. We provide a comprehensive empirical analysis, demonstrate the shortcomings of current evaluations, and release Lethe as a reproducible, extensible benchmark.

</details>


### [500] [Provably Efficient Risk-Sensitive Offline Reinforcement Learning via Optimized Certainty Equivalents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21870)
*Hanzhen Wang,Boxiang Lyu,Zhongxiang Dai,Siyang Gao,Dake Zhang,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文首次系统研究了基于优化确定性等价（OCE）的离线风险敏感强化学习，针对动态OCE与静态OCE两种形式，在表格设定与线性函数逼近下分别给出悲观值迭代/最小二乘值迭代算法，并建立了上下界匹配的次线性次优性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在与环境交互代价高昂的场景中，需要从固定数据集学习风险敏感策略；而既有风险敏感RL研究集中于在线设定或特定风险度量，缺乏对离线设定下一般风险度量的理论理解。

Method: 采用优化确定性等价（OCE）这一通用风险度量族。考虑两种形式：逐步递归应用OCE的动态OCE RL，以及对累积回报一次性应用OCE的静态OCE RL。表格设定下设计两种形式的悲观值迭代算法；大规模状态空间下，将OCE风险准则融入线性函数逼近，设计悲观最小二乘值迭代算法。

Result: 表格设定下建立紧密的次线性次优性上界，显式刻画由效用函数编码的风险敏感性对学习难度的影响；并建立极小极大次优性下界以刻画问题基本极限。线性逼近下给出依赖效用函数且显式依赖特征维度d的次线性保证。据作者所知，这是动态与静态OCE RL的首批离线算法及首批上下界。

Conclusion: 该工作为离线风险敏感RL提供了基于OCE的统一理论框架，上界与下界揭示了风险敏感性的统计代价，并将结果推广至线性函数逼近，填补了离线风险敏感RL理论空白。

Abstract: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) addresses decision-making under uncertainty and adverse outcomes. Learning risk-sensitive policies from fixed datasets is important when additional interaction with the environment is costly. Existing work on risk-sensitive RL focuses on online settings or specific risk measures, leaving a general theoretical understanding of its offline setting underdeveloped. In this work, we investigate efficient offline risk-sensitive RL using the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), a general class of risk measures. We consider two formulations: dynamic-OCE RL, which applies OCE recursively at each step, and static-OCE RL, which applies a single OCE to the cumulative rewards. Under the tabular setting, we develop pessimistic value-iteration algorithms for both formulations and establish tight sublinear suboptimality bounds, explicitly capturing how risk sensitivity, encoded by utility functions, affects learning difficulty. Moreover, we establish minimax suboptimality lower bounds to characterize the problem's fundamental limits. To handle large state spaces, we further develop pessimistic least-squares value-iteration algorithms that incorporate the general OCE risk criterion into linear function approximation. We establish utility-dependent sublinear guarantees with explicit dependence on the feature dimension $d$. To our knowledge, we provide the first offline algorithms along with the first upper and lower suboptimality bounds for both dynamic- and static-OCE RL.

</details>


### [501] [Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21881)
*Lazar Milikic,Etienne Bamas,Emmanuel Abbe,Viktor Kunčak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练形式化定理证明模型需大量验证器调用，为缓解Lean 4检查慢、超时导致GPU等待与奖励延迟问题，作者用484万个标注程序在GPU上训练神经评估器预测Lean 4判定与编译器反馈，并提出分类器+反馈模型的两阶段评估器（87.8%准确率，单张H100吞吐为64 worker Lean基线的4.2倍），再与Lean判定组合成混合奖励系统，使GRPO训练步缩短约31%，性能几乎无损（miniF2F pass@1 62.2% vs 62.4%，pass@32 72.4% vs 71.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化定理证明的强化学习依赖大量Lean验证器调用，检查缓慢与超时会令GPU空等，并使潜在正确证明因超时而拿不到奖励，训练效率与奖励信号质量受限。

Method: 用4.84M标注程序在GPU上训练神经评估器，预测Lean 4判定结果与编译器反馈；对比两个有效性分类器与一个反馈模型（为证明尝试标注预测的目标状态与错误信息）；构建两阶段评估器：先用分类器筛选候选，再用反馈模型对其正例打分；并在68,932个来自公开prover的程序基准上评测，最后将该评估器与Lean真实判定结合为混合奖励系统用于GRPO训练。

Result: 两阶段评估器预测Lean是否接受候选证明的准确率达87.8%；单张H100上每秒处理3.5个候选，吞吐为带环境复用的64 worker Lean基线的4.2倍；混合奖励使GRPO训练步缩短约31%；一个epoch后miniF2F pass@1为62.2%（Lean-only 62.4%），pass@32为72.4%（Lean-only 71.3%）。

Conclusion: 神经评估器可作为Lean判定的高效替代/补充，在显著提升吞吐、加速GRPO训练的同时保持证明性能基本持平，验证了混合奖励方案在形式化定理证明训练中的实用性。

Abstract: Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls. Slow checks and timeouts often leave GPUs waiting and withhold rewards from potentially correct proofs. We train neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs using 4.84M labelled programs. We compare two validity classifiers with a feedback model that annotates proof attempts with predicted goal states and error messages. A two-stage evaluator that screens candidates with a classifier and scores its positive predictions with the feedback model reaches 87.8% accuracy in predicting whether Lean accepts a candidate proof, evaluated on a 68,932-program benchmark collected from public provers. The combined evaluator processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the throughput of our 64-worker Lean baseline with environment reuse. Finally, we combine our evaluator with Lean verdicts to obtain a hybrid reward system that shortens GRPO training steps by approximately 31%. After one GRPO epoch with hybrid rewards, the prover achieves nearly the same miniF2F pass@1 as with Lean-only rewards (62.2% versus 62.4%) and a pass@32 of 72.4% versus 71.3%.

</details>


### [502] [Graph Dirichlet Energy for Fitting-Free Bivariate Causal Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21892)
*Povilas Daniušis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图狄利克雷能量因果推断（GDECI）准则，将候选原因变量构造核相似图、候选结果变量视为图信号，以无权拉普拉斯诱导的狄利克雷能量作为方向评分，低能量方向判为因果方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在双变量因果方向识别中，现有方法（如基于回归拟合和独立性检验的RESIT、基于信息几何的IGCI/RECI）通常需要模型拟合或独立性检验，且对变量的单调变换敏感、计算代价高。作者希望构建一个无需回归拟合与独立性检验、对严格单调变换不变、且可高效精确计算的方向判别准则。

Method: 对候选方向 X→Y，由 X 构造核相似图，将 Y 视为图信号，用无权图拉普拉斯计算其狄利克雷能量作为评分；反向交换变量得到反向评分，取能量较低者为因果方向。经经验概率积分变换后决策对任一变量的严格单调变换不变；图运算化为卷积，可在 O(n log n) 时间与 O(n) 内存内精确计算。总体层面，GDECI 等价于比较度加权的贝叶斯平方预测误差加回归函数的非负光滑项；带宽趋于零时权重趋于均匀、光滑项消失，退化为 copula 空间中基于期望条件方差的 RECI 型比较。

Result: 在 1899 个因果对上与 QCCD、GRCI、CAM、IGCI（两种变体）、RESIT、LOCI、QPE-k、RECI（两种变体）共 11 种方法比较：12 个合成数据集的宏平均准确率排名第五（0.776）；真实 Tuebingen 对上未加权准确率排名第三（0.684）、加权准确率排名第五（0.678）；在 n≈10^4 以内为所有对比方法中最快。

Conclusion: GDECI 提供了一种无拟合、无独立性检验、对单调变换不变且计算高效的因果方向判别准则，并具备清晰的总体层面解释及与 RECI 的理论联系；实证中准确率处于中等偏上水平，但速度优势显著。代码见 https://github.com/povidanius/gdeci。

Abstract: We propose the Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion for distinguishing cause from effect in bivariate settings. For a candidate direction $X\to Y$, we construct a kernel similarity graph from $X$ and treat $Y$ as a graph signal. The score is the Dirichlet energy of this signal, induced by the unnormalized graph Laplacian. The reverse score swaps the variables, and the lower-energy direction is inferred as causal. The method requires neither regression fitting nor independence testing.
