After the empirical probability integral transform, its decisions are invariant under strictly monotone transformations of either variable, and the graph operations reduce to convolutions, allowing exact evaluation in $O(n\log n)$ time and $O(n)$ memory. At the population level, GDECI compares degree-weighted Bayes squared prediction errors plus a non-negative smoothness term of the regression function. As the bandwidth tends to zero, the weights become uniform and the smoothness term vanishes, reducing the criterion to a RECI-type comparison of expected conditional variances in copula space. Empirically, we compare GDECI with QCCD, GRCI, CAM, IGCI (two variants), RESIT, LOCI, QPE-k, and RECI (two variants), in accuracy on 1899 cause--effect pairs and in inference speed. GDECI ranked fifth of eleven methods in macro-averaged accuracy on 12 synthetic suites ($0.776$). On the real-world Tuebingen pairs, it ranked third in unweighted accuracy ($0.684$) and fifth in weighted accuracy ($0.678$). It was also the fastest of the compared methods up to $n\approx10^{4}$. The accompanying code repository: https://github.com/povidanius/gdeci.

</details>


### [503] [Self-Calibrated Subspace Robust PCA for Parameter-Free Removal of Mixed Noise and Line Stripes in Hyperspectral Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21896)
*Wenzhe Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自校准RCCTV（SC-RCCTV）高光谱去噪模型，噪声参数在迭代中自适应估计，无需人为调参，且每个ADMM子问题都有闭式解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始RCCTV模型缺少高斯噪声与条纹项，其"噪声感知"版本需预先给定噪声水平和条纹预算，实际应用中难以获得，因此需要无需先验参数的自适应方案。

Method: 在RCCTV中引入逐波段稠密噪声项与线恒定的列/行条纹项；各波段噪声水平用条纹不变的中值绝对偏差（MAD）估计器初始化，并基于残差在线细化，将稀疏/稠密噪声分离转化为逐波段自适应Huber损失；条纹阈值由显著性检验确定，误报率可解析预测；ADMM所有子问题闭式求解。

Result: 在线条纹下，对原生尺寸立方体比无参FastHyMix高8.17 dB；在完全无噪声信息时比给定真实噪声参数的S3TTV高1.52 dB且快1900倍以上；平均与给定真实噪声水平的同模型差距在0.01 dB内；在线校准优于两阶段"先估计后去噪"；真实Indian Pines与Urban数据实验界定了其对非整行条纹的适用范围。

Conclusion: SC-RCCTV实现了免调参、噪声自适应的高光谱复原，性能接近甚至超过已知真实噪声参数的强基线，并具备高效求解与良好泛化性。

Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are often corrupted by Gaussian noise, impulses and stripes whose intensities vary across bands. The representative coefficient correlated total variation (RCCTV) model restores HSIs efficiently, but it lacks Gaussian and stripe terms, and its noise-aware extensions require the noise level and a stripe budget to be specified in advance. This article proposes a self-calibrated RCCTV (SC-RCCTV) model, in which the noise parameters are estimated adaptively during the iterations. A band-wise dense term and line-constant column and row stripe terms are introduced into RCCTV. The noise level of each band is initialized by a stripe-invariant median absolute deviation estimator and refined online from the residual, which turns the separation of sparse and dense noise into a band-adaptive Huber loss, and the stripe thresholds follow from a significance test whose false-alarm rate can be predicted analytically. No parameter is tuned for a specific image, and every subproblem of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver is solved in closed form. Under line stripes, SC-RCCTV outperforms the parameter-free FastHyMix by 8.17 dB on native-size cubes, and, without any noise information, it exceeds S3TTV, which is given the true noise parameters, by 1.52 dB while running more than 1,900 times faster. On average, it stays within 0.01 dB of the same model given the true noise levels, and its online calibration improves on a two-stage estimate-then-denoise scheme. Experiments on real Indian Pines and Urban data further delineate its scope for stripes that do not span entire lines.

</details>


### [504] [In-Context Learning Before Specialisation: Theory of Learning in a Solvable Topic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21901)
*Francesco Cagnetta,Casper L. Christensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一个可解的topic model学习理论，解释序列模型为何在不同样本复杂度下分别倾向"专业化预测器"与"上下文学习"两种策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究从理论与经验上刻画了序列模型两类泛化策略（外推训练结构 vs. 利用prompt适应新任务）及其随预训练数据质量/数量的转变，但缺乏学习理论来解释"为何某一解被偏好"，因此需要可解析的理论框架。

Method: 构造一个有限隐主题混合的可解topic model（模拟预训练数据异质性），该数据生成过程对应两个解：存储有限主题混合的专门化预测器，以及对训练中未见过主题最优的上下文预测器；分析二者出现的样本复杂度阈值。

Result: 理论预测：上下文预测器在较小样本复杂度下即可获得，专门化解仅在训练token数超过数据生成过程参数量后才出现。训练的transformer定量复现了这两个尺度与分离交叉点，且无需拟合参数。

Conclusion: 为两类泛化策略的竞争提供了首个可解析学习理论，将策略转换归因于样本复杂度阈值，并获实验一致验证。

Abstract: Sequence models can generalise in fundamentally distinct ways: extrapolating structures seen in training, or using their prompt to adapt to novel tasks. The prevailing strategy determines how the model behaves beyond its training distribution, controlling potential capabilities and risks. Recent work has characterised many different strategies theoretically, and empirically described the transition between them as the quality and quantity of pretraining data vary. However, there is no learning theory for this competition, hence no fundamental understanding of \textit{why} one solution might be favoured over another. Here we provide such a theory in a solvable topic model---documents drawn from a finite mixture of latent topics, mirroring the heterogeneity of modern pretraining data. The dataset comes with two distinct solutions: a specialised predictor, that stores the finite topic mixture, and an in-context one, optimal for topics never seen during training. Our theory predicts their emergence at distinct sample complexities: the in-context predictor is available early, while the specialised one emerges only after the training tokens outnumber the parameters of the data-generating process. Trained transformers reproduce both scales and the separating crossover in remarkable agreement with the theory, with no fitted parameters.

</details>


### [505] [The Tilted Sampling Problem: Optimism, Posterior Sampling, and Logarithmic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21908)
*Mohammad Pedramfar,Siamak Ravanbakhsh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究"倾斜采样"在线学习问题：从不已知奖励诱导的Gibbs分布中采样，定义采样遗憾为温度归一化的累积KL散度，并给出平方置信宽度驱动的通用遗憾框架及UCS、TS²算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代学习系统（熵正则RL、RLHF、奖励引导生成模型）常需采样多样化的高质量输出，而非选单一最优动作；已有基于采样的和KL正则的bandit/RL表述缺乏统一的遗憾分析框架，且采样目标的不确定性结构与经典遗憾最小化不同。

Method: 形式化倾斜采样问题，定义采样遗憾为学习器分布与Gibbs目标间按温度归一化的累积KL散度（对应熵正则奖励最大化的次优性差距）；提出捕捉采样特有不确定性结构的通用遗憾框架，并构造UCB与Thompson采样的采样类比算法UCS和TS²，给出统一的遗憾分解，包含基于后验随机Gibbs分布新界的首个贝叶斯采样遗憾分解。

Result: 标准遗憾受一阶不确定性支配，规模为Õ(√T)；采样遗憾由平方置信宽度支配，在固定温度下标准设定中可达对数级（log T）遗憾，从而解释并扩展了近期若干对数级保证。

Conclusion: 从软最优分布中学习采样在统计上与识别硬最优解本质不同，需专门的不确定性度量与算法设计；该框架统一并推广了bandit与RL中近期的采样型和KL正则表述。

Abstract: Many modern learning systems are used not to select a single best action, but to sample diverse high-quality outputs. Examples include entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, RLHF, and reward-guided generative modeling. Motivated by these settings, we study tilted sampling: an online learning problem in which the goal is to sample from the Gibbs distribution induced by an unknown reward function. We define sampling regret as the temperature-normalized cumulative KL divergence between the learner's distribution and the Gibbs target, corresponding to the suboptimality gap in entropy-regularized reward maximization. Our framework generalizes recent sampling-based and KL-regularized formulations in bandits and reinforcement learning. Our main contribution is a general regret framework that captures the different uncertainty structure of tilted sampling and classical regret minimization. While standard regret scales as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ due to first-order uncertainty, sampling regret is governed by squared confidence widths, yielding logarithmic-in-$T$ regret in standard settings at fixed temperature. We develop sampling analogues of UCB and Thompson sampling (UCS and TS$^2$) and provide unified regret decompositions that explain and extend recent logarithmic guarantees, including the first Bayesian sampling-regret decomposition based on new bounds for posterior-random Gibbs distributions. Our results show that learning to sample from a soft-optimal distribution is statistically distinct from learning to identify a hard optimum.

</details>


### [506] [The Lagrangian Structure of Cost-Penalized Active Feature Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21919)
*Joseph Bingham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文为主动特征获取(AFA)中的贪心策略EIG-Cost给出后验误差证书，把与最优硬预算策略的差距分解为预算松弛项与贪心次优项Del_lam，并对等代价情形给出基于子模性比的结构性界，辅以理论与三组实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EIG(j|x_S)-lam*c_j 这类贪心启发式在AFA中很常用，但其理论保证不清晰：A→I(Y;X_A)未必子模（即便联合高斯也如此），无法直接用Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher界，因此需要一个可计算的、能分解误差来源的保证框架。

Method: (1) 将EIG-Cost解读为期望代价AFA的拉格朗日松弛的一步贪心优化，lam为对偶乘子；(2) 构造后验证书，把与最优硬预算策略的差距分解为预算松弛项与贪心次优项Del_lam；(3) 等代价时证明 Del_lam <= exp(-gam*I(Y;X_[d]))，gam为子模性比；(4) 辅助结果：自适应链式法则恒等式、非子模反例与朴素贝叶斯恢复子模性、硬预算与期望代价最优间的随机化间隙界、对偶乘子误差敏感性与局部光滑条件下的条件CVAE生成器漂移界（以前向预测KL为诊断量）。

Result: 在4,000个已求解的小规模异构代价实例上精确验证证书，Del_lam接近零；大规模临床任务中Del_lam不可计算，分解仅作诊断。MIMIC-IV上$30预算下EIG-Cost取得macro-F1 0.180±0.012，仅耗全面板代价的6.6%。

Conclusion: EIG-Cost的保证是条件性的：小规模可精确认证，大规模只能诊断；等代价近子模区间存在结构性保证，而一般情形需借助拉格朗日视角与敏感性分析来界定可靠范围。

Abstract: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects features to maximize predictive accuracy under an acquisition budget. A natural heuristic greedily maximizes Expected Information Gain minus a cost penalty, EIG(j|x_S)-lam*c_j (EIG-Cost), but its theoretical guarantees are unclear. We provide an a-posteriori certificate decomposing the gap to the optimal hard-budget policy into a budget-slack term and a greedy-suboptimality term Del_lam. The certificate is computable when the penalized optimum is tractable; on small heterogeneous-cost instances, we verify it exactly, finding Del_lam near zero across 4,000 solved cases. On the large clinical task, Del_lam is not computable, so the decomposition is diagnostic rather than a numerical guarantee. Our analysis identifies EIG-Cost as one-step greedy optimization of the Lagrangian relaxation of expected-cost AFA, with lam as its dual multiplier. For equal costs, we prove Del_lam <= exp(-gam*I(Y;X_[d])), where gam is the submodularity ratio, yielding a structural guarantee in the near-submodular regime. Supporting results establish an adaptive chain-rule identity showing that cumulative stepwise EIG optimizes transcript information, and prove that A -> I(Y;X_A) need not be submodular, even for jointly Gaussian variables. This rules out a direct Nemhauser-Wolsey-Fisher bound; naive Bayes restores submodularity. We also bound the randomization gap between hard-budget and expected-cost optima, analyze sensitivity to dual-multiplier error under local smoothness, and derive a conditional CVAE generator-shift bound given a bound on forward predictive KL. We treat this KL as a diagnostic quantity, not as a transform of training loss. Experiments cover synthetic Gaussian settings, AFA benchmarks, and clinical differential diagnosis on MIMIC-IV. On MIMIC-IV, EIG-Cost achieves macro-F1 0.180 +/- 0.012 at a $30 budget, using 6.6% of full-panel cost.

</details>


### [507] [ChronoSheaf: Joint Spatio-Temporal Spectral Filtering on Cellular Sheaves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21958)
*Abeer Mostafa,Zahra Ahmadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出谱层拉普拉斯算子（联合时空定义）并基于此构建ChronoSheaf时空层网络，通过过渡限制映射与对偶谱滤波器扩展感受野而不增大层结构，在时空预测基准上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层神经网络（sheaf NN）虽通过为每条边学习线性限制映射缓解过平滑，但其层拉普拉斯是瞬时空间算子，无法显式建模信号在图上随时间演化的过程；而直接在空间或时间上扩展算子感受野会导致层结构越来越复杂。

Method: 1) 定义时空联合的谱层拉普拉斯算子，用单一算子调控空间图与时间域上的信号传播；2) 提出谱滤波器，在不扩大底层sheaf的前提下沿空间与时间两个维度扩展有效感受野；3) ChronoSheaf含两组件：过渡限制映射（TRM）将节点限制映射分解为空间项与前后两个时间帧，实现非对称时间影响；对偶谱滤波器（DSF）对联合时空层算子施加单一有界次多项式滤波器，并自适应估计谱半径。

Result: 在多个多样化时空预测基准上验证，性能优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: 将sheaf拉普拉斯从瞬时空间算子推广为时空联合谱算子，配合TRM与DSF可在不增加sheaf复杂度的情况下获得时空双维感受野，是一种有效的时空建模框架。

Abstract: Sheaf neural networks generalize graph neural networks by assigning each edge a learned linear restriction map that specifies how the local representations of adjacent nodes relate to one another, thereby mitigating oversmoothing. Existing sheaf architectures, however, define the sheaf Laplacian as an instantaneous spatial operator and therefore cannot explicitly model how signals evolve over time on a graph. We first introduce a spectral sheaf Laplacian, defined jointly over space and time, such that a single operator regulates signal propagation across both the spatial graph and the temporal domain. Directly extending this operator's receptive field in space or time would require increasingly complex sheaf structures. Instead, we propose a spectral filter that expands the effective receptive field along both dimensions without enlarging the underlying sheaf. Building on this operator, we introduce ChronoSheaf, a spatio-temporal sheaf network with two key components. First, Transitional Restriction Maps (TRM) decompose each node's restriction map into a spatial term and two temporal frames that independently control its relation to neighboring nodes at the preceding and following timestep, enabling asymmetric temporal influence. Second, the Dual Spectral Filter (DSF) applies a single bounded-degree polynomial filter with an adaptively estimated spectral radius to the joint spatio-temporal sheaf operator. We validate ChronoSheaf on a diverse set of spatio-temporal forecasting benchmarks, where it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ChronoSheaf-1D7D/.

</details>


### [508] [Why Shallow Neural Networks Learn Sinusoidal Components First: An Orthogonal Polynomial Dynamics Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21964)
*Yanyang Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将网络输出在正交多项式基下展开为广义傅里叶级数(GFS)，把梯度下降动力学写成系数ODE，通过分析动力学矩阵H的特征值衰减与特征向量形状，从理论上解释神经网络先学低频后学高频的谱偏置现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱偏置(F-principle)虽被大量数值实验证实，但既有理论仍有五点不足：缺乏渐近解释及"偏好正弦分量"的来源说明；难以推广到sigmoid、ReLU等一般激活函数；对数据分布假设过强；有限域傅里叶分析存在混叠干扰；缺乏适用于任意网络的统一框架。

Method: 以正交多项式基将网络输出展开为广义傅里叶级数(GFS)，将GFS系数的梯度下降动力学表述为常微分方程组，得到动力学矩阵H；进而解析H的特征值衰减规律与特征向量形状，并借助正交多项式理论分析学习偏置对激活函数及网络结构的依赖。

Result: H呈现分级(graded)结构，可直观解释谱偏置的产生；正交多项式理论为刻画偏置如何随激活函数（如sigmoid、ReLU）乃至网络结构变化提供了解析工具，同时规避了有限域傅里叶分析中的混叠效应，且对数据分布假设较弱。

Conclusion: 基于正交多项式下的GFS与动力学矩阵H特征分析，给出了可渐近解释、适配一般激活函数与任意网络结构、弱数据假设且无混叠的谱偏置理论框架。

Abstract: Neural networks often learn low-frequency components before high-frequency ones --- a phenomenon called spectral bias or termed F-principle. Many numerical studies have demonstrated this phenomenon, and theoretical studies have sought to explain it. However, several goals remain insufficiently addressed: (1) explaining spectral bias asymptotically, including its origin and why the preferred components are generally sinusoidal; (2) extending the explanation to general activation functions, such as sigmoid and ReLU; (3) making weak assumptions about the data distribution; (4) avoiding aliasing effects, such as those arising in finite-domain Fourier analysis; and (5) developing a theoretical framework applicable to arbitrary networks. We address these goals theoretically by analyzing the eigenvalue decay and eigenvector shapes of the dynamics matrix H, which arises when we expand the network output as a general Fourier series (GFS) in an orthogonal polynomial basis and express the gradient-descent dynamics of the GFS coefficients as ordinary differential equations. The graded structure of H enables an intuitive explanation of spectral bias, while orthogonal polynomial theory helps us analyze how learning bias depends on the activation function and, potentially, the network architecture.

</details>


### [509] [Time to Fake It: Continual Machine Learning Intensifies Unfairness in Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21974)
*Kajaree Das,Oliver Böse,Subarnaduti Paul,Gabriel Storch,Martin Mundt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统考察持续学习（CL）方法在应对不断演化的深度伪造生成器时对“公平性”的影响，发现准确率下降通常加剧不公平、公平性改善罕见，且CL的三个方法族（回放、提示、正则化）都不能解释不平等的遗忘现象，从而呼吁将社会结果纳入稳定性-可塑性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器失效具有社会性后果；生成器持续演化使静态训练的检测器漏检新威胁，而渐进训练会灾难性遗忘。既有CL研究只以准确率衡量遗忘，无法反映真实世界影响（对各类人群的公平性），因此需要从公平性维度审视CL方法。

Method: 按11种真实世界深度伪造生成方法的时间顺序构建序列，渐进训练检测器；在多个不同人群与人口交叉组上，从四个公平性维度追踪公平性指标随时间的变化；并对回放（rehearsal）、提示（prompts）、正则化（regularization）三类CL方法族进行拆解对比分析。

Result: 性能与公平性之间存在依赖于CL算法选择和人群交叉组的非平凡交互；准确率退化通常加剧不公平性，而公平性随时间改善的情况很少；不平等的遗忘无法仅由训练数据中代表性不足解释，更可能与表征学习纠缠在一起。

Conclusion: 仅以准确率为导向的CL评估不足以反映真实社会影响；CL方法在平衡稳定性-可塑性权衡时必须纳入社会结果（公平性），作者据此发出行动呼吁。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors safeguard against misinformation, rendering their failures as much a societal as a technical concern. As generators constantly evolve, detectors trained on static datasets miss newly arising threats, while progressive training interferes catastrophically. Yet, mitigating forgetfulness in terms of accuracy, the prevalent focus of continual learning (CL), is insufficient to reflect real-world impact. We therefore scrutinize the effects of CL methods with respect to evolving fairness. To this end, we analyze four dimensions of fairness across diverse demographics for detectors trained progressively on a chronological sequence of 11 real-world deepfake generation methods. Tracking fairness metrics over time, we expose non-trivial interplays between performance and fairness that depend on both the choice of CL algorithm and demographic intersections. We find accuracy degradation to typically exacerbate unfairness and, conversely, fairness improvements to remain scarce over time. Dissecting the CL method families (rehearsal, prompts, regularization), we observe that inequitable forgetting is not explained by underrepresentation alone, but likely entangled with representation learning. We thus issue a call to action for CL methods to take social outcomes into account when balancing the stability-plasticity tradeoff.

</details>


### [510] [Learn Only Where You Can't Compute: Structured Corrections to Gaussian Process Posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21977)
*Tobias Weber,Carla Sagebiel,Philipp Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种结构化后验校正框架：以可解的高斯过程为参考，均值校正与协方差标定后，用扩散模型在低维子空间学习定向校正，其余方向保持高斯分布，在三个科学推断任务中恢复隐藏模态并降低预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息高斯过程可对测量、边界条件和控制方程表达不确定性，但难以扩展到大数据与非线性信息；扩散模型擅长从大规模数据学习复杂函数分布，却在训练数据稀缺、需融入物理或观测信息的科学场景中受限。二者存在互补空间。

Method: 构建结构化后验校正框架：以可处理的高斯参考分布为基础，先进行均值校正与协方差标定，再通过生成式学习引入数据驱动校正——扩散模型在被选定的低维子空间中学习针对参考分布偏差的定向校正，而补子空间保持其高斯分布律。

Result: 在三个科学推断任务上，校正能够恢复隐藏模态、改善样本结构，并相对高斯参考降低预测误差；与全场生成模型对比揭示了任务相关的收益，以及预测精度与计算成本之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 将高斯参考的可解性与生成模型的表达能力以子空间校正方式结合，是一种兼顾物理信息融入与生成建模的可扩展科学推断思路。

Abstract: Physics-informed Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a principled framework for scientific inference by expressing uncertainty over empirical measurements, boundary conditions, and governing equations. However, they struggle to scale to larger datasets and nonlinear information. Conversely, diffusion models excel at learning complex distributions over functions from massive datasets, but struggle in scientific contexts where training data are scarce and physical or observational information must be incorporated. We propose a structured posterior-correction framework that combines a tractable Gaussian reference with data-driven corrections via generative learning. After a mean correction and covariance calibration, a diffusion model learns a targeted correction in a low-dimensional subspace selected to capture discrepancies from the reference, while the complement retains its Gaussian law. Across three scientific inference tasks, these corrections recover hidden modes, improve sample structure, and reduce prediction error relative to the Gaussian reference. Comparisons with full-field generative models reveal task-dependent benefits and tradeoffs between predictive accuracy and computational cost.

</details>


### [511] [P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21979)
*Yong Zu,Ninghua Yang,Zezhong Tan,Xinhong Ma,Ziqiang Dong,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Page-to-Token Policy Optimization（P2TPO），一种面向全页文档解析的、结构对齐的信用分配框架，将页面级奖励细化到元素块与 span 粒度的 token 级优势，在六个文档解析基准上均优于现有策略优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端全页文档解析需同时保留异构元素的内容与结构，但即使整体输出较准确，仍可能含有局部错误与遗漏；页面级的单一优势信号无法指出哪些元素质量不同、错误发生在何处，导致信用分配粒度过粗。

Method: 三个组件：(1) 参考元素对齐（Reference-element alignment），将块级质量对比与生成 span 关联；(2) 统一锚点定价（Unified Anchor Pricing, UAP），在采样输出对同一参考元素得分相同但不完美时，纳入匹配与缺失元素的结果，并以固定质量上限为参照提供反馈；(3) 块内 span 信用重分配（Span Credit Redistribution, SCR），依据对齐的正确/错误 span 重新分配已有块信用，用边界代理处理块内遗漏，同时保持块级优势在其 token 上的总量不变。理论分析表明，在固定权重的加性页面效用下，按元素索引的对比能保留被页面级聚合抵消的局部质量差异。

Result: 主实验中，P2TPO 在六个文档解析基准的种子平均得分上均优于所有评估的策略优化基线；额外实验显示其在不同模型规模与初始化下均有增益。

Conclusion: 将页面级奖励结构对齐地分解到元素与 span 层级，可有效实现细粒度信用分配，提升全页文档解析的策略优化效果，并具备跨模型规模与初始化的泛化性。

Abstract: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary proxies for within-block omissions while preserving the total block-derived advantage across its tokens. Under a fixed-weight additive page utility, we show that element-indexed contrasts retain local quality differences that page-level aggregation can cancel out. In the main experimental comparison, P2TPO outperforms all evaluated policy optimization baselines in seed-averaged scores on each of the six document parsing benchmarks. Additional experiments demonstrate gains across model scales and initializations.

</details>


### [512] [Interfaces and Modules: A Scalable Representation for Weight-Space Learning across Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21995)
*Michał Kozyra,Michael Bronstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出以"接口"节点组织坐标置换对称性的类型化图表示，并据此构建通用权重编码器UWE，实现跨架构权重空间学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨架构的权重空间学习需要既能遵守参数对称性、又能扩展到大规模网络的表示。现有等变张量编码器需针对特定架构手工指定对称性；而神经元图方法因节点数庞大导致全局注意力代价高昂。

Method: 构建以共享坐标置换作用为中心的类型化图：节点为"接口"，表示必须联合置换的坐标空间；算子实例"模块"构成类型化超边。由编译器从受支持的PyTorch模型自动导出该图，并精确恢复约束所定义的置换因子。在此基础上提出Universal Weight Encoder（UWE）：对参数特征做局部等变更新，并对不变接口摘要做全局注意力。

Result: 接口数量很少，使全局注意力可行，且单一编码器可处理多种受支持架构。UWE在已有基准上与架构专用的SOTA方法相当；在含100种架构、1200个Transformer的新数据集上，于未见架构内排序网络的性能超过所评估基线，包括规模大于训练所用架构的情形，同时内存占用显著更低。

Conclusion: 以接口为核心的类型化图表示可自动、精确地刻画参数置换对称性，将全局注意力成本降至与接口数相关，从而用单一编码器实现高效、可泛化的跨架构权重空间学习。

Abstract: Weight-space learning across architectures requires representations that respect parameter symmetries and scale to large networks. Existing equivariant tensor encoders require architecture-specific symmetry specifications, while neuron graphs make global attention costly. We introduce a typed graph organized around shared coordinate-permutation actions. Its nodes, called interfaces, represent coordinate spaces whose bound tensor axes must be permuted jointly; operation occurrences, called modules, form typed hyperedges. A compiler derives this graph from supported PyTorch models, with exact recovery of the permutation factors defined by its constraints. The Universal Weight Encoder (UWE) combines local equivariant updates to parameter features with global attention over invariant interface summaries. The small number of interfaces makes global attention practical, and a single encoder processes different supported architectures. UWE is competitive with architecture-specific state-of-the-art methods on established benchmarks. On a new zoo of 1,200 transformers spanning 100 architectures, it outperforms the evaluated baselines at ranking networks within unseen architectures, including architectures larger than those used for training, while using substantially less memory.

</details>


### [513] [Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22016)
*Adam Deng,Shicheng Liu,Yada Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 冻结模型间的KV缓存直接替换无效，障碍在于读取方的"可容忍集"，但把发送方缓存作为额外上下文、仅适配查询则有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统以文本通信，信息有损且浪费（发送方已完成的"阅读"被丢弃）。已有工作转向传输KV缓存——这种阅读的自然载体。本文研究最具吸引力的形式：双方模型均冻结、无任何训练，仅将发送方缓存替换到读取方中。作者意在检验这一"免费"方案是否真正可行，并厘清失败根源。

Method: 提出"可容忍集"(tolerable set)概念：冻结transformer只能读取接近其自身会写出的缓存的那些缓存。用几何相似度检验其与读取方可利用性的关系；用竞争性注意力(competitive attention)解释失败机制。实验上以八个多样化的替换方法与两个实测锚点对比：无信息缓存基线与读取方亲自阅读原文的准确率。另测试替代设计：读取方保留自身缓存、将发送方缓存作为额外上下文进行注意力、仅适配其查询。

Result: 与自身缓存的几何相似度不能预测读取方能否使用该缓存，且失败并非渐进式，因而"更忠实的替代"并非解药。八种替换方法均停留在无信息缓存基线上。替代设计则超过读取方自身基线；在八个发送方池化设置下同样超过基线，而无向注意力在同一并集上低于基线。

Conclusion: 将大量分散的负面结果统一为一个结论，并给出推翻该结论的明确条件。核心贡献是方向纠正：追求"忠实的替代缓存"是错误的靶标，把缓存"追加"到读取方已有内容之上才是有前景的方向。作者强调这是单一探针上的刻画，而非排行榜式论断。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from having read the passage. All sit at the baseline. That turns a long tail of separate negative results into one outcome with a stated condition for overturning it. A different design does work: if the reader keeps its own cache and attends over the sender's as extra context, adapting only its queries, it beats its own baseline, and also clears the baseline with eight senders pooled where undirected attention over the same union falls below it. We offer this as a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim. Our central contribution is a redirection: pursuing faithful substitute caches is the wrong target; adding a cache to what the reader already has is the promising one.

</details>


### [514] [Not All Unlabeled Data Are Equal: Unlabeled Data Selection for Semi-Supervised QSAR Modeling with Large Chemical Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22025)
*Oliver Majer,Saso Dzeroski,Jurica Levatic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了QSAR建模中的无标注数据选择问题：在10个ChEMBL提取的QSAR数据集和40万+无标注分子池上，评估三种半监督算法与四种采样策略，发现合理选择少量"化学上远离"的分子即可稳定提升QSAR模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QSAR建模依赖昂贵的湿实验标注，标注数据规模小，而ChEMBL等化学库含有数百万无标注分子，理论上非常适合半监督学习；但大型化学库对QSAR的SSL增益仍缺乏探索，且在真实无标注数据场景下如何选择无标注样本亦不明确。

Method: 构建10个来自ChEMBL的QSAR数据集与超过40万个无标注分子池；评估self-training、co-training、label propagation三种SSL算法；设计基于随机、最近邻、最远邻与混合采样的四种无标注数据选择策略，并进行系统对比实验。

Result: 大型化学库的无标注数据可提升QSAR模型，10个数据集上均有至少一种SSL配置优于有监督基线；最可靠的提升通常来自选择相对少量、化学距离较远的分子。

Conclusion: 无标注集合的"组成"可能比"规模"更重要，挑战了SSL必须有大量无标注数据这一常见前提；在真实SSL设定下应优先考虑多样性/远距离采样策略。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is particularly attractive in domains where labels are expensive to obtain, while unlabeled examples are readily available. Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) modeling, which predicts molecular biological activity from chemical structure, is one such domain. Obtaining activity measurements requires costly wet-lab experiments, resulting in small labeled datasets, while chemical repositories such as ChEMBL contain millions of unlabeled molecules. Despite this apparent suitability, the potential of large chemical databases to improve QSAR models via SSL remains largely unexplored. Furthermore, it is unclear how unlabeled data should be selected in realistic SSL settings with genuine unlabeled data. We conduct a systematic study of unlabeled-data selection using 10 QSAR datasets extracted from ChEMBL and a pool of more than 400,000 unlabeled molecules. To this end, we evaluate three established SSL algorithms (self-training, co-training, and label propagation) and formulate four unlabeled-data selection strategies based on random, nearest-neighbor, furthest-neighbor, and mixed sampling. Our results show that unlabeled data from large chemical repositories can improve QSAR models, with at least one SSL configuration outperforming the supervised baseline on each of the 10 datasets. Moreover, the most reliable improvements are generally achieved by selecting a relatively small number of chemically distant molecules. This suggests that the composition of the unlabeled set may be more important than its size, challenging the common premise that SSL necessitates an abundance of unlabeled data.

</details>


### [515] [Augment the Cache, Replace the Activation: A 2x2 Study of Internal-State Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22026)
*Adam Deng,Shicheng Liu,Yada Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将多智能体间的内部状态传递从"转移(transfer)"重构为"共享(sharing)"：智能体把内部状态发布到一个池中，所有同伴通过一个不针对任何特定发送者拟合的单一机制读取；并发现内部状态的载体与融合方式相互耦合，规则是"增强KV缓存、替换激活值"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于冻结语言模型的多智能体系统若只用文本通信，会丢弃发送方已计算好的内部状态，并让接收方重复构建该状态的代价。已有的"内部通道"工作把问题当作转移(transfer)，即A向B发送信息，导致每一对通信智能体都需要各自的转移桥接，每加入一个新智能体都要与所有旧智能体重建桥接，扩展性差。

Method: 1) 提出共享范式：发送方一次性将内部状态发布到池中，同伴用一个不针对任何特定发送者拟合的统一机制读取，新增智能体只需增加发布者；2) 研究载体(carrier)与融合机制(fusion)的耦合关系，关键变量是载体进入接收方计算的位置；3) KV缓存采用"增强"而非"替换"：接收方在对等方缓存上做交叉注意力同时保留自身缓存，仅训练一个小的查询侧适配器；4) 激活值采用直接写入接收方的方式，无桥接、无适配器、无训练；5) 在统一协议下设置共享的控制梯度(control ladder)进行对比验证。

Result: KV缓存增强方案在仅训练小型查询侧适配器的情况下，达到与直接阅读源文档相当的准确率；激活值直接替换的最佳效果优于将其与接收方自身状态并列暴露，但前提是知道状态应写入接收方的哪个位置；单个适配器训练一次即可服务于未参与训练的发布者以及同时多个发布者组成的池，但仅限于内部状态与接收方本身接近的发布者。

Conclusion: 可消费性(consumability)是接收方计算的性质而非表示本身的性质；内部状态共享的核心规则为"增强KV缓存、替换激活值"，该规则在统一协议与共享控制阶梯下得到确立；单一适配置器具备跨发布者泛化能力，但受状态相似性限制。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built from frozen language models communicate through text, which discards the internal state the sender already computed and makes the receiver pay to rebuild it. Work on internal channels avoids that cost, framing the problem as transfer: agent A sends information to agent B. Every agent pair that must communicate needs its own transfer bridge, and every agent added to a system needs a new bridge fitted against each previous agent. We reframe this problem as sharing: an agent publishes its internal state once into a pool, and every peer reads that pool through a single mechanism fitted to no sender in particular, so adding an agent adds a publisher and no new bridge. Whereas the carrier of the internal state and the fusion mechanism are usually chosen independently in the literature, our main finding is that these two choices are coupled; the deciding factor is where the carrier enters the receiver's computation. Consumability is a property of the receiving computation rather than of the representation. We find that the key-value (KV) cache must be augmented rather than swapped in: the receiver cross-attends over a peer's cache while keeping its own, and with only a small query-side adapter trained, matches the accuracy it gets from reading the source document. Activations invert this. They are best written straight into the receiver, with no bridge, no adapter and no training, which beats exposing them alongside the receiver's own, though that advantage rests on knowing where in the receiver the state belongs. The rule is augment the KV cache, replace the activation, established under one protocol with a shared control ladder. One adapter, trained once, also serves publishers it never trained on, and a pool of several at once, but only those whose internal state lies close to the receiver's own.

</details>


### [516] [NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20349)
*Yaozhi Wen,Kun Zhao,Wei Wei,Haoyang Chen,Kangning Wang,Yi Sun,Shaowei Gu,Dingkun Liu,Shuang Qiu,Huiguang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 NeuroDETR，一个离散时空多尺度框架，通过结构化 tokenization 与事件感知特征精炼，实现连续 EEG 中事件类别与起止边界的异步联合检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步 EEG 事件检测需在推理时无需预设事件边界即可从连续记录中识别事件类别与时间边界，其核心挑战在于从持续背景活动中提取事件相关模式。

Method: 采用结构化 tokenization 与事件感知特征精炼相结合：多尺度时间码本捕捉短促响应与持续动态，Spatial-Pyramid VQ 对跨通道空间结构进行层级编码，二者构成紧凑事件记忆以联合分类事件并估计起止点；tokenization 前引入 FOCAL 事件感知稀疏注意力模块，利用预测的事件存在性引导时间特征精炼与空间聚合，聚焦潜在事件段并保留全局上下文。

Result: 在覆盖多种范式的八个 EEG 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。

Conclusion: 为在连续交互与监测中识别有意义神经活动的 BCI 系统开发提供了基础。

Abstract: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the development of BCI systems that recognize meaningful neural activity during continuous interaction and monitoring.

</details>


### [517] [RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34004)
*Tong Liu,Lanmiao Liu,Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RICE-Alpha：时点约束下的股票打分框架，将历史事件延续信息以可靠性校准的残差修正形式引入多视图基预测，在纳指100与恒指面板上ICIR超过最强基线两倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 股票相关新闻通过时间相依的公司事件演化，历史信息只有在建模事件连续性、信息可得性与转移可靠性时才有用。现有LLM金融智能体虽引入历史证据，但难以在point-in-time约束下保持发行人专属时序，也难以识别历史转移何时带来超越当前预测的增量信息。

Method: 框架分为历史感知的多视图Base Alpha与由历史事件延续导出的可靠性校准残差修正两部分。Multi-Tier Memory Layer将新闻解读锚定在时间上合法的发行人专属历史；Typed Event Agent构建事件状态，后继关系先在发行人体内形成，仅在完成有效本地配对后才跨公司池化；成熟转移按经验可靠性校准，图信号对Base Alpha与技术视图做残差化得到RICE Delta。

Result: 2024–2026年纳斯达克100与恒生指数日频面板上，在4项预测指标与4项组合指标上均优于所评估的LLM智能体与动量基线；ICIR为最强基线的两倍以上；美国与香港净夏普分别为1.656与1.725；美国消融显示移除主要组件后IC与RankIC在Holm校正下显著下降。

Conclusion: 历史事件延续在时间接地、可靠性校准并作为多视图预测的残差修正引入时，能提供增量信息。

Abstract: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuers and pooled across firms only after valid local pairing. Matured transitions are calibrated by their empirical reliability, and the resulting graph signal is residualized against the Base Alpha and technical view to obtain the RICE Delta. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, RICE-Alpha achieves the strongest results among the evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio-level metrics. Its ICIR more than doubles that of the strongest baseline, while net Sharpe ratios reach 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong, respectively. U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed. These results indicate that historical event continuation adds incremental information when it is temporally grounded, reliability-calibrated, and introduced as a residual correction to a multi-view forecast.

</details>


### [518] [Selection Is Not Learning: Choosing Model Futures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22029)
*Haoyi Yang,Kshitij Mishra,Nils Lukas,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对自进化语言模型中"任务可选≠更新有用"的选择—更新缺口，提出HeirCommit（用新评估题决定是否继承更新后模型）与EvoHeir（分离参数继承与经验继承），减少有害更新并提升数学与通用推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化循环（R-Zero、Agent0、Skill Self-Play）以"任务是否看起来可学习"作为继承依据，并默认继承每个产生的更新，存在选择—更新缺口：经验证的任务所产生的更新多数并未提高正确答案概率，但这些有害更新仍被全部继承。

Method: HeirCommit：冻结更新后模型，用全新评估问题判定继承或保留当前模型；EvoHeir：将参数继承与经验继承解耦，利用当前与归档经验修复失败、保留成功，再作最终确认。理论上分析选择诱导的乐观偏差，并将遗憾分解为选择、吸收与确认三类误差。

Result: 相同接受率下，HeirCommit 将有害被接受更新的比例相对随机继承降低 68–83%；在四个骨干模型上，EvoHeir 取得最佳数学与通用推理平均成绩，数学平均较最强基线 Agent0 提升 5.3%。

Conclusion: 应以独立评估确认更新价值而非依赖任务选择信号；参数继承与经验继承可分离，使有用经验在模型未被继承时仍得以保留。

Abstract: Self-evolving language models train on tasks they generate, so every round must decide which updated model the next round inherits. Current loops such as R-Zero, Agent0, and Skill Self-Play make this decision through the task, admitting tasks that look learnable and inheriting every resulting update. We identify a selection-to-update gap in these loops, where a task that looks learnable need not produce a useful update. Most updates on verified tasks fail to make correct answers more likely, yet these loops inherit them all. HeirCommit freezes the updated model and uses fresh evaluation questions to decide whether to inherit it or retain the current model. EvoHeir separates parameter inheritance from experience inheritance, using current and archived experience to repair failures and preserve successes before final confirmation. Our analysis characterizes selection-induced optimism and decomposes regret into selection, absorption, and confirmation errors. HeirCommit cuts the harmful share of accepted updates by 68-83% relative to random inheritance at the same acceptance rate. Across four backbones, EvoHeir achieves the best mathematics and general-reasoning averages, raising the math average by 5.3% relative to the strongest baseline, Agent0. The framework lets useful experience persist even when the model that produced it is not inherited.

</details>


### [519] [Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22043)
*Alina Khaybullina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过构造合成财报公告，测量六个指令/对话模型在盈利预测中对动量、评论语气与EPS意外三类输入的依赖程度，发现语气与动量的影响普遍强于EPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想弄清语言模型在财务预测中究竟依赖哪些输入，因此需要把动量、非信息性评论语气、EPS是否超出被操纵的一致预期这三个因素解耦，单独观察各因素的条件影响。

Method: 构造合成财报公告，分别独立反转20日动量、无信息量的评论语气、以及固定实际EPS是否超过被操纵的一致预期；选取四个模型家族、0.49–7.61B基础参数的六个指令/对话检查点，采用直接作答的Q8_0协议各输入2016条提示；设计涵盖24个数值模块、6组评论配对、盈亏、年度EPS升降与两种意外幅度，A/B与U/D答案分配覆盖每个转换的384个主场景；估计条件答案前缀分数的配对变化，而非校准后的市场概率。

Result: 各检查点的主EPS对比在-0.19至86.80个百分点之间；有符号语气对比的幅度在6个模型中有5个超过EPS，动量在5个模型中超过EPS；自然语言数值诊断准确率为51.0%–95.8%；答案编码、措辞、上下文和检查点转换控制对结果有调节作用。

Conclusion: 实验测量的是可观测的输入依赖性与数值识别能力，既不确立内部推理机制，也不证明可实现收益的可预测性；公开基准提示、记录分数与交互式结果浏览器随研究一并发布。

Abstract: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither an internal reasoning mechanism nor realized return predictability. Public benchmark prompts, recorded scores, and an interactive recorded-results explorer accompany the study.

</details>


### [520] [FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20636)
*Zahra Dehghani,Pablo Piantanida,Mohammadhadi Shateri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLOWBUDGET：一种免训练估计器，通过仿真无关的插值探针估计求解器相关的采样复杂度，将数值容差映射为步数/NFE预算，从而无需多预算生成样本或FID-NFE扫描即可确定采样预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配等连续流生成器的推理需数值ODE/SDE积分，成本取决于函数评估次数（NFE）。实践中采样预算常沿用前人设定或通过昂贵的FID-NFE扫描选取，需在多个预算下反复生成与评估，代价高。因此作者提出与求解器设计、时间步分配互补的问题：对固定预训练模型与求解器，何种数值分辨率足够？

Method: 提出FLOWBUDGET，免训练的求解器相关采样复杂度估计器。利用对学习动力学的仿真无关插值探针，将主导的一步离散化误差按运动量归一化，由插值探针估计其系数，并按求解器阶数将数值容差映射为步数预算。针对流匹配采样推导了Euler与Heun（ODE）及加噪Euler–Maruyama（SDE）的估计量，并将ODE系数与终端积分误差关联。

Result: 在SiT、FlowDCN与Rectified Flow模型（涵盖不同流模型架构与表述）上实验，检验FLOWBUDGET能否在不在多预算下生成样本、也不做FID-NFE扫描的情况下估计NFE预算。

Conclusion: FLOWBUDGET为固定预训练模型与求解器下的采样预算选择提供了免训练、免多预算经验扫描的数值分辨率估计途径，可作为求解器设计与时间步分配的补充工具。

Abstract: Sampling from continuous flow-based generators such as flow matching models requires numerical ODE or SDE integration, making inference cost depend on the number of function evaluations (NFEs). In practice, the sampling budget is inherited from prior work or selected through expensive FID-versus-NFE sweeps, using FID to assess image-generation quality, requiring sample generation and evaluation at multiple budgets. This makes sampling-budget selection dependent on repeated empirical evaluation. We therefore ask a complementary question to solver design and timestep allocation: for a fixed pretrained model and solver, what numerical resolution is sufficient? We introduce FLOWBUDGET, a training-free estimator of solver-relative sampling complexity. Using simulation-free interpolation probes of the learned dynamics, FLOWBUDGET normalizes the leading one-step discretization error by the motion, estimates its coefficient from interpolation probes, and maps a numerical tolerance to a step budget using the solver order. We derive estimators for numerical solvers in flow~matching sampling, namely Euler and Heun for ODE sampling and additive-noise Euler--Maruyama for SDE sampling, and connect the ODE coefficients to terminal integration error. Experiments on SiT, FlowDCN and Rectified Flow models, spanning flow-model architectures and formulations, test whether FLOWBUDGET can estimate the NFE budget without generating samples at multiple budgets or performing an FID-versus-NFE sweep. The code is available at https://github.com/Yasaman-dt/FlowBudget

</details>


### [521] [Effectiveness of Hidden-State Probes for Localizing Reasoning Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22046)
*Shubham Subhnil,Yannis Belkhiter,Erik Miehling,Adam Dahlgren Lindström,Elizabeth M. Daly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验4B与8B推理模型的隐藏状态能否区分"超出能力/另一尝试可成功/单步致命"三类失败并定位失败步骤，发现现有探针受训练设计影响、且均不优于基于轨迹长度的规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用最终答案正确性作标签训练隐藏状态探针，会把三类性质不同的失败混为一谈；蒙特卡洛回滚能区分这些情形并定位失败步骤，但推理成本高。作者试图判断隐藏状态是否本身已编码失败类型与失败步骤。

Method: 在4B和8B推理模型上，用隐藏状态训练探针预测失败类型与失败步骤，并与不使用隐藏状态的最强基线（含仅基于轨迹长度的规则）对比；同时比较不同训练设计下同一隐藏状态的探针表现。

Result: 在中点阈值校准的置信度探针上，8B错误轨迹中81%的单步不可恢复案例与47%的"再试可成"案例被漏判；不同训练设计的探针会反转这两类失败排序。两个规模下均无探针在定位失败步骤上超过轨迹长度规则；4B下专训探针在10次相同轨迹运行中均未超越该规则。

Conclusion: 置信度探针只能提示答案错误，其失败类型排序取决于训练设计；隐藏状态对失败步骤定位的增益尚不及简单长度基线。

Abstract: Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same states reverses the ordering of these two kinds of failure, so either ordering can be read from those states. At both scales, no single tested probe locates the failing step more accurately than a rule based only on trace length, and at 4B a probe trained to predict that step fails to outperform this rule in any of 10 runs on identical traces. The confidence probe therefore indicates that an answer is wrong, but its failure-type ordering depends on its training design.

</details>


### [522] [Decoding Naturalistic Speech from fMRI with Temporal Modeling and Multimodal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22049)
*Corentin Caris,Louis Jalouzot,Nona Rajabi,Géraud Ilinca,Ahmed Hassayoune,Asilbek Muminov,Thaddée Delebarre,Clara Fonteneau,Charles Maussion,Bertrand Thirion,Alexis Thual,Antoine Collas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NOEMA时间卷积解码器，将连续fMRI窗口与多模态刺激嵌入对齐，实现从脑活动中检索自然语音片段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从脑活动中重建感知内容是检验神经记录是否携带有效信息的关键测试；自然语音多时间尺度展开，但fMRI噪声大、时间模糊，难以恢复其结构。

Method: NOEMA为时间卷积解码器，将连续fMRI测量窗口与同一刺激片段的文本、音频、语音多模态互补嵌入对齐；通过条件对比学习/检索目标实现从脑活动直接检索对应刺激段。

Result: 在Cephalonauts One与LeBel两个自然语音数据集上，超过42%的留出查询能在2000个候选中将正确片段检索至前10；显著优于基线解码器，且优势在候选池加入数千训练中未出现的干扰项时仍保持；消融实验验证了时间建模与互补刺激表示的贡献。

Conclusion: 结果表明fMRI记录携带可恢复的、多时间尺度的语音信息；时间卷积建模与多模态嵌入组合是提升脑解码检索性能的关键因素。

Abstract: Reconstructing what a person perceives from their brain activity is a stringent test of whether neural recordings carry meaningful information. Naturalistic speech offers a rich testbed for this challenge: it unfolds over multiple timescales, but fMRI's noisy, temporally smeared measurements make this structure hard to recover. We introduce NOEMA, a temporal convolutional decoder that aligns windows of consecutive fMRI measurements with multimodal stimulus embeddings. These embeddings combine complementary text, audio, and speech representations of the same stimulus segment, enabling its retrieval directly from brain activity. On two naturalistic speech datasets, Cephalonauts One and LeBel, NOEMA retrieves the correct segment among 2,000 candidates within the top 10 for more than 42% of held-out queries. This substantially outperforms baseline decoders, an advantage that persists when the candidate pool is extended with thousands of distractors absent from training. Controlled ablations establish the contributions of temporal modeling and complementary stimulus representations.

</details>


### [523] [ABNAT: Attention-Based Noise-Aware Training for Robust Transformers on Analog Compute-in-Memory Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22065)
*Wenshuai Yao,Wenyong Zhou,Hanyong Shao,Zhiyuan Ning,Yizhe Chen,Yuannuo Feng,Kechao Tang,Ru Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ABNAT是一种基于注意力蒸馏的噪声感知训练框架，让含噪学生模型对齐干净教师模型的逐头注意力路由，在无硬件改动与推理开销下显著提升Transformer在模拟存内计算噪声下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer计算与数据搬运能耗高，模拟存内计算（CIM）虽高效但硬件非理想性会扰动权重、损害性能。现有噪声感知训练（NAT）仅在训练中注入噪声，忽视了注意力机制在Transformer推理中的关键作用。

Method: 先分析CIM噪声如何重塑注意力，得到两点观察：(1) 深层中干净与含噪注意力图的差异显著增大；(2) 传统NAT即使注意力路由明显偏离干净参考仍过度自信。据此提出ABNAT：以干净教师为参照，训练含噪学生保留教师逐头注意力路由而非仅拟合输出答案；并提供可选变体降低训练开销。

Result: 在视觉、语言与多模态Transformer上广泛实验，ABNAT相对对应NAT基线持续提升鲁棒性，噪声退化下的精度最高提升11.28%，注意力偏差最高降低85.77%。

Conclusion: 注意力层面的监督是提升CIM噪声鲁棒性的有效切入点；ABNAT无需硬件改动或推理开销，可作为一种通用、低成本的NAT增强方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based models have become the backbone of a wide range of tasks, but their intensive computation and data movement incur substantial energy overhead. Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) offers an energy-efficient alternative, yet its inherent hardware non-idealities perturb stored weights and can significantly degrade model performance. Although existing noise-aware training (NAT) methods improve robustness by injecting noise during training, they largely overlook the critical role of attention mechanisms in Transformer inference.To bridge this gap, we analyze how CIM-induced noise reshapes attention in Transformers and identify two key observations: (1) the divergence between clean and noisy attention maps increases substantially in deeper layers, and (2) conventional NAT can remain overconfident even when its attention routes deviate markedly from the clean reference. Motivated by these findings, we propose ABNAT, an attention-based noise-aware training framework that teaches the noisy student to preserve the clean teacher's headwise attention routes rather than merely reproduce answers, without hardware changes or inference overhead; selective variants further reduce training cost.Extensive experiments across vision, language, and multimodal Transformers show that ABNAT consistently improves robustness over corresponding NAT baselines, improving noise-degraded accuracy by up to 11.28% and reducing attention deviation by up to 85.77%.

</details>


### [524] [Can AI Forecast the Extremes? Evaluating Probabilistic Weather Models on Tropical Cyclones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22077)
*Nathan Chalumeau,Xavier Renard,Remi Meynadier,Hugo Rakotoarimanga,Marcin Detyniecki,Emmanuel de Bezenac*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究对GenCast、FourCastNet 3、FGN三种AI天气模型与ECMWF IFS-ENS进行热带气旋概率预报的广泛基准测试，发现AI模型在气旋路径追踪上显著优于IFS-ENS（FGN在2025年90%的风暴上取得更优概率位置评分），但在强度与集合离散度上仍有局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动AI模型在平均意义上已超越领先的数值天气预报系统且计算成本更低，但其在极端事件上的表现仍存争议；已有评估多聚焦确定性模型与指标，对最新概率模型的极端事件能力了解不足。

Method: 开展热带气旋预报的广泛基准测试，对比GenCast、FourCastNet 3、FGN与ECMWF业务化物理集合预报IFS-ENS；构建一套概率指标与诊断分析，评估气旋追踪、强度偏差、不确定性和表征风暴结构的风压关系。

Result: 尽管在强度和集合离散度上仍有限制，领先AI模型在气旋追踪上大幅优于IFS-ENS：FGN在2025年所评估的90%风暴上取得更优的概率位置评分。进一步分析揭示各模型特有的失效模式，并提示预训练数据的持续影响，指出针对性改进的机会。

Conclusion: AI模型能够捕捉在典型天气条件之外仍具预测力的物理关系，这一能力值得进一步研究其形成机制并加以强化。

Abstract: Weather prediction is undergoing an important shift, with data-driven AI models outperforming leading numerical weather prediction systems on average at a fraction of the computational cost. Yet, whether this success extends to extreme events remains contested. Earlier evaluations have exposed important shortcomings, but have largely focused on deterministic models and metrics, leaving the capabilities of the latest probabilistic models less understood. We conduct an extensive benchmark of tropical cyclone forecasting, comparing GenCast, FourCastNet 3, and FGN with ECMWF's operational physics-based ensemble, IFS-ENS. We develop a suite of probabilistic metrics and diagnostic analyses to assess cyclone tracking, intensity biases, uncertainty, and the wind-pressure relationship that characterizes storm structure. We find that, despite remaining limitations in intensity and ensemble spread, leading AI models substantially outperform IFS-ENS in cyclone tracking: FGN achieves better probabilistic location scores for 90% of evaluated storms in 2025. Further analyses reveal model-specific failure modes and suggest a lingering influence of pretraining data, pointing to opportunities for targeted improvement. Nonetheless, these results suggest that AI models are capable of capturing physical relationships that remain predictive well beyond typical weather conditions, motivating further investigation into how these capabilities emerge and how to strengthen them.

</details>


### [525] [TIPS: A Tiny Inference-time Policy for Scaling in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22099)
*Ya-Shi Zhang,Jian Tang,Pierre-André Noël,Oleksiy Ostapenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出约600K参数的轻量级推理期控制器TIPS，让冻结的掩码扩散语言模型在解码时学习"何时揭示、何时重新遮蔽"token，从而在不更新主干网络的前提下改善精度-计算权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在推理时面临"每轮去噪后哪些位置可见"的选择问题；现有解码方法多依赖人工设计规则，或要求可见比例单调增长，限制了灵活性。作者希望以可学习方式优化这一可见性调度。

Method: TIPS为约600K参数的控制器，采用可见性感知的置信度特征与浅层Transformer来选择哪些token可见，同时用固定调度控制期望的可见比例；允许unmasking与remasking并存。训练分两阶段：监督预热 + 以最终正确性为奖励的强化学习。底层语言模型（LLaDA-8B-Instruct）保持冻结。

Result: 在GSM8K与MATH-500上，full-canvas与two-block两种TIPS变体在32次解码器评估预算下取得58.46%与57.97%的微平均准确率，分别比主对比中最强基线高12.1与11.6个百分点；两变体均以32次评估预算训练，在更高预算下无需重训仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 学习"何时揭示与重新考虑token"可改善准确率-计算权衡，且无需更新解码器主干；说明轻量推理期策略是提升扩散语言模型解码效率与效果的有效途径。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models expose an inference-time choice: which positions become visible after each denoising pass. Many existing decoding methods use hand-designed rules or require visibility to grow monotonically. We present a $\textbf{T}$iny $\textbf{I}$nference-time $\textbf{P}$olicy for $\textbf{S}$caling ($\textbf{TIPS}$), an approximately $600$K-parameter controller that learns both unmasking and remasking while keeping the underlying language model frozen. TIPS uses visibility-aware confidence features and a shallow transformer to select which tokens should be visible, while a fixed schedule controls the expected visible fraction. We train the controller through supervised warmup followed by reinforcement learning from terminal correctness rewards. On GSM8K and MATH-500 with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the full-canvas and two-block TIPS variants achieve $58.46\%$ and $57.97\%$ micro-averaged accuracy at a budget of $32$ decoder evaluations, exceeding the strongest baseline in our main comparison by $12.1$ and $11.6$ percentage points, respectively. Both variants are trained at a budget of $32$ evaluations and remain competitive at higher budgets without retraining. These results demonstrate that learning when to reveal and reconsider tokens can improve the accuracy-compute trade-off without updating the decoder backbone.

</details>


### [526] [Scene Reconstruction Using Ubiquitous Wireless Signals via Diffusion Posterior Inference Over physics-Grounded Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22120)
*Vahid Yazdnian,Yasaman Ghasempour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将无线信道测量反演物理场景（建筑布局）的问题形式化为后验推断，提出两阶段分层框架：先用遵守传播物理的无线基础模型将信道测量编码为场景结构表征，再用扩散模型联合多条测量的表征建模并采样建筑占用后验，通过样本共识得到最终重建，仅凭无线测量即可准确恢复建筑轮廓。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机、LiDAR等传感器在黑暗、恶劣天气或被墙体遮挡时会失效，而无线信号不受这些限制：基站与用户间每条链路的信道都受沿途建筑反射、阻挡的影响，因此信道中隐含了周围场景信息。然而从信道测量映射到环境是严重不适定问题——单条测量只记录与传播路径相互作用的那些结构，且这些观测常可由多个合理场景解释。因此需要以后验推断的方式处理不确定性。

Method: 将无线场景重建建模为后验推断，设计两阶段分层框架：(1) 无线基础模型经预训练以遵守传播物理，把每个信道测量转换为刻画形成该观测的场景结构的表征；(2) 扩散模型联合整合多条测量的表征，对建筑占用（occupancy）的后验进行建模与采样，以样本间共识产生最终重建。

Result: 实验表明该框架能够在仅有无线信道测量的条件下准确恢复建筑轮廓（building footprints）；消融显示性能关键依赖两个设计要素：物理基础表征可揭示场景相关信息，联合后验推断可连贯地整合互补观测。

Conclusion: 无线信道可作为被动、穿透性强且不受光照与天气影响的场景感知模态；以后验推断替代确定性回归、并以物理先验表征加扩散式联合采样为架构，是缓解无线反演病态性的有效途径，两组件缺一不可。

Abstract: Knowing the layout of the physical world matters for many applications, yet the sensors we rely on for it (e.g., cameras and LiDAR) can fail in darkness, in adverse weather, or behind walls. Wireless signals do not face these limitations: every link between a base station and a user is shaped by the buildings it passes, reflects from, or is blocked by, leaving information about the surrounding scene embedded in the wireless channel measured at the endpoints. However, mapping channel measurements to the environment is a severely ill-posed problem: a measurement records only the structures that interact with the transmitted electromagnetic waves along its propagation paths, and even these observations can often be explained by multiple plausible scenes. We therefore formulate wireless scene reconstruction as posterior inference and develop a hierarchical framework with two complementary stages to approach this problem. A wireless foundation model, pretrained to respect propagation physics, transforms each channel measurement into a representation of the scene structure that shaped the observation. A diffusion model then jointly integrates representations from multiple measurements to model and sample the posterior over building occupancy, with consensus over samples producing the final reconstruction. We demonstrate that the framework can accurately recover building footprints from wireless channel measurements alone and show that its performance depends critically on both design components: physics-grounded representations expose scene-relevant information, while joint posterior inference coherently integrates complementary observations.

</details>


### [527] [Beyond Fixed Acquisition Functions: Temporal Difference Active Learning for Perturbation Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22122)
*Xudong Zhang,Jianzhe Li,Yitong Tang,Peijie Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TDAL（时序差分主动学习），将预算受限的扰动发现建模为序贯决策问题，通过时序差分学习在线学习采集函数，在八个公开筛选数据集上平均排名1.63（共11种方法），四个任务排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传与药物扰动筛选可用于阐明疾病机制和验证治疗靶点，但实验成本限制了可测试候选数量。现有筛选方法通常在反馈中更新代理模型而保持采集函数固定，难以适应不同响应景观，无法从实验反馈中学习"如何选择实验"。

Method: 将预算受限扰动发现形式化为序贯决策问题；提出TDAL，从单条筛选轨迹中通过时序差分学习在线学习采集函数，兼顾当前命中与未来发现；用实验前后未测候选命中概率之间的Hellinger距离加权后继价值；并通过leave-batch-out（LBO）复用已测结果构造虚拟转移，缓解训练数据稀缺。

Result: 在涵盖单、双、三扰动及多种实验配置的八个公开筛选数据集上，TDAL在11种方法中平均排名1.63，并在四个任务上排名第一，体现出跨响应景观的自适应性。

Conclusion: 实验反馈不仅是筛选信号，也可作为学习数据获取策略的训练信号；在线学习采集函数可提升扰动筛选的样本效率与跨任务适应性。

Abstract: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training signal for learning how to select experiments. We formulate budgeted perturbation discovery as a sequential decision problem and propose Temporal Difference Active Learning (TDAL), which learns an acquisition function online through temporal difference learning from a single screening trajectory, accounting for current hits and future discoveries. TDAL uses the Hellinger distance between hit probabilities for unmeasured candidates before and after an experiment to weight successor value, and reuses measured outcomes through leave-batch-out (LBO) to construct virtual transitions and alleviate training data scarcity. Across eight public screens spanning single, double, and triple perturbations under varied experimental configurations, TDAL achieves an average rank of 1.63 among eleven methods and ranks first on four tasks, demonstrating its adaptability across response landscapes.

</details>


### [528] [Causal Integrated Gradients: Scalable Feature Attribution Along Causal Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22126)
*Joran Michiels,Anis Ismail,Maarten De Vos,Alejandro Sifrim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出因果积分梯度（CIG）与因果期望梯度（CEG），通过在因果图上路由积分路径，将先验因果结构嵌入基于梯度的特征归因，从而在保持可扩展性与公理保证的同时，准确归因上游因果驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有考虑特征依赖的归因方法难以扩展到高维；而梯度类方法虽高效，却无法利用已已知的因果结构，容易将功劳错误地归于下游效应（如把靶基因排在调控它的转录因子之上），而非真正的上游原因。

Method: 将积分梯度（IG）推广为CIG/CEG：沿着因果图而非直线路径进行积分，把每个特征的归因分解为直接效应与经由其因果后代的中介效应；在因果图满足一定条件时保留IG的高效计算与公理性质。

Result: （1）已知因果模型的合成基准上，CIG 归因最贴近 Pearl do-演算的真值因果效应，精度与因果 Shapley 值相当但计算成本大幅降低；（2）在已知基因调控网络的单细胞模拟数据（Dyngen）上，最准确恢复驱动模拟的转录因子；（3）在真实干扰素-β刺激数据（仅有近似因果图）上，比 DeepSHAP 与 IG 更好地优先排序驱动响应的转录因子。

Conclusion: 将因果结构融入梯度归因，可在不牺牲可扩展性的前提下恢复现有方法遗漏的上游驱动因素，在合成、模拟与真实数据三级设置中均验证有效。

Abstract: Existing feature attribution methods that account for feature dependencies do not scale to high dimensions. We propose causal integrated gradients (CIG) and causal expected gradients (CEG), which extend integrated gradients to incorporate prior causal structure among input features while retaining its computational efficiency and, under conditions on the causal graph, its axiomatic guarantees. In many settings, some causal structure between features is already known, for example, that a transcription factor causally regulates a target gene's expression. Yet existing gradient-based methods cannot exploit this structure, instead crediting a feature's downstream effects over its true upstream cause, such as ranking the target gene above the transcription factor that regulates it. Our key idea is to embed this causal structure by routing the integration path along the causal graph. The method thereby decomposes each feature's attribution into a direct effect and effects mediated through its causal descendants. We evaluate CIG in three settings of increasing realism. First, on a synthetic benchmark with a known causal model, CIG's attributions best match the ground-truth causal effect from Pearl's do-calculus, matching the accuracy of causal Shapley values at a fraction of the computational cost. Second, on simulated single-cell gene expression data with a known gene regulatory network (Dyngen), CIG most accurately recovers the transcription factors driving the simulation. Third, on real interferon-$β$ stimulation data, where only an approximate causal graph is available, CIG better prioritizes the transcription factors driving the measured response than DeepSHAP and integrated gradients. Together, these results show that incorporating causal structure into gradient-based attributions recovers upstream drivers that existing methods miss, without sacrificing scalability.

</details>


### [529] [Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22152)
*Hilda Adwubi Osei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 构建最小网格世界使清洁机器人可"清除"或"掩盖"污渍，标准DQN仅优化传感器代理奖励会完全游戏化（接近满分代理奖励但零真实目标）；提出对利用行为的约束式RL惩罚，消除游戏行为并大幅恢复真实性能；并推导、验证代理奖励—真实奖励—代价信号的精确恒等式，证明代价信号精确度量代理/真实差距，硬约束变体下给出确定性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规范游戏（specification gaming）证据多为观察性的，缺少"受控构造的代理/真实目标差距 + 具备可验证保证（而非仅经验性改善）的缓解方法"这一配对示范；作者希望在一个可控最小环境中同时提供清晰失败演示与带保证的修复方案。

Method: 构造最小网格世界：清洁机器人可真正移除污渍，亦可让污渍对廉价传感器不可见；真实目标=清除污渍，代理奖励=传感器读数。用标准深度Q网络仅在代理奖励上训练；随后引入约束强化学习，对利用代理/真实差距的具体行为施加代价惩罚（并提出硬约束变体）；同时推导代理奖励、真实奖励与代价信号之间的精确核算恒等式。

Result: DQN收敛到完全游戏化策略：代理奖励接近最大，但真实目标从未达成。约束式方法从最终策略中消除游戏行为，并显著恢复真实目标性能。精确恒等式经实证验证，表明代价信号精确测量（而非仅仅跟踪）代理/真实差距；硬约束变体下给出确定性保证。

Conclusion: 以最小可控环境将规范游戏从观察性轶事升级为可复现的受控演示，并配以可验证保证的约束式缓解方法；明确的代理/真实核算恒等式使代价信号成为差距的精确度量，为"有保证的规范游戏缓解"提供了可检验范式，但结论目前限于该最小网格世界，需进一步验证可扩展性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor's proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, penalizing the specific behaviors through which the agent exploits the gap, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. We further derive and empirically verify an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, true reward, and our cost signal for this environment, showing that the cost signal measures the proxy/true gap exactly rather than merely tracking it, and yields a deterministic guarantee under a hard-constrained variant of the method.

</details>


### [530] [The importance of tensor handling and implementation of physics-informed DeepONets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22157)
*Nahum Banks,Gustavo A. M. de Almeida,Sergio Maldonado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出改进的PI-DeepONet架构，消除Branch网络在配置点上处理输入函数的冗余，数学等价于原架构但显著降低训练时间与显存，使3D问题可训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PI-DeepONet虽能学习解算子并减少对标注数据依赖，但训练计算成本随维度升高而激增，限制其在高维问题上的应用。

Method: 分析原架构中Branch网络对同一输入函数在不同配置点上重复计算的冗余，提出去除该冗余的等价重构，缩小输入张量规模与Branch网络调用次数；并推导训练时间随配置点数与输入函数数的理论复杂度缩放律。

Result: 在1D/2D/3D线性对流问题上精度与原PI-DeepONet相当且训练时间持续降低；2D最大加速3.75倍，实测训练时间缩放符合理论线性依赖；3D模型仅在本架构下可在A100上训练（原架构超显存）。

Conclusion: 实现层面的细致优化可带来显著收益，提升PI-DeepONet的实际性能并使其适用于原本难以处理的物理信息学习问题。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) reduce or eliminate the need for large labelled datasets by enforcing governing equations during training. Physics-informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) extend this approach to learning solution operators, enabling rapid prediction across families of problems. Despite these advantages, we show that their application to higher-dimensional problems remains limited by the computational cost of training. To address this issue, we propose a modified PI-DeepONet architecture that reduces this cost by removing redundancy in how the Branch network processes input functions across collocation points. The proposed formulation is mathematically equivalent to the original architecture but reduces input tensor sizes and the number of Branch network evaluations. We analyse the computational complexity of both architectures and derive theoretical scaling laws for training time with respect to the number of collocation points and input functions. The proposed architecture is evaluated on 1D, 2D, and 3D linear advection problems. In all cases, it achieves comparable predictive accuracy to the original PI-DeepONet while consistently reducing training time. In 2D experiments, a maximum speed-up of $3.75\times$ is observed, with empirical training-time scaling agreeing with the predicted linear dependence on collocation points and input functions. Furthermore, training a 3D model on an NVIDIA A100 GPU is only feasible using the proposed architecture, as the original formulation exceeds memory limits. These results demonstrate that careful consideration of how PI-DeepONets are implemented can yield substantial gains, enhancing the practical performance of PI-DeepONets and enabling their application to otherwise intractable physics-informed learning problems.

</details>


### [531] [LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22179)
*Max Zhu,Bohang Sun,Pietro Lio,Jialin Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LCT：面向训练中反复编解码场景的GPU无损张量压缩框架，利用FP数据自然冗余压缩权重/激活/优化器状态，最高1.455×压缩比，NanoGPT内存降24.6%（步时+7.2%），Qwen3-4B微调节省峰值内存23.8%并支持3.5×更长上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练过程中张量需被反复重新编码，使无损压缩的收益被编解码开销侵蚀；现有压缩方法缺乏针对这一repeated encode-decode regime的GPU执行支持，因此需要低开销、可实用的无损张量压缩框架以降低训练显存占用。

Method: 提出LCT（Losslessly Compressed Tensors）GPU执行框架：挖掘浮点数据的自然冗余，对权重、激活与优化器状态进行压缩存储；采用高度优化的GPU kernel实现基于预计算码本的Huffman编码，以降低压缩/解压开销；并对LCT的存储成本及对数值幅度漂移的自适应性进行理论分析。

Result: 压缩比最高达1.455×；在162M参数NanoGPT训练中内存占用降低24.6%，步时仅增加7.2%；在Qwen3-4B微调中峰值内存节省最高23.8%，同GPU下支持3.5×更长的训练上下文长度。

Conclusion: LCT表明在可接受的步时开销下，无损张量压缩可作为实用的训练显存优化手段，并能显著扩展可训练上下文长度；其收益依赖于低开销GPU编码与对数据分布变化的适应能力。

Abstract: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.

</details>


### [532] [OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22234)
*Bowen Yang,Kaiming Jin,Zichen Ding,Zhenyu Wu,Zehao Li,Zhoumianze Liu,Kanzhi Cheng,Fangzhi Xu,Yanan Sun,Qiushi Sun,Yu Qiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OS-Helix，将 GUI 操作与代码执行统一于单一动作空间的多模态计算机使用智能体。通过应用-产物组合构建可执行 Ubuntu 状态、解耦式指令/评估器生成可验证任务，经 SFT 冷启动后在真实桌面中在线 RL（Step-balanced GSPO）优化。OSWorld-Verified 上 OS-Helix-27B/35B-A3B 相对基线提升 35.0%/33.7%，27B-RL 达 66.44%（+42.9%），并验证了跨平台迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实桌面自动化既非纯视觉也非纯程序化：智能体既要理解用户界面，又需高效操作文件、脚本与系统状态。然而原生 GUI/代码协同无法通过提示层面的工具组合获得——预备实验显示，朴素加入代码工具反而降低 GUI 智能体性能，说明 GUI/代码路由必须通过高质量混合数据训练来内化。

Method: 1) 端到端训练的多模态计算机使用智能体，统一 GUI 动作与代码执行到同一动作空间；2) 应用-产物组合（application-artifact composition），将桌面应用与真实文件产物配对，实例化可执行的 Ubuntu 状态；3) 解耦的指令/评估器生成流水线，产出环境接地、与解法模态无关的最终状态可验证任务；4) 在筛选后的混合数据上 SFT 冷启动策略，再在真实桌面环境进行在线 RL；5) 提出 Step-balanced GSPO，按动作步而非原始 assistant token 聚合重要性权重，避免长代码动作在异构动作优化中占主导。

Result: OSWorld-Verified 上，OS-Helix-27B 与 OS-Helix-35B-A3B 相对各自匹配的 Qwen3.5 混合基线分别提升 35.0% 与 33.7%；OS-Helix-27B-RL 进一步提升 42.9%，成功率 66.44%。消融实验结果与"习得式 GUI/代码协同""可扩展可验证监督""动作步平衡优化"三方面贡献一致，并在 WindowsAgentArena 上展示了跨平台迁移能力。

Conclusion: GUI/代码协同应作为模型内在能力通过混合数据训练获得，而非依赖提示级工具编排；可验证监督与动作步粒度的优化平衡是端到端桌面智能体训练的关键，且该方法具备跨平台泛化性。

Abstract: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.

</details>


### [533] [Generalization Guarantees of Randomized Block Coordinate Descent for Nonconvex Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22213)
*Ruixi Hu,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为带非凸目标的随机块坐标下降（RBCD）建立高概率泛化保证，涵盖一般非凸、梯度主导及特定结构三类情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RBCD 理论分析主要关注优化视角下的收敛行为，其非凸问题的泛化行为研究不足。

Method: 在仅需标准光滑性假设下，推导经验风险与总体风险梯度的界；采用多项式衰减步长，通过调节迭代次数平衡优化与泛化，刻画早停对总体梯度最优收敛率的作用；在梯度主导设定下以函数次优性给出界；并针对特定结构损失函数建立与维度无关的界。

Result: 一般非凸情形得到经验与总体风险梯度的上界，并由早停量化总体梯度的最优收敛率；梯度主导情形下的界几乎匹配凸与低噪声设定中的乐观速率；特定结构损失下得到与维度无关的界。

Conclusion: RBCD 的泛化行为可在非凸设定下被严格刻画，早停可平衡优化与泛化，且所得保证可推广至高维问题。

Abstract: Randomized block coordinate descent (RBCD) is a popular optimization algorithm for many large-scale machine learning problems. The existing theoretical analysis of RBCD mainly focuses on its convergence behavior from an optimization perspective, while its generalization behavior remains less understood for nonconvex problems. In this paper, we establish high-probability generalization guarantees for RBCD with nonconvex objectives. In the general nonconvex setting, we derive bounds on the gradients of both empirical and population risks, requiring only standard smoothness assumptions. With polynomially decaying step sizes, we tune the iteration number to balance optimization and generalization, thereby quantifying how early stopping leads to the optimal convergence rate for the population gradients. In the gradient-dominated setting, we provide bounds in terms of functional suboptimality, which nearly match the optimistic rates in convex and low-noise settings. Finally, we develop dimension-independent bounds for loss functions of a specific structure, making the generalization guarantees applicable to high-dimensional problems.

</details>


### [534] [Training-Free On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22236)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Zhaoyu Zhu,Hongbo Ma,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的在策略蒸馏（\method）：仅用前向计算和最小二乘闭式解，即可将多个专用模型融合为一个平均准确率更高的通用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在策略蒸馏通常需要为每个教师模型进行 rollout、教师前向和梯度更新，成本高昂；作者希望证明模型整合不必依赖训练。

Method: 利用专用模型共享基座这一特性，为每个线性层求精确的逐层闭式解：融合层需在"专家自己读取自身答案时接收到的输入"上复现该专家的输出，这是一个最小二乘问题，只依赖这些输入的二阶矩；数百条 rollout 的一次前向即可获得。并强调 rollout 内容质量的重要性——剔除陷入重复循环而被截断的答案。

Result: 在 AIME25 上，剔除重复循环截断样本可将融合模型从任务算术水平提升至与专家模型相当（同等精度下）。在 Olmo 3 7B 上，每个专家仅需数 GPU 小时的前向计算，所得通用模型在七个数学与代码基准上保留了各自专家的多数增益。

Conclusion: 专家能力的合并不需要训练，前向计算即可完成；rollout 数据的构成比求解器本身更关键。

Abstract: On-policy distillation consolidates specialist models into one student at the price of rollouts, teacher passes and gradient steps for every teacher. We show that the consolidation does not need training: with forward passes only, the capabilities of separately tuned specialists can be aggregated into one model that is, on average, more accurate than either specialist alone. When specialists share a base model, distillation has an exact layer-wise solution: each linear layer of the fused model must reproduce every specialist's output on the inputs that specialist receives while reading its own answers, a least-squares problem whose solution needs only the second moments of those inputs. One forward pass over a few hundred rollouts provides them. We call this training-free on-policy distillation (\method). What the rollouts contain matters more than the solver: answers truncated in repetition loops are few among a mathematics specialist's rollouts but carry a large share of their tokens, and removing them lifts the fused model on AIME25 from task arithmetic's level to the specialist's at matched precision. On Olmo~3 7B, a few GPU-hours of forward computation per specialist yield a generalist that keeps most of each specialist's gain on each of seven mathematics and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [535] [Query-Efficient Rejection Sampling for Parallel Masked Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22238)
*Shiyuan Zhang,Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出单增量拒绝采样器（SIRS），用一次查询的随机增量估计对数接受概率，并通过Bernoulli factory与Rao-Blackwell化实现高效无偏校正的掩码扩散并行解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）并行解掩多个token可加速生成，但独立采样忽略token间相关性，导致输出分布有偏。Anari et al. (2026) 用拒绝采样校正该偏差，将log接受概率分解为token级项之和，但需为每个解掩token各做一次score查询，开销随块大小线性增长。

Method: SIRS以单次随机采样的增量、单次查询来估计log接受概率；再将Poisson数量的截断估计经改编自Chen et al. (2026)的Bernoulli factory转化为接受/拒绝决策。由于每次查询返回块内所有剩余token的条件分布，作者对这些token做Rao-Blackwell化平均，无额外查询成本地降低截断概率。

Result: 理论上证明数据分布与SIRS输出之间的KL散度被一个截断项加模型训练误差所界住。在精确score下，普通并行解码需付出完整的块内依赖代价，而SIRS仅需付出超出截断范围的那部分代价。

Conclusion: SIRS在保持拒绝采样的偏差校正性质的同时将每块查询成本降至常数级，并给出KL散度上界与截断误差可控性，为MDM高效、低偏的并行生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) accelerate generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel, but sampling these tokens independently ignores their correlations and biases the output. Anari et al. (2026) corrected this bias with rejection sampling, decomposing the log acceptance probability into a sum of token-level terms, but the evaluation requires one score query per unmasked token. We propose the Single-Increment Rejection Sampler (SIRS), which provides an estimate of the log acceptance probability from a single randomly sampled increment at the cost of one query. SIRS then converts a Poisson number of clipped estimates into accept/reject decisions through a Bernoulli factory adapted from Chen et al. (2026). Since each query returns the conditionals of all remaining tokens in the block, we further Rao-Blackwellize each increment by averaging over these tokens at no extra cost, thereby reducing clipping. We show that the KL-divergence between the data distribution and the SIRS output is bounded by a clipping term plus the model's training error. With exact scores, parallel decoding pays the full within-block dependence, whereas SIRS pays only the part beyond the clipping range.

</details>


### [536] [Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22252)
*Spyros Dragazis,Yilei Chen,Aldo Pacchiano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线性奖励结构的随机上下文bandit中同时评估K个目标策略的问题，提出PRISMA算法，通过无奖励规划、正则化采样设计与共享岭回归估计器，以依赖对数log(K)的样本复杂度同时估计所有目标策略的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多策略同时评估（如离线强化学习中的策略选择、A/B测试式多方案比较）相比单独评估每个策略更高效，但现有方法样本开销随K线性增长。作者希望利用策略间共享的采样分布和信息共享，使总样本复杂度仅随K对数增长，并在不依赖第二矩特征值数值下界、不显式依赖上下文/动作空间基数的情况下给出保证。

Method: 提出PRISMA（Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation）：1）采用无奖励规划（reward-free planning）为每个目标策略构造查询；2）设计正则化采样分布，使共享采样分布的难度由实例相关量ρ*≤d刻画；3）对所有K个策略共享单一岭回归估计器，实现信息共享；4）通过自适应倍增（doubling）程序选择正则化尺度，无需预先知道ρ*；5）策略查询成本单独核算，每个共享规划上下文需K次查询。

Result: 在概率至少1−δ下，将每个目标策略的价值估计到精度ε，所需上下文采样与奖励观测数为 Õ( ((L²S²+β²)(1∨ρ*)/ε²)·log(K) )，其中L、S、β分别为特征范数、奖励参数范数与奖励噪声的界，隐藏因子为关于K、d、1/δ的对数项。该保证不要求第二矩特征值的数值下界，也不显式依赖上下文与动作空间基数。

Conclusion: PRISMA通过共享采样设计与单一回归估计器，将K策略同时评估的样本复杂度降至log(K)级别的对K依赖，并借助自适应正则化避免了未知的ρ*与特征值下界假设，在理论上实现了高效且鲁棒的多策略评估。

Abstract: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure.
