Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+β^2)(1\veeρ^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ context draws and reward observations, where $ρ^\star\le d$ is an instance-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution. Here, $L$, $S$, and $β$ bound the feature norm, reward parameter norm, and reward noise, respectively, and the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $K$, $d$, and $1/δ$. Our method combines reward-free planning, a regularized sampling design, and a single ridge regression estimator shared across all target policies. An adaptive doubling procedure selects the regularization scale without knowledge of $ρ^\star$. The guarantees require no numerical lower bound on second-moment eigenvalues and have no explicit dependence on the cardinalities of the context and action spaces. Policy-query costs are accounted for separately, with $K$ queries per shared planning context.

</details>


### [537] [BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22256)
*Max Zhu,Bohang Sun,Pietro Lio,Jialin Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitSparse：面向稀疏激活的GPU端无损压缩缓存格式，压缩比接近理论最优，降低每token显存31%（Modded-NanoGPT）与30%（Nemotron-H），开销≤1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM训练显存受限：激活检查点靠重计算省显存，有损压缩改变存储的激活值（引入误差）。而稀疏ReLU/ReLU²激活的复兴提供了第三条路径——对激活缓存本身做无损压缩。

Method: 提出BitSparse：驻留GPU的稀疏激活无损压缩格式。压缩与重建由定制Triton内核实现，并融合为autograd函数，在前向时压缩激活缓存、反向时精确还原。支持BF16与FP8激活，可选符号位打包进一步提升压缩比逼近理论上限。另设计预分配缓冲区系统，在分配变长张量时避免主机同步。

Result: 分析并对比理论最优压缩比；每token显存分别降低31%（Modded-NanoGPT）和30%（Nemotron-H），在实际序列长度下开销不超过1%。

Conclusion: 利用稀疏激活的冗余，BitSparse以无损、低开销方式减少训练显存占用，可与现有省显存手段互补，并保持反向精度不受损。

Abstract: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.

</details>


### [538] [Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22262)
*Arjun Dadhwal,Brian Summa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对科学超分模型点式重建损失与拓扑/极值结构解读之间的张力，基于预训练CNN与GAN风场SR模型分析不同拓扑距离的分歧，提出拓扑启发的可微辅助损失（梯度幅值与固定对监督），在168场基准上同时改善PD与MT距离并提升PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学超分辨率模型通常以点式重建损失优化，但科学解读依赖极值、连通区域与多尺度标量结构；且实验显示点式指标、瓶颈PD距离、MT距离偏好CNN，而2阶Wasserstein PD距离偏好更锐利的GAN，同一拓扑描述符的不同距离奖励不同性质，说明单一损失无法兼顾科学结构保真。

Method: 以预训练CNN与GAN风场SR模型为对象，比较点式指标与瓶颈PD、MT、W2,∞、W2,2距离的表现差异；据此对预训练CNN引入可微拓扑启发辅助损失，作用于标量速度、梯度幅值、高速水平集软指示与局部极大值，并加入固定对监督（利用Topology ToolKit离线定位真值persistence-pair端点，约束其预测值与persistence）；开展16种微调配置的损失研究，每种均与仅用原重建损失的匹配标准微调对照，在固定168场基准（拓扑在每场固定的160×160子区域评估）上评测；最终目标结合梯度监督与固定对监督两种信号。

Result: 在标量场损失中，梯度监督带来的PD改善最强但不改善平均MT距离；固定对监督取得最大且最一致的PD与MT联合改善。最终组合目标相对预训练CNN将平均瓶颈、W2,∞、W2,2距离分别降低31%、25%、27%（相对标准微调对照降低32–35%，而对照自身使三者全部变差），PSNR提升1.30 dB（约为标准微调增益的一半），在150/168个场上三项PD距离同时下降；平均MT距离亦改善，但仅在其中91个场上实现，表明PD与MT刻画互补结构。

Conclusion: 点式重建损失与拓扑一致性存在系统性张力，且不同拓扑距离奖励不同性质，需组合多信号监督；梯度监督与固定对监督互补，组合目标可在几乎不牺牲（甚至提升）PSNR的前提下显著改善PD并部分改善MT，验证PD与MT捕捉互补结构，提示科学SR评估应采用多拓扑描述符的联合视角。

Abstract: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. A loss study of 16 fine-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168-field benchmark (with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field), shows that, among the scalar-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances. The final objective combines these two signals. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, $W_{2,\infty}$, and $W_{2,2}$ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% (and by 32-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine-tuning. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure.

</details>


### [539] [Baselines and Score Centering in Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22263)
*Shuo Han,Ziqing Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文从协方差视角重新审视正则化重要性采样下的大语言模型强化学习策略梯度估计，厘清组均值基线与得分中心化的作用与关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型后训练常用离策略强化学习，因训练-推理不匹配或策略陈旧需用重要性采样；但实践中对重要性比率做截断、掩码或裁剪等正则化后，重要性加权策略梯度不再对奖励常数平移保持不变，需要恢复该不变性。

Method: 以奖励与重要性加权得分的协方差作为估计量（比率未正则化时与策略梯度一致），分别在序列级与词元级重要性采样下展开该协方差视角，分析组均值基线与得分中心化各自的去均值作用及其无偏协方差估计量的方差差异。

Result: 组均值基线用样本均值中心化，得分中心化用总体均值中心化，二者构成不同的无偏协方差估计量且方差不同；是否需同时使用取决于重要性采样的层级。

Conclusion: 序列级重要性采样下，采用组均值基线后得分中心化无额外收益；词元级重要性采样下，当重要性比率被正则化时，仅用组均值基线而不做得分中心化通常引入偏差。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used approach to post-training large language models. In a typical implementation, learning is off-policy: The policy generating the responses differs from the policy being trained because of training-inference mismatch or policy staleness in asynchronous training. This discrepancy is commonly addressed by importance sampling, whose ratio is usually regularized in practice through truncation, masking, or clipping. Under regularized importance sampling, the importance-weighted policy gradient is no longer invariant to constant shifts in the reward. This invariance is recovered by using the covariance between the reward and the importance-weighted score as the estimand, which coincides with the policy gradient when the ratio is not regularized. This note develops this covariance perspective for both sequence-level and token-level importance sampling. The covariance perspective reveals the roles of the group-mean baseline and score centering in policy gradient estimation. Both perform centering in covariance estimation, but they differ in the mean being subtracted: The group-mean baseline uses a sample mean, whereas score centering uses a population mean. The two lead to distinct unbiased covariance estimators with different variances. Whether both forms of centering should be used simultaneously depends on whether importance sampling is applied at the sequence level or at the token level. With sequence-level importance sampling, score centering adds no benefit once the group-mean baseline is used; with token-level importance sampling, using the group-mean baseline without score centering generally introduces bias when the importance ratio is regularized.

</details>


### [540] [Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22273)
*Anikait Singh,Teresa Zhang,Yoonho Lee,Roshen Sanjay Nair,Aviral Kumar,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Librarian Agents 框架，让 builder agent 将原始文档主动重组织为分层虚拟文件系统工作区，并用强化学习以下游问答准确率为目标优化构建策略，实现长文档跨文档推理的可复用检索基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长文档上下文推理仍是 LLM 的难题。标准检索方法本质是"反应式"的，在推理时成为跨文档推理的瓶颈；知识图谱等预计算结构又依赖僵化启发式。作者观察到现代 agent harness（如 Claude Code）中的关键不对称：agent 擅长在既有文件系统中导航解决即时任务，却很少被训练去构建可供未来复用的工作区，因此希望实现"前瞻性定向策展"。

Method: 构建 Librarian Agents 框架：builder agent 把原始文档转化为由合成文件与引用链接组成的分层文件系统，形成面向下游回答 agent 的工作区。将工作区构建建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用强化学习优化 builder 策略，奖励直接取下游问答准确率。

Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强检索与预计算基线高出 33 个百分点；前期构建成本可通过重复查询摊销；在 BRIGHT 上零样本迁移至未见领域，平均准确率提升 31 点。

Conclusion: 以"为未来查询构建可复用工作区"替代推理时的反应式检索，是长文档推理的有效范式；RL 直接对齐下游任务目标优于刚性启发式结构化，并具备跨域泛化与成本摊销优势。

Abstract: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.

</details>


### [541] [Learning Rational Strategies for Temporal Objectives in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22287)
*Omar Adalat,Edwin Hamel-De le Court,Francesco Belardinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究未知动态随机多智能体系统的理性综合问题，各智能体拥有基于PLTL_f的概率时序目标，在Nash均衡、子博弈完美均衡等解概念约束下求解理性综合，提出结合tabular Nash-Q学习的无模型MARL方法，并给出条件收敛保证与有限样本置信界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统理性综合通常假设系统动态已知并依赖模型求解，而实际多智能体系统动态未知；同时需要保证策略剖面满足指定智能体的概率时序约束且保持策略稳定性，因此有必要在无模型强化学习框架下处理该问题。

Method: 将每个智能体的PLTL_f目标自动编译为奖励自动机，以目标满足概率导出收益；把理性综合表述为在选定解概念（如Nash均衡、子博弈完美均衡）约束下求满足指定智能体概率时序约束的策略剖面；采用tabular Nash-Q学习进行无模型求解，给出条件收敛保证，利用同时有限样本置信界认证满足性，并通过近似最佳响应检查评估策略稳定性；在8个一般和并发随机博弈上进行实证验证。

Result: 给出了tabular Nash-Q学习的条件收敛保证；能够以同时有限样本置信界认证目标满足性；通过近似最佳响应检查评估策略稳定性；在8个一般和并发随机博弈上完成实证验证。

Conclusion: 该工作将概率时序逻辑目标的理性综合与无模型MARL相结合，为未知动态随机多智能体系统提供可认证、可评估稳定性的求解框架，并在多类一般和并发随机博弈中显示了有效性。

Abstract: We study rational synthesis for stochastic multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, where each agent is equipped with its own probabilistic temporal objective specified using Probabilistic Linear Temporal Logic on Finite Traces ($\mathsf{PLTL}_f}$). We impose solution concepts (e.g., Nash equilibrium, subgame-perfect equilibrium) as constraints on the joint strategy profile, using payoffs derived from each agent's probability of satisfying its temporal objective. In particular, we formulate per-agent rational synthesis as finding a strategy profile -- if one exists -- such that (i) the designated agent's probabilistic temporal constraint is satisfied, and (ii) the profile represents a stable solution under a chosen solution concept. We give conditional convergence guarantees for tabular Nash-Q learning, certify satisfaction with simultaneous finite-sample confidence bounds, and assess strategic stability with approximate best-response checking. Our approach operates in a stochastic \emph{Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning} (MARL) environment, where model-free learning algorithms attempt to attain extremal satisfaction probabilities for temporal objectives automatically compiled into reward automata. Our approach is empirically validated using 8 general-sum concurrent stochastic games.

</details>


### [542] [CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22292)
*Yuan-Chen Chang,Niklas Herbster,Gauthier Gidel,Tommaso Tosato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CATCH（Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty），通过"奖励诚实回答、惩罚不诚实回答"的连续对抗训练提升LLM诚实性，仅用数百个自报告场景样本即可泛化到多个基准，并在保持模型效用上优于诚实激活引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在对诚实性要求极高的场景中仍表现出不诚实行为（输出与知识相矛盾的断言、缺乏上下文支持的断言），且对齐训练并未有效消除该问题。作者希望借用原本用于稳健拒绝有害查询的方法，训练出可稳健泛化、且不损害模型能力的诚实行为。

Method: 提出Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH)：在训练中同时推向诚实回答、远离不诚实回答，并引入一种新颖的效用数据选择以维持模型能力。在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct与Qwen3-3.6-27B两种架构上评估，训练目标由自报告（self-reporting）场景构建，仅数百条。对比基线包括提示工程、监督微调（SFT）与SOTA诚实激活引导（activation steering）。

Result: CATCH在MASK上持续降低压力下的不诚实行为；在Among Us多智能体游戏中增加"坦白"行为；在AuditBench上提高模型隐藏行为的发现率。效果优于提示与SFT，与SOTA诚实激活引导相当；同时因新颖的效用数据选择，CATCH在维持效用方面优于激活引导。

Conclusion: CATCH表明基于少量自报告场景的连续对抗训练可获得稳健泛化、可跨基准迁移的诚实行为，并在诚实性与效用之间取得优于激活引导的平衡，为LLM诚实性对齐提供了有效且低数据成本的方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming prevalent in scenarios where honesty is critical. However, despite alignment training, these models still exhibit dishonest behaviour, such as outputting claims that contradict some knowledge or are not supported by what is accessible in context. We introduce Continuous Adversarial Training for Consistent Honesty (CATCH), inspired by a method originally developed to robustly refuse harmful queries. CATCH trains the model towards an honest answer and away from a dishonest one while maintaining the model's capabilities. We evaluate two architectures (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B). We show that trained with only hundreds of targets built from self-reporting scenarios, CATCH learns an honest behaviour that robustly generalizes and transfers across distinct benchmarks. It consistently reduces dishonesty under pressure on MASK, increases confessions in the multi-agent game of Among Us, and improves the discovery rates of the model's hidden behaviours in AuditBench. We show that CATCH outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning in improving honesty, and it is on par with state-of-the-art honesty activation steering. However, CATCH surpasses honesty steering in maintaining utility, thanks to a novel choice of utility data.

</details>


### [543] [Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22293)
*Arnav Chavan,Kusha Sareen,Rishabh Tiwari,Abhranil Chandra,Johan Obando-Ceron,Kurt Keutzer,Scott Niekum,Inderjit S Dhillon,Devvrit Khatri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出子空间微调（SST），将每次权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间，从而在保持目标任务性能的同时显著缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM微调会破坏已有能力，灾难性遗忘是持续学习的核心障碍。已有工作发现遗忘与微调对权重的移动幅度和方向有关：RL、同策略蒸馏等on-policy方法不更新权重矩阵的主奇异方向因而遗忘较少，而SFT往往沿这些主方向集中更新，容易导致灾难性遗忘。

Method: SST将每个权重更新约束在底部奇异子空间中，完全消除沿主奇异方向的变化。方法具有优化器无关性，可与SFT、自蒸馏等微调流程组合；其结合了紧致的子空间保护、稠密梯度估计以及简单的刷新（refresh）机制。

Result: 保护高达99%的权重子空间仍能显著提升保持性并维持较强的目标任务性能；该效果随模型与数据规模增大而增强，在大模型情形下几乎消除遗忘。相比基线，SST诱导的KL漂移减少2–4倍。

Conclusion: SST推进了学习–遗忘的Pareto前沿，学习效果强于先前的正交微调方法，可作为预训练语言模型微调的实用默认方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.

</details>


### [544] [Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22316)
*Leyang Shen,Yaxin Gong,Yang Zhang,Chenxiao Fan,Jiakai Wang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Fuli Feng,Chun Kai Ling,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“引导智能体”(steering agent)在线监督LLM智能体及多智能体系统的执行过程，识别并及时纠正目标漂移(goal drift)，通过快/慢双路径与强化学习联合训练实现对单/多智能体系统性能与效率的提升，并具备跨任务、跨执行者泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体与多智能体系统在执行长程工具调用与协作任务时，容易随执行推进偏离总体目标（目标漂移），造成资源浪费与不良结果。现有系统缺乏对执行过程的在线监督与纠正机制。

Method: 设计引导智能体，观察执行上下文，用低成本快路径决定“何时干预”，用高成本慢路径决定“如何干预”；联合训练两条路径，将成对排序目标(pairwise ranking objective)与组相对策略优化(GRPO)结合，以习得目标漂移评估与有效干预生成能力。

Result: 在信息检索类搜索任务上，引导智能体对单智能体和多智能体系统均提供有效监督，提升其性能与效率；所学引导智能可泛化到域外任务、迁移到未见过的执行者，并支持无需重训练的可控干预频率。

Conclusion: 在线引导监督是缓解目标漂移、提升LLM智能体系统长程执行可靠性与资源效率的有效范式，且具备良好的泛化性与可调控性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift. In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.

</details>


### [545] [Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22327)
*Hedi Zisling,Liran Nochumsohn,Ilan Naiman,Mihir Parmar,Omri Azencot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"互补表示"设计原则：将折线图（保留绝对度量与坐标系）与归一化延迟嵌入（消除正幅度缩放与偏移、暴露时间结构）两种视觉视图结合，经专用视觉编码器与多级特征融合注入共享语言模型，基于Qwen3-VL-8B显著提升时序推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）通常只向语言模型暴露单一表示，从而在所有下游任务上强加固定的归纳偏置，缺乏对"应保留何种信息、应消除何种变化"这一根本问题的显式设计。

Method: 以互补表示为原则构建双视图模型：视图一为折线图，保留绝对测量值与观测坐标系；视图二为归一化延迟嵌入，消除正幅度缩放与偏移并暴露时序结构。两个视图分别由专用视觉编码器编码，作为视觉token通过多级特征融合进入共享语言模型。通过评估时的干预实验验证两视图具有不同的不变性轮廓，并进行单视图消融。

Result: TSRBench总体准确率由仅用折线图的44.5%提升至53.2%，大幅超过最强专用TSLM基线36.7%；TSExam达89.9%，多变量ChatTS对齐的数值准确率达86.8%。消融显示双视图组合在超越基础感知的预测与推理任务上增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 互补表示是一种有效的通用TSLM设计原则，使模型在不牺牲原始测量坐标系访问能力的前提下利用时间结构。

Abstract: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. Evaluation-time interventions verify that the two views exhibit distinct invariance profiles, while single-view ablations show that their combination is particularly beneficial beyond basic perception, with the large gains in prediction and reasoning. Built on Qwen3-VL-8B, our dual-view model improves overall TSRBench accuracy from 44.5% with line plots alone to 53.2%, substantially exceeding the strongest evaluated dedicated TSLM baseline at 36.7%. It further achieves 89.9% accuracy on TSExam and 86.8% numerical accuracy on multivariate ChatTS alignment. Together, these results demonstrate that complementary representations provide an effective design principle for general-purpose TSLMs, enabling models to exploit temporal structure without sacrificing access to the original measurement frame.

</details>


### [546] [Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22336)
*Chengze Xie,Xuan Wang,Ying Ding,Hairong Wang,Yan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个鲁棒强化学习（RL）框架，把患者视为隐上下文，用鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程统一处理跨患者泛化与对生物标志物测量误差、疾病动态漂移的鲁棒性，并在转移性前列腺癌自适应治疗模拟中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应治疗方案难以在不同患者间泛化，且在生物标志物测量存在误差、疾病动态发生偏移时可靠性下降；需要一种能同时兼顾泛化性与鲁棒性的原则性方法。

Method: 将患者建模为隐上下文（hidden context），构建鲁棒上下文MDP（robust contextual MDP）框架来学习自适应治疗策略；在经临床数据校准的转移性前列腺癌模拟器中验证。

Result: 所得策略具备可泛化性与鲁棒性，显著优于现有自适应治疗方法；在生物标志物准确且疾病按预期演化时几乎无性能损失，且在多种情景下帕累托支配（Pareto-dominate）现有方法。

Conclusion: 鲁棒RL是一种学习可靠自适应治疗策略的有前景的原则性方法。

Abstract: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. By modeling the patient as a hidden context, we address generalization and robustness in a unified manner through robust contextual Markov decision processes. Applying our framework to adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer in a simulator calibrated to clinical data, we obtain generalizable and robust policies that substantially outperform the existing adaptive therapy method. In particular, we attain robustness with almost no loss of performance when the biomarker is accurate and the disease evolves as anticipated, and find that the resulting policy Pareto-dominates the existing method across a diverse array of scenarios. Our findings suggest that robust RL holds great promise as a principled methodology for learning reliable adaptive treatment policies.

</details>


### [547] [Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22339)
*Yihan Xu,Jia-Chen Gu,Junyi Zhang,Di Wu,Haikang Deng,Po-Nien Kung,Kai-Wei Chang,Amit Sahai,Wei Wang,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LeanGraphSearch：基于Mathlib前向依赖图的多跳依赖链检索方法，在检索召回与端到端定理证明通过率上均优于LeanSearch v2，且准确率-成本效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有引理检索系统仅将库声明与目标定理或其证明中间步骤做匹配，对声明间多跳依赖利用不足；依赖关系可揭示与目标词面不相似、但在相关问题证明中反复出现的支撑引理。

Method: 1) 从Mathlib的前向依赖构建声明图，将每个声明链接到其依赖的前提；2) 使用图排序算法（类似PageRank式传播）把语义匹配声明的相关性传播至其依赖项，扩展候选；3) 对扩展候选相对原始查询重排序；4) 将检索模块嵌入由Lean反馈引导的迭代证明循环，实现端到端证明。

Result: 检索：在MathlibQR上召回较最强基线LeanSearch v2最高提升12%；在MathlibMPR上完整标注证明路径覆盖新增最多3.7%的组。证明：在三个基准、{8,16,32}反思轮数下，通过率较原始prover最高提升40%、较LeanSearch v2最高提升10%，准确率-成本效率更高。

Conclusion: 依赖图搜索对定理证明具有明确价值，结构感知的检索有助于证明发现，值得进一步研究。

Abstract: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. Specifically, LeanGraphSearch links each declaration to the premises it depends on, uses a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance from semantically matched declarations to their dependencies, and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query. Across two mathematical retrieval benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves recall by up to 12% over the strongest baseline, LeanSearch v2, on MathlibQR and increases coverage of complete annotated proof routes on MathlibMPR, covering up to 3.7% of extra groups. More importantly, we evaluate whether these retrieval gains translate into improved end-to-end theorem proving by integrating LeanGraphSearch into an iterative proving loop guided by Lean feedback. Across three theorem proving benchmarks, LeanGraphSearch improves pass rate at {8, 16, 32} reflection turns by as much as 40% compared to vanilla prover and at most 10% compared to LeanSearch v2, showing higher accuracy-cost efficiency. These findings highlight the value of dependency graph search for theorem proving and motivate further research on structure-aware search for proof discovery.

</details>


### [548] [Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22353)
*Bingcong Li,Hao Ma,Michael Muehlebach,Niao He,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出细粒度专家分割与共享专家之间存在“探索困境”（exploration dilemma），并提出MirrorMoE通过对不必要的专家进行token自适应抑制来缩小探索空间，从而调和该困境并稳定提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代MoE架构越来越多地同时采用细粒度专家分割与共享专家两种设计。细粒度分割在固定激活比例下通过更多专家组合提升表达力，但也组合性地扩大了路由空间，因而更需要探索；而共享专家会降低token表示的变异性，使路由探索性下降。二者叠加导致细粒度分割带来的额外表达力在实际中难以充分发挥，这构成需要解决的“探索困境”。

Method: 提出MirrorMoE：通过对不必要的专家进行token自适应抑制（token-adaptive suppression）来缩小探索空间，从而在保持细粒度表达力的同时缓解共享专家造成的探索不足问题。

Result: MirrorMoE在不同模型规模上均取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 细粒度专家分割与共享专家之间存在结构性张力；通过token自适应地抑制冗余专家、压缩探索空间，可在实践中兑现细粒度分割的表达力收益，验证了该调和思路的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.

</details>


### [549] [PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22358)
*Jiachen Yao,Xiyuan Zhang,Annan Yu,Boran Han,Abdul Fatir Ansari,Shuai Zhang,Michael Bohlke-Schneider,Bernie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PathFM，基于flow matching生成完整未来轨迹的时序基础模型，并通过蒸馏与共享历史注意力缓存实现高效多次采样，同时引入fps-bench评测轨迹依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流时序基础模型只预测边缘分位数，未刻画未来轨迹的联合依赖结构，因而无法评估累积需求、峰值负荷、事件时序等轨迹相关量；点预测与边缘指标无法揭示这一点。

Method: 用flow matching生成完整未来路径；将模型蒸馏到1-2步采样，并在多次采样间共享历史注意力KV缓存，使单条序列生成多条路径的耗时约等于一次分位数模型查询；蒸馏后的采样器支持直接优化校准损失；另构建fps-bench，在fev-bench任务上增加energy score、variogram score及下游指标。

Result: 在fev-bench与TIME上边缘精度具竞争力；在fps-bench上聚合路径得分高于所有对比外部基线；在混沌系统实验中保持长期变异性，而强基线快速坍缩。

Conclusion: PathFM使生成式时序预测兼具竞争力与实用性，可支撑多样化下游应用；同时指出仅用边缘指标评测的不足并给出轨迹级评测方案。

Abstract: Time series foundation models are becoming increasingly popular for general-purpose forecasting. However, most leading models predict marginal quantiles, leaving the dependence structure of future trajectories unspecified. This distinction matters for trajectory-dependent quantities such as cumulative demand, peak load, and event timing, yet point and marginal scores do not reveal it. To model this dependence, we introduce PathFM, a trajectory-based forecasting model that uses flow matching to generate complete future paths. We further distill the model to one or two steps and share history attention cache across draws. Together, these enable PathFM to generate multiple paths for a single series in roughly the time needed for one query to a quantile model. The distilled sampler also makes it practical to optimize a calibration loss directly. PathFM achieves competitive marginal accuracy on the established forecasting benchmarks fev-bench and TIME. To complement these evaluations, we introduce Forecast Path Score Bench (fps-bench), which augments fev-bench tasks with energy and variogram scores and downstream metrics. PathFM achieves a higher aggregate path score on fps-bench than all evaluated external baselines. Experiments on chaotic systems further show that our flow model sustains long-run variability, while strong baselines rapidly collapse. PathFM makes generative time series forecasting both competitive and practical, enabling diverse downstream applications.

</details>

### [550] [The role of friction on heave-induced motion of offshore drilling systems: modelling, analysis, and numerical experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22189)
*Luigi Romano,Ole Morten Aamo*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 本文研究摩擦动力学对升沉诱导扰动传播的影响，建立ODE-PDE耦合水力-结构钻柱模型，给出适定性与稳定性分析，并通过数值实验揭示摩擦对稳定裕度的显著作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上钻井中升沉运动诱导的扰动传播受水力与结构耦合动态及钻柱-井壁分布式摩擦共同影响，而现有分析往往未充分刻画空间分布式记忆摩擦效应及其对稳定性的作用，因此需要建立耦合模型加以系统研究。

Method: 构建常微分方程与双曲偏微分方程半线性互联的耦合水力-结构钻井模型，捕捉钻柱-井壁相互作用中的空间分布式记忆效应；先建立局部与全局解的存在唯一性，再借助小增益分析推导有界性与输入-状态稳定性（ISS）的充分条件；随后开展谐波激励、非线性畸变、空间放大、机理隔离、参数敏感性及真实海况宽带激励等多组数值实验。

Result: 仿真表明：水力响应主要由波传播、可压缩性与边界反射主导；结构动力学对分布式摩擦效应敏感得多。钻柱-井壁摩擦对问题适定性的影响相对有限，但对稳定裕度可能产生显著影响。

Conclusion: 分析与监测、控制海上钻井系统时，须同时考虑耦合水力-结构动力学与分布式摩擦机制；摩擦是影响稳定裕度的关键因素而非适定性的主要决定因素。

Abstract: This paper investigates the influence of friction dynamics on heave-induced disturbance propagation using a coupled hydraulic-structural drilling model formulated as a semilinear interconnection of ordinary and hyperbolic partial differential equations (ODE-PDEs), and capturing spatially distributed memory effects in the drillstring-wellbore interaction. First, local and global existence and uniqueness results are established, and sufficient conditions for boundedness and input-to-state stability are deduced via a small-gain analysis. Subsequently, extensive numerical investigations are carried out, including harmonic excitation studies, nonlinear distortion analysis, spatial amplification investigations, mechanism-isolation experiments, parameter sensitivity analysis, and broadband simulations under realistic offshore sea-state excitation. The simulation results indicate that, whilst the hydraulic response is governed primarily by wave propagation phenomena, compressibility, and boundary reflections, the structural dynamics display substantially greater sensitivity to distributed friction effects. Furthermore, drillstring-wellbore friction is shown to have a relatively limited influence on well-posedness but a potentially significant impact on stability margins. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for coupled hydraulic-structural dynamics and distributed friction mechanisms when analysing, monitoring, and controlling offshore drilling systems.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [551] [Resilient and Efficient Aerial Wireless Sensor Networks Using Pinching-Antenna Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20924)
*Ahmed A. Al-habob,Octavia A. Dobre,Yindi Jing,Hyundong Shin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文提出将夹持天线（pinching antenna）系统用于空中无线网络，通过优化波导上夹持天线单元的位置来最大化网络图的代数连通度，并在保证最小连通度指标下最小化无人机数量，设计了启发式天线布置算法与迭代式无人机部署算法，仿真表明连通性与效率均得到提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中无线网络中无人机节点的连通性与部署效率有待提升，作者希望通过夹持天线系统这一新型天线架构来增强网络连通性并减少所需无人机数量。

Method: 以网络图的代数连通度为目标，优化上下行波导中夹持天线单元的位置；设计启发式夹持天线布置算法以最大化连通性；设计迭代式无人机部署算法，联合确定最少无人机数量、其部署位置及夹持天线布置。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所考虑的夹持天线系统能够改善网络连通性并提升网络效率。

Conclusion: 夹持天线系统可作为空中无线网络中提升连通性与部署效率的有效手段，天线位置优化与无人机部署的联合设计具有实际价值。

Abstract: This paper proposes a pinching antenna system to enhance the connectivity and efficiency in aerial wireless networks. The algebraic connectivity of the network's graph is maximized by optimizing the placement of the pinching antenna elements in the uplink and downlink waveguides. The number of deployed unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is minimized while maintaining a minimum network connectivity indicator. A heuristic pinching antenna placement algorithm is designed to maximize the network connectivity. An iterative UAV deployment algorithm is also designed to find the minimum number of UAVs, their placement locations, and the pinching antenna placement. Simulation results show that the considered pinching antenna system improves network connectivity and efficiency.

</details>


### [552] [How large an effect would we have seen? Positive controls, detection floors and dataset pitfalls in scalp-EEG speech decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20942)
*Blessing Isoyiza Adeika,Onyema Osuagwu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该研究审计了三个脑电（EEG）数据集上的言语解码流程，发现曾用于阳性对照的"外显言语"解码主要由肌电伪迹驱动，因此无法验证流程；作者建议报告频带限制与伪迹通道准确率、准确率随频率的变化方向，以及实测检测下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG想象言语解码研究通常以外显言语作为阳性对照，并在报告中给出零结果，却不说明该流程本可检测到多大效应量，导致阳性对照的效力未被检验，结论可比性与可信度不足。

Method: 使用ds003626、KaraOne和国际脑机接口竞赛2020 Track 3三个语料库；在以断言强制保证数据划分完整性的协议下，审计外显言语、构音器官准备与想象言语的解码，采用伪迹通道子集、带限解码与试次筛选。向真实记录注入已知幅度的类别相关效应以测量五类解码器的检测下限，并依据采集协议核验ds003626的标签。

Result: ds003626中，两个唇部电极解码外显言语准确率为0.7430，八个外部通道为0.7068，而128通道头皮蒙太奇仅0.4231；8–30 Hz频带内无可解码信号。另两个语料库上，受试者内准确率随频率单调上升，直至进入肌电主导的频段。带功率逻辑回归可检测到注入的0.54 µV的8–30 Hz去同步，而紧凑卷积网络EEGNet在受试者内至4.31 µV仍检测不到。此外，ds003626的条件编码与直觉读法相反、公开发布版本间类别编码发生变更，且条件在每个会话内是时间的确定函数。

Conclusion: 这些语料库中外显言语阳性对照由肌源性信号主导，无法验证解码流程。建议言语解码研究报告带限与伪迹通道准确率、准确率随频率的变化方向，以及实测的检测下限。

Abstract: Objective. Studies that decode imagined speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) commonly validate their pipelines with a positive control, usually overt speech, and report null results without stating what effect size the pipeline could have detected. Approach. Using ds003626 ("Thinking out loud"), KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, we audited decoding of overt speech, articulator preparation and imagined speech with artifact-channel subsets, band-limited decoding and trial selection, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion. We injected class-dependent effects of known amplitude into the real recordings to measure the detection floor of five decoder families, and we checked the ds003626 labels against the dataset's acquisition protocol. Main results. On ds003626, two lip electrodes decoded overt speech at 0.7430 and the eight external channels at 0.7068, against 0.4231 for the 128-channel scalp montage, and no decodable signal survived in the 8-30 Hz band. On the other two corpora, within-subject accuracy rose monotonically with frequency into the range dominated by muscle activity. Band-power logistic regression detected an injected 8-30 Hz desynchronization of 0.54 uV under a criterion fixed in advance, whereas a compact convolutional network (EEGNet) detected nothing within subject up to 4.31 uV. In ds003626, the condition codes are the reverse of the intuitive reading, the class encoding changed between public releases, and condition is a deterministic function of time within each session. Significance. In these corpora the overt-speech positive control is dominated by myogenic signal and cannot validate a decoding pipeline. We recommend that speech-decoding studies report band-limited and artifact-channel accuracy, the direction of accuracy across frequency, and a measured detection floor.

</details>


### [553] [Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20954)
*Blessing Isoyiza Adeika,Onyema Osuagwu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 脑电想象语音内容在个体之间不迁移，受试者内解码精度亦受限于每类试次数量，应优先扩大单条件数据集而非改进模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无需校准即可对新用户工作的想象语音解码器，才能使非侵入式语音接口走向实用；因此需检验想象语音内容能否跨人迁移，并查明单人内部解码精度为何仍低。

Method: 分析三个公开语料库（ds003626、KaraOne、2020国际脑机接口竞赛Track 3）；采用断言保证划分完整性、报告精确二项阈值、组检验与自助法置信区间；对每名受试者训练并测试于其余所有受试者；在无分类器条件下比较受试者间表征几何；施加受试者级对齐；检验关于受试者内精度上限的五种解释。

Result: 482个有序受试者对中无一通过多重比较校正，平均配对迁移精度在各语料库均落在随机水平0.006以内，而所有受试者内参照均高于随机；想象与刺激前静息对比在伪迹与时间漂移控制后泛化约0.61，但其解码器将想象前区间判为想象的比例与想象本身相当，说明该对比反映刺激后状态而非想象；受试者内仅竞赛语料库所有受试者均高于阈值（0.3147，随机0.200），音节数解释力有限，其频率特征未通过伪迹审计。

Conclusion: 在这些语料库中，想象语音内容未通过所考察的任何表征跨人迁移；每类试次数量是唯一能区分语料库的变量，故应优先构建更大的单条件数据集，而非继续模型开发。

Abstract: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. Main results. Across 482 ordered pairs of participants, no pair survived correction for multiple comparisons; mean pair-transfer accuracy lay within 0.006 of chance on every corpus, while every within-subject reference lay above it. Imagery against pre-stimulus rest generalized at about 0.61 after artifact and elapsed-time controls, but its decoder labelled the interval preceding imagery as imagery as often as imagery itself, so the contrast reflects a post-stimulus state, not imagery. Within subject, only the competition corpus decoded above threshold for every participant (0.3147; chance 0.200); syllable count explained little of this, but its frequency profile failed an artifact audit. Significance. In these corpora, imagined-speech content did not transfer between people through any representation we examined. Trial count per class was the only variable that ordered the corpora, which favors larger single-condition datasets over further model development.

</details>


### [554] [Antenna Placement for Movable Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Target Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21191)
*Jinjian Liu,Xianxin Song,Xianghao Yu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究可移动天线（MA）赋能的近场目标定位，以SPEB为感知度量优化接收端天线布放，将非凸问题转化为截断矩问题并以SDP求解，得到三簇结构的最优天线位置分布与高效簇化布放方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MA可通过额外的空间自由度提升无线感知性能；本文针对基于设备感知架构下的近场目标定位，在最小天线间距约束下最小化目标的SPEB。

Method: 以SPEB为感知度量建立天线位置优化问题；先松弛天线间距约束，将问题重构为以四次截断矩为变量的天线位置分布问题，等价转化为半正定规划（SDP）用标准凸优化求解器求得最优解；再利用截断矩理论恢复支撑于有限个位置的最优分布，并构造高效的簇化布放策略。

Result: 数值结果表明，所构造的最优分布呈三簇结构且簇权重与信源相关；所提布放方法优于传统阵列几何，并接近穷举搜索基准。

Conclusion: 基于截断矩的SDP框架可有效求解MA近场定位中的非凸天线布放问题，获得可解释的三簇最优布放结构并显著提升感知精度。

Abstract: Movable antennas (MAs) have recently emerged as a promising technology to enhance the wireless sensing performance by exploiting additional spatial degrees of freedom. In this work, we consider an MA-enabled near-field target localization problem under a device-based sensing architecture, where the sensing target actively transmits signals and the sensing receiver estimates its location based on the received signals. We adopt the squared position error bound (SPEB) as the sensing performance metric and aim to minimize the target's SPEB by optimizing the antenna placement at the sensing receiver. The resulting optimization problem is highly non-convex due to the minimum antenna spacing constraints and the intricate dependence of the SPEB on the antenna locations and the intractable form of SPEB. To tackle this problem, we first relax the inter-spacing constraints and accordingly formulate an antenna position distribution problem in terms of degree-4 truncated moments. The reformulated moment-based problem admits an equivalent semidefinite programming formulation and can be optimally solved using standard convex optimization solvers. Using truncated moment theory, we then recover an optimal antenna position distribution supported on a finite number of locations and construct an efficient clustered placement policy. Numerical results demonstrate that the constructed optimal distribution exhibits a three-cluster structure with source-dependent weights. The proposed antenna placement method outperforms conventional array geometries and closely approaches the exhaustive-search benchmark scheme.

</details>


### [555] [Micro-Doppler Sensing for UAV Flight-State Estimation in ISAC Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21225)
*Henglin Pu,Lu Su,Zhu Han,Athina P. Petropulu,Husheng Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出OFDM-ISAC框架，利用UAV微多普勒特征估计旋翼转速与旋翼轴朝向，并从单站扩展到多站分布式网络实现旋翼轴方向估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低空UAV监测的ISAC研究多聚焦位置与整体速度，缺乏旋翼动力学与姿态信息，信息维度有限。

Method: 基于OFDM-ISAC提取微多普勒特征，在单站估计旋翼转速；扩展至分布式网络，融合多视角的多普勒带宽特征（不依赖载波相位同步）估计公共旋翼轴方向。证明三视角几何多样性可局部辨识旋翼轴方向与未知桨尖速度尺度；建立特征感知雷达方程联系叶片RCS、作用距离、发射功率、观测时长与检测及转速估计精度；分析残余运动与距离徙动对CPI的影响。

Result: 仿真与实测验证了框架有效性，展示了旋翼转速估计与多站旋翼轴感知的可行性。

Conclusion: 微多普勒-多站融合可为UAV提供超出定位与测速的丰富状态信息，且无需站间载波相位同步，具备工程可行性。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides a promising foundation for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) monitoring. However, most existing studies focus primarily on position and bulk velocity, thus providing limited information about UAV rotor dynamics and orientation. To address this limitation, this paper develops an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC framework that exploits UAV micro-Doppler signatures to estimate operational states, including rotor rate and rotor-axis orientation, thereby providing richer UAV state information beyond conventional ISAC localization and velocity sensing. The framework progresses from single-station micro-Doppler sensing to multi-station rotor-axis estimation. At each base station, micro-Doppler signatures are first extracted and used to estimate the rotor rate. The framework is then extended to a distributed ISAC network, where view-dependent micro-Doppler signatures from multiple sensing directions are fused to estimate the common rotor-axis direction. Since the fusion relies on Doppler-bandwidth features rather than complex channel phases, inter-station carrier-phase synchronization is not required. We show that three geometrically diverse views can locally identify both the rotor-axis direction and the unknown rotor-tip-speed scale. In addition, a feature-aware radar equation bridges blade radar cross section (RCS), sensing range, transmit power, and observation duration to micro-Doppler detection and rotor-rate estimation accuracy. The effects of residual motion and range migration on the coherent processing interval (CPI) are also analyzed. Simulations and experimental measurements validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of rotor-rate estimation and multi-station rotor-axis sensing.

</details>


### [556] [Finite-History Outage Certification for Partially Observed Fluid Antenna Receivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21252)
*Yuanjun Shen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对"冻结"的部分观测流体天线选择规则，提出使用前(deployment-before-use)的可靠性认证框架：用预测密度构造基于历史的参数区域，借助高斯协方差包络、共享条件概率界和选择器包络，对连续参数与不连续端口决策给出同时风险界，并将误认证概率控制在0.05。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流体天线接收机只能从部分端口观测中选服务位置，而有限历史数据使决策所依赖的协方差存在不确定性，现有做法缺乏对固定规则在使用前的可靠性保证。

Method: 以proper predictive density定义历史参数区域；用Gaussian covariance envelopes、shared conditional-probability bounds与selector enclosures在连续参数和不连续端口决策上同时给出风险上界；拆分history-coverage与integration预算以控制误正认证概率；通过置信集包含使新的独立历史可复用同一风险计算。

Result: 32个候选位置、5个含噪探测、目标中断率0.001的结构化高斯算例中，282个风险组全部通过认证，最大上界0.000999748；耦合比较给出当前规则中断率区间[7.6820,9.1266]×10⁻⁴，并判定其低于两个同历史拟合的观测端口对照；一个独立重校准历史可零额外风险采样复用证书，未解与不良成员对照界定了复用边界。

Conclusion: 该框架为部分观测流体天线规则提供了可复用、可量化的使用前可靠性认证，误认证率受控且风险界接近目标中断率。

Abstract: Fluid antenna receivers can select a service position from partial port observations, but finite historical data leave uncertainty in the covariance used for that decision. We develop deployment-before-use reliability certification for a frozen partial-observation rule. A proper predictive density defines a history-based parameter region. Gaussian covariance envelopes, shared conditional-probability bounds and selector enclosures provide simultaneous risk bounds over continuous parameters and discontinuous port decisions. Separate history-coverage and integration budgets limit erroneous positive certification to 0.05 for a single qualification procedure under the stated stationary model and numerical assumptions. Confidence-set inclusion allows a new independent history to reuse the risk computation with the rule unchanged. In a structured Gaussian example with 32 candidate positions, five noisy probes and target outage 0.001, all 282 risk groups are qualified; the largest upper bound is 0.000999748. A separate coupled comparison gives a current-rule outage interval of $[7.6820,9.1266]\times10^{-4}$ and resolves lower outage than two observed-port controls using the same historical fit. One independently recalibrated history reuses the certificate without additional risk sampling. Unresolved and adverse-member controls delimit this reuse.

</details>


### [557] [Receiver-Specific Interventional Valuation of Semantic Atoms for Budget-Constrained Multi-Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21504)
*Danial Dehghani,Maximilian Lübke,Friedemann Laue,Zahra Seifaei,Norman Franchi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种编码器无关的发送端框架，将可独立选择的语义单元（语义原子）赋予带符号价值，量化其投递对目标接收方下游决策的增益或损害，并通过"影子接收器"估计接收方特定的LOO与Shapley原子价值，实现预算受限下的接收方特定语义投递选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作多智能体语义通信中，发送端不仅需决定如何编码观测，还需在有限链路预算下决定向每个接收方投递哪些语义内容。现有方法缺乏对"投递给特定接收方是否有益"的显式、接收方特定的价值度量，且往往与特定编码器耦合。

Method: 构建编码器无关的发送端框架：将语义内容分解为可独立选择的语义原子；以受控投递效用刻画原子对接收方下游决策的影响，并在接收方行动前通过前瞻性随机载荷投递进行识别；用仅依赖发送端可得信息的影子接收器估计该效用，进而计算接收方特定的留一法（LOO）与Shapley原子价值，用于预算约束下的子集选择。

Result: 在四接收方交叉口基准上，非显著LOO原子效应符号恢复准确率达68.4%，估计与参考LOO值的Spearman相关系数为0.302；有限预算下，接收方特定选择持续优于共享选择与随机选择；在可全量投递时，穷举子集选择亦优于全载荷传输，说明传输全部内容未必最大化接收方效用。

Conclusion: 接收方特定的语义价值评估能在原子价值估计不完美的情况下支撑有效的预算受限通信，验证了将语义排序适配至目标接收方的必要性。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent semantic communication requires deciding not only how a transmitter encodes its observation, but also which resulting semantic content should be delivered to each receiver under a limited link budget. We introduce an encoder-agnostic transmitter-side framework for receiver-specific valuation of independently selectable semantic units, termed semantic atoms. Each atom is assigned a signed value that quantifies whether delivering it is expected to improve or degrade the intended receiver's downstream decision. We formulate this effect through a controlled-delivery utility and identify it via prospective randomized payload delivery before the receiver acts. A shadow receiver estimates this utility using only transmitter-available information, from which receiver-specific leave-one-out (LOO) and Shapley atom values are computed. Experiments on a four-receiver intersection benchmark show 68.4% accuracy in recovering the sign of non-negligible LOO atom effects and a Spearman correlation of 0.302 between estimated and reference LOO values. Under limited budgets, we show that receiver-specific selection consistently outperforms shared and random alternatives, demonstrating the benefit of adapting semantic ranking to the intended receiver. At full affordability, exhaustive subset selection also outperforms full-payload transmission, showing that transmitting all available content need not maximize receiver utility. Overall, our results show that receiver-specific semantic valuation can support effective budget-constrained communication despite imperfect atom-value estimation.

</details>


### [558] [Wavefront Engineering for Physical Layer Security in Near-Field Wireless Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21521)
*Sotiris Droulias,Angeliki Alexiou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究近场大孔径阵列下的多种波束类型（聚焦波束、弯曲波束、突然自聚焦波束、余弦波束），提出垂直聚焦与"空心聚焦波束"设计以增强物理层安全性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线传输易被非预期接收者截获，波束成形可利用空间特性将功率集中于合法用户并抑制窃听者；当系统进入大孔径阵列的辐射近场时，波前曲率为进一步的空间波前工程提供了新机遇，但其对物理层安全的增益尚待系统研究。

Method: 基于均匀线阵/平面阵（ULA/UPA）生成聚焦、弯曲、突然自聚焦与余弦等波束；引入功率型指标量化合法用户与潜在窃听者的接收功率；对所有波束类型施加沿UPA垂直方向的聚焦，以独立控制两个维度的相位分布，提升合法端与窃听端的功率区分度；并提出在发射孔径中引入非激活条带、在发射机与合法用户之间形成受保护低功率区的"空心聚焦波束"。

Result: 垂直聚焦显著提升物理层安全性能；空心聚焦波束在视距（LoS）与用户邻近（VoU）两种场景下均取得更优的PLS性能。

Conclusion: 近场波前工程为物理层安全提供了有效手段，垂直聚焦与空心聚焦波束设计可显著增强合法端与窃听端之间的功率判别，是提升近场无线通信安全性的可行方案。

Abstract: With wireless transmission exposing information to potential interception by unintended receivers, physical layer security (PLS) offers a promising approach to securing wireless communications. Beamforming can mitigate this vulnerability by exploiting the spatial characteristics of wireless propagation to concentrate power toward the intended receiver while suppressing it at potential eavesdroppers. However, as wireless systems enter the radiating near field of large-aperture antenna arrays, the resulting wavefront curvature provides additional opportunities for spatial wavefront engineering to enhance PLS. In this work, we investigate the use of different beam types for PLS, including focused, curved, abruptly autofocusing, and cosine beams, generated using uniform linear and planar arrays (ULAs/UPAs). To quantify their performance, we introduce power-based metrics that characterize the power received by the legitimate user and a potential eavesdropper. For all beam types we introduce focusing along the vertical UPA direction, to independently control the phase distributions along the two UPA dimensions and enhance the power discrimination between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper. We also propose hollow-focused beams, in which an inactive strip is introduced in the transmitting aperture to create a protected low-power region between the transmitter and the legitimate receiver. The results demonstrate that vertical focusing dramatically enhances the PLS performance and that hollow-focused beams achieve superior PLS performance in both line-of-sight (LoS) and vicinity-of-user (VoU) scenarios.

</details>


### [559] [From Interference to Diversity: Mode Coloring and Two-Dimensional Modal-Time Rake Combining for Multipath OAM Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21602)
*Runyu Lyu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 将涡旋电磁波（OAM）多径散射导致的模态间干扰视为可收集的结构化能量，通过模态域与多径延迟域的二维（2D）模态-时间Rake接收，实现多径分集与能量收集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OAM波束为无线通信提供空间复用维度，但多径散射会展宽模式谱、造成模态间干扰（IMI）。传统OAM解复用直接将泄漏模态能量丢弃，浪费了其中蕴含的结构化信息与能量。

Method: 为每个激活OAM模态分配不同的时域正交扩频码，接收端在OAM模态与可分辨多径时延构成的2D网格上联合合并解扩输出（2D模态-时间Rake）。理论基于倾斜OAM波束的Bessel阶差耦合律，用高斯模式扩散模型与模式相干性指标刻画残余正交性，并提出有效分集指标，区分有限SNR下的合并增益与渐近分集阶。仿真采用28 GHz、四模态八阵元UCA、四个可分辨多径抽头。

Result: 在独立分支衰落下达LK阶渐近分集，在秩受限的逐抽头衰落下可获得收集能量；相比逐模态检测及模态域ZF/MMSE检测，BER降低1–3个数量级，所需SNR节省约10–15 dB，并优于未加色扩频的模态-时间MMSE均衡器；该优势在考虑扩频的频谱效率代价、信道估计与时序误差后依然保持。

Conclusion: 多径引起的模态泄漏并非纯干扰，而是可被结构化利用的分集与能量资源；模态-时间二维联合处理配合正交扩频是提升OAM通信鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams provide a spatial-multiplexing dimension for wireless communications, but multipath scattering broadens their mode spectrum, so that energy leaks across modes as inter-mode interference (IMI), which conventional OAM demultiplexing discards. This paper treats the leaked modal energy not as interference but as a structured, harvestable resource: it attains up to $LK$-fold asymptotic diversity under independent-branch fading and yields harvested energy under the rank-limited per-tap fading of the operating channel. Each active OAM mode is colored with a distinct time-domain orthogonal spreading code, and a two-dimensional (2D) receiver grid spanning the OAM modes and the resolvable multipath delays jointly combines the despread outputs. The design builds on the Bessel order-difference coupling law of tilted OAM beams, summarized by a Gaussian mode-diffusion model with a mode-coherence metric that quantifies the surviving orthogonality, and on an effective diversity metric that separates the combining gain available at finite signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from the asymptotic diversity order. At 28~GHz, with a four-mode eight-element uniform circular array (UCA) and four resolvable multipath taps, the proposed 2D modal-time Rake lowers the bit-error rate (BER) by one to three orders of magnitude and saves roughly 10--15~dB of required SNR over mode-wise detection and mode-domain zero-forcing (ZF) and minimum mean-square error (MMSE) detection, and it also outperforms an uncolored modal-time MMSE equalizer; the advantage survives the spectral-efficiency cost of spreading as well as channel-estimation and timing imperfections.

</details>


### [560] [Dual-Purpose SSB Design for Joint Time-Frequency Synchronization Using Relocated DMRS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21617)
*Sadiq Iqbal,Abdelali Arous,Huseyin Arslan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出双用途SSB（DP-SSB）：通过重映射并接收端感知优化的DMRS在现有SSB中嵌入窄带可检测结构，实现低复杂度IoT同步，同时保持传统UE正常PSS/SSS同步与PBCH解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSB无法被窄带、低复杂度、低功耗IoT设备用于同步，需在不影响传统UE操作的前提下复用已有SSB实现IoT同步。

Method: 将选定DMRS符号连续映射到DP-SSB第2、4符号的部分PRB，并用接收端感知的最小二乘（LS）方法优化，在IoT前端输出形成特定时域结构；IoT接收端经窄带滤波与抽取获得降速率观测，用于能量检测与序贯时频同步；UE侧保留PSS/SSS同步并评估DMRS移位对信道估计和PBCH接收的影响。

Result: 在检测概率、时频同步精度、IoT接收机计算复杂度及UE侧PBCH解码方面评估；仿真验证了检测概率的解析刻画，相比基准方案在保持传统UE操作的同时实现可靠的低功耗IoT同步。

Conclusion: DP-SSB可在复用现有SSB资源下兼顾低复杂度IoT同步与传统UE操作，是一种可行的双用途同步设计。

Abstract: The synchronization signal block (SSB) is designed to synchronize a capable user-equipment (UE) with the base-station (BS) in recent cellular networks. However, the same SSB cannot be utilized by a narrowband, low-complexity, and low-power internet of things (IoT) device for synchronization. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a dual-purpose SSB (DP-SSB) to enable low-complexity IoT synchronization using the existing SSB, while ensuring uninterrupted conventional UE operation. Specifically, selected demodulation reference signal (DMRS) symbols are contiguously mapped to some physical resource blocks (PRBs) in the second and fourth symbols of the DP-SSB. These DMRS symbols are further optimized using a receiver-aware least square (LS) approach to impose a distinct time-domain structure at the output of the IoT front-end. At the IoT receiver, a reduced-rate observation of the DP-SSB is obtained after narrowband filtering and decimation that is exploited for energy detection and sequential time-frequency (TF) synchronization. For the UE, primary synchronization signal (PSS) and secondary synchronization signal (SSS)-based synchronization is preserved, while the effect of relocated DMRS on the channel estimation and physical broadcast channel (PBCH) reception is assessed. The performance of the proposed DP-SSB is evaluated in terms of detection probability, TF synchronization accuracy, IoT receiver computational complexity, and UE-side PBCH decoding. Simulation results validate the analytical detection characterization and demonstrate reliable low-power IoT synchronization performance compared with the benchmark synchronization schemes while maintaining conventional UE operation.

</details>


### [561] [High-Order Sinusoidal Modeling for Precise Parameter Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21643)
*Shaowen Chen,Tomoki Toda*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文从频率失配角度重新审视准谐波模型（QHM/aQHM/eaQHM），指出其精度受模型阶数限制，提出高阶建模框架并用Levenberg–Marquardt算法估计参数，实现对幅度、频率、相位的更精确估计，仿真与语音实验验证了其优越性与抗噪鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正弦幅度估计在频率已知时是线性可解问题，但现有方法不可避免的频率失配从根本上限制了建模精度。QHM及其扩展虽能在提取幅度的同时细化频率，但其提取与校正能力仍受限。

Method: 首先从频率失配视角重新分析QHM类方法，揭示其性能本质上受模型阶数约束——这些方法为线性模型，无法刻画高阶频率变化；随后提出高阶建模框架以更精确地逼近信号分量，对优化问题进行定性刻画，并采用Levenberg–Marquardt算法进行参数估计。

Result: 所提方法显著提升正弦分量的幅度、频率与相位估计精度，实现更准确的信号建模；仿真研究与语音信号实验表明，高阶模型在频率细化与参数提取上优于现有方法，且在加性噪声条件下具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 模型阶数是限制QHM类方法频率细化能力的根本因素；引入高阶频率变化建模并结合LM优化，可有效缓解频率失配，获得更优的正弦参数估计与信号建模性能。

Abstract: Although the amplitude estimation of sinusoids is a linear and tractable problem when their frequencies are known, the accuracy of signal modeling is fundamentally limited by the inevitable frequency mismatches produced by existing methods. Quasi-harmonic modeling (QHM) and its extensions (aQHM and eaQHM) offer the ability to refine frequency estimates while extracting amplitudes; however, their extraction and correction capabilities remain limited. In this paper, we first revisit QHM methods from the perspective of frequency mismatches, and reveal that their performances are essentially constrained by the order of the model. Specifically, QHM methods are linear models and thus incapable of capturing higher-order frequency variations, leading to suboptimal modeling accuracy. Second, to address this limitation, we propose a higher-order modeling framework that enables more precise approximation of signal components. Eventually, we qualitatively characterize the optimization problem and employ the Levenberg--Marquardt (LM) algorithm for parameter estimation. As a result, the proposed method allows for significantly improved estimation of amplitudes, frequencies, and phases of sinusoidal components, enabling more accurate signal modeling. Experiments on both simulation study and speech signals demonstrate the superiority of the high-order model in frequency refinement and parameter extraction and its robustness under additive noise conditions.

</details>


### [562] [A hidden Markov model for unsupervised EEG-based tracking of auditory attention to a single voice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21691)
*Tianyi Li,Simon Geirnaert,Davina Van den Broek,Elien Bellon,Bert De Smedt,Alexander Bertrand*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种无监督的绝对听觉注意解码（aAAD）流程，将神经包络追踪（NET）与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）时间推断结合，在无注意状态标签条件下估计连续注意轨迹；1 s 窗下 HMM 将平均 AUC 从 0.547 提升至 0.832，5 s 窗达 0.858。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝对听觉注意解码（aAAD）需在仅有单一语音源、缺乏竞争语音参考的条件下，用 EEG 追踪听者对单一语音源的注意强度；相比选择性听觉注意解码缺少对比参考，可靠追踪更具挑战性，且通常缺乏注意状态标签。

Method: 构建全无监督流程：以神经包络追踪（NET）从 EEG 与目标语音包络得到注意观测特征，再用 HMM 进行时序概率推断，输出连续注意轨迹，无需显式注意状态标签。基于 30 名成人 EEG 数据评估，考察分析窗长影响，并将 HMM 后处理与滑动平均（MA）平滑及 alpha 功率、频谱熵等替代 EEG 特征对比。

Result: 1 s 窗下非因果 HMM 后处理使全部 30 名被试 AUC 均提升，平均 AUC 由原始 NET 的 0.547 升至 0.832；5 s 窗取得最高平均 AUC 0.858。在所考察的各平滑尺度上，HMM 的 AUC 均高于非因果 MA 平滑；个体切换检测时间相近，而 HMM 的组水平检测时间总体更短。NET 作为观测特征优于 alpha 功率与频谱熵。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了无需标签估计听觉注意时间波动的途径，表明概率时序推断在单说话人聆听场景下用于连续注意追踪的有效性。

Abstract: Objective: Absolute auditory attention decoding (aAAD) aims to track how strongly a listener attends to a single speech source using electroencephalography (EEG). Unlike selective auditory attention decoding, aAAD lacks a competing speech reference, making reliable attention tracking challenging.
  Approach: We propose a fully unsupervised aAAD pipeline combining neural envelope tracking (NET) with hidden Markov model (HMM)-based temporal inference. Using EEG signals and the target speech envelope, the framework estimates a continuous attention trajectory without explicit attention-state labels. We evaluate the approach using EEG recordings from 30 adults, investigate the impact of analysis window length, and compare HMM post-processing with moving-average (MA) smoothing and alternative EEG features.
  Main results: With 1-s analysis windows, non-causal HMM post-processing improves the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) for all 30 participants, increasing mean AUC from 0.547 for raw NET to 0.832. A 5-s window achieves the highest mean AUC of 0.858. Compared with non-causal MA smoothing, the HMM achieves higher AUC across the examined smoothing scales. Individual switch detection times are comparable, while the HMM generally achieves lower group-level detection times. NET also outperforms alpha power and spectral entropy as an observation feature in the unsupervised HMM framework.
  Significance: The proposed framework provides a label-free approach for estimating temporal fluctuations in auditory attention, demonstrating the utility of probabilistic temporal inference for continuous attention tracking in single-speaker listening scenarios.

</details>


### [563] [Sensing-Assisted OFDM with Index Modulation: A Waveform for Optical Wireless Integrated Communication and Localisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21753)
*Ali Waqar Azim,Mohamed Sufyan Islim,Muhammad Ali Imran,Harald Hass Hanaa Abumarshoud*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出感知辅助OFDM索引调制(SA-OFDM-IM)，在光无线系统中联合通信与定位，兼顾低复杂度检测与高精度定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光无线系统中通信与定位需共享频谱与功率资源，现有DCO-OFDM等方案信道估计误差大、定位存在误差下限，且难以在低复杂度下同时优化BER与定位精度。

Method: 采用多层频域架构，将每层可用子载波划分为互不重叠的通信子集与分布式感知导频子集，通信子集内做分组索引调制；在最小功率域裕度约束下进行受限的感知-通信能量分配，联合最小化平均BER与基于时延的定位RMSE，并支持有序能量低复杂度检测；帧内聚合感知音重构信道频响，提取LoS时延抽头与相位补偿LoS增益用于多边定位，并提出时延辅助RSS精化。

Result: BER达到同等性能所需SNR最多降低5 dB；信道估计误差比DCO-OFDM低至三个数量级；时延辅助RSS估计器消除仅时延与混合RSS基准的SNR无关误差下限，实现亚时延bin级测距与定位精度，并在接收机朝向已知/未知随机情形下保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: SA-OFDM-IM为光无线系统提供了一种低复杂度、资源高效且定位精度高的联合通信与定位方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes sensing-assisted OFDM with index modulation (SA-OFDM-IM) for joint communication and localisation over optical wireless systems. In SA-OFDM-IM, a multilayer frequency-domain architecture partitions each layer's admissible subcarriers into disjoint communication and distributed sensing-pilot subsets, applying group-wise index modulation (IM) within the communication subset. A constrained sensing-to-communication energy allocation jointly minimises average bit-error rate (BER) and delay-based localisation root mean square error (RMSE) under a minimum power-domain margin, enabling low-complexity, ordered-energy detection of both sensing and communication subcarriers without exhaustive maximum-likelihood search. Sensing tones are aggregated across the frame to reconstruct the channel frequency response, yielding the line-of-sight (LoS) delay tap and phase-compensated LoS gain for multilateration and, via the proposed delay-aided received signal strength (RSS) refinement. Simulation results indicate that SA-OFDM-IM can achieve up to 5 dB lower SNR requirement in BER and up to three orders of magnitude lower channel-estimation error than DC-biased optical OFDM, while the RSS estimator removes the SNR-independent error floors of delay-only and hybrid-RSS benchmarks to attain sub-delay-bin range and position accuracy, remaining robust under random known and unknown receiver orientations.

</details>


### [564] [Confidence-Guided Adaptive Beam Selection for Vision-Aided Beam Tracking in mmWave Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21880)
*Sohani Munteha Hiam,Mohammad Soleymani,Rafael F. Schaefer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出置信度引导的自适应候选波束选择：对预测器logits做温度校准，在最大预算约束下保留累积概率达到目标阈值的最小top-ranked波束集合，替代固定top-K。在DeepSense 6G Scenario 8上（5个随机种子、等开销条件下），候选集准确率最高提升3.80个百分点，归一化接收功率提升0.32个百分点，中断概率降低2.06个百分点，且无需重训练预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉辅助波束跟踪通过相机观测预测波束索引以降低毫米波波束训练开销，但固定top-K选择对所有预测分配相同的候选波束预算，忽略了样本间与预测时域（horizon）上的不确定性差异，导致开销分配次优。

Method: 将预测器logits进行温度校准以获得可靠置信度；基于校准后的排序概率，在最大预算约束下选择累积概率达到预设目标阈值的最小top-ranked波束集合，实现样本自适应与时域自适应的候选集规模分配，作为固定top-K的即插即用替代策略。

Result: 在DeepSense 6G Scenario 8上，跨5个随机种子、开销匹配条件下：候选集准确率最高提升3.80个百分点，归一化接收功率提升0.32个百分点，中断概率降低2.06个百分点；预测器无需重新训练。

Conclusion: 置信度引导的自适应候选选择以校准概率为依据按不确定性动态分配波束预算，在同等开销下稳定优于固定top-K，且为后处理策略、无需重训练，便于部署于视觉辅助毫米波波束跟踪系统。

Abstract: Vision-aided beam tracking reduces mmWave beam-training overhead by predicting beam indices from camera observations. Fixed top-$K$ selection, however, assigns the same candidate beam budget to all predictions, ignoring uncertainty variations across samples and horizons. This letter proposes confidence-guided adaptive candidate selection: predictor logits are temperature-calibrated, and the smallest top-ranked beam set whose cumulative probability reaches a target threshold is retained under a maximum budget. On DeepSense~6G Scenario~8, over five random seeds and at matched overhead, the policy improves candidate set accuracy by up to 3.80 percentage points, increases normalized received power by 0.32 percentage points, and reduces outage probability by 2.06 percentage points without retraining the predictor.

</details>


### [565] [Statistical Ambiguity-Function-Aware Joint Beamforming and Subcarrier Allocation for MIMO-OFDM ISAC under Random Symbols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21888)
*Wonill Kim,Yumin Kim,Hyeonsu Lyu,Hyun Jong Yang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文统计刻画了ISAC多用户多目标MIMO-OFDM系统中随机通信符号下的离散周期模糊函数，证明二维ISLR对波束成形不变、零多普勒PSLR可控，并基于"方向功率谱平坦化—变异系数CV—凸约束"给出AF感知的联合波束成形与子载波分配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC中随机通信符号使模糊函数(AF)随数据变化，难以刻画并纳入发射设计；核心问题是：在实际MUMT MIMO-OFDM系统中，究竟哪种AF特性可通过波束成形有效控制。

Method: 对离散周期AF(DP-AF)做统计刻画，推导精确闭式期望旁瓣电平(ESL)；分析各ESL切面与ISLR、PSLR对波束成形的依赖；构建带目标级PSLR与照射约束的AF感知联合波束成形与子载波分配问题；由于直接PSLR约束不可解，刻画其全局最优结构，证明符号峰度大于1时PSLR最大当且仅当各目标方向功率谱在子载波上平坦，并引入变异系数(CV)度量平坦度偏差、推导紧的CV相关PSLR上下界，用下界构造凸充分约束进行高效重构。

Result: 非零多普勒ESL切面呈时延平坦，二维ISLR对波束成形不变，零多普勒PSLR可控；仿真中在平坦谱点相对纯通信波束成形获得9.4–11.0 dB最差情况PSLR增益，代价为2.4–5.9%和速率损失；CV松弛方案达到原PSLR约束问题平均和速率的99.7%，运行时间降低10.35–12.15倍。

Conclusion: 在随机通信符号下，波束成形可有效控制的是零多普勒PSLR而非ISLR；方向功率谱平坦性是PSLR最优的充要结构条件，CV可将其转化为凸约束，从而在性能与复杂度间取得良好折中。

Abstract: Ambiguity function (AF) characterizes the delay--Doppler sidelobe structure that governs target resolution and masking in radar sensing. In ISAC, however, random communication symbols make the AF data-dependent, complicating its characterization and incorporation into transmit design. This raises a fundamental question: which AF characteristic can be effectively controlled through beamforming in a practical multiuser multitarget (MUMT) MIMO--OFDM system? To answer this, we statistically characterize the discrete-periodic AF (DP-AF) and derive an exact closed-form expected sidelobe level (ESL). We observe that nonzero-Doppler ESL cuts are delay-flat and the full two-dimensional integrated sidelobe level ratio (ISLR) is invariant to beamforming, whereas the zero-Doppler peak-to-sidelobe ratio (PSLR) remains controllable. We accordingly formulate an AF-aware joint beamforming and subcarrier-allocation problem with target-wise PSLR and illumination constraints. Since the direct PSLR constraint is intractable, we characterize its global optimum and prove that, for symbol kurtosis greater than one, the PSLR is maximized if and only if each target-wise directional-power profile is flat across subcarriers. We then introduce the coefficient of variation (CV) to measure deviation from this flatness and derive tight CV-dependent PSLR bounds. The lower bound yields a convex sufficient constraint for a desired PSLR, enabling an efficient reformulation. Simulations show $9.4$--$11.0$ dB worst-case PSLR gains over communication-only beamforming at the flat-spectrum point with a $2.4$--$5.9\%$ sum-rate loss. The CV-relaxed formulation achieves $99.7\%$ of the average sum-rate of the original PSLR-constrained problem, while reducing runtime by factors of $10.35$--$12.15$ under the considered scenarios.

</details>


### [566] [Seeing Through Sparse Signals: CS-Enhanced Sensing With QoS Guarantees for 6G ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21905)
*Yifei Wang,Pradyumna Kumar Bishoyi,Marina Petrova*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文研究NR兼容的ISAC系统中感知与通信的折中，联合设计调度方案（QoS保证调度与PF调度）与2D-mmCAMP压缩感知重建算法，通过行列自适应阈值抑制旁瓣、保留弱目标，弱目标检测较基线提升≥16%且满足下行QoS约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC中通信与感知共享时频资源，存在通信QoS与感知质量(QoSe)的根本折中。复用5G NR参考信号可实现标准兼容感知，但RS固有的稀疏性导致信道欠采样与强旁瓣，恶化弱目标检测。现有CS方法要么忽略通信QoS约束，要么依赖对步长敏感的重建算法或全局阈值处理，在多目标场景下造成弱目标被遮蔽。因此需要资源调度与CS重建的联合设计。

Method: 对比研究两种调度方案——QoS保证调度与比例公平(PF)调度——对感知-通信折中的影响；并提出2D max-median复近似消息传递(2D-mmCAMP)算法，采用行/列自适应阈值处理抑制旁瓣，同时保留多目标场景下弱目标的响应。

Result: 仿真表明，在满足下行(DL)QoS约束的前提下，所提方案相对基线重建算法在弱目标检测上取得≥16%的提升，验证了所提NR兼容ISAC方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 联合调度设计与2D-mmCAMP重建可有效缓解NR参考信号稀疏性带来的旁瓣与弱目标遮蔽问题，在保证通信QoS的同时显著提升多目标感知性能，验证了NR兼容ISAC方案的可行性。

Abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, communication and sensing share time-frequency resources, creating a fundamental trade-off between communication quality of service (QoS) and quality of sensing (QoSe). Reusing 5G new radio (NR) reference signals (RSs) enables standard-compliant sensing, but their inherent sparsity leads to undersampled channels and strong sidelobes that degrade weak-target detection. Compressed sensing (CS) can mitigate these effects, yet existing methods either overlook communication QoS constraints or rely on reconstruction algorithms that are step-size-sensitive or employ global thresholding, leading to weak-target masking in multi-target scenarios. The multi-target detection problem, therefore, requires a joint design of resource scheduling and CS-based reconstruction. In this work, we investigate the impact of two scheduling schemes, namely QoS-guaranteed scheduling and proportional-fairness (PF)-based scheduling, on the sensing-communication trade-off. To further enhance sensing performance, we employ a 2D max-median complex approximate message passing (2D-mmCAMP) algorithm that performs adaptive row- and column-wise thresholding to suppress sidelobes while preserving weak-target responses in multi-target scenarios. Simulations demonstrate an improvement of >= 16% in weak-target detection over baseline reconstruction algorithms while meeting downlink (DL) QoS constraints, validating the effectiveness of the proposed NR-compliant ISAC scheme.

</details>
